chapters.title: Chapter 1001: New Prisoner
paragraphs: Zhang Xiaolong [3] sighed in disappointment after he examined Gu Changsheng. "I can’t do anything to this old man’s soul, especially since his soul power is so high. Moreover, he planted some strange Gu insects into his soul, and they will attack me back if I try to do anything to his soul."
"Can’t your friends take out those Gu insects from his body?"

"No." Zhang Xiaolong shook his head in response to Tian Kui. "The Gu insects inside this old man’s body are ancient Gu insects, so they can’t do anything to them. At first, I wanted to take him to my private space, but I was worried that he would release his Gu insects there and kill my prisoners, so I gave up on my idea."
"So, what do you want to do to this man?" Serpentera asked him.

"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately checked Gu Changsheng’s mind. "Hahaha! This old man is overly confident in himself and doesn’t protect his mind, and I can still control him without having to enslave him."
"Do you want to manipulate his mind?"

"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately used his memory manipulation ability on Gu Changsheng. However, he did not change too many of his memories to avoid people’s suspicions, especially the members of the Gu Clan and all the clans related to them. He added new memories, all related to him, to the old man’s existing ones.
After he finished, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately woke Gu Changsheng up, and the old man knelt on one knee before him without the slightest hesitation. "Master."
’This kid! He has too many evil abilities!’ Serpentera and Tian Kui shouted in their hearts, but they were even more certain of their decision to follow Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"Hahaha!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed in satisfaction, especially since Gu Changsheng was one of the oldest and strongest cultivators in the Three Mortal Realms. He suddenly remembered something and asked the old man. "Do you have a spare Gu Heart?"
"Unfortunately, I don’t have it, Master." Gu Changsheng replied disappointedly. "However, I can create one for you, but I need three months for that."
"Only three months?"
"Yes, Master."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] exhaled heavily after hearing that, especially since Li Tiannan and Gu Jinling had been working hard for more than two years. However, despite their efforts, they still hadn’t managed to create the Gu Heart, while Gu Changsheng was able to accomplish it in just three months. "Go back to your clan and create the Gu Heart for me, and I want you to teach me all about Gu Insect after."
"Yes, Master." Gu Changsheng instantly disappeared from their sight.
"Do you really want to learn the Gu technique, Kid? Do you know that Gu cultivators are considered heretics in the Paradise Realm?" Serpentera asked with a serious tone.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] actually smiled at that. "Did you forget that I am a transcendent lust demon? Doesn’t that mean I was already a heretic from the start?"

"Yeah." Serpentera nodded in response. "However, Gu cultivators are viewed differently, and people hate them significantly more than they hate demons. If they know you’re a demon and Gu cultivator, you’ll be the most wanted person in the Paradise Realm."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shrugged casually. "If they find out about it and hunt me down, I’ll hide in my personal space until I become truly powerful. Once I achieve true power, I’ll hunt them down again, and I’ll kill them down to their roots."
"Hahaha." Tian Kui laughed and patted his shoulder. "I don’t really like killing, but I really like your mindset, and I’ll support you if you kill all your enemies, Kid."

"Don’t like killing my ass!" Serpentera cursed at his old friend. "Did you forget how many people you killed when my late master took us to escape from the Paradise Realm back then? You killed more than a hundred thousand living beings!"
"More than a hundred thousand living beings?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Tian Kui in shock.

Tian Kui rubbed his head while smiling to himself. "They were controlled by the primordial nihility beast, and they surrounded the three of us from all directions, so I devoured them alive in order to save ourselves. Actually, Old Snake was more terrifying than me, and the number of his victims was far greater than mine."
"How many did you kill back then?"

Serpentera shook his head at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "We were in a desperate situation at the time, so I don’t remember how many living beings I killed at that time, but I remember killing the people who got in our way."

"Tch! Such a liar! You compared your number of victims with mine back then, so there’s no way you can’t remember it!" Tian Kui then told Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "He killed at least five hundred thousand living beings at that time because he was on the front line with his late master, and his late master killed more than that."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] took a deep breath after hearing that. Throughout this time, he believed that he had taken too many lives, but in reality, the number of his victims was insignificant compared to theirs. "You two are truly terrifying! Fortunately, you two are not my enemies, or I would have died long ago."
"Hahaha." Tian Kui laughed at that.

Unlike his friend, Serpentera immediately reminded Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Kid, we are not your enemies now, but we might become your enemies in the future. If that happens, I hope you won’t hesitate to kill us, or we’ll kill you and your loved ones."
"What do you mean by that?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked with a frown.

Serpentera immediately explained to him. "As Old Kui said just now, the primordial nihility beast controlled those living beings to hunt us back then, and we once fell under his control. Fortunately, my late master had a secret technique, and he managed to break his control over us. Otherwise, we wouldn’t be standing together today, especially since we would have died at his hands."

"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "I don’t know the true strength of the primordial nihility beast yet, and I also don’t have any information about its abilities. However, I might be able to do something to prevent such a thing from happening, but I don’t have the right method for that right now."
"That’s still far off, so don’t worry about it and focus on the current issue." After that, Serpentera and Tian Kui leave the area.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a soft sigh and went into the eastern forest, especially since he left Yuan Tianling there.
When Zhang Xiaolong [3] arrived there, Jia Yuyan was already waiting for him. "Did you wait for me on purpose?"
"Yes." Jia Yuyan then asked Zhang Xiaolong [3] about Gu Changsheng and the Leng Clan, and he explained everything to her. "Are you sure there won’t be any problems with that old man?"

"I’ve always been confident in my memory manipulation abilities, so you don’t need to worry about that. I’m sure Gu Changsheng won’t be able to restore his memories, and the people in their group won’t realize it." Jia Yuyan then led Zhang Xiaolong [3] to enter the underground passage. "Leng Hua and the Leng Clan are in my control now, so we just need to wait for Cao Ren and the Cao Clan to return."
Jia Yuyan sighed heavily, remembering the Cao Clan. "If only Cao Ren wasn’t so ambitious, the situation in this realm would be completely safe, and we could live here in peace."

"We can’t do anything about it, right?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled bitterly in response. "Ambition is a part of our life, and it is our ambition that keeps pushing us to move forward. If we didn’t have ambition in our lives, we would never have reached this point, and our lifespan would have run out long ago. However, many individuals possess excessive ambition and do not hesitate to sacrifice others, such as Cao Ren, in order to achieve their goals. His ancestor, along with the ancestors of the other clans, was one of the founders of this realm, and they coexisted peacefully for millions of years. However, he brought about drastic changes to this realm, which was due to his personal ambition to become the sole ruler."
Jia Yuyan nodded to him. "That’s why this universe needs a savior to bring back peace, and you are the chosen one."

"Stop talking about the savior and the writing, okay?" Jia Yuyan turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3] in confusion. "I’m not a villain, but I’m not a hero or a savior either, and I have never been interested in saving this universe. I make every effort to protect myself and those closest to me, and if they put me in a difficult situation, I will not hesitate to bring chaos to this universe."
"Then, why are you helping people in this realm?"

Black lines appeared on Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s forehead, making Jia Yuyan realize that she had asked the wrong question. He immediately hugged her and kissed her for a moment. "Who revealed so much about me to Tian Jingxuan and the others? I originally didn’t want to get too close to them, but you repeatedly pushed me to them, remember?"
"I’m sorry, okay?"
"Sigh." Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn’t say anything else and dragged her out of the underground passage as quickly as possible.
When they arrived there, the other natural races had not yet started their activities because it was dawn, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] found Yuan Tianling staying at Ren Xiyi’s house.
"You can go to the Life Pond, and I will return to my hut now." Jia Yuyan hurriedly left him.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] wanted to follow Jia Yuyan, but he found Qian Shuang sleeping under a big tree a little away from his location. He remembered that he had promised to talk to her, but he was too focused on his cultivation at the Life Pond and had forgotten about it.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then approached Qian Shuang, sat beside her, and leaned her head against her shoulder.
Qian Shuang opened her eyes for a moment and looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3], but she immediately closed her eyes again and continued sleeping while hugging him.

’This girl is too innocent.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] embraced her and removed the effects of his demon charm from her. He briefly thought about erasing her memories of him, but he canceled his intention and used his dream technique to meet Shangguan Yan in her dream.
In the inn, Zhang Fei [5], who was accompanying Leng Xueyan to sleep, suddenly detected someone’s movement. He naturally knew that the person was Leng Hua’s subordinate, Leng Xiulan.
Zhang Fei [5] enveloped Leng Xueyan with his aura before using his lust domain, so she would not be affected by some of its effects.

As soon as she entered the room, Leng Xiulan immediately fell into the sexual illusion trap of Zhang Fei [5]’s domain, and her face turned extremely red because of the illusion that appeared in front of her. However, his domain started absorbing her Yin Qi before channeling it into his body, gradually weakening her. ’Haha! I’m lucky because her cultivation is in the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, and her Yin Qi is also stronger than the average woman. Moreover, I have five empty rooms in the Yin-Yang Space, and I will continuously milk out her Yin Qi until I reach that stage.’
[Why don’t you stimulate this woman and have sex with her, Master?]
’What if I had sex with you, Mei?’
[Humph! Keep dreaming!]
’Hehe.’ Zhang Fei [5] chuckled in response. ’I always hope that you have a soul, and I will help you shape your body. That way, we can be together for real.’
Mei did not respond to Zhang Fei, but she secretly contemplated his words and immediately began to explore the system as thoroughly as possible to find an answer.
After Leng Xiulan was completely weakened, Zhang Fei [5] deactivated his domain and hurriedly sealed her cultivation. After he sent her into the Yin-Yang Space, he continued to accompany Leng Xueyan.

chapters.title: Chapter 1002: Leng Hua Shocked
paragraphs: Duanmu Luolan slowly opened her eyes, her face flushed with shame as the memory of her kiss with Zhang Xiaolong last night resurfaced. "Crap! How could I possibly have done such a shameful thing last night? I pounced on him and kissed him so passionately, and I even had the thought of taking off my dress to show him my body."
*Crack*
"Wake up?" Duanmu Luolan turned to Shangguan Yan, who immediately teased her. "How does it feel to kiss a young man like him? You were so passionate when you kissed him last night."
"Let’s not talk about that anymore." Duanmu Luolan immediately sat down on the side of the bed. "What exactly happened to me? Why did I act like that last night?"

"Domain." Duanmu Luolan raised an eyebrow at Shangguan Yan. "That kid used his lust domain to influence Leng Hua and Leng Kuan, and its effects are deadly to all genders. I’ve experienced some of the effects of his lust domain when he created it for the first time, and they affect you as soon as you enter it. Fortunately, he held himself back and knocked you unconscious as soon as you wanted to take off your dress; otherwise, you would have become his woman overnight."
"Can you tell me the effects of his domain?" Duanmu Luolan curiously asked.
"No." Shangguan Yan refused. "His domain is his secret weapon, so I won’t tell anyone about its effects. Just like its name, all the effects are related to human lust."
Duanmu Luolan nodded in understanding before asking her again. "What about Leng Hua and the Leng Clan? Did he manage to do anything to them?"
"Do you really want to know the results?" After Duanmu Luolan nodded, Shangguan Yan immediately shared her memories of what she witnessed in the room with her.
"Disgusting!" Duanmu Luolan shouted loudly as she stood up. "How could those two old men do such a disgusting thing?"
Shangguan Yan shrugged in response. "They act like that because of one of the effects of that kid’s domain, so you’re lucky that he didn’t eat you up last night."
"Phew." Duanmu Luolan patted her chest in relief, but she still felt ashamed of her own madness in kissing Zhang Xiaolong [3] so passionately. "I will return to my clan now."

Shangguan Yan smiled to herself as she watched Duanmu Luolan leave. "Unfortunately, that kid has already targeted you, and I’m sure you won’t be able to avoid him once he makes a move on you. Sooner or later, you will fall for him, and I will be waiting for that day to come."
Shangguan Yan suddenly remembered her dreams last night, and she rubbed her lips with a faint smile. She then left the room to take care of other things.

Qian Chaoying, who walked out of his house, immediately stopped at his spot. He frowned for a moment, especially after he saw Qian Shuang sleeping under the tree and leaning against Zhang Xiaolong [3], with her head resting on his shoulder. ’Since when did my daughter know him? How did they become so close without me realizing it?’

Soon, Qian Chaoying’s two sons walked out of their house, and they immediately followed his line of sight. Qian Zhanji wasn’t too surprised to see Qian Shuang and Zhang Xiaolong [3], but Qian Li wore an angry face after seeing the two sleeping like that.
Qian Li wanted to go over and wake them up, but Qian Chaoying moved quickly and grabbed his shoulder. "Don’t disturb or interfere in their relationship, or you will die at that kid’s hands."
"But father, that kid—"

"Forget it." Qian Chaoying immediately took his two sons away. "I don’t really like that kid, but I have to admit all his advantages, and your sister would be fortunate if he does take an interest in her."

Qian Li clearly didn’t like his father’s decision, and he repeatedly stole glances at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a hateful gaze. He still believed that he had a special relationship with Ren Xiyi, and he was now targeting his sister. ’Tch! That bastard makes me really angry!’
Noticing his brother’s expression, Qian Zhanji could only shake his head, especially since Qian Li was too stupid to realize the true situation.

Not long after they left, a woman who was none other than Qian Bing walked out from another building. She wanted to go look for Qian Shuang, but instead she saw her cousin with Zhang Fei at a distance.
’Since when were they together? Are they lovers now?’ Since both of them were still sleeping, Qian Bing did not disturb them; instead, she went to look for her friends.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened his eyes as soon as they left. ’That possessive brat still doesn’t want to change, huh?’

"Mhmm..." Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Qian Shuang, who was just groaning. He smiled at her as soon as she opened her eyes, which made her feel stunned and blush. ’Why... why am I sleeping in his arms like this?’
’If I look closely, this girl is adorable.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] directly carried Qian Shuang like a princess, causing her to blush even redder. "Do you want to accompany me?"
"Where?" Qin Shuang asked in a crisp voice like a little girl.
"The Life Pond." After Qin Shuang nodded, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately brought her to that place.
*Splash*

Qian Shuang was shocked and did not expect that Zhang Xiaolong [3] would directly carry her into the pond, causing her dress to become soaked and transparent, revealing a faint outline of her smooth body. ’Ugh! Why did he do this? He should have told me first if he wanted to do this!’
"Hey." Qian Shuang looked up at Zhang Xiaolong [3], but her eyes widened as soon as he gave her a brief kiss. "I’m sorry I made you restless over the last few days."
Qian Shuang hurriedly buried her embarrassed face in Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s chest, shaking her head slightly. "It’s okay; you don’t need to apologize to me."
*Thud... Thud...*
Two women suddenly landed there, surprising Qian Shuang. Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to them, but Yuan Tianling immediately pulled Ren Xiyi into the pond.
*Splash... Splash...*
"Ahhh! Sister Tianling! Why are you doing this?" Ren Xiyi shouted as she crossed her arms in front of her chest, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3] was with them. ’Ugh! I’m embarrassed!’
"Haha." Yuan Tianling softly laughed. "Rather than thinking about that possessive man, it would be better if you soaked with us here."
Ren Xiyi shook her head vigorously. "I’m not thinking about Qian Li, and I’ve decided to stay away from him because his jealousy disgusts me."
"That’s good, then! A man like him is not worthy of having a lover!" Yuan Tianling then pointed at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Instead, you can be his lover, and you will definitely be happy with him."
"No!" Ren Xiyi refused immediately. "He is handsome, strong, and talented at many things. However, I don’t like a dual cultivator, and I want to have a loyal husband like my father."
"Hey—"
"Don’t force her, Yuanling." Zhang Xiaolong [3] released Qian Shuang from his embrace instantly. "By the way, you three can do whatever you want, and I will cultivate at the bottom of the pond."
"Why do you want to cultivate at the bottom of this pond?" Ren Xiyi asked in confusion.

"The water in this pond is different from normal water, so I want to use it to improve my water element and elemental laws." After he said that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] quickly left the three women and dove to the bottom of the pond.
Ren Xiyi immediately swam to Qian Shuang’s side and embraced her. "How did you two get together? Have you talked to him?"

"Not yet." Qian Shuang shook her head in response. "I fell asleep under a tree near my house last night, and he was beside me when I opened my eyes. He then brought me here, and you two arrived not long after."
"Oh." Ren Xiyi nodded slightly.

"Uhm." Qian Shuang nodded at her. "What are we going to do now? Are we going to take a bath here?"
"No!" Ren Xiyi pointed down. "He’ll definitely peek at us if we take a bath here, so I won’t do that!"
"Hahaha!" Yuan Tianling laughed at that. "Hey! He has more than a hundred women, and his women are pretty, remember? Do you think he still needs to peek at you?"
"Humph!" Ren Xiyi immediately jumped out of the pond. "Even though he has so many women, it doesn’t mean he won’t peek at me. You two can shower here if you like, and I’ll go back to my house."
Yuan Tianling shook his head before asking Qian Shuang. "Do you want to go home too?"

"No." Qian Shuang shook her head. "I have never soaked in this pond because they used it to maintain the life of Ancestor Ju Xing, and I have heard that the water here has beneficial effects on our body and soul, so I would like to try it now."
Yuan Tianling nodded at her. "How about the two of us accompany him to cultivate at the bottom?"
"Sure." Both women immediately followed Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the bottom of the pond, where they spent quite a lot of time cultivating.

Leng Kuan himself had left the room with a face full of shame, leaving Leng Hua to be angry on his own. "Fuck! What happened to me? How could I do such a disgusting thing?"
After he swallowed some healing pills, Leng Hua immediately left his room, but he didn’t see any of his clan members, and he found them sleeping in their respective rooms.

Leng Hua then looked up and found that the barrier protecting his clan had been opened, and he immediately went to the back of his clan to check. Unfortunately, he still didn’t realize that Zhang Xiaolong [3] had planted his demon slave mark into his soul, and his life would change significantly because of it.

Leng Hua frowned as soon as he got there, especially since there was no damage done, which confused him even more. "What exactly happened last night? Who infiltrated my clan and did all that to me? How did that person get past my barrier and turn it off? Does that brat have anything to do with this whole incident?"
Leng Hua decided to turn on the barrier again before leaving the place, and he summoned all his clan members to meet him.

Shangguan Yan shrugged in response.
"They act like that because of one of the effects of that kid’s domain, so you’re lucky that he didn’t eat you up last night."
"Phew." Duanmu Luolan patted her chest in relief, but she still felt ashamed of her own madness in kissing Zhang Xiaolong [3] so passionately.
"I will return to my clan now."
Shangguan Yan smiled to herself as she watched Duanmu Luolan leave.
"Unfortunately, that kid has already targeted you, and I’m sure you won’t be able to avoid him once he makes a move on you.

Shangguan Yan suddenly remembered her dreams last night, and she rubbed her lips with a faint smile.

How did they become so close without me realizing it?’
Soon, Qian Chaoying’s two sons walked out of their house, and they immediately followed his line of sight.
Qian Zhanji wasn’t too surprised to see Qian Shuang and Zhang Xiaolong [3], but Qian Li wore an angry face after seeing the two sleeping like that.
Qian Li wanted to go over and wake them up, but Qian Chaoying moved quickly and grabbed his shoulder.
"Don’t disturb or interfere in their relationship, or you will die at that kid’s hands."
"But father, that kid—"
"Forget it." Qian Chaoying immediately took his two sons away.
"I don’t really like that kid, but I have to admit all his advantages, and your sister would be fortunate if he does take an interest in her."
Qian Li clearly didn’t like his father’s decision, and he repeatedly stole glances at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a hateful gaze.
He still believed that he had a special relationship with Ren Xiyi, and he was now targeting his sister. ’Tch!
That bastard makes me really angry!’
Noticing his brother’s expression, Qian Zhanji could only shake his head, especially since Qian Li was too stupid to realize the true situation.
Not long after they left, a woman who was none other than Qian Bing walked out from another building.
She wanted to go look for Qian Shuang, but instead she saw her cousin with Zhang Fei at a distance.
’Since when were they together?
Are they lovers now?’ Since both of them were still sleeping, Qian Bing did not disturb them; instead, she went to look for her friends.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened his eyes as soon as they left. ’That possessive brat still doesn’t want to change, huh?’

"Where?" Qin Shuang asked in a crisp voice like a little girl.

chapters.title: Chapter 1003: A Soul Mark
paragraphs: (A/N: I made a mistake from Chapters 966 to 1038 by writing his soul level as ancestral soul level, and his true soul cultivation has reached the Perfection Saint Soul level in Chapter 966. I have already corrected the few Chapters that showed his soul level, and I will correct the rest soon. If you find one, please mention me in paragraph comment, and I will fix it immediately.)

They had already arrived at the Qiang Royal Palace, and Leng Xueyan led Zhang Fei [5] into it. Although the gate guards tried to stop them, she could not care less about them and knocked them unconscious directly, as did the troops who tried to stop them.

In contrast to Leng Xueyan, who actively dealt with the guards, Zhang Fei [5] did nothing and walked leisurely behind her, especially since she was more than enough to deal with them. "You are completely different from last night, and you are so fierce today."
Leng Xueyan blushed hearing that, but she ignored Zhang Fei [5]’s teasing and walked faster, as she would rather not spend much time in that realm.

The commotion outside attracted the attention of the entire palace, and the Qiang Emperor immediately ordered his generals and ministers to stop Leng Xueyan. Unfortunately, they were too weak for a cultivator at the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm like her, and she effortlessly immobilized them.
Several young men and women also ran out of the palace; they were none other than the sons and daughters of the Qiang Emperor, one of whom was Qiang Yin.
Qiang Yin was shocked to see Zhang Fei [5] with Leng Xueyan, but she was annoyed that he pretended not to know her. ’Ugh! How arrogant! I’ll teach him a lesson later!’
"Stop!" One of the princes shouted at Leng Xueyan, but she immediately forced all of them, including Qiang Yin, to prostrate on the ground.

"Let’s go." Leng Xueyan walked past the princes and princesses without caring about their expressions or releasing her pressure on them, but Zhang Fei [5]’s action of freeing Qiang Yin from that pressure startled her. She looked at him with a dark face, but he simply smiled and pulled the Qiang Princess with him. "Tch! A womanizer!"
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [5] chuckled and hugged Qiang Yin’s waist. "Don’t do anything, or she will attack you."

As she walked by Zhang Fei [5]’s side, Qiang Yin turned to her brothers and sisters. Unfortunately, she was powerless to save them from Leng Xueyan, and she asked him. "Who are you really? Who is that woman? Why did you two attack us?"

"I have never lied to you about my identity, and my name is really Zhang Fei. That woman is Leng Xueyan, and she is my bedmate." Qiang Yin was shocked to hear Zhang Fei [5]’s revelation because the woman walking in front of her was significantly stronger than her father. "Honestly, I have no problem with your family, and I followed her here to witness her strength in person. Unlike me, her family has a favorable relationship with the Huang Kingdom, and her father sent her here to save them, so she attacked this kingdom now."

Hearing that, Qiang Yin sighed deeply. "Everyone has forbidden my father from attacking the Huangfu Kingdom, including the emperors of the other kingdoms. However, he turned a blind eye and a deaf ear to their advice, and he still carried out his plan."

"Do you know your father’s reason for attacking the Huangfu Kingdom?" Qiang Yin shook his head at Zhang Fei [5], particularly considering her father’s prohibition against her interfering in their kingdom’s affairs. "Did he do it suddenly, or has he been planning it for a long time?"
Qiang Yin thought for a moment. "Actually, my father used to have a good relationship with Huangfu Hongjun, but he suddenly changed and immediately planned to attack the Huangfu Kingdom."

"As expected." Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the map to look for someone or something that influenced the Qiang Emperor to attack Huangfu Hongjun, but he found nothing. "If my guess is right, there is someone controlling your father, but I can’t find that person anywhere. He or she is probably afraid of Leng Xueyan, so he or she immediately fled this kingdom as soon as we came here."
"If your guess is right, who is the person who influenced my father to do such a thing?"
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at her. "For now, that is just my guess, and we have to see your father first before I can confirm his situation."

Soon, they had arrived at the throne room, and Leng Xueyan had already suppressed the helpless Qiang Emperor and all his wives. She strangled the emperor and lifted him. "Tell me, who told you to attack the Huangfu Kingdom?"

"Xueyan, I believe someone is controlling him, so don’t waste your time interrogating him." Leng Xueyan turned to Zhang Fei [5], who immediately moved to her side. "Seal his cultivation first, and I will examine his soul."
As soon as she sealed the Qiang Emperor’s cultivation, Zhang Fei forcefully pulled his soul out of his body, shocking both Leng Xueyan and Qiang Yin.
"A soul mark, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] checked the soul mark, and he sensed a familiar aura from it.
"Do you recognize the soul mark?" Leng Xueyan and Qiang Yin asked at the same time.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "The aura of this soul mark is familiar to me, and if I’m not mistaken, the aura emanating from it is similar to my master’s aura."
"Your master?"
Zhang Fei [5] put the Qiang Emperor’s soul back into his body. "My master is the Soul Emperor, Hun Di."
"Huh?" Both Leng Xueyan and Qiang Yin gasped in shock upon hearing the name.

"My master once told me about his missing junior brother named You Shanyi, and their late master expelled him because he used his abilities in soul cultivation carelessly." Zhang Fei[5] then examined the souls of the empress and the two concubines, and he also found the soul mark inside their souls. "This soul mark is quite different from usual, so I don’t dare forcefully remove it from their souls, but my master should be able to do it. Unfortunately, he is still busy right now, and I cannot bring him to this realm anytime soon."
Leng Xueyan immediately asked him. "So, what should we do now? If we can free them from that person’s control, I can stop the war between the two kingdoms, and I won’t have to kill these guys."

"I can’t free them now, but I have a way to stop this war without further bloodshed." Leng Xueyan and Qiang Yin looked at Zhang Fei [5] impatiently, prompting him to explain his plans to them. "You should release the other princes and generals first, and I will talk to them."
Leng Xueyan immediately disappeared from the throne room, but she returned not long after with the princes and generals, who looked terrified of her.

Those princes became even more afraid of Leng Xueyan once they saw their parents’ condition, and so did the generals. However, Zhang Fei [5] immediately explained the situation to them, which shocked them. "I will save this kingdom, but I need time to free the emperor and all his wives, so I will lock them up in my private quarters until I find a method. For the time being, I want Qiang Yin to take over the leadership of this kingdom, and all of you must help her. If any of you object to that, I will let Leng Xueyan kill you, and Princess Qiang will become the empress of this kingdom. Do you guys understand?"
"Yes... yes... we understand..." They answered with a strong nod.
On the other hand, Qiang Yin fell into a daze, as she never expected that Zhang Fei [5] would do such a thing for her. "I—"

"Hey." Zhang Fei [5] stopped Qiang Yin. "You have the capability to be an empress, so you should have more confidence in yourself and lead your kingdom as long as your parents’ situation has not changed. Once I succeed in freeing them from that person’s control, I will send them back to this kingdom, and you can step down from the throne if you do not wish to continue your leadership."

Qiang Yin did not directly respond to Zhang Fei and instead looked at her brothers and the generals, who all nodded in agreement, afraid that Leng Xueyan would kill them. She softly sighed before agreeing. "All right, I will lead this kingdom for the time being, and I hope you can free them from that person’s control as soon as possible. However, I’m afraid that that person will come here after you two leave, and he or she will definitely control us to continue his plan."
"Can you do something for them?" Zhang Fei asked Leng Xueyan.

Leng Xueyan nodded slightly and flicked her fingers; several balls of Qi instantly entered their bodies, including the princesses who were waiting outside. "If that person comes here again and intends to do something to them, my Qi will immediately move, and he or she will at least suffer a serious injury because of it."

"That’s good." Zhang Fei [5] then sent the Qiang Emperor and his three wives into the Yin-Yang Space, regardless of their shocked expressions, including Leng Xueyan’s. "Since our business here is finished, we will leave now, and you can take care of everything with their help."

"All right." After they left, all the princes immediately asked Qiang Yin about the identities of Leng Xueyan and Zhang Fei [5], and she explained to them as far as she knew. "General Han, tell all troops to withdraw from the Huangfu Kingdom territory, and we will end the war today."
"Yes, Princess." General Han immediately led the other generals away from the throne room.
Qiang Yin then asked her brothers to talk to their sisters, especially since it would be useless if she were to talk to them and they would turn on her instead.

After all her brothers left, Qiang Yin sat on her father’s throne and leaned against it, but there was not the slightest happiness on her face. "What do you think I should do next, Mother? Should I replace my father and become the empress of this kingdom?"

Zhang Fei [5] and Leng Xueyan had already arrived at the Huangfu Royal Palace, and she took him to meet Huangfu Hongjun in the throne room. She then told him that the Qiang Kingdom had begun to withdraw their troops, so she asked him to withdraw his troops back as well.

However, Leng Xueyan did not tell him about the situation in the Qiang Kingdom, especially since she did not want Huangfu Hongjun to take advantage of it to attack them. If that happened, he would definitely contact her father, and he was sure Leng Hua would force him to stay in the Grand Royal Realm longer to help him.
Unfortunately, Leng Xueyan’s worries were unfounded because Leng Hua had already become Zhang Fei [5]’s slave, and her father would never be able to force her to help Huangfu Hongjun.

Huangfu Hongjun was greatly relieved after hearing that, and he immediately ordered all his generals to withdraw their troops, but he still asked some of them to lead small troops to guard the border with the Qiang Kingdom. "Senior Leng, since the situation has calmed down, I want to host you and celebrate the end of the war, so I hope you are willing to stay for a few days."
"Three days." Leng Xueyan then turned to leave while pulling Zhang Fei [5] away with her.

Huangfu Hongjin then contacted his wives and asked them to prepare a banquet for Leng Xueyan and Zhang Fei [5]. He then ordered some of his generals to announce the end of the war, and he also asked them to prepare a banquet for the people of his kingdom in several cities.
As soon as they arrived at the inn, Leng Xueyan immediately questioned Zhang Fei [5]. "Are you interested in that weak princess? Why are you willing to go to such lengths to help her?"
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed and rubbed her cheeks. "Are you jealous of her, my little Xueyan? Have you forgotten about the plans I told you last night?"
"Hmm?" Leng Xueyan furrowed her brows. "So, you want to use that little princess to your advantage?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "Unlike many realms, this realm still adheres to a monarchy system, and there are several kingdoms within it. Qiang Yin is a princess, and she is currently in control of her kingdom. Therefore, I will establish the main headquarters of my organization in her kingdom, and I will use her as a backer for my organization."

"I see." Leng Xueyan nodded in understanding. "Unfortunately, that little princess is too weak, and she will not be able to protect your organization from the other emperors. Therefore, you must place a truly powerful person in this realm to take care of your organization, or they will destroy it if they see it as a threat."

"Do you think I’m stupid not to think about all that?" Zhang Fei [5] started to take off Leng Xueyan’s dress, making her heart beat faster. "Naturally, I have prepared some strong people, and they are much stronger than all the emperors in this realm, so I don’t need to worry about my organization. Moreover, I have a teleportation device, and I will install it in my headquarters. That way, I can come here whenever I want, and I will kill those who dare to attack my organization."
Once she was naked, Leng Xueyan helped Zhang Fei [5] undress. "Why do I feel that you are crueler than Zhang Xiaolong?"

"Do you believe me now that Zhang Xiaolong is my twin brother?" Leng Yueyan answered Zhang Fei [5] with a shake of her head. "If you still doubt it, I can bring him here, and the three of us will have fun together."
"No!" Leng Xueyan shouted loudly. "I am not a prostitute, and I will never do such a thing with two men."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] then carried Leng Xueyan, threw her on the bed, and pinned her down.

In a few minutes, the two of them were already engaged in their sexual activities, causing Leng Xueyan to moan and writhe in delight under Zhang Fei [5]. Unlike last night, she enjoyed their sexual activities more, especially since she was not under the influence of his demon abilities.

"Don’t do anything, or she will attack you."
As she walked by Zhang Fei [5]’s side, Qiang Yin turned to her brothers and sisters.
Unfortunately, she was powerless to save them from Leng Xueyan, and she asked him.
"Who are you really?
Who is that woman?
Why did you two attack us?"
"I have never lied to you about my identity, and my name is really Zhang Fei.
That woman is Leng Xueyan, and she is my bedmate." Qiang Yin was shocked to hear Zhang Fei [5]’s revelation because the woman walking in front of her was significantly stronger than her father.
"Honestly, I have no problem with your family, and I followed her here to witness her strength in person.
Unlike me, her family has a favorable relationship with the Huang Kingdom, and her father sent her here to save them, so she attacked this kingdom now."
Hearing that, Qiang Yin sighed deeply.
"Everyone has forbidden my father from attacking the Huangfu Kingdom, including the emperors of the other kingdoms.
However, he turned a blind eye and a deaf ear to their advice, and he still carried out his plan."

"Do you know your father’s reason for attacking the Huangfu Kingdom?" Qiang Yin shook his head at Zhang Fei [5], particularly considering her father’s prohibition against her interfering in their kingdom’s affairs.
"Did he do it suddenly, or has he been planning it for a long time?"
Qiang Yin thought for a moment.
"Actually, my father used to have a good relationship with Huangfu Hongjun, but he suddenly changed and immediately planned to attack the Huangfu Kingdom."
"As expected." Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the map to look for someone or something that influenced the Qiang Emperor to attack Huangfu Hongjun, but he found nothing.
"If my guess is right, there is someone controlling your father, but I can’t find that person anywhere.
He or she is probably afraid of Leng Xueyan, so he or she immediately fled this kingdom as soon as we came here."
"If your guess is right, who is the person who influenced my father to do such a thing?"
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at her.
"For now, that is just my guess, and we have to see your father first before I can confirm his situation."
Soon, they had arrived at the throne room, and Leng Xueyan had already suppressed the helpless Qiang Emperor and all his wives.
She strangled the emperor and lifted him.
"Tell me, who told you to attack the Huangfu Kingdom?"
"Xueyan, I believe someone is controlling him, so don’t waste your time interrogating him." Leng Xueyan turned to Zhang Fei [5], who immediately moved to her side.
"Seal his cultivation first, and I will examine his soul."
As soon as she sealed the Qiang Emperor’s cultivation, Zhang Fei forcefully pulled his soul out of his body, shocking both Leng Xueyan and Qiang Yin.
"A soul mark, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] checked the soul mark, and he sensed a familiar aura from it.
"Do you recognize the soul mark?" Leng Xueyan and Qiang Yin asked at the same time.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them.
"The aura of this soul mark is familiar to me, and if I’m not mistaken, the aura emanating from it is similar to my master’s aura."
"Your master?"
Zhang Fei [5] put the Qiang Emperor’s soul back into his body.
"My master is the Soul Emperor, Hun Di."
"Huh?" Both Leng Xueyan and Qiang Yin gasped in shock upon hearing the name.

"My master once told me about his missing junior brother named You Shanyi, and their late master expelled him because he used his abilities in soul cultivation carelessly." Zhang Fei[5] then examined the souls of the empress and the two concubines, and he also found the soul mark inside their souls.
"This soul mark is quite different from usual, so I don’t dare forcefully remove it from their souls, but my master should be able to do it.
Unfortunately, he is still busy right now, and I cannot bring him to this realm anytime soon."
Leng Xueyan immediately asked him.
"So, what should we do now?
If we can free them from that person’s control, I can stop the war between the two kingdoms, and I won’t have to kill these guys."
"I can’t free them now, but I have a way to stop this war without further bloodshed." Leng Xueyan and Qiang Yin looked at Zhang Fei [5] impatiently, prompting him to explain his plans to them.
"You should release the other princes and generals first, and I will talk to them."
Leng Xueyan immediately disappeared from the throne room, but she returned not long after with the princes and generals, who looked terrified of her.
Those princes became even more afraid of Leng Xueyan once they saw their parents’ condition, and so did the generals.
However, Zhang Fei [5] immediately explained the situation to them, which shocked them.
"I will save this kingdom, but I need time to free the emperor and all his wives, so I will lock them up in my private quarters until I find a method.
For the time being, I want Qiang Yin to take over the leadership of this kingdom, and all of you must help her.
If any of you object to that, I will let Leng Xueyan kill you, and Princess Qiang will become the empress of this kingdom.
Do you guys understand?"
"Yes... yes... we understand..." They answered with a strong nod.
On the other hand, Qiang Yin fell into a daze, as she never expected that Zhang Fei [5] would do such a thing for her.
"Hey." Zhang Fei [5] stopped Qiang Yin.
"You have the capability to be an empress, so you should have more confidence in yourself and lead your kingdom as long as your parents’ situation has not changed.
Once I succeed in freeing them from that person’s control, I will send them back to this kingdom, and you can step down from the throne if you do not wish to continue your leadership."
Qiang Yin did not directly respond to Zhang Fei and instead looked at her brothers and the generals, who all nodded in agreement, afraid that Leng Xueyan would kill them.
She softly sighed before agreeing.
"All right, I will lead this kingdom for the time being, and I hope you can free them from that person’s control as soon as possible.
However, I’m afraid that that person will come here after you two leave, and he or she will definitely control us to continue his plan."
"Can you do something for them?" Zhang Fei asked Leng Xueyan.
Leng Xueyan nodded slightly and flicked her fingers; several balls of Qi instantly entered their bodies, including the princesses who were waiting outside.
"If that person comes here again and intends to do something to them, my Qi will immediately move, and he or she will at least suffer a serious injury because of it."
"That’s good." Zhang Fei [5] then sent the Qiang Emperor and his three wives into the Yin-Yang Space, regardless of their shocked expressions, including Leng Xueyan’s.
"Since our business here is finished, we will leave now, and you can take care of everything with their help."
"All right." After they left, all the princes immediately asked Qiang Yin about the identities of Leng Xueyan and Zhang Fei [5], and she explained to them as far as she knew.
"General Han, tell all troops to withdraw from the Huangfu Kingdom territory, and we will end the war today."
"Yes, Princess." General Han immediately led the other generals away from the throne room.
Qiang Yin then asked her brothers to talk to their sisters, especially since it would be useless if she were to talk to them and they would turn on her instead.
After all her brothers left, Qiang Yin sat on her father’s throne and leaned against it, but there was not the slightest happiness on her face.
"What do you think I should do next, Mother?
Should I replace my father and become the empress of this kingdom?"
Zhang Fei [5] and Leng Xueyan had already arrived at the Huangfu Royal Palace, and she took him to meet Huangfu Hongjun in the throne room.
She then told him that the Qiang Kingdom had begun to withdraw their troops, so she asked him to withdraw his troops back as well.
However, Leng Xueyan did not tell him about the situation in the Qiang Kingdom, especially since she did not want Huangfu Hongjun to take advantage of it to attack them.
If that happened, he would definitely contact her father, and he was sure Leng Hua would force him to stay in the Grand Royal Realm longer to help him.
Unfortunately, Leng Xueyan’s worries were unfounded because Leng Hua had already become Zhang Fei [5]’s slave, and her father would never be able to force her to help Huangfu Hongjun.

Huangfu Hongjun was greatly relieved after hearing that, and he immediately ordered all his generals to withdraw their troops, but he still asked some of them to lead small troops to guard the border with the Qiang Kingdom.
"Senior Leng, since the situation has calmed down, I want to host you and celebrate the end of the war, so I hope you are willing to stay for a few days."
"Three days." Leng Xueyan then turned to leave while pulling Zhang Fei [5] away with her.
Huangfu Hongjin then contacted his wives and asked them to prepare a banquet for Leng Xueyan and Zhang Fei [5].
He then ordered some of his generals to announce the end of the war, and he also asked them to prepare a banquet for the people of his kingdom in several cities.
As soon as they arrived at the inn, Leng Xueyan immediately questioned Zhang Fei [5].
"Are you interested in that weak princess?
Why are you willing to go to such lengths to help her?"
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed and rubbed her cheeks.
"Are you jealous of her, my little Xueyan?
Have you forgotten about the plans I told you last night?"
"Hmm?" Leng Xueyan furrowed her brows.
"So, you want to use that little princess to your advantage?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her.
"Unlike many realms, this realm still adheres to a monarchy system, and there are several kingdoms within it.
Qiang Yin is a princess, and she is currently in control of her kingdom.
Therefore, I will establish the main headquarters of my organization in her kingdom, and I will use her as a backer for my organization."
"I see." Leng Xueyan nodded in understanding.
"Unfortunately, that little princess is too weak, and she will not be able to protect your organization from the other emperors.
Therefore, you must place a truly powerful person in this realm to take care of your organization, or they will destroy it if they see it as a threat."
"Do you think I’m stupid not to think about all that?" Zhang Fei [5] started to take off Leng Xueyan’s dress, making her heart beat faster.
"Naturally, I have prepared some strong people, and they are much stronger than all the emperors in this realm, so I don’t need to worry about my organization.
Moreover, I have a teleportation device, and I will install it in my headquarters.
That way, I can come here whenever I want, and I will kill those who dare to attack my organization."
Once she was naked, Leng Xueyan helped Zhang Fei [5] undress.
"Why do I feel that you are crueler than Zhang Xiaolong?"
"Do you believe me now that Zhang Xiaolong is my twin brother?" Leng Yueyan answered Zhang Fei [5] with a shake of her head.
"If you still doubt it, I can bring him here, and the three of us will have fun together."
"No!" Leng Xueyan shouted loudly.
"I am not a prostitute, and I will never do such a thing with two men."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] then carried Leng Xueyan, threw her on the bed, and pinned her down.
In a few minutes, the two of them were already engaged in their sexual activities, causing Leng Xueyan to moan and writhe in delight under Zhang Fei [5].
Unlike last night, she enjoyed their sexual activities more, especially since she was not under the influence of his demon abilities.

chapters.title: Chapter 1004: You Shanyi
paragraphs: Still in the Grand Royal Realm, an old man sat alone in a cave while drinking the wine in his jug, but his expression was extremely serious, and there was a hint of worry in his eyes.

"Who exactly is that woman? Why would a powerful cultivator like her come to this remote realm? Moreover, the young man by her side is also unusual, and I can sense a familiar aura from him, but I can’t remember it." When the wine ran out, the old man’s irritation intensified, prompting him to smash the jug against the cave wall. He tried to do something, but his expression changed to confusion and shock. "Why was my connection with that foolish Qiang Emperor and his wives suddenly cut off? Could it be that those two people have the ability to erase my soul mark from them? I don’t believe they can do that because my soul level is already high in the early stage of the Saint Soul Realm, and only Senior Brother Hun Di or Senior Sister Tang Ying can do it."
The old man is none other than You Shanyi, Hun Di’s junior brother who disappeared long ago. As Zhang Fei [5] expected, he was the mastermind controlling the Qiang Emperor and his three wives.

You Shanyi carefully walked out of the cave to monitor the situation in the Qiang Kingdom, but he was confused after he could not find the Qiang Emperor and his three wives. "Where are those people? Why aren’t they in the palace? Could it be that those two people took them somewhere else? Where did they hide them?"

After he considered the situation, You Shanyi decided to walk out of the cave and put on an artifact like a cape to hide his aura and presence. He quickly flew toward the Qiang Kingdom to ascertain the situation there.

When he arrived there, You Shanyi still couldn’t find the Qiang Emperor and his three wives, but he discovered that their children were discussing matters with General Han and the others. He eavesdropped on their conversation about plans for Qiang Yin to temporarily take over the throne, which further confused him.
Since he couldn’t find their parents, and they also planned for Qiang Yin to temporarily ascend the throne, You Shanyi decided to look for the princess.
You Shanyi found Qiang Yin in her office, and he immediately barged in before putting her subordinates to sleep, shocking her.

Despite her fear, Qiang Yin immediately calmed down because Leng Xueyan had provided her with protection, and she secretly sent a voice transmission to Zhang Fei [5]. "So, you are the one controlling my father, right, You Shanyi?"
"Hmm?" You Shanyi frowned for a moment when Qiang Yin mentioned his name, but he immediately moved in front of her and grabbed her neck. "Who told you my name? The young man or the woman?"
"Hehe." Qiang Yin chuckled. "I didn’t expect that a senior soul cultivator like you would be afraid of them; otherwise, you wouldn’t have run away as soon as they got here, right?"

"You—" You Shanyi stopped speaking and placed his hand on Qiang Yin’s chest. "Are you still unaware of your situation? I can control a powerful cultivator like your father, so I can control a weak little girl like you easily."
Qiang Yin smiled and tried to provoke him. "Why are you talking so much? Aren’t you confident in your abilities? Once you control me, you will have all the answers to your questions."

’What’s going on? Why isn’t this weakling afraid of me at all?’ Despite his confusion, You Shanyi still tried to plant his soul mark into Qiang Yin’s soul, but his action triggered Leng Xueyan’s Qi inside her body, which right away struck and bounced him backward. "Arghh!"
*Bam*
You Shanyi was slammed heavily onto the floor, causing him to spurt a mouthful of blood from his mouth. He momentarily stared at Qiang Yin, who was smiling triumphantly.

You Shanyi said nothing and fled from the Qiang Royal Palace, especially since he realized that the Qi attacking him included Leng Xueyan. He was aware of his strength, and he didn’t have the confidence to fight her.

"Fortunately, Zhang Fei asked that woman to protect me, and that old man overestimated himself." Qiang Yin breathed a sigh of relief as she sat back in her chair. "If it weren’t for them, I would have fallen into his control, and he would have controlled others as well. What exactly does he want? Why is he targeting this kingdom? Why didn’t he choose the other kingdoms? The Zhu and Wei Kingdoms are stronger than ours, so they should be more useful to him."

Qiang Yin then woke up her subordinates before going to see her brothers and sisters, and she informed them about You Shanyi, asking them to increase their vigilance, especially since the old man could come again at any time.

Meanwhile, You Shanyi was already quite far from the Qiang Kingdom, but he didn’t linger there for long and took out his flying artifact straight away. He hurriedly flew it into the sky, leaving the Grand Royal Realm.

"Damn it! The presence of those two people has messed up my plan! If I continue to stay in that realm, they will definitely capture me." You Shanyi immediately sat cross-legged and swallowed pills to heal his injuries, but he was unaware that someone had infiltrated his flying artifact. "Sigh! I will look for another, better realm, and I will control important people there to gather resources for me."

Zhang Fei [4] immediately went to the Qiang Kingdom as soon as Zhang Fei [5] received the voice transmission from Qiang Yin, but he had no intention of stopping the old man from escaping, and he hid there to find out his next destination.
[Why don’t you knock out this old man, Master?]

’Why should I rush with that, Mei?’ Zhang Fei responded to her with a slight shake of his head. ’The Qiang Emperor and his three wives are quite powerful, so I will stall for time and lock them up in the Yin-Yang Space. Once I finish harvesting their Qi, I will release them and return them to Qiang Yin. Moreover, I intended to bring this old man to my master, but he is busy in the Star Tower right now, so I will let him roam free for now.’
[I see. Your Yin-Yang Space is already full of them again, so you can’t lock up other cultivators there anymore.]

’That’s not a problem, right? All my prisoners are much stronger than me, and their Qi is more than enough to help me break through to the next few major stages.’ Zhang Fei [4] suddenly thought of someone, and he immediately planned some other things.
"What are you planning? Why did you let that person go?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] hugged Leng Xueyan closer. "I have no problem with that old man directly, and I’m not concerned about Qiang Yin or the Qian Kingdom either. Moreover, You Shanyi is my master’s former junior disciple, so I will not take any action against him, and I will hand him over to my master in the future.
"I see." Leng Xueyan nodded in understanding.

"Hey, do you know the location of the Falling Star Realm?" Leng Xueyan looked up at Zhang Fei [5]. "My master once said that he has a senior sister named Tang Ying, and she lives in that realm. She is stronger than him, and she has also been looking for You Shanyi for a long time. Therefore, I thought of going to see her, and I will bring her to capture the old man."
"Do you know the Shandian Realm?"
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [5] was surprised to hear that. "Is the Falling Star Realm close to that realm?"
Leng Xueyan nodded at him. "The Falling Star Realm is east of the Shandian Realm, and you only need a day’s journey from there."

"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in response. "Actually, I plan to go to the Shandian Realm and open a shop there after this, and since the Falling Star Realm is close to it, I will go and open my other shop there as well."
"I still don’t understand how you can have so much spare time to take care of all that." Leng Xueyan commented by shaking her head.

Zhang Fei [5] just smiled at Leng Xueyan, especially since he couldn’t possibly tell her that he and Zhang Xiaolong [3] were clones. He then pinned her beneath him again, causing her face to flush. "Since you’ll be returning to your realm in three days, we’ll have fun until then, okay?"
"Uhm." Leng Xueyan shyly nodded, as she herself still wanted to enjoy their intimate action. "Do you want to go with me?"

"No." Zhang Fei [5] unhesitatingly refused. "I have to develop our organization and shop, so I can’t stay in your realm. However, you don’t have to worry because I will visit you there, and I will accompany you again at that time."
Leng Xueyan sighed in disappointment. "You have to visit me in my realm, okay?"
"I will."

In just a few moments, they were engaged in intense sexual activity, but they were just satisfying each other as before because Leng Xueyan still didn’t want to take their relationship to the next stage.

When Zhang Xiaolon [3] opened his eyes at the bottom of the Life Pond, he saw that it was already dark. Yuan Tianling and Qian Shuang had also left the place long ago, but he found Jia Yuyan waiting for him on the surface.
Zhang Xialon [3] swam quickly to the surface before pulling Jia Yuyan into the Life Pond, and he directly sealed her lips, kissing her for a while.
Jia Yuyan released a heavy sigh and shook her head at him. "You have to stop doing this, okay?"
"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that. "Why should I stop? You said yourself that I am your future husband, right? Since you are my future wife, it is okay if I do this, right?"

Jia Yuyan chose not to comment on that and instead informed him about something else. "I told Tian Jingxuan and the others about Leng Hua’s actions against the Nalan and Beihuang clans, and they have already freed the two clans from his control, which made him even more panicked, especially after your actions against him last night."

"What if we go see Leng Hua now?" Jia Yuyan raised her eyebrows for a moment, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately carried her out of the Life Pond and dried their clothes. "At first, I thought of waiting for Cao Ren and the Cao Clan to come back, but I think I should show him that he is my slave now. I will take charge of him, ensuring that he does not make any further troublesome actions.
Jia Yuyan nodded at him. "Let’s meet him now."

A while later, they had already arrived above the Leng Clan, but two other women immediately appeared beside them, especially since Jia Yuyan had intentionally contacted Duanmu Luolan and Shangguan Yan to meet them.

Duanmu Luolan’s face turned red with embarrassment as soon as she saw Zhang Xiaolong [3], particularly because the memory of their kiss last night kept replaying in her mind. ’Ugh! I shouldn’t have done that last night!’
Zhang Xiaolong [3] only smiled at Duanmu Luolan’s embarrassed expression, but he didn’t say anything and shouted towards the Leng Clan. "Leng Hua! Come out and meet your master!"
In a few moments, Leng Hua and Leng Kuan had appeared before them, and both of them frowned at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "You—"

"Kneel to your master!" Naturally, Leng Hua and Leng Kuan would not do such a thing, but their bodies moved on their own and knelt before Zhang Xiaolong [3], which shocked them. He approached the two old men and pulled their hair. "Didn’t you want to kill me before? Unfortunately, you no longer have the chance to do so, especially since you are my slave now."

"I will."

In just a few moments, they were engaged in intense sexual activity, but they were just satisfying each other as before because Leng Xueyan still didn’t want to take their relationship to the next stage.
When Zhang Xiaolon [3] opened his eyes at the bottom of the Life Pond, he saw that it was already dark.
Yuan Tianling and Qian Shuang had also left the place long ago, but he found Jia Yuyan waiting for him on the surface.
Zhang Xialon [3] swam quickly to the surface before pulling Jia Yuyan into the Life Pond, and he directly sealed her lips, kissing her for a while.
Jia Yuyan released a heavy sigh and shook her head at him.
"You have to stop doing this, okay?"
"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that.
"Why should I stop?
You said yourself that I am your future husband, right?
Since you are my future wife, it is okay if I do this, right?"
Jia Yuyan chose not to comment on that and instead informed him about something else.

"I told Tian Jingxuan and the others about Leng Hua’s actions against the Nalan and Beihuang clans, and they have already freed the two clans from his control, which made him even more panicked, especially after your actions against him last night."
"What if we go see Leng Hua now?" Jia Yuyan raised her eyebrows for a moment, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately carried her out of the Life Pond and dried their clothes.
"At first, I thought of waiting for Cao Ren and the Cao Clan to come back, but I think I should show him that he is my slave now.
I will take charge of him, ensuring that he does not make any further troublesome actions.
Jia Yuyan nodded at him.
"Let’s meet him now."

A while later, they had already arrived above the Leng Clan, but two other women immediately appeared beside them, especially since Jia Yuyan had intentionally contacted Duanmu Luolan and Shangguan Yan to meet them.
Duanmu Luolan’s face turned red with embarrassment as soon as she saw Zhang Xiaolong [3], particularly because the memory of their kiss last night kept replaying in her mind. ’Ugh!
I shouldn’t have done that last night!’
Zhang Xiaolong [3] only smiled at Duanmu Luolan’s embarrassed expression, but he didn’t say anything and shouted towards the Leng Clan.
"Leng Hua!
Come out and meet your master!"
In a few moments, Leng Hua and Leng Kuan had appeared before them, and both of them frowned at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"You—"
"Kneel to your master!" Naturally, Leng Hua and Leng Kuan would not do such a thing, but their bodies moved on their own and knelt before Zhang Xiaolong [3], which shocked them.
He approached the two old men and pulled their hair.
"Didn’t you want to kill me before?
Unfortunately, you no longer have the chance to do so, especially since you are my slave now."

chapters.title: Chapter 1005: True Faces
paragraphs: Inside the Leng Clan hall, Leng Hua and Leng Kuan prostrated themselves on the floor with their foreheads pressed against it. Their faces were pale, especially after Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s soul mark inside their souls tortured them.

Previously, Leng Hua and Leng Kuan released their killing intent, and they were about to attack Zhang Xiaolong [3], but they did not realize that he had already planted his soul mark into their souls, which immediately reacted once they had malicious intentions towards him, giving them excruciating torture.
’Damn it! This bastard did all that to us last night!’ Leng Hua and Leng Kuan only dared to express their thoughts silently.

Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was sitting at the head seat, casually smiled at their expressions. Meanwhile, Jia Yuyan, Duanmu Luolan, and Shangguan Yan sat side by side on the side seats. "From now on, you two are my slaves, and you have already experienced the consequences if you choose to oppose me. Therefore, you guys should forget your intentions and obey me, or I will make you suffer even more than this. If you can please me, I might change my mind and let you two go one day, so the choice is yours."
’Such a big liar!’ Jia Yuyan, Duanmu Luolan, and Shangguan Yan screamed in their hearts, as they were sure that Zhang Xiaolong [3] would never let go of Leng Hua and Leng Kuan.
Leng Hua was furious in his heart listening to Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he didn’t want to feel that painful pain again. "What do you want from us, Master?"
"Hahaha!" Jia Yuyan, Duanmu Luolan, and Shangguan Yan couldn’t hold back their laughter when they heard the proud Leng Hua address Zhang Xiaolong [3] as his master, causing his face to darken.

"I want various cultivation resources, including Yin and Yang Qi." Not only were Leng Hua and Leng Kuan confused by Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s answer, but the three women were also confused by it. "I have many people by my side, both men and women. I need them to help me, but I can’t give them my Yang Qi or my wife’s Yin Qi, so I need other people’s Yin and Yang Qi for them. Your Leng Clan has many powerful cultivators, so I need you to order them to collect their Yang and Yin Qi for my people."
"Consider it done." Leng Hua then asked him again. "What kind of cultivation resources do you need, Master?"

"Everything." The three women immediately thought that Zhang Xiaolong [3] wanted to milk Leng Hua and the Leng Clan’s resources. "Additionally, appoint Leng Xueyan as your clan leader to replace your son, and she will be the one who will communicate with me in the future."
’Tch! What a treacherous daughter! She actually had a relationship with him and betrayed me!’ Leng Hua felt a deep anger in his heart.

"Hey! Leng Xueyan didn’t have any relationship with me before you sent her to the Grand Royal Realm, so your suspicions of her are completely unfounded." Leng Hua froze after Zhang Xiaolong [3] mentioned it, making her realize that he could read her mind. "By the way, I want to thank you for sending Leng Xiulan to pursue her in that realm, as it resulted in me obtaining a pretty strong prisoner."
"Did you really not have any relationship with Leng Xueyan before that?" Shangguan Yan curiously asked.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] explained it to them straight away. "I met Leng Xueyan once in the Phoenix Realm, and I’ve done something to her, which made her think about me all the time. Therefore, she reacted like that when she first saw me arrive in this realm, and this foolish old man became paranoid about our nonexistent relationship."

Even though he had heard that, Leng Hua still couldn’t believe that Leng Xueyan had no relationship with Zhang Xiaolong [3] before that day, and he was sure that it was her daughter who helped him to breach their clan’s barrier.
"How did you make Leng Xueyan keep thinking about you?" Zhang Xiaolong briefly glanced at Shangguan Yan before shaking his head in response to Duanmu Luolan. "Cheapskate!"

Shangguan Yan raised her eyebrows, and a guess emerged in her mind. Even so, she was doubtful about her guess, especially since she didn’t have much information about the abilities of a lust demon. ’Did he really use the dream technique on Leng Xueyan? Does that mean the one I met in the dream is the real one? Sigh! I will ask him this the next time he comes to my dreams.’
*Tap... Tap...*
Several people suddenly came and walked into the main hall, and their arrival made Leng Hua feel humiliated. ’Fuck! Why did the three of them come here?’

"Hahaha!" Shi Yan laughed, seeing the two old men prostrate themselves like that. "Hey, Old Qing! I never dreamed that I would see this old man prostrate himself like this, let alone him prostrating himself in front of a man who is much younger than his great-grandchildren."

Qing Huang nodded in agreement with him. "This old man has always been arrogant and believed he was the best. He even considered taking over our clans and the other clans, but he had to face the consequences of his greed after kicking an iron plate today."
Unlike them, Tian Jingxuan directly asked Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "What are your plans for them and their clan?"

"Do you mind if I take over this clan?" Tian Jingxuan and the other two old men were momentarily taken aback by Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s response. "It’s true that I didn’t do it myself, and I was able to subdue this clan because of the help of others. However, you guys wouldn’t be able to do anything to this clan without my people, so I want to take over the clan and all of their possessions. If you guys object to my wishes, I will withdraw my people from this realm, and you guys can face the Cao Clan and Qi Lai yourselves."

Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s threat caused the faces of Tian Jingxuan and the other two to darken, but Jia Yuyan hurriedly spoke to them. "You guys always think Leng Hua is greedy, but you guys will be no different from him if you insist on taking this clan from him. He and his people subdued this clan, so it’s already his. Moreover, we don’t have the strength to face Qi Lai, and this realm will fall into the hands of the Cao Clan if this kid takes his people away. So, you should consider everything broadly, or the impact will be devastating for all residents of this realm."
"All right." Tian Jingxuan immediately agreed. "The Leng Clan will be yours from now on, so please don’t take your people away from this realm."

"You don’t need to worry about that." Shi Yan and Qing Huang were furious with Zhang Xiaolong [3], but they said nothing and followed Tian Jingxuan to leave the Leng Clan. "Do you now understand why I don’t want to have too close a relationship with them?"
Jia Yuyan released a soft sigh and nodded in resignation. "I’ve already apologized to you, so please stop bringing up that matter."

"I’ve always been selective in choosing people, especially since I have the ability to read the dark side of other people’s souls. They seem good on the outside, but their souls are too dark, and they harbor many ambitions in their hearts." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then got off his chair, ordered Leng Hua and Leng Kua to immediately carry out their duties, and afterward led the three women away from the Leng Clan. "You two better be careful of them, especially Shi Yan and Qing Huang."
"Hmm?" Duanmuo Luolan and Shangguan Yan exchanged confused glances. "What do you mean by that? Are they going to attack us?"

"I’m not a fortune teller, and I can’t predict their next plans. Please listen to my warnings and be careful of them, and you can contact me if anything happens." Duanmuo Luolan and Shangguan Yan nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately brought Jia Yuyan back to the eastern forest.
"Do you think they will really do something to us?"

Unlike Duanmu Luolan, Shangguan Yan seriously considered Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s words. "Regardless of whether they will do something to us or not, we had better listen to him and be wary of them, or we will be the ones to suffer."
"You’re right." Duanmu Luolan nodded in agreement. "Let’s go back; it’s almost midnight now."
"Let’s go."
Three old men gathered in another area, and their faces were filled with anger. "Are we really going to hand over the Leng Clan to that kid, Jingxuan?"

"Do you think we have any other choice?" Tian Jingxuan gazed in another direction. "That kid has many powerful backers behind him, and some of them clearly came from the Paradise Realm. If we become his enemy now, I’m sure those people will make a move against us. Moreover, we still need them to stop Qi Lai, so we must restrain ourselves. Once all the trouble is resolved, we can devise another plan to deal with him."

Qing Huang immediately put forward his idea, but he conveyed it through voice transmission. ’What if we use Duanmu Luolan and Shangguan Yan to help us? They are obviously close to that kid, but they won’t help us just like that, so we have to do something about them first. This way, we don’t have to make a move on him ourselves, and they will bring him to us.’

’What’s your idea?’ Qing Huang told his two friends about his idea, surprising both men. ’I think we can do that, but you should send someone else to meet that person. That kid is overly cautious, so I’m sure he’s already asked his people to keep an eye on us, and he’ll be suspicious if you go to meet that person yourself.’
Qing Huang nodded to Tian Jingxuan, and the three of them hurriedly left the place.

After he arrived at the Qing Clan, Qing Huang immediately called someone and ordered him to meet the person he had mentioned to his two friends earlier. ’I hope this plan will work, or that kid will be even more impudent towards us, especially if his people manage to stop the Cao Clan and Qi Lai.’
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was already lying on Jia Yuyan’s bed, but he didn’t do anything with her, especially since the female fairy fell asleep as soon as they arrived there.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] remembered the glance that Shangguan Yan had given him when they were in the Leng Clan earlier, and he immediately activated his dream ability to meet her.
When he arrived at the dream, Zhang Xiaolong [3] saw Shangguan Yan waiting for him with a suspicious look. "Hey, tell me the truth, are you a real person?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chose to admit the truth, which caused Shangguan Yan to appear angry. He immediately approached her and held her hand. "I’m sorry I lied to you, but I didn’t want to make you feel uncomfortable because of my approach, so I purposely met you here."
Shangguan Yan pulled her hand back and spoke. "You should have told me from the start, did you know that? Is this place really my dream or the effect of your abilities?"

"This place is your dream." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told her about his dream abilities. "I can manipulate other people’s dreams, but I never use it on those who are not my enemies, and I only use it on my prisoners specifically to milk their Yin Qi."
"Your prisoners?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "I have fifteen prisoners now, and I put them in a special place. If it weren’t for them, my cultivation would not have reached this stage now."

Shangguan Yan nodded in response. "Honestly, I am disappointed that you lied to me, but I always feel comfortable being with you in this place. For the past few days, I have been able to be myself, and you have always given me solutions to all my problems."
"Are you willing to forgive me?"
"Please tell me more about your true self, but I don’t want to hear any more lies, and I will decide whether to forgive you or not after that."
"All right."
