chapters.title: Chapter 1006: Disclosure
paragraphs: (A/N: I made a mistake from Chapters 966 to 1038 by writing his soul level as ancestral soul level, and his true soul cultivation has reached the Perfection Saint Soul level in Chapter 966. I have already corrected the few Chapters that showed his soul level, and I will correct the rest soon. If you find one, please mention me in paragraph comment, and I will fix it immediately.)

In the dream, the two of them sat side by side, with Shangguan Yan’s head resting on Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s left shoulder and their fingers interlocked together. "I never thought that you had died before, but your death was a blessing in disguise for you, and it took you far to this realm from the lower realms. Moreover, you have experienced betrayal from the two people closest to you, so I’m not surprised if you are so cautious toward people. Even though you became a demon because of it, you enjoyed your life as one, and you have so many women because of it."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed and embraced her. "Do you believe me if I never dreamed of having such a huge harem? Before that day’s incident, I only loved one woman, and she was my little sister, Zhang Lin. After I came back to life, my lust demon nature slowly began to affect me, and I became increasingly difficult to control myself after my first evolution, which was exacerbated by my second evolution."

Shangguan Yan looked up at him. "I’ve heard of lust demons before, but I never knew their character or abilities, especially since I’ve never met one. However, I feel that you’ve gone insane by taking your mother, big sister, and little sister as your wives."

"You’re right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not deny that. "Zhang Lin and I have loved each other since we first knew romance, but we never thought of getting into a serious relationship because we were bound by mortal norms, and our situation changed after we became cultivators. As for my big sister, I never had such a feeling for her before, but I became possessive after I learned of her feelings for me. I didn’t want her to marry another man, and I decided to take her as my wife as well. I originally did it with my mother just to take revenge on her and her husband, but I decided to forgive her after I learned the truth."
"I see." Shangguan Yan then asked him something. "Can you make them all appear here using your dream ability?"
"Sure." All of Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s women immediately appeared in Shangguan Yan’s dream, but they were divided into six different groups according to their respective partners.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then gestured to the first group, occupied by his main harems, before revealing their identities to Shangguan Yan. He also explained to her the identities of all the women in the other five groups. "All of them are partners of my five clones, including this one."
"So, your original body has the most women?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "My first clone has the second most women, and my second clone is third. My fourth clone only has three women, and this third clone only has two partners. The least is my fifth clone, and he only has one partner."
"Are you really going to marry them all in the future?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded seriously. "Not only will I marry them, but I will also impregnate them, and my descendants will be numerous."

Shangguan Yan massaged her forehead after hearing that, imagining what it would be like if Zhang Xiaolong [3] were to impregnate so many women at once. "Are you capable of taking care of such a huge family?"

"Do you need to doubt me?" Shangguan Yan didn’t answer Zhang Xiaolong [3], but she clearly doubted him. "I may not be able to do it now, but we still have a long road ahead, and I’m sure we can do it in the future. That’s why I don’t want to rush into having children; I will consider having them only after our situation is stable and settled."
"Remove them." After Zhang Xiaolong [3] did that, Shangguan Yan asked him again. "Are you going to give me to your clone if I become your woman?"
"Do you still not know the answer?"
"I know." Shangguan Yan suddenly had an idea. "Hey, you like Luolan, right? If you’ve used your abilities on her, you can bring her here now."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at her. "I can’t bring her into your dream, but I can bring the subconscious of both of you into a dream that I created myself."
"Bring me there now, and you can bring Luolan’s subconscious there."

A few moments later, they had already moved on to another dream, but it was almost no different from Shangguan Yan’s dream. Soon, Duanmu Luolan appeared in front of them naked, but her face immediately turned red as soon as she saw Zhang Xiaolong [3].

Duanmu Luolan shook her head vigorously while rubbing her eyes, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] was still standing in front of her. She then pinched her own cheeks, but she didn’t feel the slightest pain. "Am I dreaming right now? Why am I dreaming of the two of them?"
"Haha." Shangguan Yan laughed. "You are indeed in a dream, and both of us are just our subconscious."

paragraphs: *Tap... Tap... Tap...*
Huangfu Hongjun, who was sitting on his throne and listening to his generals’ reports, immediately frowned as soon as Zhang Fei [5] entered the room. "What are you doing here?"
"I have important business with you."
Huangfu Hongjun wanted to stand up from his throne, but Huangfu Shong and Huangfu Fanbo suddenly appeared behind him and held him down, which shocked not only him but also everyone in the room.
Those generals wanted to capture Zhang Fei [5], but he immediately summoned the four beast ancestors, and their auras suffocated them.
As a cultivator at the 1-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm, Huangfu Hongjun immediately recognized the superior strength of Long Jiutian and the others, a realization that left him in a state of shock.

However, Huangfu Hongjun was confused by the attitude of his two ancestors, especially since Huangfu Shong and Huangfu Fanbo clearly sided with Zhang Fei [5]. He did not even realize that they had already fallen into his hands.
"Move him."
Huangfu Shong pulled Huangfu Hongjun down from his throne and forced him to kneel on the floor, causing him to be furious and humiliated.
Zhang Fei [5] then sat on the throne, propped one leg over the other, and looked at Huangfu Hongjun with a faint smile.
"What do you mean by this? Why do you treat me like this?" Huangfu Hongjin asked angrily.

"One of your Huangfu Clan descendants tried to kill me several times, and he also tried to harm some of my closest people. Although I have killed him, I am not a forgiving person." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer confused Huangfu Hongjun, who immediately turned to his two ancestors, but they didn’t say anything to him.
"Who exactly are you referring to?"

"Huangfu Shou." Huangfu Hongjun immediately realized Zhang Fei [5]’s true identity. "That’s right, I used to live in the Nine Stars Realm. You sent Huangfu Fanbo and Huangfu Shong to help him kill me, so I came here specifically to settle accounts with you. Oh! You don’t need to think about asking Leng Hua for help because he is my slave now, and Leng Xueyan won’t come back here to save you. Even if she comes back here, she will be on my side because she is my woman, so you are alone now."

Huangfu Hongjun was shocked to hear Zhang Fei [5] call Leng Hua his slave. As for Leng Xueyan, he could already see their closeness, so he was sure that she would not be willing to save him. "What do you want from me?"

"You don’t need to be afraid because I won’t kill you, especially since I need a chess piece to help me monitor everything in this realm." Huangfu Shong brought Huangfu Hongjun before Zhang Fei [5], who immediately touched his chest. "Just like Leng Hua, you will be my slave from today onward."

"Stop!" Huangfu Hongjun tried to struggle, but Huangfu Shong was much stronger than him, leaving his struggle futile. In a few seconds, he could feel Zhang Fei [5]’s demon slave mark being planted into his soul, making him his new slave. "You—"

"If I were you, I would control my anger; otherwise, my slave mark would torture you, and you would experience great pain." Zhang Fei [5] then looked at the people, who were frightened of him. "I give you all two choices: obey me willingly or become my slaves like your emperor. If you obey me, I will give you the opportunity to become powerful, but I will slaughter your clans if you dare to betray me, so the choice is up to you all."
Those people trembled violently once Zhang Fei [5] released his killing intent, making them even more suffocated. "We... we will obey you, so please don’t enslave us."
"Traitors!" Huangfu Hongjun furiously shouted.

"Hahaha!" Zhang Fei [5] laughed as he pulled his killing intent back, and he sent the five beast ancestors back into the beast space after that. Then, he took out several bottles of pills, and he asked Huangfu Fanbo to distribute them to the people. "These pills are my first gift to all of you, and I will give you much better ones if you show your loyalty to me. However, you must always remember my previous words; otherwise, your clans will disappear forever from this realm."

Their expressions changed with excitement after they saw the grade of the pills, especially since superior-grade pills are extremely rare in their realm. Even if such pills were available, they would have to waste a lot of jewels to buy them, yet Zhang Fei [5] gave his pills to them for free. "Thank you, Master."
Zhang Fei [5] then conveyed some orders to them. "Leave and carry out my orders right now."
"Yes, Master."
After those people left, Zhang Fei [5] ordered Huangfu Hongjun to call his wives, sons, and daughters. He did not enslave them, but he planted his soul mark into their souls.

After he installed the teleportation portal in the dungeon of the palace, Zhang Fei [5] immediately left the Huangfu Palace, and he took one of the princesses with him, leaving Huangfu Hongtian and his other family members desperate.
[Are you interested in this woman, Master?]
’No.’ Zhang Fei [5] looked at the princess, who was quite beautiful and graceful. However, he did not have the slightest interest in her, and he took her with him for something. "What’s your name?"
"Huangfu... Huangfu Ziqian." The princess answered with a trembling voice.

"Hey! You don’t have to be afraid of me because I won’t do anything to you." Huangfu Ziqian timidly looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "Where is your family’s best building? I want to use it to open my shop, and I want you to help me take care of it."

"Huh?" Huangfu Ziqian found it hard to believe that Zhang Fei [5] would let a princess like her take care of his shop. Moreover, she had never done such a job before, and she usually enjoyed everything from behind the palace.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly at her reaction. "I chose you because you are the best among your sisters, and I need someone to communicate with Princess Qiang Yin."
"Do... do you also treat Princess Qiang Yin like us?"

"No." Zhang Fei [5] then continued. "I will open my other shops in several other kingdoms, and I will ask the princesses of those kingdoms to take care of them. Since you are all princesses, I believe you can communicate more easily. I know you are not used to such work, but you will not be taking care of my shops alone, and I will assign some of my subordinates to help you."
"Are... are you sure the other princesses will be willing to help you?"
Zhang Fei [5] just smiled, making Huangfu Ziqian shiver. "Show me your best building."

"Over there." Huangfu Zhiqian pointed to a three-story building. "My family has many buildings, but that building is the best of them all. Moreover, it was recently vacated, so you can use it whenever you want."
"Let’s go there."

Upon arriving inside the building, Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the gate leading to the Sky Dragon Realm before disappearing into it, leaving Huangfu Zhiqian in shock. A while later, he returned with five members of the Demon Fox Group that he had intentionally left there.

Huangfu Zhiqian did not say a word as she watched Zhang Fei [5] distribute many items to the five women, such as pills, alchemy ingredients, Earth goods, and many more. However, only the sex toys piqued her curiosity, especially since such items did not exist in her realm. ’What kind of items are those? Why are they shaped so peculiar?’

"Are you interested in this item?" The five women of the Demon Fox Group giggled as Zhang Fei [5] showed Huangfu Zhiqian a dildo. Since they had been following him for a long time, they naturally knew its function. "You can have it if you are interested in it."
Huangfu Zhiqian accepted the dildo and squeezed it gently. "How do I use this item?"

Zhang Fei [5] put his face closer to Huang Zhiqian’s ear and whispered to her about how to use it, causing her face to turn extremely red. She immediately returned it to him and ran out of the building, but he could hear her grumbling and cursing him. "Arrange all the items today and open the shop tomorrow, and that princess will be in charge of it."
"Yes, Master."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately followed Huangfu Zhiqian and took her to the Qiang Kingdom, where he met five other members of the Demon Fox Group.
Huangfu Zhiqian still didn’t say anything to Zhang Fei [5], but she was shocked by his ability to bring her to the Qiang Kingdom in such a short time.
After he confirmed that all the goods there were ready, Zhang Fei [5] asked his subordinates to open the shop tomorrow, and he took Huangfu Zhiqian to meet Qiang Yin at the Qiang Royal Palace.
"Huh?" Qiang Yin was surprised to see Zhang Fei [5] appear together with Huangfu Zhiqian. "Why did you bring her here?"

"Zhiqian will take care of my shop in the Huangfu Kingdom, and since you will take care of the one in this kingdom, I want the two of you to work together in the future." Zhang Fei [5] then asked them. "Do you two know the princesses of the Zhu, Wei, and Jiang Kingdoms?"

"Yes." Qiang Yin then told him. "For the Zhu Kingdom, you can meet Princess Zhu Jing, and you can meet Princess Wei Xiaoya in the Wei Kingdom. As for the Jiang Kingdom, they only have two princes, and their rulers are Emperor Jiang Bai and Empress Ling Yingfei."
Zhang Fei [5] thought for a moment, especially about the Jiang Kingdom. "What is Jiang Bai’s character?"
"He’s strong, open-minded, and easy to talk to. I think you won’t have any trouble talking to him, but he won’t necessarily be willing to meet you because he’s busy."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] wasn’t too worried about that. "Do you have a lot of business right now? If not, I want you to help me talk to Zhu Jing and Wei Xiaoya."
Qiang Yin shook her head in response. "My brothers and ministers are taking care of everything, and I have handed over my old job to my subordinates, so I have a lot of free time now."
"In that case, let’s go now because I don’t have much free time."
Sometime later, Zhang Fei [5] and the two women had arrived at the Zhu Kingdom, and Qiang Yin immediately contacted Zhu Jing, asking her to meet them at a restaurant.

After they waited for about an hour, Zhu Jing finally arrived at the restaurant, but she was surprised by the presence of Zhang Fei [5] among the two women. However, she immediately ignored him because his cultivation was too low for her to care; instead, she asked the two women. "Since when did you two get along like this?"

"Hehe." Qiang Yin giggled in response. "Zhu Jing, you know that we never get involved in our kingdom’s affairs directly, so the war between our kingdoms is none of our business. Actually, we came here because my friend Zhang Fei needed your help."
"Hmm?" Zhu Jing raised an eyebrow as she looked at him. "What do you need from me?"

"A building and a protection." Zhang Fei [5] then explained to Zhu Jing about his plans for his shop, but the princess seemed reluctant to help him, especially since they didn’t know each other. He then placed a pill on the table, which caused her eyes to widen in surprise upon seeing its grade. "My cultivation is indeed far below yours, but I am a Venerable Rank alchemist, and I concocted this Yin Purifying Pill myself. Honestly, I can protect my shop myself, but I still have to travel to many realms, so I want to cooperate with you."

Zhu Jing took the Yin Purifying Pill and questioned him. "What kind of cooperation do you want? Do you want to share the profits of your shop with me? If that is the case, I want a minimum of 45 percent of the profits, and I will ensure the security of your shop."

"Princess, you are too greedy if you ask for 45 percent of the profits." Zhu Jing fiercely glared at Zhang Fei [5], who immediately took out another pill. "What are you most afraid of in your life? Are you more afraid of losing your beauty due to aging, or is there something else that frightens you?"
Zhu Jing furrowed her brows. "For a woman, beauty is everything, so aging is what I fear the most. You two must agree with me, right, Qiang Yin and Huangfu Zhiqian?"

Huangfu Hongjun wanted to stand up from his throne, but Huangfu Shong and Huangfu Fanbo suddenly appeared behind him and held him down, which shocked not only him but also everyone in the room.
Those generals wanted to capture Zhang Fei [5], but he immediately summoned the four beast ancestors, and their auras suffocated them.
As a cultivator at the 1-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm, Huangfu Hongjun immediately recognized the superior strength of Long Jiutian and the others, a realization that left him in a state of shock.
However, Huangfu Hongjun was confused by the attitude of his two ancestors, especially since Huangfu Shong and Huangfu Fanbo clearly sided with Zhang Fei [5].
He did not even realize that they had already fallen into his hands.
"Move him."
Huangfu Shong pulled Huangfu Hongjun down from his throne and forced him to kneel on the floor, causing him to be furious and humiliated.
Zhang Fei [5] then sat on the throne, propped one leg over the other, and looked at Huangfu Hongjun with a faint smile.
"What do you mean by this?
Why do you treat me like this?" Huangfu Hongjin asked angrily.
"One of your Huangfu Clan descendants tried to kill me several times, and he also tried to harm some of my closest people.
Although I have killed him, I am not a forgiving person." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer confused Huangfu Hongjun, who immediately turned to his two ancestors, but they didn’t say anything to him.
"Who exactly are you referring to?"
"Huangfu Shou." Huangfu Hongjun immediately realized Zhang Fei [5]’s true identity.
"That’s right, I used to live in the Nine Stars Realm.
You sent Huangfu Fanbo and Huangfu Shong to help him kill me, so I came here specifically to settle accounts with you.
Oh!
You don’t need to think about asking Leng Hua for help because he is my slave now, and Leng Xueyan won’t come back here to save you.
Even if she comes back here, she will be on my side because she is my woman, so you are alone now."
Huangfu Hongjun was shocked to hear Zhang Fei [5] call Leng Hua his slave.
As for Leng Xueyan, he could already see their closeness, so he was sure that she would not be willing to save him.
"What do you want from me?"

"You don’t need to be afraid because I won’t kill you, especially since I need a chess piece to help me monitor everything in this realm." Huangfu Shong brought Huangfu Hongjun before Zhang Fei [5], who immediately touched his chest.
"Just like Leng Hua, you will be my slave from today onward."
"Stop!" Huangfu Hongjun tried to struggle, but Huangfu Shong was much stronger than him, leaving his struggle futile.
In a few seconds, he could feel Zhang Fei [5]’s demon slave mark being planted into his soul, making him his new slave.
"You—"
"If I were you, I would control my anger; otherwise, my slave mark would torture you, and you would experience great pain." Zhang Fei [5] then looked at the people, who were frightened of him.
"I give you all two choices: obey me willingly or become my slaves like your emperor.
If you obey me, I will give you the opportunity to become powerful, but I will slaughter your clans if you dare to betray me, so the choice is up to you all."
Those people trembled violently once Zhang Fei [5] released his killing intent, making them even more suffocated.
"We... we will obey you, so please don’t enslave us."
"Traitors!" Huangfu Hongjun furiously shouted.
"Hahaha!" Zhang Fei [5] laughed as he pulled his killing intent back, and he sent the five beast ancestors back into the beast space after that.
Then, he took out several bottles of pills, and he asked Huangfu Fanbo to distribute them to the people.
"These pills are my first gift to all of you, and I will give you much better ones if you show your loyalty to me.
However, you must always remember my previous words; otherwise, your clans will disappear forever from this realm."
Their expressions changed with excitement after they saw the grade of the pills, especially since superior-grade pills are extremely rare in their realm.
Even if such pills were available, they would have to waste a lot of jewels to buy them, yet Zhang Fei [5] gave his pills to them for free.
"Thank you, Master."
Zhang Fei [5] then conveyed some orders to them.
"Leave and carry out my orders right now."
"Yes, Master."
After those people left, Zhang Fei [5] ordered Huangfu Hongjun to call his wives, sons, and daughters.
He did not enslave them, but he planted his soul mark into their souls.

After he installed the teleportation portal in the dungeon of the palace, Zhang Fei [5] immediately left the Huangfu Palace, and he took one of the princesses with him, leaving Huangfu Hongtian and his other family members desperate.
[Are you interested in this woman, Master?]
’No.’ Zhang Fei [5] looked at the princess, who was quite beautiful and graceful.
However, he did not have the slightest interest in her, and he took her with him for something.
"What’s your name?"
"Huangfu...
Huangfu Ziqian." The princess answered with a trembling voice.
"Hey!
You don’t have to be afraid of me because I won’t do anything to you." Huangfu Ziqian timidly looked at Zhang Fei [5].
"Where is your family’s best building?
I want to use it to open my shop, and I want you to help me take care of it."
"Huh?" Huangfu Ziqian found it hard to believe that Zhang Fei [5] would let a princess like her take care of his shop.
Moreover, she had never done such a job before, and she usually enjoyed everything from behind the palace.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly at her reaction.
"I chose you because you are the best among your sisters, and I need someone to communicate with Princess Qiang Yin."
"Do... do you also treat Princess Qiang Yin like us?"
"No." Zhang Fei [5] then continued.
"I will open my other shops in several other kingdoms, and I will ask the princesses of those kingdoms to take care of them.
Since you are all princesses, I believe you can communicate more easily.
I know you are not used to such work, but you will not be taking care of my shops alone, and I will assign some of my subordinates to help you."
"Are... are you sure the other princesses will be willing to help you?"
Zhang Fei [5] just smiled, making Huangfu Ziqian shiver.
"Show me your best building."
"Over there." Huangfu Zhiqian pointed to a three-story building.
"My family has many buildings, but that building is the best of them all.
Moreover, it was recently vacated, so you can use it whenever you want."
"Let’s go there."
Upon arriving inside the building, Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the gate leading to the Sky Dragon Realm before disappearing into it, leaving Huangfu Zhiqian in shock.
A while later, he returned with five members of the Demon Fox Group that he had intentionally left there.
Huangfu Zhiqian did not say a word as she watched Zhang Fei [5] distribute many items to the five women, such as pills, alchemy ingredients, Earth goods, and many more.
However, only the sex toys piqued her curiosity, especially since such items did not exist in her realm. ’What kind of items are those?
Why are they shaped so peculiar?’
"Are you interested in this item?" The five women of the Demon Fox Group giggled as Zhang Fei [5] showed Huangfu Zhiqian a dildo.
Since they had been following him for a long time, they naturally knew its function.
"You can have it if you are interested in it."
Huangfu Zhiqian accepted the dildo and squeezed it gently.
"How do I use this item?"
Zhang Fei [5] put his face closer to Huang Zhiqian’s ear and whispered to her about how to use it, causing her face to turn extremely red.
She immediately returned it to him and ran out of the building, but he could hear her grumbling and cursing him.
"Arrange all the items today and open the shop tomorrow, and that princess will be in charge of it."
"Yes, Master."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately followed Huangfu Zhiqian and took her to the Qiang Kingdom, where he met five other members of the Demon Fox Group.
Huangfu Zhiqian still didn’t say anything to Zhang Fei [5], but she was shocked by his ability to bring her to the Qiang Kingdom in such a short time.
After he confirmed that all the goods there were ready, Zhang Fei [5] asked his subordinates to open the shop tomorrow, and he took Huangfu Zhiqian to meet Qiang Yin at the Qiang Royal Palace.
"Huh?" Qiang Yin was surprised to see Zhang Fei [5] appear together with Huangfu Zhiqian.
"Why did you bring her here?"

"Zhiqian will take care of my shop in the Huangfu Kingdom, and since you will take care of the one in this kingdom, I want the two of you to work together in the future." Zhang Fei [5] then asked them.
"Do you two know the princesses of the Zhu, Wei, and Jiang Kingdoms?"
"Yes." Qiang Yin then told him.
"For the Zhu Kingdom, you can meet Princess Zhu Jing, and you can meet Princess Wei Xiaoya in the Wei Kingdom.
As for the Jiang Kingdom, they only have two princes, and their rulers are Emperor Jiang Bai and Empress Ling Yingfei."
Zhang Fei [5] thought for a moment, especially about the Jiang Kingdom.
"What is Jiang Bai’s character?"
"He’s strong, open-minded, and easy to talk to.
I think you won’t have any trouble talking to him, but he won’t necessarily be willing to meet you because he’s busy."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] wasn’t too worried about that.
"Do you have a lot of business right now?
If not, I want you to help me talk to Zhu Jing and Wei Xiaoya."
Qiang Yin shook her head in response.
"My brothers and ministers are taking care of everything, and I have handed over my old job to my subordinates, so I have a lot of free time now."
"In that case, let’s go now because I don’t have much free time."
Sometime later, Zhang Fei [5] and the two women had arrived at the Zhu Kingdom, and Qiang Yin immediately contacted Zhu Jing, asking her to meet them at a restaurant.
After they waited for about an hour, Zhu Jing finally arrived at the restaurant, but she was surprised by the presence of Zhang Fei [5] among the two women.
However, she immediately ignored him because his cultivation was too low for her to care; instead, she asked the two women.
"Since when did you two get along like this?"
"Hehe." Qiang Yin giggled in response.
"Zhu Jing, you know that we never get involved in our kingdom’s affairs directly, so the war between our kingdoms is none of our business.
Actually, we came here because my friend Zhang Fei needed your help."
"Hmm?" Zhu Jing raised an eyebrow as she looked at him.
"What do you need from me?"
"A building and a protection." Zhang Fei [5] then explained to Zhu Jing about his plans for his shop, but the princess seemed reluctant to help him, especially since they didn’t know each other.
He then placed a pill on the table, which caused her eyes to widen in surprise upon seeing its grade.
"My cultivation is indeed far below yours, but I am a Venerable Rank alchemist, and I concocted this Yin Purifying Pill myself.
Honestly, I can protect my shop myself, but I still have to travel to many realms, so I want to cooperate with you."
Zhu Jing took the Yin Purifying Pill and questioned him.
"What kind of cooperation do you want?
Do you want to share the profits of your shop with me?
If that is the case, I want a minimum of 45 percent of the profits, and I will ensure the security of your shop."
"Princess, you are too greedy if you ask for 45 percent of the profits." Zhu Jing fiercely glared at Zhang Fei [5], who immediately took out another pill.
"What are you most afraid of in your life?
Are you more afraid of losing your beauty due to aging, or is there something else that frightens you?"
Zhu Jing furrowed her brows.
"For a woman, beauty is everything, so aging is what I fear the most.
You two must agree with me, right, Qiang Yin and Huangfu Zhiqian?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1008: Wei Xiaoya
paragraphs: Qiang Yin nodded in agreement with Zhu Jing. "Isn’t that one of the reasons we cultivate? Unfortunately, nothing is eternal in this universe, and we will still grow old one day."

"There is one person who has no interest in beauty or staying young forever." Qiang Yin and Zhu Jing immediately turned to Huangfu Zhiqian, but they laughed after remembering that person. "Wei Xiaoya never cared about either of them, and she lived according to her own will without caring about people calling her an ugly and fat princess."
"Is Wei Xiaoya really that bad?" Zhang Fei [5] curiously asked.
*Bam... Bam...*

"Hahaha!" Zhu Jing laughed out loud as she banged on the table. "Hey! You don’t know that the people of the Wei kingdom secretly gave her the nickname ugly hippopotamus, but the news kept spreading from one mouth to another, and everyone in this realm finally found out about it. Emperor Wei was truly furious after he heard that, but Xiaoya stopped him and asked him to ignore those people, as she couldn’t care less about their opinions."

"Wei Xiaoya is really interesting." The three princesses looked at Zhang Fei [5] in confusion. "Why are you all looking at me like this? Do you think I should care about people’s opinions? They are not my family, friends, or acquaintances. I live for myself and the people who care about me, so I can’t care about their opinions. They can talk as much as they like about me, but I will kill them if they dare insult my family."
Zhu Jing just shook her head and pointed to the pill in her hand. "So, what does your previous question have to do with this pill?"

"This pill is the Youthful Retaining Pill, and you should be able to tell its effects from its name." Zhu Jing, as fast as lightning snatched the pill from Zhang Fei [5]’s hand; he could have stopped her, but he deliberately did not do so. "You don’t need to doubt it because many people have swallowed it, including the Alchemy Goddess."
"What?" The three princesses screamed when they heard the title. "Do... do you really know the Alchemy Goddess?"

"Is there any point in me lying to you guys?" Zhang Fei [5] touched their foreheads and shared his memories of speaking with Lin Jingxia. "Not only do I know her, but three of my wives are her disciples, so our relationship is very close. Therefore, you don’t need to doubt the effect of my pill, and it will restore your youth. However, this pill is not free; you must agree to help me manage and protect my shop in order to obtain it, or else you can forget about getting the pill. Moreover, no one can match this pill, including the Alchemy Goddess. If you waste this opportunity, you can only wait for the time for you to grow old."

Qiang Yin and Huangfu Zhiqian pursed their lips because they also wanted the pill, but Zhang Fei [5] didn’t give it to them. On the other hand, Zhu Jing stared at him with several thoughts in her head, but she immediately threw her crazy idea away. "Will I really stay young forever after taking this pill?"
"If you still don’t believe me, I’ll show you some of my wives’ images." Zhang Fei [5] once again touched Zhu Jing’s forehead and shared some images, such as Hu Lili, Hu Yue, and several others.
"Hey! Share with us too."

Zhang Fei [5] sighed and shared their image with Qiang Yin and Huangfu Zhiqian. Moments later, the three princesses stared at him dumbfounded, and he could see the jealousy in their eyes. "You three always feel beautiful, right? Unfortunately, all my wives are much prettier than all of you, and they became even more beautiful after swallowing my pills."

"All right! I agree to manage and protect your shop!" Zhu Jing immediately swallowed the pill, with the two princesses impatiently wanting to see its effects on her. "Hmm? How long do I have to wait for it to take effect?"
"A few minutes."

A few minutes later, they smelled an unpleasant odor from Zhu Jing’s body, and black liquid began to come out of her body, but she quickly cleaned it up. She then took out a mirror, but she didn’t see any changes in herself.

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at her. "That is a pill to maintain your youth and not a pill to restore your face to youth, so you will not see any changes in yourself. However, you do not need to worry about it, and I dare to guarantee that you will never age. If the effects are not as I said, you can take all the goods in my shop in the future."
"I see." Zhu Jing nodded in understanding. "In that case, you can come here in three days, and I will prepare a building for you during the time."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately stood up, followed by Qiang Yin and Huangfu Zhiqian. "Since my business here is finished, I will take them to see Wei Xiaoya."
"Okay." After they left the restaurant, a middle-aged woman appeared behind Zhu Jing. "What do you think of that young man, Aunt Wu?"

"Princess, you have to be careful of that man." Zhu Jing immediately turned to Aunt Wu. "He knew I was here even though I had suppressed my aura and presence as much as possible, and I noticed he glanced at me several times with a strange smile."
"Do you think he’s dangerous?"
Aunt Wu shook her head in response. "I can’t say for sure, but I can smell the thick smell of blood from his body, which means he has killed many people before."
"Can you investigate him for me, Aunt Wu?"

"Princess, I advise you not to do that, especially since he’s clearly not an ordinary young man." Zhu Jing raised her eyebrows, which prompted Aunt Wu to explain the situation to her. "As soon as they left this restaurant, I immediately lost track of him, and I couldn’t find him. Although I wasn’t very familiar with him, I could tell that he had no bad intentions toward you, and he just wanted to cooperate with you."
Zhu Jing nodded in understanding and stood up. "Aunt Wu, please send some people to start arranging the building near my private residence, and I want them to finish it in three days."
"Yes, Princess."
After Aunt Wu disappeared, Zhu Jing hurriedly left the restaurant with many questions about Zhang Fei [5] on her mind. ’I guess I’ll have to talk to him again in three days.’
"So, where are we going now? Are you going to call Wei Xiaoya to meet us?"
Qiang Yin pointed to the Wei Royal Palace. "Unlike Zhu Jing, Wang Xiaoya has always lived in the palace, so we have to go there to meet her."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] also looked towards the royal palace. "If Wang Xiaoya always lives there, how will she help me to manage my shop in this kingdom?"

"Haha." Qiang Yin softly laughed. "Hey, don’t judge Wang Xiaoya just from Zhu Jing’s previous story, especially since she is an expert in financial matters. In fact, there is no finance minister in this kingdom, and she handles everything herself from behind the palace."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [5] was surprised to hear that.

"Just pay attention to the situation in the royal capital; the situation is much better than the other kingdoms, right?" Zhang Fei [5] looked around them before nodding in agreement to Qiang Yin. "Once Wei Xiaoya took over the financial affairs of this kingdom, she overhauled the entire financial system, and she made it more structured. Under her control, there was no more money wasted, and their budget has always been in surplus for the past few decades. She allocated the surplus budget to develop many sectors in this kingdom, such as agriculture, animal husbandry, and others, which made this kingdom the most prosperous among the others. That’s why I was confused by You Shanyi’s reasons for controlling my father, and he should control her father instead."
Zhang Fei [5] himself didn’t know You Shanyi’s real reason yet, but he didn’t care much about it either. "Let’s go, we have to see Wang Xiaoya now."
Qiang Yin immediately led Zhang Fei [5] and Huangfu Zhiqian toward the Wei Royal Palace, and the two princesses right away showed their identities to the two guards standing at the entrance gate.
One of them immediately informed Wei Xiaoya of their arrival, but she refused to meet them, especially after she learned that Zhang Fei [5] was with the two princesses.
"Haha." Qiang Yin laughed after the guard conveyed Wei Xiaoya’s refusal. "She doesn’t like meeting men, and she doesn’t know you yet, so it’s natural that she refuses to meet us."
"How about just the two of us meeting her? I’m sure she won’t refuse us." Huangfu Zhiqian asked.
Instead, Qiang Yin posed a question to Zhang Fei [5]. "What do you think about that?"

"No need." Zhang Fei [5] then took the two princesses away from the royal palace area to a quiet place. Once they arrived there, he immediately brought them into an invisible state, which shocked them.

In a few moments, they were already inside the Wei Royal Palace, and they saw Wei Xiaoya gracefully enjoying many dishes in the garden in front of her room, leaving Qiang Yin and Huangfu Zhiqian speechless.
’You’re crazy! Why did you bring us to barge in here?’ Qiang Yin asked as she looked around the area, as did Huangfu Zhiqian, who looked scared because of Zhang Fei [5]’s action.

Zhang Fei [5] did not respond to them and focused more on observing Wei Xiaoya’s plump body, but he discovered that she was different from what she looked like from the outside. ’Did she use a special technique to shape her body like that? She’s definitely not fat, but she made herself that fat on purpose.’

Despite her fat body, Wei Xiaoya’s face was delicate and beautiful, with fair skin, gentle eyes, and soft lips. A blue gemstone sits on her forehead, matching her calm and graceful expression. Her long, straight black hair flows neatly down her back. She wore a blue and white robe that fit her body. Her chest was round and full, outlined under the fabric, offset by a distinguished and modest appearance.
’Is he interested in Wei Xiaoya? The way he looks at her is different from the way he looks at us.’ Both Qiang Yin and Huangfu Zhiqian wondered in their hearts.
"Hmm?" Wei Xiaoya immediately stopped eating and glared at them once Zhang Fei [5] canceled his invisibility, revealing their presence to her. "Guards, there’s—"
"Shh." Zhang Fei [5] had already moved behind Wei Xiaoya, making her freeze in fear. "Princess Wei, we have no ill intentions whatsoever, and I brought them here because you refused to meet us."

"Zhang Fei is right, Xiaoya." Qiang Yin pulled Huangfu Zhiqian toward them. After they arrived in front of Wei Xiaoya, she immediately continued speaking. "We’ve known each other for a long time, so you should know that we have no ill intentions toward you. Actually, he wanted to open an alchemy shop in your kingdom, and he had a close relationship with the alchemy goddess, but no outsider could buy property here. Therefore, I brought him here to see you, but you refused to meet us, so he barged in here."
"Sit." Zhang Fei [5] and the two princesses immediately sat in front of Wei Xiaoya. "Show me your pills first."
Zhang Fei [5] placed several pills in front of Wang Xiaoya, and their grade caused her jaw to drop. "I am a Venerable Rank alchemist, and I concoct these pills myself."

"Do you know how valuable a superior grade is in this realm?" Wei Xiaoya took one of the pills. "Our realm doesn’t have an alchemist with a rank as high as yours, so pills with such a grade are extremely rare here, and one pill can cost millions of jewels."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "I know about that, especially since this realm is almost the same as several other realms. I have opened my shops in all of those realms, and I want to open some shops here. To maintain balance between all the kingdoms, I will open one shop in each kingdom. I’m ready to open three shops in the Qiang, Zhu, and Huangfu kingdoms, so I hope you are willing to help me to open one in your kingdom."
"I see." Wei Xiaoya then asked. "What is your offer to me? Since you want to cooperate with me, you have to give me a suitable reciprocity, right?"

She allocated the surplus budget to develop many sectors in this kingdom, such as agriculture, animal husbandry, and others, which made this kingdom the most prosperous among the others.
That’s why I was confused by You Shanyi’s reasons for controlling my father, and he should control her father instead."
Zhang Fei [5] himself didn’t know You Shanyi’s real reason yet, but he didn’t care much about it either.
"Let’s go, we have to see Wang Xiaoya now."
Qiang Yin immediately led Zhang Fei [5] and Huangfu Zhiqian toward the Wei Royal Palace, and the two princesses right away showed their identities to the two guards standing at the entrance gate.
One of them immediately informed Wei Xiaoya of their arrival, but she refused to meet them, especially after she learned that Zhang Fei [5] was with the two princesses.
"Haha." Qiang Yin laughed after the guard conveyed Wei Xiaoya’s refusal.
"She doesn’t like meeting men, and she doesn’t know you yet, so it’s natural that she refuses to meet us."
"How about just the two of us meeting her?
I’m sure she won’t refuse us." Huangfu Zhiqian asked.
Instead, Qiang Yin posed a question to Zhang Fei [5].
"What do you think about that?"
"No need." Zhang Fei [5] then took the two princesses away from the royal palace area to a quiet place.
Once they arrived there, he immediately brought them into an invisible state, which shocked them.

In a few moments, they were already inside the Wei Royal Palace, and they saw Wei Xiaoya gracefully enjoying many dishes in the garden in front of her room, leaving Qiang Yin and Huangfu Zhiqian speechless.
’You’re crazy!
Why did you bring us to barge in here?’ Qiang Yin asked as she looked around the area, as did Huangfu Zhiqian, who looked scared because of Zhang Fei [5]’s action.

Zhang Fei [5] did not respond to them and focused more on observing Wei Xiaoya’s plump body, but he discovered that she was different from what she looked like from the outside. ’Did she use a special technique to shape her body like that?
She’s definitely not fat, but she made herself that fat on purpose.’
Despite her fat body, Wei Xiaoya’s face was delicate and beautiful, with fair skin, gentle eyes, and soft lips.
A blue gemstone sits on her forehead, matching her calm and graceful expression.
Her long, straight black hair flows neatly down her back.
She wore a blue and white robe that fit her body.
Her chest was round and full, outlined under the fabric, offset by a distinguished and modest appearance.
’Is he interested in Wei Xiaoya?
The way he looks at her is different from the way he looks at us.’ Both Qiang Yin and Huangfu Zhiqian wondered in their hearts.
"Hmm?" Wei Xiaoya immediately stopped eating and glared at them once Zhang Fei [5] canceled his invisibility, revealing their presence to her.
"Guards, there’s—"
"Shh." Zhang Fei [5] had already moved behind Wei Xiaoya, making her freeze in fear.
"Princess Wei, we have no ill intentions whatsoever, and I brought them here because you refused to meet us."
"Zhang Fei is right, Xiaoya." Qiang Yin pulled Huangfu Zhiqian toward them.
After they arrived in front of Wei Xiaoya, she immediately continued speaking.
"We’ve known each other for a long time, so you should know that we have no ill intentions toward you.
Actually, he wanted to open an alchemy shop in your kingdom, and he had a close relationship with the alchemy goddess, but no outsider could buy property here.
Therefore, I brought him here to see you, but you refused to meet us, so he barged in here."
"Sit." Zhang Fei [5] and the two princesses immediately sat in front of Wei Xiaoya.
"Show me your pills first."
Zhang Fei [5] placed several pills in front of Wang Xiaoya, and their grade caused her jaw to drop.
"I am a Venerable Rank alchemist, and I concoct these pills myself."
"Do you know how valuable a superior grade is in this realm?" Wei Xiaoya took one of the pills.
"Our realm doesn’t have an alchemist with a rank as high as yours, so pills with such a grade are extremely rare here, and one pill can cost millions of jewels."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her.
"I know about that, especially since this realm is almost the same as several other realms.
I have opened my shops in all of those realms, and I want to open some shops here.
To maintain balance between all the kingdoms, I will open one shop in each kingdom.
I’m ready to open three shops in the Qiang, Zhu, and Huangfu kingdoms, so I hope you are willing to help me to open one in your kingdom."
"I see." Wei Xiaoya then asked.
"What is your offer to me?
Since you want to cooperate with me, you have to give me a suitable reciprocity, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1009: Wei Xiaoya Agreed
paragraphs: "The most suitable reciprocity is me." Qiang Yin and Huangfu Zhiqian facepalmed as soon as Zhang Fei [5] said that, and Wei Xiaoya looked at him with a confused look. "I’m handsome, and you’re beautiful, so we should be a perfect couple, right?"
Wei Xiaoya’s eyes blinked repeatedly, as she couldn’t believe that Zhang Fei [5] would say something like that to her.

’Narcissistic!’ Despite this, Qiang Yin and Huangfu Zhiqian were aware that Zhang Fei [5] was indeed handsome, but unfortunately, he did not show the slightest interest in them, and he only considered them as his acquaintances.

Zhang Fei [5] propped his chin with both hands, looked at her eyes, and spoke to her again. "I’m in my early twenties, but my cultivation has already reached the Divine Transcend Realm. Additionally, I’m a skilled alchemist, a grandmaster rank blacksmith, a rank 5 array master, and a sovereign swordmaster. I don’t think you will be able to find a man like me anywhere, so you’re lucky that I like you."
Wei Xiaoya still didn’t say anything in response to Zhang Fei [5], especially since her brain was having difficulty digesting his shamelessness and narcissism.
On the other hand, Qiang Yin and Huangfu Zhiqian are shocked by his revelation. ’Did he really master the three fields as well?’

"Huftt!" Wei Xiaoya exhaled heavily. "I acknowledge your excellence, but I find you to be quite shameless and excessively narcissistic! We’ve only met this time, but you dare to say that you like me."

"Hehehe." Zhang Fei [5] softly laughed. "Princess, liking someone doesn’t mean we have known each other for years or even decades first, and such a feeling can come at any time without us realizing it, which is called love at first sight."

"Hmm?" Wei Xiaoya’s expression changed slightly upon hearing the phrase ’love at first sight’, and Zhang Fei [5] noticed her reaction. "Love at first sight is simply bullshit, and I will never believe it!

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] did not immediately reply to Wei Xiaoya, and he seriously pondered her reaction. "Based on your reaction, I’m sure you’ve experienced love at first sight in the past, but the outcome was not as you expected, and you suffered greatly because of it. My guess is correct, right?"
Wei Xiaoya’s face darkened, and she pointed her index finger at the exit. "Leave me, or—"

"To be honest, I understand your pain, especially because I experienced a similar situation with my first girlfriend." Wei Xiaoya furrowed her brow, but Zhang Fei immediately began recounting his past relationships with Chen Xin and Zhang He, which shocked her and the other two princesses. "I don’t know what happened to you in the past, but I’m sure it wasn’t as painful as mine. My blood brother stole my girlfriend, and they framed me like that."
Wei Xiaoya took a deep breath before nodding to him. "You’re right, your love story is sadder than mine."

"Unlike you, I never look back at my past, and I have moved far forward, leaving my sadness behind." Wei Xiaoya lowered her face after Zhang Fei [5] said that. "I won’t lie to you, and I have more or less a hundred women by my side."
"Huh?" Wei Xiaoya suddenly looked up at Zhang Fei [5], as did Qiang Yin and Huangfu Zhiqian, who stared at him in shock. "Are you kidding me? How could you possibly have that many women?"
Zhang Fei [5] shrugged in response. "What else? I’m handsome, suave, and talented."

"You are too narcissistic!" The three women shouted loudly at him, attracting the attention of the guards and servants. However, Wei Xiaoya ordered them to shut their ears and mouths, especially regarding Zhang Fei [5]’s presence in her private courtyard.

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] then took out a device. "I know you won’t believe me, but all my women live under one roof. They have a harmonious relationship, and they are much closer than blood sisters. I won’t say more about them, and you three can see for yourselves."

The three princesses immediately looked at the Qi screen that appeared from inside the device, and they could see all of Zhang Fei [5]’s women there after he injected his memories into it. On the screen, they could see all the women, both the old and the young, blending together. The sight of the women happily talking and joking with each other perplexed the three princesses, especially since their number was so large but their relationship was so warm.
Half an hour later, the Qi screen disappeared by itself. "This device is a memory extractor, and what you see just now is a small part of my memories with them."
’This man is insane!’ How could all those women be willing to share him with so many of them?’ The three princesses are inwardly wondering.
"Do you believe me now, Princess?" Zhang Fei [5] asked with a wide grin.

Wei Xiaoya gave him a light nod. "I believe you, but your relationship with them has nothing to do with me. Moreover, I don’t like a bastard who divides his heart between so many women at once, so you must prepare a worthy offer if you want to cooperate with me."

"Did you disguise yourself like this on purpose to keep all the men away from you?" Zhang Fei [5]’s question confused Huangfu Zhiqian and Qiang Yin, but they could see Wei Xiaoya’s expression turning serious because of it. "I don’t know how you can disguise yourself like this, but I know that this is not your true self."
Wei Xiaoya asked immediately. "How did you guess that? This is the real me, and I enjoy being like this. If those men dislike me, they’re dumb and don’t deserve to be near me, even as servants."

"Princess, I like you because of your character like this. I personally will say go to hell to those who have a bad opinion about me, considering they are just insignificant people." Wei Xiaoya wanted to say something, but she and the two princesses immediately fell into a daze as Zhang Fei [5] turned into a fat man. "Just like you, I have the ability to completely change my appearance, so I can recognize that the current you is not your true self but a disguise to keep those men away from you."
"Is this really your disguise, Xiaoya?" Qiang Yin asked.
Wei Xiaoya did not respond to Qiang Yin and instead directed her question to Zhang Fei [5]. "How can you have the same abilities as me?"

"You’re wrong, Princess." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head in reply. "The effects of our abilities are the same, but I believe our abilities are different. Since I’ve shown you so many things, you can at least show me your true form, right?"

Wei Xiaoya thought for a moment before canceling her ability, and her appearance quickly changed, leaving Qiang Yin and Huangfu Zhiqian shocked. Both of them had known her for so long, and everyone in their realm knew her as the fatty princess. In reality, she was a beauty, and her figure was truly exquisite with deep curves. Her posture was firm, her gaze focused, and she carried the air of someone intelligent, strong, and disciplined.
*Clasp*
Zhang Fei [5] clasped his hands. "As expected! You are such a beauty!"
"Humph!" Wei Xiaoya immediately returned to her fat form before saying to the two princesses. "Don’t tell anyone else about my true form! Do you guys understand?"
"Yeah." Both Qiang Yin and Huangfu Zhiqian nodded at her. "I didn’t expect that you had fooled everyone in this realm, including your family, for so long."

Wei Xiaoya simply smiled before looking at Zhang Fei [5], who seemed to be thinking about something seriously. "What are you thinking while looking at me like that? Are you thinking about molesting me?"
"Hey! I’m not a molester but a lover." Wei Xiaoya snorted at Zhang Fei [5]. "Have you ever heard of the Earth?"
"You—" Wei Xiaoya was shocked by his question.

Wei Xiaoya’s reaction convinced Zhang Fei [5] that his guess about her was correct. He turned to the two princesses before standing up and leading the Wei princess away from them, confusing Qiang Yin and Huangfu Zhiqian.

Upon arriving at a different location, Zhang Fei [5] immediately posed a question to Wei Xiaoya. "Are you a reincarnator from Earth? You don’t need to lie to me because your reaction has already answered my guess, and I myself am an earthling."
"Huh?" Zhang Fei [5]’s revelation shocked Wei Xiaoya again. "Are you really an earthling?"

Zhang Fei [5] took out his old wallet, which he had kept in the system inventory for a long time. He then showed his earth identity to her, giving her a feeling of longing. "I don’t know when you lived and died on Earth, but this is my identity there."

"How can you become a cultivator?" Wei Xiaoya took the ID card and asked him. "A few years ago, I went to Earth and spent some time there, but there was no Qi there, so you shouldn’t be able to cultivate."

"Just like you, I died once, but I didn’t reincarnate like you, and someone brought me back from my death." Wei Xiaoya doubted Zhang Fei [5], as she could not believe that resurrection was real. "There’s no point in me lying to you, okay? So, when did you die?"
Wei Xiaoya released a soft sigh. "I don’t know how much time has passed since I died, but I died in 2010 due to depression after my boyfriend cheated on me."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] seemed confused by that. "If you died in 2010, that means you’ve only been dead for about 15 years, but the current you is already thousands of years old."
"You are wrong in assuming that I am a reincarnator." Wei Xiaoya returned the ID card to him. "I’m not a reincarnator, and this isn’t my real body."
Zhang Fei [5] did not expect that Wei Xiaoya’s identity was so complicated. "So, your soul took over this body?"

"Yes." Wei Xiaoya nodded to him. "I remember that I was dead, but I don’t know how long I was dead. I also don’t know how my soul got into this body, but I was already in it when I opened my eyes again. According to the information I got, the real Wang Xiaoya died for no apparent reason, and I woke up in this body when they were about to cremate her body."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "So, what was your old name?"
"Just call me Wei Xiaoya." Wei Xiaoya then asked him. "How did you die?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed wryly as he still always felt that his death was ridiculous. "I died because a woman fell from the sky, and she brought me back to life. However, I don’t know her identity or how she managed to bring me back to life, especially since she had already disappeared when I woke up."

"How could you guess that I am a reincarnator?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately told Wei Xiaoya about his suspicions, which were based on the financial system she implemented in the Wei Kingdom. "Sigh! If you weren’t an earthling, you would never have noticed it."

"That’s true." Zhang Fei [5] then asked. "Are you willing to help me open my shop here? If you are willing, I will help you become much stronger than now, and you won’t have to think about those nuisances."

"How are you going to help me if your cultivation is four major stages below mine?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately activated the soul link and enveloped Wang Xiaoya with his aura. "How... how is this possible? Your... your aura is even much stronger than my father and the other emperors."

Zhang Fei [5] smiled at that. "Do you think I could learn all that if I were an ordinary cultivator? I have revealed many secrets, so you have to believe that cooperating with me is your best opportunity."
"Let’s go back first; the two women are confused about our situation." Wei Xiaoya immediately led him back to the two princesses.
"Have you two discussed it?" Qiang Yin asked them once they returned.

Wei Xiaoya sat down in front of them first. "I’ve decided to help him open his shop, but I need a few days to prepare the building, so you guys can go back now and come back here when everything is ready."

"I’ll stay here because I want to talk to you more." Zhang Fei [5] immediately sent the two princesses back to their respective kingdoms before returning to Wei Xiaoya. "How about you accompany me to walk around your kingdom?"
"Are you not embarrassed to walk with a fat woman like me?"
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] immediately pulled her to her feet. "Let’s go now."

chapters.title: Chapter 1010: Emperor And Empress Wei
paragraphs: After Qing Huang waited three days, his subordinate finally returned, but he gave him some unpleasant news. "Did Yin Cheng tell you why he refused to help us?"
"Ancestor Yin didn’t tell me anything, and he asked you not to send anyone else to see him because he would still refuse your request."
Qing Huang did not ask further and went to see Tian Jingxuan and Shi Yan, and he informed them about Yin Cheng’s refusal to help them, which angered the two.

In the end, the three decided to go to Spring City and meet Yin Cheng, but the Yin Ancestor still refused their request, mainly because Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already shown off his strength to him and his clan members.

Yin Cheng was actually furious about Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s actions a few days ago, but he was neither senile nor stupid, and he didn’t want to get into trouble with a young monster like him. Moreover, he had seen his pills and several other items, and he believed that being on his side was the most correct decision.

Qing Huang and the other two eventually returned empty-handed, which made them even more furious. However, they immediately devised another plan to deal with Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he discovered all their plans through Tian Kui and Serpentera.

If it were not for the Cao Clan and Qi Lai, Zhang Xiaolong [3] would not have held himself back, and he would have immediately retaliated against Qing Huang and the other two. Moreover, he didn’t want to be disturbed by anything, as he was still focused on improving his water element and elemental laws.

In the Wei Kingdom, the presence of Zhang Fei [5] and Wei Xiaoya attracted the residents of the royal capital, and both of them could hear many people whispering about them, especially about the body of the Wei Princess.

paragraphs: "How can you see my daughter’s heart and soul, Zhang Fei?" Hun Liying curiously asked.
"Here." Wei Xiaoya handed the Hun plaque to her mother, which surprised her. "Zhang Fei is Uncle Hun’s newest disciple, so you don’t need to be surprised if he can do such a thing."

"Oh?" Hun Liying accepted the plaque and took out her own, and she nodded in understanding after confirming the authenticity of Zhang Fei [5]’s plaque and returned it to him. "I didn’t expect that you were my brother’s disciple, but I’m glad to hear this. Since you like my daughter, how about you two get married as soon as possible?"
"No!" Wei Xiaoya immediately refused. "Mother! I just met him today, and I don’t like him because he has too many women by his side, so you should throw your idea of marrying us far from your mind!"
"If you don’t like him, why did you kiss him so passionately?" Emperor Wei asked with a playful smile.

"All right, you don’t have to argue anymore, especially since we’ve seen you two kissing so passionately with our own eyes." Hun Liying then directed her question to Zhang Fei [5]. "How many women do you have now?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] rubbed his nose whenever he felt awkward. "More or less a hundred women, and all of them live together in my pavilion."

Emperor Wei and Hun Lingyi were shocked to hear that, but they were even more shocked to hear that so many women could live under the same roof. Zhang Fei then used the memory extractor to show them some of his memories, and they were amazed by the situation among the women in the pavilion.
’Ugh! They will force me to marry him!’ Wei Xiaoya inwardly grumbled.

As Wei Xiaoya expected, Hun Lingyi spoke to her directly. "Xiaoya, you can see for yourself that they are so harmonious, which means they have accepted each other. Therefore, I think there is no problem if you marry him, and they will definitely accept your presence among them. Moreover, he is my brother’s disciple, so he is worthy to be your husband."
"But, Mother, I—"

Hun Lingyi glared at her daughter before speaking to her husband. "Husband, announce to the people of our kingdom that our daughter has found her future husband, and we will arrange their marriage as soon as possible."
Wei Xiaoya ferociously glared at Zhang Fei [5] as if she wanted to pounce on him, but he responded to her with a triumphant smile, making her helplessly sigh in her heart.

"Yeah." Emperor Wei immediately contacted his ministers and ordered them to announce their relationship to the public, and he also ordered them to announce Zhang Fei [5]’s status as Hun Di’s disciple. "How about you join us at our palace?"

"Father-in-law, please forgive me, but I have to go to the Jiang Kingdom now, and I will take Xiaoya with me." Wei Xiaoya felt frustrated because Zhang Fei kept referring to her father in that manner. "After we meet Jiang Bai, I will bring him back, and we will talk after that."

"What do you want from Jiang Bai?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately explained to them about his plan to open the shop in the Jiang Kingdom and the other kingdoms. Hun Liying directly gave him a token. "Show it to their guards, and they will take you to see Ling Yingfei directly. If you can help them, they will be willing to fully support you and your shop."
"Thank you, mother-in-law." Zhang Fei [5] immediately took the irritated Wei Xiaoya away.

"Haha." Hun Liying softly laughed and hugged her husband. "After waiting for so long, I can finally be relieved that our daughter has found the right man. Although I feel strange about the number of his women, I am amazed by his ability to get so many beautiful women, and he can make them live harmoniously under one roof."
"I agree with you." Emperor Wei led his wife to leave the building. "Did you feel anything unusual from him?"
"Zhang Fei is a demon."
"That’s right." Emperor Wei nodded in agreement. "Even though it was faint, I smelled a demon scent from his body, but I was sure that his human form was also real, which confused me."

Hun Liying gave a light nod. "I’m confused about that myself, but we don’t need to think too much about it, and we can ask him directly after they come back. Even so, I’m sure he’s not an evil demon; otherwise, my brother wouldn’t have been willing to accept him as his disciple, and he would have killed him directly."
"How about you contact my brother-in-law?"

"You have heard for yourself that my brother is in the Star Tower with his other disciples, so we should not disturb him." Hun Liying then contacted someone to prepare for the formalization of Zhang Fei [5] and Wei Xiaoyan’s relationship. "Husband, you can return to the palace by yourself, and I will go see Aunt Ming now."
"All right."
Zhang Fei [5] and Wei Xiaoya had already arrived at the Jiang Kingdom, but the Wei princess continued to put on a sullen look. "Why are you like this?"

"Isn’t this because of you?" Wei Xiaoya asked angrily. "I already said that I don’t like a bastard with too many women like you, but you forcibly kissed me without my consent, and my parents are now forcing me to marry you."
Zhang Fei [5] instead teased her. "You said that I kissed you forcibly, but you kissed me back on your own, and you clearly enjoyed our kiss."
"Humph! I don’t care about you anymore!" Wei Xiaoya snorted and sped up toward the Jiang Royal Palace.
A while later, they had arrived there, and Zhang Fei [5] immediately showed the token to the guards, one of whom hurriedly led them to meet Ling Yingfei.

"Little Ya!" Ling Yingfei called out before running towards them and hugging Wei Xiaoya like her own daughter. She then looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "Your mother just contacted me, and I didn’t expect you to get such a handsome young man as your husband."

Wei Xiaoya could only sigh upon hearing that, and she hugged Ling Yingfei back for a moment before letting her go. "Aunt Ling, I brought Zhang Fei here to treat Uncle Jiang, and he needs some help from him."
"Oh?" Ling Yingfei was surprised to hear that. "Are you a physician, Zhang Fei?"
"No." Zhang Fei [5] replied with a shake of his head. "Even though I am not a physician, I have a special method to cure your husband, and you will like the results."
Ling Yingfei seemed interested when she heard that, and she pulled Wei Xiaoya with her. "Please follow us, and we will meet my husband now.
Along the way, Ling Yingfei interrogated Wei Xiaoya about her relationship with Zhang Fei [5], leaving the Wei princess helpless.
On the way, suddenly someone shouted at them. "Hey! Fatty Ya! When did you get here?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately turned to the two princes, Jiang Ren and Jiang Hu. He was eager to smack the second prince, but he held himself back immediately.

"Hmm?" Jiang Ren also looked at Zhang Fei [5], but his gaze was clearly condescending and filled with disgust for him. "Let’s go somewhere else, Hu’er. We don’t need to get close to people like them."
"Hahaha." Jiang Hu laughed and followed his big brother away, but he shouted at Zhang Fei [5]. "Hey, kid! I advise you not to get too close to Fatty Ya, or you’ll become fat and ugly like her."
Ling Yingfei sighed heavily because of her two sons’ behavior. "Little Ya, I—"
"No need, Aunt." Wei Xiaoya shook her head. "I don’t care about their insult, so you don’t need to apologize to me."

"They are just virgin frogs who don’t know true beauty." Ling Yingfei frowned after Zhang Fei [5] said that, but he couldn’t care less about her reaction. "Compared to your two sons, I understand and have more experience with women than them."
Wei Xiaoya spoke straightaway. "Aunt Ling, Zhang Fei has around a hundred women by his side, so he is indeed much more experienced than Ren and Hu."
"Huh?" The expression on Ling Yingfei’s face was filled with shock. "How can your parents allow you to be with him if he already has so many women by his side?"
"Of course, it’s because I am handsome and talented." Zhang Fei [5] blurted out. "Let’s meet your husband, and I’ll take Xiaoya for a walk somewhere else after this."
’This brat is so impudent and has no respect!’ Despite her annoyance, Ling Yingfei said nothing and continued leading them.
On the other hand, Wei Xiaoya kept glancing at Zhang Fei [5] in annoyance, but he only smiled casually in response.
They soon reached a room where Jiang Bai appeared to be busy making numerous checks. "Oh? When did you come, Little Ya?"

"How... how could you become a fox beast?

"This is my other secret." Wei Xiaoya felt strange hearing Zhang Fei [5] speak in his fox form.

Actually, my three identities are already known to many people, including my master and those powerful cultivators of the Xianjin Realm."
"I see." Wei Xiaoya nodded in understanding.
"Return to your human form; I feel strange talking to a giant fox like this."
Soon, Zhang Fei [5] had returned to human form, and he took Wei Xiaoya’s hand directly.
"As I said before, I am attracted to you because of your heart and soul.
I know our relationship happened too suddenly, but I hope you are willing to give me a chance, and I will prove to you that I sincerely like you."
"I don’t know." Wei Xiaoya pulled her hand back.
"Like I told you, I died of depression after my boyfriend cheated on me, and I could never trust any man after that.
