My mother is obviously preparing for our wedding, and I can’t refuse her.
I will marry you, but I will never truly be your wife."
Zhang Fei [5] smiled at that.
"I’m not someone who gives up easily, okay?
If you become my wife, I will make you one physically and spiritually, and you will know that polygamous relationships are not as bad as you imagine, especially with a husband like me."
"You are too narcissistic!" Wei Xiaoya shouted at him with great annoyance.
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [5] chuckled and gave Wei Xiaoya a few pills, confusing her.
"My basic pills will improve your foundation, and the Yin Purifying Pill will speed up your cultivation.
The other two pills are beauty pills, and no alchemist has them except me."
"Beauty pills?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her.
"Once you swallow both of them, you can see for yourself the changes in your true form.
You should not hesitate and swallow them now, and you will be surprised by their effects."

chapters.title: Chapter 1013: Toward The Paradise Realm
paragraphs: Wei Xiaoya was already standing in front of the mirror in her true form, and she rubbed her face in disbelief, especially since she had become much younger after swallowing the Beauty Restoring Pill. "Where did you get these magical pills?"

"The Star Tower." Wei Xiaoya looked at Zhang Fei [5] through the mirror. "You still don’t know much, and that tower comes from the realm beyond the Three Mortal Realms, which is called the Paradise Realm."

"What?" Wei Xiaoya screamed softly as she faced him. "Does the realm beyond really exist? I’ve heard Uncle Hun talk about it with my parents, and he heard it from Senior Xia Tian, but he himself doesn’t have any clear information about it."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "The Paradise Realm really exists, and the Seven Divine Realms are not the end of cultivation. After we reach the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, we will break through to the Five Celestial Realms. However, we will never be able to break through to that stage as long as we stay here, and we must go to that realm first, especially since we need the Celestial Qi to break through."
"The Five Celestial Realms and the Celestial Qi." Wei Xiaoya muttered in disbelief. "How did you know all that information?"

"The Star Tower." Zhang Fei [5] then explained to her about the tower and his encounter with Wan Jiang and the others. "The Divine Ascension Realm is still far from our reach, but I have found a way to go to the Paradise Realm without having to reach that stage first, and I plan to send one of my clones there."
"Clones?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "Actually, I have five clones, and this one is my fifth clone."
"Huh?" Wei Xiaoya was stunned. "How is that possible? Does that mean your true cultivation is much higher than this? As far as I know, our clone would only have half or less of our true strength."

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed in response. "My clones are not a clone technique, but I used my demon abilities to create them, so they are ordinary clones. My current cultivation is my true cultivation, and I managed to reach this stage in three years thanks to my status as a dual cultivator and some other things."
Wei Xiaoya released a soft sigh. "So, where is your real body? How are you going to go to the Paradise Realm without breaking through to the Divine Ascension Realm first?"

"My real body is at the Star Tower with my wife and others, including my master." Zhang Fei [5] then told her about the Jia Yuyan and the Sovereign Heaven Realm. "I plan to send one of my clones to the Paradise Realm today, and he will arrive there in a few months. However, I haven’t thought about exploring that realm yet, and I will wait until I am fully prepared. At that time, I will bring them all there, and we will become stronger faster."
"How are you going to bring them there?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened a gate to the Earth before bringing Wei Xiaoya there.
"Huh?" Wei Xiaoya looked at the area around them in shock. "Isn’t this the Earth? How did we arrive here so quickly?"

Zhang Fei [5] pointed at the gate. "This gate is one of my abilities as a heavenly fox, and it allows me to travel to all the realms I’ve visited before. I’ve already confirmed with someone, and that person told me that I can use my gate to connect the Paradise Realm and the Three Mortal Realms, so my clone will go there first, and I’ll bring them all there in the future."
"I see." Wei Xiaoya nodded in understanding, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately brought her back to the Grand Royal Realm.
Knock... Knock...
Someone suddenly knocked on the door and informed Wei Xiaoya. "Princess, your mother asked you to bring your fiancé to the dining room, and the others are waiting for you two there."
"We’ll be there soon." Wei Xiaoya sighed heavily and returned to her fat form. "Let’s go now."
When they arrived at the dining room, Zhang Fei [5] saw a young man and a young woman, and both of them were one and two minor stages stronger than Wei Xiaoya.
Wei Xiaoya told Zhang Fei [5] that the young man was her big brother, Wei Zhutong. Meanwhile, the young woman is her big sister, Wei Xiaolu.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately used his demon eyes to examine the two before raising his eyebrows. ’These two are not good people, especially Wei Xiaolu.’
Wei Zhutong briefly looked at Zhang Fei [5] before continuing his conversation with the Wei Emperor, but Wei Xiaolu, on the other hand, stared at Wei Xiaoya with hatred and envy.
Wei Xiaolu then gave Zhang Fei [5] a flirtatious look and mumbled something under her breath. However, he ignored her and followed Wei Xiaoya before sitting beside her.
Wei Xiaolu was furious because of Zhang Fei [5]’s attitude. ’Tch! What’s so good about this ugly bitch? Why does he care more about her than me?’
After they had gathered, Hun Liying ordered the maids to serve the dishes, and they enjoyed them while talking about casual things.
Both Wei Zhutong and Wei Xiaolu were surprised when their mother introduced Zhang Fei [5] as their uncle’s disciple, but the Wei prince did not think much of it and enjoyed himself.

Unlike her brother, Wei Xiaolu tried to tease Zhang Fei [5] using her legs, but he avoided her action, which angered her further. She wanted to mock Wei Xiaoya, but she abandoned her intention straight away, especially since their mother loved her so much.

The Wei Emperor and Hun Liying tried to confirm Zhang Fei [5]’s demon identity during their dinner, and he didn’t hide it from them. Despite this, they didn’t mind it because Hun Di was willing to accept him as his disciple.

Wei Xiaoya was furious once Hun Liying told her that she would marry Zhang Fei [5] in a week, but she could only sigh in resignation and agree to her mother’s wishes. However, she continued to blame him in her heart, especially since he was the one who caused their situation to become like that.
After they finished their dinner, Hu Liying asked Zhang Fei [5] to stay at the royal palace, and she asked him to stay with Wei Xiaoya, making her continue to grumble in her heart.

Zhang Fei [5] did not disturb Wei Xiaoya to rest and contacted Feng Xishui, informing him about their wedding plans. After that, he went to meet Leng Xueyan in her dream, where they spent time together.
[Congratulations! Your water element has been upgraded to the intermediate stage.]
[Congratulations! Your water elemental law has been upgraded to the intermediate stage.]

"The water in this pond is indeed extraordinary; my water element and elemental laws are improving faster than others." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened his eyes and shot out of the life pond, finding Jia Yuyan waiting for him. "Has anything happened in the past three days?"
"No." Jia Yuyan then asked him. "Have you made a decision yet?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "Cao Ren and the others will probably arrive sooner, so I was thinking of sending one of my clones to the paradise realm tonight. However, we must cover his departure from Tian Jingxuan and the others, or they will interfere with our affairs, and they might escape there."

"Sigh." Jia Yuyan released a heavy sigh after hearing that, as she did not expect that Tian Jingxuan and the other two would turn against Zhang Xiaolong [3], and it all happened because of her mistake. "Can you do anything about them?"
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled in response. "I already knew their rotten hearts, so I already did something about them from the start, and I just need to activate it now."
"Are you going to send them to the dream?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened the gate. "Let’s go to the main city."
"Yeah."
As soon as they arrived at the main city, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately activated his dream ability. He sent the subconscious Tian Jingxuan, Qing Huang, and Shi Yan to the dream.

After that, they went to the Tiantang Mountain, and Jia Yuyan asked Han Ling to meet them there. Since his fourth clone was still following You Shanyi, Zhang Xiaolong [3] summoned Feltia [2] out of the training space to go to the Paradise Realm.

Before long, Han Ling arrived in front of them, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately gave him a device. "Old Han, I will go to the Paradise Realm with you today, but I will not stay there, and I will come back here again. Once I am ready to explore that realm, I will go there again, and I will look for you through this device."

"I will wait for you there." Han Ling turned to Jia Yuan. "I guess it’s time for us to part ways, Senior Jia. Once we arrive there, I will go straight to the Floral Mirage Domain, and I will wait for you two there."
"That’s good." Jia Yuyan immediately took out the key and activated it, causing the sky to split open and a light tunnel to descend from there. "Go now! Otherwise, people will come here."
Feltia [2] immediately took out Feng Jiu’s flying artifact, took Han Ling aboard it, and flew it straight into the light tunnel.

Once they disappeared, Jia Yuyan immediately deactivated the portal and turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "With the speed of your flying artifact, you will probably arrive there in six months, but you can get there faster if you use many jewels to speed it up."
"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked into the distance. "For now, we just need to wait for the Cao Clan and Qi Lai to arrive, and I will focus on my seclusion again after that."
Wan Jiang suddenly appeared in front of them. "Why are you impatient to go to my realm? Are you thinking of meeting Young Miss Luo at the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary earlier?"
"Do you have any relationship with the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary?" Jia Yuan asked in shock.

"My childhood friend, Luo Yunxiao, is the princess of the Eternal Lotus Sanctuary." Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s answer further shocked Jia Yuyan, and she then replied to Wan Jiang. "Old man, I know my limits, so I’m not crazy enough to go there. As you already know, I’m a heavenly fox, and I’ve confirmed that my gate ability can connect two realms, but I can only do so if I’ve been there before. Therefore, I sent my clone there, and he’ll return here as soon as he gets there."
Wan Jiang nodded in understanding. "Doesn’t that mean your efforts in the Star Tower will be in vain?"

"Haha! Why would it be in vain?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head. "There are so many free and valuable treasures in your tower, so I want to get them for our future provisions in the Paradise Realm."

Wan Jiang let out a heavy sigh at that. "I still don’t understand how you trained them, but the progress of all your women is truly extraordinary compared to the last time I saw them in the Soul Challenge. Unfortunately, their strength is not enough even for these upper realms, let alone the Paradise Realm. Therefore, you should think twice before bringing them there, or they will be depressed if you bring them there too early."
"Yeah, you’re right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then hugged Jia Yuyan’s waist. "Old man, I’ll go back to my residence now."
After they disappeared, Wan Jiang looked up at the sky above the stone monument, and his three disciples appeared behind him. "Do you think that kid will really come back here right away, Master?"

"Do you really believe him, Xun’er?" Hua Mei’er asked her sister. "That kid is quite arrogant and overconfident, so I’m sure he won’t come back here right away, and he’ll force himself to explore our realm."

"Hey! Have you forgotten what he did to you last time?" Hua Mei’er turned to Sima Yun, and her body immediately trembled after remembering what happened that day. "You’d better watch your words, or he’ll do worse to you, and you’ll submit to him."
Hua Mei’er hugged her own body. "Stop! Don’t scare me like that!"

"I actually agree with Mei’er." The three of them turned to Wan Jiang in surprise, but he looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s residence. "I don’t know what that kid is planning next, but I’m sure he won’t bring his clone back here right away, and he might do something there. At least I’ve warned him, but the decision is in his hands."
After that, the four of them disappeared from the Tiantang Mountain and returned to the southern region of the realm.

paragraphs: Zhang Fei relaxed under a tree while watching Xian Xianqin and the others try to create their domains. Among them, only Bai Tian’er managed to create her domain, and she managed to create two. One based on her light element, and the other based on soul cultivation.
"I didn’t expect you to have a new wife, not to mention she is your master’s niece." Bai Tian’er spoke as she approached Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei pulled Bai Tian’er into his lap and gave her a brief kiss. "I liked Wei Xiaoya after I saw her soul, but I didn’t plan to marry her so soon. Our marriage happened so quickly because her mother, Hun Liying, couldn’t wait to marry her off. She and her husband were spying on us from afar, and she immediately arranged our marriage after she found out that I was Master Hun’s disciple."

Bai Tian’er nodded in understanding, leaned against his chest, and held his hands. "How long will it take for your clone to arrive at the Paradise Realm? What about the problems in the Sovereign Heaven Realm?"

"I burned a lot of purple jewels to speed up Feng Jiu’s flying artifact, and Feltia [2] will probably arrive there in around two to three months. Although it is wasteful, I have no other choice; otherwise, it will take him six months to arrive there." Zhang Fei then sighed softly before continuing. "I can’t understand the Cao Clan, especially since Qi Lai should have been able to bring them back to that realm in a short time, but they chose to stall for time, which makes me think that they are preparing something else."

Bai Tian’er immediately expressed her idea. "Why don’t you try infiltrating the Cao Clan? Since Gu Changshen is their ally, he should be able to bring you into the clan, right? You can ask Helian Xun’er for assistance if he is unable to do so, just as he assisted you in breaking into the Leng Clan."

"You’re not wrong about that, and they can help me infiltrate there." Zhang Fei nodded in response. "However, I have a feeling that the Cao Clan isn’t that simple, and I’m sure my feeling isn’t wrong. Therefore, I have not yet made a decision about this matter, and I’m still considering other possibilities, particularly the worst-case scenarios. Moreover, Tian Jingxuan and the others have already started to turn their backs on me after I took over the Leng Clan, and they are trying to persuade the other clans to join them."
"Are all the clans willing to join those people?"

Zhang Fei shook his head at her. "The Yin Clan has rejected Qing Huang’s request, and Yin Cheng decided to stay on my side, mainly because of my alchemy items. Li Zuxin has also rejected Shi Yan’s invitation, but Chi Yuexin hasn’t made a decision yet. She seems to be afraid of the Tian Clan, but she is also afraid of me after I pressured her when she went to the Red Sun Realm some time ago."

"There are too many stupid people in this universe." Bai Tian’er commented with a shake of her head. "Tian Jingxuan and the others are so afraid of the Cao Clan and Qi Lai, and they can’t protect their clan from them. Moreover, they are already aware of your strength and connections, yet they still consider provoking you; only those blinded by their greed like them would act in such a foolish manner."

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "You’re right; they are indeed foolish people blinded by their greed and jealousy. Since they want to find trouble with me, I naturally have to fight back against them. However, I won’t take action anytime soon; instead, I will allow the Cao Clan to create chaos within their clans first. Once their clans are in chaos, I will ask Serpentera and Tian Kui to help them, and I will take over their three clans at that time. This way, we will obtain a lot of free resources from them, and we will focus fully on preparing for our departure to the Paradise Realm after that."

Bai Tian’er let out a soft sigh and looked up at him. "Before I met you, I was unaware of many things, and I had never considered the possibility of going to the upper realms. Our meeting broadened my perspective, leaving me feeling akin to a frog in a well, oblivious to the vastness of the universe. I know many things now, and I have also set foot in the upper realms, which makes me impatient to go to the Paradise Realm. However, I realize that I am just an ant in that realm, but I don’t want to continue like this, and I want to be able to travel freely in that realm."

"The Three Mortal Realms are indeed harsh, and there are too many powerful cultivators within them. However, the Paradise Realm is on a completely different level, and the situation there is much more unpredictable. Moreover, the differences between the two realms are too significant, and all the cultivators there are the true powerhouses of the cultivation world." Bai Tian’er gave Zhang Fei a light nod. "After my clone arrives there, I will go there and enter the training space afterward. This way, the Qi inside there will become the Celestial Qi, and it will speed up our cultivation. When we’re ready, I’ll take you all there, and our first destination is the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary in the Empyrean Domain."
"You can’t wait to reunite with Goddess Luo Yunxiao again, huh?" Bai Tian’er teased her.
Zhang Fei gave her a deep kiss for a while. "All of you are no less beautiful than Yunxiao, okay? Therefore, you don’t need to be jealous or jealous of her beauty."
"Hehe." Bai Tian’er softly giggled. "What about my mother and the others? Have they made it past the second floor?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei replied with a nod. "They outnumber us by a lot, and many senior cultivators are with them, such as my master, Senior Jingxia, Senior Xia, and the others are with them. Therefore, they have no difficulty completing the second challenge, and they have already begun to take on the ones on the third floor. For now, let Xianqin and the others try to create their domains first, and we will continue our journey after they arrive at this floor."
Bai Tian’er nodded in agreement with that. "If your master and the others are with us, I think we can reach the top floor much faster; otherwise, we will waste too much time and energy."
"Yeah." Bai Tian’er raised an eyebrow because Zhang Fei suddenly activated his domain, and the area inside was filled with mist. "Let’s dual cultivate while waiting for them to finish."

Bai Tian’er became excited after hearing that, especially since they hadn’t dual cultivated since they started challenging the Star Tower again. In a few minutes, the two of them were already involved in hot sexual activity.
Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was cultivating at the bottom of the life pond, suddenly opened his eyes. He quickly swam out of it, meeting Ju Tan, who had just arrived there.
"Are you guys leaving now?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] dried his clothes immediately.
"Yes, Master." Ju Tan nodded at him. "We wanted to leave three days ago, but you were focused on your cultivation at the bottom of the pond, so I didn’t disturb you."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded and led Ju Tan away from the area. "Have you started selling your goods in my shop?"
"As you wish, my wife and the others only sell our goods in your shop."
"That’s good."
When they were about to go to the residence of the giant race, they ran into Ren Xiyi and Qian Shuang. "Are you guys going out?"
"Would you two like to join us, Xiyi and Shuang?" Ju Tan then pointed at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I will take my master to the Verdant Northern Forest to hunt and meet the beast races."
"I’m in!" Ren Xiyi then asked her friend. "What about you, Shuang?"
Qian Shuang nodded slightly. "I’m bored right now, so I want to go to another area."
"Let’s go then."

After they picked up Ju Tan’s family, Zhang Xiaolong [3] took them all to leave the eastern forest using the gate. He then enveloped them with their aura, and he brought them to the Verdant Northern Forest directly.
"You leave me speechless, Master." Ju Tan commented with a shake of his head. "We usually need several hours to arrive at this forest, but you brought us here in a matter of seconds."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] just smiled and watched the back area of the Verdant Northern Forest to look for the location of the residence of the beast races, but the map was blocked by a powerful barrier. "How about we go straight to the back area? The others can hunt from there, and the two of us will go meet the beast races."

"I have no problem with that." Ju Tan then spoke to his family. "The five of you can follow our master’s instructions, and I will take him to meet the beast races. Xiyi and Shuang, the two of you should join my family, especially since those guys don’t like humans."
"Yes, Uncle Ju." Both Ren Xiyi and Qian Shuang nodded at him.
A while later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already brought them to the back area of the Verdant Northern Forest, and Ju Ning immediately led them to hunt into the forest.
"So, how are we going to enter their residence?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked, looking at the area around them.
"Wait a minute, Master." Ju Tan took out a device and contacted a member of the beast races. "Someone will pick us up soon."
"Let’s wait then." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked at the forest behind them. "Is it okay for them to hunt at night like this?"
"Haha." Ju Tan laughed at that. "Master, the vine tiger is actually a nocturnal beast, so tonight is the best time to hunt them, and they will hunt other beasts tomorrow morning until evening."
A gap suddenly opened in the barrier in front of them, and two old men walked out from within. One had the appearance of a dragon, and the other had the appearance of an elephant.

Mei immediately informed Zhang Xiaolong [3] of their identity and cultivation. The one with the appearance of a dragon is an earth dragon, Long Qiu. The one with the appearance of an elephant is the vajra elephant, Jin Xiang. Both of them had cultivation at the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, just like Ju Tan.
"A human?" Both old men frowned after seeing Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Why did you bring humans to us, Ju Tan?"
"Hahaha!" Ju Tan laughed loudly in response before grabbing Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s shoulder. "Do you think I would acknowledge him as my master if he was just a human?"
Both old men were shocked to hear that. "Then?"
Ju Tan turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Master, you should show them your other two forms, and they will recognize your true identity immediately."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] actually summoned the four beast ancestors first, which shocked Jin Xiang and Long Qiu. They were even more shocked when he transformed into his transcendent lust demon form, but he immediately transformed into his heavenly fox form, with eight tails behind his hips.
Jin Xiang and Long Qiu’s eyes widened, and their jaws dropped, staring dumbly at Zhang Xiaolong [3].

Ju Tan shook his head when he saw them in that state. "Oy! Wake up! Do you two now understand the reason I brought him here? We, the natural races, have already accepted him. My family and I have also acknowledged him as our master."
"Let’s talk inside." Long Qiu spoke as he led Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Ju Tan in, followed by Huli Jinhu and the other three beast ancestors. Jin Xiang entered last as he closed the barrier again.
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow as they arrived behind the barrier. "Is this place a dimensional space, senior?"

"Yes." Long Qiu explained it to him. "Even though our ancestors were also one of the founding fathers of this realm, they never liked to mingle with humans, and they only mingled with the natural races. Therefore, they created this dimensional space in the past, and our beast races have remained here even after the barrier separated this realm from the realm beyond."
"I didn’t expect that the man in the writings of the ten-tailed fox had already appeared in this realm." Jin Xiang then asked Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Can I test your strength?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "Since my cultivation is still far below yours, we will pit our raw strength against each other, Senior."
"Yes."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Jin Xiang immediately stood facing each other, and they prepared to attack each other.
*Boom*
In an instant, their fists collided with each other, but Long Qiu and Ju Tan’s eyes widened in shock as they watched Jin Xiang roll on the ground several meters back from Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s attack.

Unlike them, the four beast ancestors had fought against Zhang Xiaolong [3] and his three clones once. They had beaten the four of them unconscious, so they knew that his raw strength was too terrifying.
"Damn!" Jin Xiang cursed as soon as he managed to stop himself. He immediately jumped to his feet and swung his right arm. "Your raw strength is far more terrifying than your cultivation, young man."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled at that. "Senior, I am a rank six body cultivator, and I master five body cultivation techniques. Although one of them is still in the initial stage, my body and raw strength have already surpassed many cultivators."

"What a freak!" Jin Xiang shouted loudly. "Learning one body cultivation technique is already too difficult, but you actually mastered five, and four of them have already reached the peak level. No wonder Ju Tan is willing to recognize you as his master, especially since your strength is too terrifying. If your cultivation had reached our level, we would probably die under your one blow."
"You’re exaggerating, Senior."
Jin Xiang sighed heavily as he shook his head. "Let’s go; we will take you to our main residence, and they will be happy to welcome you."
"Sure."

sentences.text: Zhang Fei relaxed under a tree while watching Xian Xianqin and the others try to create their domains.
Among them, only Bai Tian’er managed to create her domain, and she managed to create two.
One based on her light element, and the other based on soul cultivation.
"I didn’t expect you to have a new wife, not to mention she is your master’s niece." Bai Tian’er spoke as she approached Zhang Fei.
Zhang Fei pulled Bai Tian’er into his lap and gave her a brief kiss.
"I liked Wei Xiaoya after I saw her soul, but I didn’t plan to marry her so soon.
Our marriage happened so quickly because her mother, Hun Liying, couldn’t wait to marry her off.
She and her husband were spying on us from afar, and she immediately arranged our marriage after she found out that I was Master Hun’s disciple."
Bai Tian’er nodded in understanding, leaned against his chest, and held his hands.
"How long will it take for your clone to arrive at the Paradise Realm?
What about the problems in the Sovereign Heaven Realm?"
"I burned a lot of purple jewels to speed up Feng Jiu’s flying artifact, and Feltia [2] will probably arrive there in around two to three months.
Although it is wasteful, I have no other choice; otherwise, it will take him six months to arrive there." Zhang Fei then sighed softly before continuing.

"I can’t understand the Cao Clan, especially since Qi Lai should have been able to bring them back to that realm in a short time, but they chose to stall for time, which makes me think that they are preparing something else."
Bai Tian’er immediately expressed her idea.
"Why don’t you try infiltrating the Cao Clan?
Since Gu Changshen is their ally, he should be able to bring you into the clan, right?
You can ask Helian Xun’er for assistance if he is unable to do so, just as he assisted you in breaking into the Leng Clan."
"You’re not wrong about that, and they can help me infiltrate there." Zhang Fei nodded in response.
"However, I have a feeling that the Cao Clan isn’t that simple, and I’m sure my feeling isn’t wrong.
Therefore, I have not yet made a decision about this matter, and I’m still considering other possibilities, particularly the worst-case scenarios.
Moreover, Tian Jingxuan and the others have already started to turn their backs on me after I took over the Leng Clan, and they are trying to persuade the other clans to join them."
"Are all the clans willing to join those people?"
Zhang Fei shook his head at her.
"The Yin Clan has rejected Qing Huang’s request, and Yin Cheng decided to stay on my side, mainly because of my alchemy items.
Li Zuxin has also rejected Shi Yan’s invitation, but Chi Yuexin hasn’t made a decision yet.
She seems to be afraid of the Tian Clan, but she is also afraid of me after I pressured her when she went to the Red Sun Realm some time ago."
"There are too many stupid people in this universe." Bai Tian’er commented with a shake of her head.
"Tian Jingxuan and the others are so afraid of the Cao Clan and Qi Lai, and they can’t protect their clan from them.
Moreover, they are already aware of your strength and connections, yet they still consider provoking you; only those blinded by their greed like them would act in such a foolish manner."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed at that.
"You’re right; they are indeed foolish people blinded by their greed and jealousy.
Since they want to find trouble with me, I naturally have to fight back against them.
However, I won’t take action anytime soon; instead, I will allow the Cao Clan to create chaos within their clans first.
Once their clans are in chaos, I will ask Serpentera and Tian Kui to help them, and I will take over their three clans at that time.
This way, we will obtain a lot of free resources from them, and we will focus fully on preparing for our departure to the Paradise Realm after that."
Bai Tian’er let out a soft sigh and looked up at him.
"Before I met you, I was unaware of many things, and I had never considered the possibility of going to the upper realms.
Our meeting broadened my perspective, leaving me feeling akin to a frog in a well, oblivious to the vastness of the universe.
I know many things now, and I have also set foot in the upper realms, which makes me impatient to go to the Paradise Realm.
However, I realize that I am just an ant in that realm, but I don’t want to continue like this, and I want to be able to travel freely in that realm."
"The Three Mortal Realms are indeed harsh, and there are too many powerful cultivators within them.
However, the Paradise Realm is on a completely different level, and the situation there is much more unpredictable.
Moreover, the differences between the two realms are too significant, and all the cultivators there are the true powerhouses of the cultivation world." Bai Tian’er gave Zhang Fei a light nod.
"After my clone arrives there, I will go there and enter the training space afterward.
This way, the Qi inside there will become the Celestial Qi, and it will speed up our cultivation.
When we’re ready, I’ll take you all there, and our first destination is the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary in the Empyrean Domain."
"You can’t wait to reunite with Goddess Luo Yunxiao again, huh?" Bai Tian’er teased her.
Zhang Fei gave her a deep kiss for a while.
"All of you are no less beautiful than Yunxiao, okay?
Therefore, you don’t need to be jealous or jealous of her beauty."
"Hehe." Bai Tian’er softly giggled.
"What about my mother and the others?
Have they made it past the second floor?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei replied with a nod.
"They outnumber us by a lot, and many senior cultivators are with them, such as my master, Senior Jingxia, Senior Xia, and the others are with them.
Therefore, they have no difficulty completing the second challenge, and they have already begun to take on the ones on the third floor.
For now, let Xianqin and the others try to create their domains first, and we will continue our journey after they arrive at this floor."
Bai Tian’er nodded in agreement with that.
"If your master and the others are with us, I think we can reach the top floor much faster; otherwise, we will waste too much time and energy."
"Yeah." Bai Tian’er raised an eyebrow because Zhang Fei suddenly activated his domain, and the area inside was filled with mist.
"Let’s dual cultivate while waiting for them to finish."
Bai Tian’er became excited after hearing that, especially since they hadn’t dual cultivated since they started challenging the Star Tower again.
In a few minutes, the two of them were already involved in hot sexual activity.
Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was cultivating at the bottom of the life pond, suddenly opened his eyes.
He quickly swam out of it, meeting Ju Tan, who had just arrived there.
"Are you guys leaving now?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] dried his clothes immediately.
"Yes, Master." Ju Tan nodded at him.
"We wanted to leave three days ago, but you were focused on your cultivation at the bottom of the pond, so I didn’t disturb you."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded and led Ju Tan away from the area.
"Have you started selling your goods in my shop?"
"As you wish, my wife and the others only sell our goods in your shop."
"That’s good."
When they were about to go to the residence of the giant race, they ran into Ren Xiyi and Qian Shuang.
"Are you guys going out?"
"Would you two like to join us, Xiyi and Shuang?" Ju Tan then pointed at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"I will take my master to the Verdant Northern Forest to hunt and meet the beast races."
"I’m in!" Ren Xiyi then asked her friend.
"What about you, Shuang?"
Qian Shuang nodded slightly.
"I’m bored right now, so I want to go to another area."
"Let’s go then."
After they picked up Ju Tan’s family, Zhang Xiaolong [3] took them all to leave the eastern forest using the gate.
He then enveloped them with their aura, and he brought them to the Verdant Northern Forest directly.
"You leave me speechless, Master." Ju Tan commented with a shake of his head.
"We usually need several hours to arrive at this forest, but you brought us here in a matter of seconds."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] just smiled and watched the back area of the Verdant Northern Forest to look for the location of the residence of the beast races, but the map was blocked by a powerful barrier.
"How about we go straight to the back area?
The others can hunt from there, and the two of us will go meet the beast races."
"I have no problem with that." Ju Tan then spoke to his family.
"The five of you can follow our master’s instructions, and I will take him to meet the beast races.
Xiyi and Shuang, the two of you should join my family, especially since those guys don’t like humans."
"Yes, Uncle Ju." Both Ren Xiyi and Qian Shuang nodded at him.
A while later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already brought them to the back area of the Verdant Northern Forest, and Ju Ning immediately led them to hunt into the forest.
"So, how are we going to enter their residence?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked, looking at the area around them.
"Wait a minute, Master." Ju Tan took out a device and contacted a member of the beast races.
"Someone will pick us up soon."
"Let’s wait then." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked at the forest behind them.
"Is it okay for them to hunt at night like this?"
"Haha." Ju Tan laughed at that.
"Master, the vine tiger is actually a nocturnal beast, so tonight is the best time to hunt them, and they will hunt other beasts tomorrow morning until evening."
A gap suddenly opened in the barrier in front of them, and two old men walked out from within.
One had the appearance of a dragon, and the other had the appearance of an elephant.
Mei immediately informed Zhang Xiaolong [3] of their identity and cultivation.
The one with the appearance of a dragon is an earth dragon, Long Qiu.
The one with the appearance of an elephant is the vajra elephant, Jin Xiang.
Both of them had cultivation at the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, just like Ju Tan.
"A human?" Both old men frowned after seeing Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Why did you bring humans to us, Ju Tan?"
"Hahaha!" Ju Tan laughed loudly in response before grabbing Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s shoulder.
"Do you think I would acknowledge him as my master if he was just a human?"
Both old men were shocked to hear that.
"Then?"
Ju Tan turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Master, you should show them your other two forms, and they will recognize your true identity immediately."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] actually summoned the four beast ancestors first, which shocked Jin Xiang and Long Qiu.
They were even more shocked when he transformed into his transcendent lust demon form, but he immediately transformed into his heavenly fox form, with eight tails behind his hips.
Jin Xiang and Long Qiu’s eyes widened, and their jaws dropped, staring dumbly at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Ju Tan shook his head when he saw them in that state.
"Oy!
Wake up!
Do you two now understand the reason I brought him here?
We, the natural races, have already accepted him.
My family and I have also acknowledged him as our master."
"Let’s talk inside." Long Qiu spoke as he led Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Ju Tan in, followed by Huli Jinhu and the other three beast ancestors.
Jin Xiang entered last as he closed the barrier again.
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow as they arrived behind the barrier.
"Is this place a dimensional space, senior?"
"Yes." Long Qiu explained it to him.
"Even though our ancestors were also one of the founding fathers of this realm, they never liked to mingle with humans, and they only mingled with the natural races.
Therefore, they created this dimensional space in the past, and our beast races have remained here even after the barrier separated this realm from the realm beyond."
"I didn’t expect that the man in the writings of the ten-tailed fox had already appeared in this realm." Jin Xiang then asked Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Can I test your strength?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him.
"Since my cultivation is still far below yours, we will pit our raw strength against each other, Senior."
"Yes."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Jin Xiang immediately stood facing each other, and they prepared to attack each other.
*Boom*
In an instant, their fists collided with each other, but Long Qiu and Ju Tan’s eyes widened in shock as they watched Jin Xiang roll on the ground several meters back from Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s attack.
Unlike them, the four beast ancestors had fought against Zhang Xiaolong [3] and his three clones once.
They had beaten the four of them unconscious, so they knew that his raw strength was too terrifying.
"Damn!" Jin Xiang cursed as soon as he managed to stop himself.
He immediately jumped to his feet and swung his right arm.
"Your raw strength is far more terrifying than your cultivation, young man."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled at that.
"Senior, I am a rank six body cultivator, and I master five body cultivation techniques.
Although one of them is still in the initial stage, my body and raw strength have already surpassed many cultivators."
"What a freak!" Jin Xiang shouted loudly.
"Learning one body cultivation technique is already too difficult, but you actually mastered five, and four of them have already reached the peak level.
No wonder Ju Tan is willing to recognize you as his master, especially since your strength is too terrifying.
If your cultivation had reached our level, we would probably die under your one blow."
"You’re exaggerating, Senior."
Jin Xiang sighed heavily as he shook his head.
"Let’s go; we will take you to our main residence, and they will be happy to welcome you."
"Sure."

chapters.title: Chapter 1017: Lei Yulong
paragraphs: "This dimensional space is truly vast and beautiful, and the air here is much better than outside, especially since nature here is naturally thriving." Not only Zhang Xiaolong [3] was amazed by the place, but Huli Jinhu and the three beast ancestors were also amazed to see it. "How many types of beast races live here? How many are there?"
"In total, there are about a billion or more beasts from thousands of different beast races." Long Qiu answered him.
Jin Xiang then added to his friend words. "The weakest beast here is at the quasi-divine rank, and the beasts below that rank live in the forest outside."

"A billion or more beasts with the minimum quasi-divine rank, huh? The number is one eighth of the population of my home realm." Zhang Xiaolong [3] displayed a subtle smirk that caught the attention of the senior beasts. "Senior, is it okay if I choose a few of them to become the contract beasts of all my wives?"

Long Qiu and Jin Xiang exchanged looks of shock after hearing that. "Young man, I can’t say whether it’s okay or not, and all your wives should try to approach and convince those beasts themselves. If they agree to follow your wives, we won’t forbid them from going with you."

"However, all the beasts here are arrogant and have high self-esteem, and they won’t easily accept humans to be their masters." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding to Jin Xiang. "Are all your wives equal in strength to you?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head in response. "Most of them have not yet reached the Seven Divine Realms, and most of those who have reached that stage are mythical beasts."
"Oh? How many mythical beasts have become your wives?"

"Eight, but three of them are mythical demon beasts." Long Qiu and Jin Xiang were naturally not surprised to hear that, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3] himself was a transcendent lust demon. "There are still a few other female mythical beasts by my side, but they are too stubborn, and I still need time to subdue them. So, where is the main city?"
"Over there." Long Qiu pointed to the center of the dimensional space. "There are a total of a thousand cities here, but the leaders of all races reside in Verdant Capital City."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately checked the area through the map, and he found at least a hundred beasts with cultivation in the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm. ’Holy shit! The overall strength of these beasts is much stronger than those humans, and they should be able to take over this realm from their hands.’
"What do you think, Master?" Ju Tan suddenly asked.

"Nothing important." Zhang Xiaolong [3] thought for a moment. "Unfortunately, all my wives are still busy elsewhere, and they cannot leave that place for the next few months; otherwise, I will bring them here to find their contracted beasts, and I will help them become stronger."

"Hahaha." Ju Tan laughed at that. "Master, you’re still going to stay in this realm for quite some time, right? Therefore, you don’t need to rush to bring all your wives here, and you can bring them here once they’re ready."
"Yeah, you’re right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked the two again. "Do you two know the location of your two ancestors? I heard about them from Old Ren, one a dragon and one a phoenix."

Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s question made Long Qiu and Jin Xiang sigh heavily. "Ancestor Long Feng and Ancestor Feng Huang are still alive, but we haven’t heard from them for over a hundred thousand years, so we don’t know their exact whereabouts. We’ve been thinking about many possibilities about them, but our leader believed that they managed to pass through the barrier and went to the realm beyond, so they couldn’t give us news due to the barrier."

"I think that possibility is there because there are many paths available to go to the realm beyond, and some humans outside recently ascended there through one of those places." Long Qiu and Jin Xiang looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with shocked gazes because they had been searching for a way to go to the Paradise Realm for hundreds of thousands of years, but they had always found a dead end. "There are several towers in the middle realms, and they were deliberately sent by people from that realm to the Three Mortal Realms to search for new talents. Their realm is experiencing a talent crisis, so they must do something to solve it; otherwise, they will decline."
Long Qiu and Jin Xiang exchanged glances before nodding to each other. "Young man, I hope you are willing to discuss this with our leader, so he can send some of us to one of the towers."
"All right, let’s meet your leader."

Sometime later, they had arrived at Verdant Capital City, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately sent the four ancestors into the beast space. After all, there were too many powerful beasts in the city, and he couldn’t borrow their power if they were outside.
The two old beasts immediately led Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Ju Tan to a five-story building in the city, and Long Qiu went straight in to report the arrival of their guests.
"Let’s go in." Jin Xian led them in directly.

Once they were inside, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately activated his reversal mirror technique and the soul link to borrow the strength of one of the beast ancestors, mainly because he sensed something unusual about the building’s occupants.
Ju Tan was confused by Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s sudden action, but he immediately followed suit and prepared to face the unexpected possibility.

Noting the change in Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s strength, Jin Xiang immediately asked him about it. "How did your strength suddenly increase to this level, young man? Moreover, there is nothing dangerous in this place, so you don’t need to be so tense."

"Sorry, but it’s my secret, so I can’t tell you about it, Senior." Jin Xiang nodded in understanding to Zhang Xiaolong [3] and did not ask further. "I always trust my gut feeling, and I sensed something unusual about one of the residents in this building."
Jin Xiang raised an eyebrow at that, and he tried to search the entire area inside the building but couldn’t feel anything. "Which direction gave you that unusual feeling?"

"There." Zhang Xiaolong [3] pointed to the stairs far to their right, but he himself was confused by it, especially since all the names of the people inside the building were in green. "Who are the people living in the upper area of the stairs?"

"Hmm?" Jin Xiang turned his head in that direction. "They are people from the soul-weaver spider race, and they are the opposite of the soul-devourer beast. Therefore, I find it strange that you feel something unusual from them, especially since they haven’t done anything evil for hundreds of thousands of years."
"The soul-weaver spider beast race?" Jin Xiang nodded slightly to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Forget it, that’s probably just my feeling, and we should meet your leader now."
"Let’s go."

Even so, Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not take his eyes off the area, and he continued to monitor it through the map, waiting for any sudden movements from the people living there. ’Mei, help me monitor them.’
[Yes, Master.]
Before long, they had arrived in another room, where Zhang Xiaolong [3] saw a bare-chested middle-aged man sitting leisurely with two women behind him massaging his shoulders.
[Master, this man is not an ordinary beast, but he is a mythical rank Thunder Fang Drake, and his name is Lei Yulong.]

’A drake with a mythical rank, huh?’ Lei Yulong narrowed his eyes at Zhang Xiaolong [3], confused by the disparity between his apparent strength and his actual bone age. "You don’t need to look at me, senior. I use a strengthening technique to increase my strength, but the technique doesn’t have a time limit like other strengthening techniques, and I do this because there are too many powerful beasts in this city."

Lei Yulong nodded his head lightly. "A strengthening technique without a time limit, eh? This is the first time I have encountered such a technique; however, Long Qiu informed me that you are the man in the writings of the ten-tailed fox, so I should not be surprised if you have such a technique, as you are his chosen heir."

"Let’s not talk about that, especially since my strength is still far from that of the old fox." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nonchalantly sat down in one of the empty chairs, followed by Ju Tan, who immediately stood behind him.

"What kind of towers were you referring to earlier?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately informed Lei Yulong about the Moon Tower in the Frozen Moon Realm. "Did they really ascend to the realm beyond that tower?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shrugged his shoulders. "If you don’t believe me, you can meet the humans out there, especially since some of them witnessed their departure. However, I advise you not to send some of them there now, especially since there are powerful enemies on the way to this realm. Qi Lai came from the realm beyond, and he was previously in charge of the Dark Tower; however, he chose to leave the tower and come here to assist the Cao Clan. Although I have never met that man before, I can confidently say that he has the power to easily destroy this realm, including this dimensional space. Therefore, you need full strength to protect this dimensional space, or they will invade here."
"How did you know about all that?" Lei Yulong suspiciously asked him.

"Naturally, I once challenged one of those towers, and I have a good relationship with the officers there. They told me about Qi Lai, and I have warned the others about him, so I came here today to warn you about him." Lei Yulong still had suspicions about Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "It’s up to you whether you want to believe me or not, but I’ve warned you. If you insist on going or sending the others to that tower, you’ll be the one who suffers the loss, especially if that person destroys this dimensional space."

Ju Tan directly spoke to Lei Yulong. "Jia Yuyan has already confirmed this matter, and our natural races have already prepared to face Qi Lai, so there is no reason for you to doubt my master, right?"
"Your master?" Lei Yutong was taken aback.

"Is there something wrong with that?" Ju Tan wore a proud expression and folded his arms across his chest. "Zhang Xiaolong is my master and family, and our natural race has also recognized him as our leader because he is the heir of the ten-tailed fox. If you don’t want the beasts in this dimensional space to suffer, you better start preparing them because Qi Lai and the Cao Clan will arrive in one to two months, so you don’t have much time now."

Lei Yulong immediately ordered Long Qiu to contact all leaders, asking them to gather in the meeting hall. He then stood up from his seat. "Since our time is limited, I will discuss this matter with them now. Therefore, I will leave you two now, and you can enjoy your time in the city."
"All right." They all immediately left the building, but they went in different directions.

As they were about to walk away, Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly felt bloodlust from inside the building, but he still couldn’t find a single red name on the map. ’What happened? Could that person be able to hide his or her hostility from the system?’
"Are you experiencing that unusual feeling again, Master?"
’Old Ju, we should leave this city to lure that person out, and we’ll deal with him or her outside.’ Ju Tan immediately agreed with Zhang Xiaolong [3], and they hurriedly left Verdant Capital City.

In one of the rooms in the building, a woman stood by the window, smiling to herself and licking her lips. Her face was mature, with smooth skin, soft red lips, and sharp, alluring eyes. Her long black hair was styled neatly with a gold hairpin, and one braid hung down over her chest.

The woman wore a dark blue dress with golden designs and a deep neckline that showed her full, round chest. The dress was tight at the waist, shaped with a black belt and flower-shaped buckle, showing off her curvy figure. The sheer fabric on her shoulders revealed several black tattoos. "Opps! I wasn’t careful, and that young man seemed to be aware of my bloodlust. After all, he was the heir of the ten-tailed fox; it would be a shame if he couldn’t do such a simple thing. He wanted to lure me to see him, but I wasn’t stupid enough to take the verse, and I’d let him wait forever."
"Do you want me to follow them, my queen?" A woman suddenly asked without appearing.
The woman paused to think while lightly tapping her cheek. "Follow them and test the young man’s abilities, Bian Ling."
"Yes, my queen."

The woman returned to her bed made of spiderwebs and lay there. "The last time I enjoyed the life essence of a human was about three years ago when that foolish human suddenly appeared in my main nest, but his life essence was too weak. However, that young man is different from him, and his life essence should be much stronger, so I have to absorb it to strengthen myself. Once I am strong enough, I will kill Lei Yulong and the others, and this dimensional space will be completely mine. After I conquer this space, I will conquer those humans and absorb their life essence."

Ju Tan was confused by Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s sudden action, but he immediately followed suit and prepared to face the unexpected possibility.
Noting the change in Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s strength, Jin Xiang immediately asked him about it.
"How did your strength suddenly increase to this level, young man?
Moreover, there is nothing dangerous in this place, so you don’t need to be so tense."
"Sorry, but it’s my secret, so I can’t tell you about it, Senior." Jin Xiang nodded in understanding to Zhang Xiaolong [3] and did not ask further.
"I always trust my gut feeling, and I sensed something unusual about one of the residents in this building."
Jin Xiang raised an eyebrow at that, and he tried to search the entire area inside the building but couldn’t feel anything.
"Which direction gave you that unusual feeling?"
"There." Zhang Xiaolong [3] pointed to the stairs far to their right, but he himself was confused by it, especially since all the names of the people inside the building were in green.
"Who are the people living in the upper area of the stairs?"
"Hmm?" Jin Xiang turned his head in that direction.
"They are people from the soul-weaver spider race, and they are the opposite of the soul-devourer beast.
Therefore, I find it strange that you feel something unusual from them, especially since they haven’t done anything evil for hundreds of thousands of years."
"The soul-weaver spider beast race?" Jin Xiang nodded slightly to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Forget it, that’s probably just my feeling, and we should meet your leader now."
"Let’s go."

Even so, Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not take his eyes off the area, and he continued to monitor it through the map, waiting for any sudden movements from the people living there. ’Mei, help me monitor them.’
[Yes, Master.]
Before long, they had arrived in another room, where Zhang Xiaolong [3] saw a bare-chested middle-aged man sitting leisurely with two women behind him massaging his shoulders.
[Master, this man is not an ordinary beast, but he is a mythical rank Thunder Fang Drake, and his name is Lei Yulong.]
’A drake with a mythical rank, huh?’ Lei Yulong narrowed his eyes at Zhang Xiaolong [3], confused by the disparity between his apparent strength and his actual bone age.
"You don’t need to look at me, senior.

I use a strengthening technique to increase my strength, but the technique doesn’t have a time limit like other strengthening techniques, and I do this because there are too many powerful beasts in this city."
Lei Yulong nodded his head lightly.
"A strengthening technique without a time limit, eh?

This is the first time I have encountered such a technique; however, Long Qiu informed me that you are the man in the writings of the ten-tailed fox, so I should not be surprised if you have such a technique, as you are his chosen heir."

"Let’s not talk about that, especially since my strength is still far from that of the old fox." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nonchalantly sat down in one of the empty chairs, followed by Ju Tan, who immediately stood behind him.
"What kind of towers were you referring to earlier?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately informed Lei Yulong about the Moon Tower in the Frozen Moon Realm.
"Did they really ascend to the realm beyond that tower?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shrugged his shoulders.
"If you don’t believe me, you can meet the humans out there, especially since some of them witnessed their departure.
However, I advise you not to send some of them there now, especially since there are powerful enemies on the way to this realm.
Qi Lai came from the realm beyond, and he was previously in charge of the Dark Tower; however, he chose to leave the tower and come here to assist the Cao Clan.
Although I have never met that man before, I can confidently say that he has the power to easily destroy this realm, including this dimensional space.
Therefore, you need full strength to protect this dimensional space, or they will invade here."
"How did you know about all that?" Lei Yulong suspiciously asked him.
"Naturally, I once challenged one of those towers, and I have a good relationship with the officers there.
They told me about Qi Lai, and I have warned the others about him, so I came here today to warn you about him." Lei Yulong still had suspicions about Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"It’s up to you whether you want to believe me or not, but I’ve warned you.
If you insist on going or sending the others to that tower, you’ll be the one who suffers the loss, especially if that person destroys this dimensional space."
Ju Tan directly spoke to Lei Yulong.
"Jia Yuyan has already confirmed this matter, and our natural races have already prepared to face Qi Lai, so there is no reason for you to doubt my master, right?"
"Your master?" Lei Yutong was taken aback.
"Is there something wrong with that?" Ju Tan wore a proud expression and folded his arms across his chest.
"Zhang Xiaolong is my master and family, and our natural race has also recognized him as our leader because he is the heir of the ten-tailed fox.
If you don’t want the beasts in this dimensional space to suffer, you better start preparing them because Qi Lai and the Cao Clan will arrive in one to two months, so you don’t have much time now."
Lei Yulong immediately ordered Long Qiu to contact all leaders, asking them to gather in the meeting hall.
He then stood up from his seat.
"Since our time is limited, I will discuss this matter with them now.
Therefore, I will leave you two now, and you can enjoy your time in the city."
"All right." They all immediately left the building, but they went in different directions.
As they were about to walk away, Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly felt bloodlust from inside the building, but he still couldn’t find a single red name on the map. ’What happened?
Could that person be able to hide his or her hostility from the system?’
"Are you experiencing that unusual feeling again, Master?"
’Old Ju, we should leave this city to lure that person out, and we’ll deal with him or her outside.’ Ju Tan immediately agreed with Zhang Xiaolong [3], and they hurriedly left Verdant Capital City.
In one of the rooms in the building, a woman stood by the window, smiling to herself and licking her lips.
Her face was mature, with smooth skin, soft red lips, and sharp, alluring eyes.
Her long black hair was styled neatly with a gold hairpin, and one braid hung down over her chest.
The woman wore a dark blue dress with golden designs and a deep neckline that showed her full, round chest.
The dress was tight at the waist, shaped with a black belt and flower-shaped buckle, showing off her curvy figure.
The sheer fabric on her shoulders revealed several black tattoos.
"Opps!
I wasn’t careful, and that young man seemed to be aware of my bloodlust.
After all, he was the heir of the ten-tailed fox; it would be a shame if he couldn’t do such a simple thing.
He wanted to lure me to see him, but I wasn’t stupid enough to take the verse, and I’d let him wait forever."
"Do you want me to follow them, my queen?" A woman suddenly asked without appearing.
The woman paused to think while lightly tapping her cheek.
"Follow them and test the young man’s abilities, Bian Ling."
"Yes, my queen."
The woman returned to her bed made of spiderwebs and lay there.
"The last time I enjoyed the life essence of a human was about three years ago when that foolish human suddenly appeared in my main nest, but his life essence was too weak.
However, that young man is different from him, and his life essence should be much stronger, so I have to absorb it to strengthen myself.
Once I am strong enough, I will kill Lei Yulong and the others, and this dimensional space will be completely mine.
After I conquer this space, I will conquer those humans and absorb their life essence."

chapters.title: Chapter 1018: Zhang Fei’s Cruelty
paragraphs: ’How is it, Master? Is that person following us?’ Ju Tan asked Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was flying by his side.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. ’My guess is right; that person is from the Soul-Weaver Spider Race. One of them has been following us from afar just now, and her name is Bian Ling.’
’Are you sure that person is Bian Ling, Master?’
’Do you know anything about her?’

Ju Tan nodded slightly and told him directly. ’Bian Ling is the confidant of the spider queen, Bian Zhizhu. According to circulating rumors, the queen has a split personality, but no one has ever witnessed it firsthand, so I can’t confirm the truth.’

’Split personality, huh?’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] stole a glance at Bian Ling’s hiding location. ’I’ve never met Bian Zhizhu in person, so I can’t say anything about her. However, the bloodlust I felt in the building and her decision to send one of her confidants to stalk us somewhat proved the truth of the rumors, and we will be able to get the answer if we capture Bian Ling.’
Ju Tan agreed with him. ’How are we going to capture Bian Ling? She seems to have a special ability to hide her presence; I can’t track her or pinpoint her location.’

"I want to go to another city, but it’s getting late. Therefore, we should spend the night outside the city, and we will go to the city in front of us tomorrow morning." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately flew in another direction after he found a suitable location, followed by Ju Tan, who continued to wonder about Bian Zhizhu’s intentions.
Before long, the two of them landed on the side of a forest, and Ju Tan immediately rushed to get some wood to make a campfire.
Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] thought of a way to capture Bian Ling without alerting Bai Zhizhu. ’Yushu, I want you to do something about that woman.’
’Yes, Master.’ Nalan Yushu disappeared as soon as she left Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s tiny soul world.

A while later, Nalan Yushu had already arrived above Bian Ling, and the female spider’s body appeared transparent. Even so, it was not difficult for her to see her true form, and she immediately entered her body before moving into her soul space.
Bian Ling was shocked by the appearance of Nalan Yushu. "Who are you? How could you invade my soul space?"
"Hehe." Nalan Yushu chuckled as she flicked her fingers, and a few soul threads shot toward Bian Ling, binding both hands and feet.
"You bitch!" Bian Ling tried to cut these soul threads, but she was shocked to find that she couldn’t sever them, even though they were within her soul space.

"This place is indeed your soul space, but your soul is too weak in front of me." Nalan Yushu flicked her fingers again and sealed Bian Lin’s mouth with several other soul threads. She then approached the female spider and lifted her chin. "I wanted to eat your soul, but my master still needs you, so I will let you live for now. I will take over your body for now, and you must wait in silence, or I will torture your soul."
Bian Ling struggled to break free, but these soul threads actually tied her tighter. ’This bitch! Who exactly is he? How could he invade my soul space?’
"Hmm?" Ju Tan, who had just returned with a pile of firewood, was surprised by Bian Ling’s sudden arrival. "Master, she—"
"Tehehe." Bian Ling giggled. "I confined her soul in her soul space and took over her body."

Ju Tan turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately explained it to him. "Her name is Nalan Yuzhu, and she is a demon cultivator soul from the Paradise Realm. I asked her to take care of Bian Ling, so Bian Zhizhu would not be aware of my actions."
"Oh." Ju Tan immediately arranged the wood and made a campfire.

"Share her memories with me, Yuzhu." Bian Ling touched Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s forehead, transferring all her memories into his mind. He immediately accessed all of Bian Ling’s memories, but after discovering something unexpected, he appeared angry and involuntarily radiated a killing intent from his body. "Bian Zhizhu, huh? I didn’t expect it, and I will kill her."
Bian Ling and Ju Tan were confused by Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s sudden outburst of anger. "What actually happened, master? Why are you suddenly like this?"

"She is the murderer of the deceased husband and father of Liu Qingyu and the Chu Sisters." Ju Tan naturally didn’t know about them because Zhang Xiaolong [3] hadn’t introduced him to them, but Nalan Yushu had been living with him for a long time. "Back then, when we destroyed the heretics in our realm, we also destroyed the portal that connected it to another realm, and we were trapped inside the space rift. All of us were thrown into other realms, and some of them died there, including Chu Hong. However, I didn’t expect that he would be stranded in this dimensional space, and Bai Zhizhu killed him by absorbing his life essence dry."
"I see." Bian Ling nodded in understanding.
"Does Bian Zhizhu really have a split personality, Master?" Ju Tan curiously asked.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "Bian Zhizhu does have a split personality; her second personality is called Bian Luosha. Moreover, her second personality is not just a personality, but it has a completely different identity from her, just like mine."
"Second identity?" Ju Tan and Bian Ling were both shocked.

"Her second identity is the Nether Spider Queen." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then pointed to the north. "Unlike Bian Zhizhu, who lives in the Verdant Capital City. Bian Luosha’s main nest is far to the north, hidden from the eyes of the beasts in this place. Bian Ling doesn’t know anything about inside that place, so we have to go there to find out everything."
"How about I go see Bian Zhizhu now, Master?" Bian Ling asked.

"No need." Zhang Xiaolong [3] refused. "Bian Zhizhu has already transformed into Bian Luosha, and she is on her way to her nest now. Here, we will go see her now, and I will make her pay dearly for the sorrow of Qingyu and the Chu Sisters over Chu Hong’s death."
"Haha." Bian Ling laughed at that. "Bian Zhizhu or Bian Luosha definitely wouldn’t have thought that death would come to them today, and they would definitely regret killing Chu Hong."
Ju Tan didn’t say anything about it, but he could see that Zhang Xiaolong [3] put the interests of all his women above all else, and he would do anything for them.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately enveloped the three of them with his aura, and he took them to the north using the nine cloud steps.

In a few minutes, they had arrived not far from a cave covered with thick, black spiderwebs at the entrance, and the front of the cave was surrounded by many trees, disguising it from the sight of other beasts. However, Bian Luosha had not arrived there yet, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s speed was too fast, forcing them to wait for her.
Bian Luosha only arrived there two hours later, but she was unaware of the presence of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others, especially since he brought Ju Tan and Bian Ling into an invisible state.
Bian Luosha casually entered her cave, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately brought the two of them to follow her inside just before her spiderwebs covered the cave entrance again.

At the end of the cave, they saw numerous black spiders, each with blood-red eyes that varied in number from two to eight. Additionally, they saw many beasts that had turned into humans wrapped in black spiderwebs, hanging down from the cave ceiling, most of which were male beasts.
’Does she intend to absorb their life and beast essences, Master?’ Ju Tan asked with a frown.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. ’Some of this bitch’s abilities are almost similar to mine, and she will use them as a sacrifice to improve herself.’
’Shit! This bitch is truly a madwoman!’ Ju Tan looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] and asked. ’How about we save them, Master?’
Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn’t care whether those beasts would live or die, but he also couldn’t bear to let them die at Bian Luoshu’s hands. ’All right, we will save them.’

Bia Luoshu immediately took off her dress before returning to her beast form, and her spider form was large enough to fill almost half of the area in the cave. She took one of the beasts from the ceiling and freed it from her spiderwebs, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately shot a huge light arrow at her, forcing her to jump to dodge. "Who’s there? Who dares to intrude into this queen’s nest?"

"A woman like you doesn’t deserve to be a queen." Bia Luoshu’s eyes widened as Zhang Xiaolong [3] canceled his invisibility, but he was most shocked by the presence of Bian Ling by his side. "If only you hadn’t sent your subordinate to tail me, I would never have known about your two identities or your evil intentions. Unfortunately, you underestimated me too much, and your subordinate has fallen into my hands now."
"Tch!" Bian Luoshu immediately shot her black spiderweb at them, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] easily destroyed it using his golden crow flames.

Bian Luoshu then ordered those spiders to attack them, but dozens of fireballs made of golden flames appeared around Zhang Xiaolong [3], and he launched them toward them, which instantly incinerated them.
"No! My babies!" Bian Luoshu screamed hysterically and dashed toward them, but Ju Tan immediately moved in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a huge hammer, and he smashed it at her directly.

However, Bian Luoshu swiftly avoided Ju Tan’s attack, and she quickly trapped him in her black spiderweb. She then tried to attack Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he had already activated the soul link and attacked her first.

"Arghhh!" Bian Luoshu was thrown backwards into a large black spiderweb behind her, which prevented her body from hitting the cave wall. ’Shit! His strength suddenly became equal to or even stronger than mine.’
Before Bian Luoshu could react, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had appeared in front of her with the demon extermination sword in his hand, and he swung it from bottom to top towards her chest.
"Arghh!" Bian Laoshu let out a scream of pain as Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s sword slashed her chest, causing black blood to flow out of the long, deep wound on her chest.

Bian Luoshu quickly moved away from Zhang Xiaolong [3], shielded herself with a thick black spiderweb, and wiped the blood from her mouth. "Cough... Cough... Why are you attacking me like this? We had no grudges with each other before, and I sent Bian Ling to you just to keep an eye on you."

"You’re right, we had no grudges before." Zhang Xiaolong [3] slashed his sword backwards and freed Ju Tan from the spiderweb. He then pointed his sword at Bian Luoshu. "Do you think I can’t feel your bloodlust and killing intent? I’m very sensitive to both, so I know you want to kill me by absorbing my life and beast essences. Moreover, I got the information I’ve been looking for from Bian Ling’s memories, which makes me even more eager to kill you."
Bian Luoshu briefly glanced at Bian Ling as she frowned. "What do you mean by that?"

"Heh!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately released his killing intent to the maximum, enveloping Bian Luoshu with it, causing her to tremble in horror. "About three years ago, a man was stranded in your lair from within the space crack, and you killed him by absorbing his life essence dry before destroying the remains of his corpse."
"How—"

"The man was my father-in-law, and you killed him." Bian Luoshu was shocked when Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that, as she never expected to meet one of the families of her victims. "I promised his wife and three daughters never to make them sad, but you made them languish and cry in sorrow for several days by killing him. I had originally given up on finding his killer because the universe was too vast, but fate had other plans and brought me to you. Since you have made them miserable, I have to pay this debt, and I will make you taste hell on earth."

"Wait—Arghhh!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] swiftly chopped off both of Bian Luoshu’s arms, causing fresh black blood to spurt from them. He then severed her spider legs, causing her to experience another wave of excruciating pain. "Arghhhh! Stop!"
"Stop?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] strangled Bian Luoshu’s neck, and his expression was scarier than a demon, making her feel that her death was before her eyes.

"You—Arghh!" Bian Luoshu once again screamed in pain as Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s sword pierced through her chest, but he deliberately avoided her heart, especially since he didn’t want her to die yet. "Cough... Cough..."
Below, Ju Tan hugged his trembling body as Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s current state was too terrifying even for an experienced cultivator like him. ’Holy fuck! My master is too scary.’

Bian Ling, who was under Nalan Yushu’s control, showed no fear at all toward Zhang Xiaolong [3]. However, her expression appeared completely serious as she contemplated a troubling matter. ’The cursed demon heart and the ten-tailed fox’s evil soul are starting to take a toll on him; I fear that he will truly become pure evil. If that happens, the result of the old fox’s prophecy will be reversed, and he will become a terrifying scourge for all living beings in this universe.’
"Kill me!"

Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s eyes turned bloodshot, and he strangled Bian Luoshu. "Did you think I would let you die so easily? Do you think this torture is enough to repay their tears and sorrow? Their tears and feelings are precious to me, but you made them cry and suffer for several days."

"Arghhh!" Bian Luoshu grabbed Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s hand to stop him from twirling his sword, especially since the pain was too painful for her. He slapped her hands away and continued his action, causing blood to continue flowing out of her mouth and chest. "Cough... Kill... me..."

Ma Kuangyu suddenly came out of Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s tiny soul world and grabbed his shoulder. "Your cursed demon heart is starting to awaken because of your anger, and it will overcome you if you like this. If you turn into a pure evil, everyone by your side will be sad and miserable, so you must control yourself now."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Ma Kuangyu, and his eyes became even redder to the point of horrifying a cultivator of his caliber.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately calmed himself down because he did not want to make all the people who cared so much about him sad and miserable, and his eyes slowly returned to normal.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately sealed Bian Luoshu’s cultivation, pulled the demon extermination sword out of her body, and threw her to the ground.
*Bam*

"Cough... Cough..." Bian Luoshu stared at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in horror, but she felt a little lucky that Ma Kuangyu managed to persuade him. ’Shit! If I weren’t so greedy, I would never have suffered this fate today.’

Ma Kuangyu breathed a sigh of relief and spoke to him again. "If you want to kill her, you can kill her directly. You must not let your anger overcome you like just now; otherwise, your cursed demon heart will truly awaken. Do you understand, kid?"
"Thank you, Old Ma." Ma Kuangyu simply nodded and returned to Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s tiny soul world immediately.

After he returned the sword to his body, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately landed beside Bian Luoshu, who was already helpless. However, she suddenly changed, and Bian Zhizhu took over the body. "Please... don’t kill me... I’m different from Luoshu..."
