paragraphs: Meanwhile, the Leng Clan was in a festive mood as they were holding the ceremony of inaugurating Leng Xueyan as their new leader, and the event was attended by several other clans, including the Shangguan, Duanmu, Yuan, Ren, Li, Chi, and many more.
However, the three old men from the Tian, Qing, and Shi Clans did not attend their event, especially since they had long been enemies with the Leng Clan.

Although the atmosphere in the Leng Clan was so lively, Leng Xueyan sat on her chair with an unhappy face, especially since Zhang Fei [5] or Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not meet her in her dream. ’Sigh! I just arrived in this realm last night, but I wanted to go to the Grand Royal Realm again to meet that kid. Unfortunately, I will be the leader of this clan starting today, so I can’t travel as far as I please.’

The ceremony did not last long, and Leng Xueyan had officially become the matriarch of the Leng Clan, but she still had many questions about her father’s decision. Moreover, she was familiar with her brother’s character, but he seemed indifferent to their father’s decision and appeared happy to no longer be the patriarch. ’What exactly happened in this clan while I was away? Why didn’t I hear any talk about it from them?’

After everything was over, the people from the other clans immediately left the Leng Clan. However, Leng Xueyan hurriedly stopped Shangguan Yan, Duanmu Luolan, and a few others. "Can I talk privately with you guys?"

Shangguan Yan and Duanmu Luolan agreed to Leng Xueyan’s request, but they asked Ren Xiyi and the others to return to their respective residences. After that, they followed her to her new room, which used to be Leng Hua’s private room.
"Please tell me, did something happen in my clan while I was away?" Leng Xueyan asked them directly without beating around the bush.
Shangguan Yan and Duanmu Luolan exchanged glances for a moment before nodding to Leng Xueyan. "Something did happen in this clan, and it was your father’s fault."
"What do you mean by that?" Leng Xueyan asked with a frown.
Shangguan Yan let out a soft sigh. "You should know that your father wants to kill Zhang Xiaolong, right?"
"Huh?" Leng Xueyan was shocked for a moment before realizing it. "Did Zhang Xiaolong enslave my father and family?"

"Yes." Duanmu Luolan confirmed it with a nod. "Zhang Xiaolong infiltrated this clan about two weeks ago, and he enslaved Leng Hua and Leng Kuan. However, he didn’t enslave your other family members, and he ordered your father to transfer the leadership of this clan from your brother to you."

Leng Xueyan should have been sad and angry after hearing that, but her expression showed the opposite. However, the two women knew that she had a relationship with Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s other clone, so they were not surprised by her reaction. "Why did he do this?"
"He did it for you and for himself." Ling Xueyan looked at Shangguan Yan in confusion. "You have a relationship with his twin brother in the Grand Royal Realm, right?"

Leng Xueyan was momentarily stunned before her face turned red, and she nodded at them. "I did meet his twin brother in the Grand Royal Realm, but I didn’t expect to have such a relationship with him."
"Haha." Both women laughed at her expression. "You’re lucky, you know? If you were hostile to him, like your father, I’m sure you would suffer the same fate as him."
Leng Xueyan did not refute that, especially after she heard so many things from Zhang Fei [5]. "Are you two his women now?"
"We have other business to attend to, so we’ll be leaving now." Duanmu Luolan quickly pulled Shangguan Yan out of the room.

"For sure, they have a relationship with Zhang Xiaolong!" Leng Xueyan then thought of something, but her expression showed hesitation. "Hmm? Should I go see him? Tch! He’s causing me trouble by making me the leader of my clan, making me unable to move freely! Sigh! I’ll take care of my clan first before deciding whether I’ll see him or not."

Meanwhile, Bian Ling has arrived at Bian Zhizhu’s residence, but the spider queen’s attitude confused her, especially since she couldn’t remember anything about last night’s events. ’Could it be that the mysterious woman erased some of her memories? What is her real purpose in doing all this?’
"Why are you daydreaming? Why didn’t you answer my question about where you were before?" Bian Zhizhu questioned her.
"My queen, you told me to follow a man yesterday." Bian Zhizhu furrowed her brows, forcing Bian Ling to share her memories. "You can see for yourself, my queen."

Bian Zhizhu nodded slightly and looked at her memories directly, and she found that she had indeed told Bian Ling to follow Zhang Xiaolong [3]. However, she felt strange about it, especially since she couldn’t remember her own order. ’What happened to me? Why can’t I remember that?’
While Bian Zhizhu was confused, Bian Luosha took over her body. However, her expression also looked confused, especially since she couldn’t remember it either.
Bian Luosha then asked Bian Ling. "Do you remember the reason I ordered you to follow him?"

"My queen, you said that he was handsome, and you wanted to have fun with him, so you asked me to follow him." Bian Luosha agreed with Bian Ling that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was handsome, but she doubted that she ordered her to follow him because of that, and she felt that there was a piece missing from her memories. "Do you want to meet him, my queen?"
"No." Bian Luosha immediately sat up on her bed. "Massage me."

’Tch! This little spider! I really want to eat her soul!’ Since she was still in Bian Ling’s body, she immediately followed Bian Luosha’s wishes and massaged her. "Are you sure you don’t want to meet him, my queen? I’ve taken a close look at him, and not only is he handsome, but his body is also perfect. The most important thing is that his yang qi is powerful, and it should be able to help you strengthen your body."
Bian Luosha frowned in response. "Why are you being talkative today?"
"I just want to persuade you to do the right thing, my queen." Bian Luosha immediately pinched Bian Ling’s cheek. "Ouch! It hurts, my queen!"
"Nonsense!" Bian Luosha shouted at her and pinched her cheeks harder. "You have the ability to numb your painful nerves, so you won’t be in pain just because of this."
"Hehe." Bian Ling giggled. "My queen, if you are not interested in that man, I will go meet him and make him mine, and I will lock him in my nest."
Hearing that, Bian Luosha pushed Bian Ling down on the bed and pinned her beneath her. "Are you not satisfied with me, my Ling?"

"How could I not be satisfied with you, my queen?" Bian Ling embraced her neck and kissed her. "If I were not satisfied with you, I would not have stayed by your side to serve you, and I would have fulfilled my father’s wish to marry me off, right?"
Bian Luosha nodded at her. "Then, why do you want that man?"

’This woman is vile, but she also has such a soft side, huh?’ Bian Ling then explained it to her. "My queen, it’s rare to find a handsome and strong man like him. His Yang Qi and life essence are also strong, so it’s natural that I want him, right? If you’re jealous, we can have fun with him together."
Bian Luosha shook his head and let go of Bian Ling. "Leave me first; I want to think about something."

"Yes." Bian Ling immediately got up, gave Bian Luosha a kiss, and hurriedly left her room. She didn’t leave the building, but instead, she eavesdropped on Lei Yulong’s conversation with several other people.
Bian Luosha leaned on the bedrest and tried to recall yesterday’s events, but she still couldn’t remember anything no matter how hard she tried.

"What actually happened to me? Is it possible that someone intentionally altered my memories? Who did it?" As soon as she had that thought, Bian Luosha felt an overwhelming drowsiness and immediately fell asleep. Seconds later, black light enveloped his body, but it didn’t last long and disappeared again.
"Ling’er." Bian Ling turned into the middle-aged man who was none other than his father, Bian Luo. "Where have you been? Why didn’t I see you yesterday?"

’Annoying pest!’ Bian Ling immediately told Bian Luo about the orders Bian Luosha had given her. "Therefore, I just came back this morning, but my queen didn’t seem to feel well, so I left her to rest."
Bian Luo nodded in understanding. "I want you to go to the Gao Clan to see Gao Ou as soon as possible."

"No." Bian Ling refused. "If you want me to marry Gao Ou, you must ask permission from my queen first. However, she will definitely not agree to your wishes, especially since she hates the Gao Clan so much."
"You—"
"Go to see my queen, and I will go to the Gao Clan if she agrees with you." Bian Ling immediately left her father, causing Bian Luo’s face to darken.
Bian Luo took a deep breath, and he looked towards Bian Luoshu’s room before leaving with a frightened look.

After Bian Ling arrived in another area, she immediately entered her soul space. In a few minutes, Nalan Yushu came out of her body and floated in front of her. "Sigh! I wanted to help my master find information about that mysterious woman from Bian Luosha, but she didn’t seem to know anything about her, especially since that woman intentionally altered some of her memories."

After Nalan Yushu disappeared, Bian Ling returned to her senses, but she looked around her in confusion. "Why am I standing here? Hmm? I have to see my queen, or she will scold me if I don’t accompany her."
Bian Ling doesn’t remember anything about yesterday’s events, especially since Nalan Yushu deliberately changed some of her memories.
Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was contemplating on the second floor of a teahouse, raised an eyebrow when he saw Nalan Yushu flying towards him. ’Did you get any information about that mysterious woman?’

’Master, that mysterious woman intentionally erased some of Bian Luosha’s memories, so I didn’t manage to dig up any information about her.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] sighed in disappointment, but Nalan Yushu immediately told him another piece of information. ’By the way, you should leave this place because some beast races have different thoughts about you, and they don’t like your status as the heir of the ten-tailed fox.’
Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised his eyebrows. ’Are they thinking about attacking me?’

’I can’t say for sure, but I think you shouldn’t confront them for now, especially since your condition is unstable. If you lose control and your anger overcomes you, your cursed demon heart will rise faster, and it will harm many people.’
Zhang Xiaolong [3] pressed his palm to his chest and squeezed it. A crazy idea suddenly flashed in his mind, but he then shook his head.

Mei immediately spoke to him. [You should forget about your crazy idea, Master. Throwing away your humanity and focusing on your demon side is not a good thing, especially with the presence of the cursed demon heart in your body.]
’I know.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] then stood up. "Old Ju, let’s leave this place and catch up with your family in the Verdant Northern Forest."
Ju Tan was taken aback for a moment, but he hurriedly followed Zhang Xiaolong [3] out of the coffee shop, and they flew toward the portal out of the dimensional space at high speed.

Sometime later, they had arrived at the back of the Verdant Northern Forest, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately searched for Ren Xiyi and the others’ location on his map. Once he managed to locate them, he brought Ju Tan to meet them.
When they arrived there, Ju Ning and the others were skinning their catch from last night, and Ju Tan rushed to help them.

"Is there something bothering you?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Qian Shuang. "I don’t know how to explain it to you, but I can feel that your emotions are unstable, and you are also afraid of something."
"Hey, Qian Shuang has had that ability since childhood." Ren Xiyi spoke to him.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at them. "You’re right, I am indeed afraid of something, and I haven’t felt this afraid since I became a cultivator."
*Slap*
Ren Xiyi suddenly slapped Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s back. "If you need someone to talk to, we’re both willing to listen to your story, and it might help you feel a little better."
"Xiyi is right; sharing with others can make us feel relieved." Qian Shuang spoke as she smiled at him.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled upon hearing that. "Thank you both for your offer, but my problem is too complicated. I don’t want to share it with anyone, including you two, especially since it’s very dangerous."
Both women seemed disappointed with Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s refusal, but they did not force him to tell them.
After Ju Tan and his family finished skinning and cleaning all their kills, they immediately continued hunting again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1022: Heaven’s Eye Perception Array
paragraphs: Inside her clan’s library, Duanmu Luolan was busy reading many books, searching for formation arrays that could be used to check on the Cao Clan without having to infiltrate it.
"Mother." Duanmu Luolan turned to the young man who had just walked in. "What are you doing here? What are you looking for in all these piles of books?"
"Yuan Hao, I’m looking for an important formation, but I can’t find it anywhere." Duanmu Luolan immediately explained to her son about her intentions. "Help me to look for it."

"I don’t think you’ll find it in them, Mother." Yuan Hao immediately went to one of the bookshelves, pushed aside all the books in front of him, and picked up an old book behind them. He then returned to Duanmu Luolan and handed it to her. "This book has older formations than the others; you may find one in it."
Duanmu Luolan immediately accepted the scroll and read every page. "Where did you find this book? Why didn’t I know this book existed? Why didn’t you give it to me?"

"A few months ago, you asked me to clean our late ancestor’s private room, and I accidentally found this book hidden in the wall." Duanmu Luolan looked at Yuan Hao with a frown. "I have read the entire contents of this book, and there are many evil formation arrays in it. Since our late ancestor deliberately hid it, I did not dare to show it to anyone, and I hid it behind others."
"Evil formation arrays?"

Yuan Hao nodded and opened one of the pages. "Look at this Thousand Souls Sacrificial Formation; it will kill every living being within its radius, forcefully extract their souls, bind them to the array, and refine them into soul or demon essence. There is also the Marionette Corpse Array, and we can use it for corpse puppeteering and creating undead armies. I don’t know where our ancestor got this book, but there are still many other evil formations in it, so you should know the danger if this book falls into other people’s hands."
"You are right." Duanmu Luolan immediately searched for the formation she needed in it. "Did you try learning all the formations in this book before?"

"I was tempted to learn them, but I didn’t want to become a heretic, so I didn’t, and I’ve hidden it ever since." Duanmu Luolan felt a sense of relief upon hearing Yuan Hao’s response. "Mother, I want to ask for your help, especially since I can’t do it myself."
"What kind of help do you need?"

"I want to propose to Shangguan Miyuan, and you are my mother, so I want you to propose to her for me." Duanmu Luolan turned to her son in surprise, especially since she had never known that Yuan Hao was close to that woman. "Actually, Miyuan and I have been in a relationship for the past two years, but we have never told anyone about our relationship."
"Do you really love Miyuan?" Duanm Luolan doubtfully asked. "She often acts childish and hot-headed, and no man likes her because of her character."

Yuan Hao scratched his head as he smiled. "Mother, Miyuan’s character is different from what she has shown so far, and she is actually a gentle and patient woman. I really like her and want to marry her, so I hope you are willing to help me talk to Aunt Yan about our relationship."

"All right, I’ll help you talk to Sister Yan, but I have to look for a detection array formation first, especially since we need it to check on the Cao Clan." Duanmu Luolan paused for a moment while looking at her son. "Hao’er, what do you think if I remarry?"

"Eh?" Duanmu Luolan surprised Yuan Hao, especially since she had always been loyal to his late father. She even repeatedly rejected his grandparents’ wishes to remarry, but she suddenly asked such a question. "Do you really want to remarry? Have you found the right man to move forward with? Who is that man? Where did you two meet?"

Duanmu Luolan inwardly sighed as she was confused about how to answer her son’s questions. Moreover, her relationship with Zhang Xiaolong [3] started with her carelessly entering his lust domain, and she kissed him without her awareness. "Actually, I got to know him when I returned to this realm, and he was the one who brought us back."

"Hmm?" Yuan Hao looked at his mother with a curious look, but Duanmu Luolan’s next story made him shocked and speechless for a while. "Is Zhang Xiaolong [3] really only in his early twenties, Mother? How could you possibly like such a young man?"

Duanmu Luolan told her son about the incident in the Leng Clan, and she also told him about their meeting in the dream. "Ever since I kissed him that night, I have been thinking about him. I have tried to put it away from my mind, but he brought me into the dream, and he talked to me about his wishes last night. However, not only is he married, but he also has so many wives."
"Hmm?" Yuan Hao frowned at that. "Why is he still seducing you if he already has so many wives? Does he never think about their feelings? Are they just objects to him?"

"You’re wrong about that." Duanmu Luolan denied it with a shake of her head. "I haven’t met all of his wives, but I’ve watched his memories with them, and I can see that they are very happy together. Moreover, there is no gap between them, and they blend together like one big happy family."

"Please share his memories with me, mother." Duanmu Luolan was hesitant to share Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s memories with Yuan Hao. "Mother, your happiness is very important to me, and I don’t want you to be with the wrong person, so I want to know what kind of man he really is."

Duanmu Luolan eventually shared Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s memories with her son, and Yuan Hao immediately closed his eyes to watch it all. His expression turned stupefied as soon as he saw so many beautiful women gathered in one place, and all of them belonged to one man.

Even so, Yuan Hao’s expression did not show the slightest hint of jealousy or envy, and there was only admiration in it, mainly because of the warmth and harmony between the women. Soon, he opened his eyes and spoke to his mother. "Mother, please contact him and tell him that I want to talk to him."
"Why do you want to do that?" Duanmu Luolan asked in confusion.

"The relationship between his wives is admirable, but I don’t know him yet, so I want to meet and talk to him." Yuan Hao then grabbed her hand. "You are my mother, and I am the only man in our family. Therefore, I must ensure that you will not be disappointed in the future, and I hope that he is willing to meet me."

Duanmu Luolan pulled one hand back and rubbed her son’s face. "I’m really proud to have a son like you, Hao’er. All right, I’ll contact him, but I don’t know when he’ll meet you, and I hope you can maintain your character when you two meet, especially since he’s a little weird."
"Haha." Yuan Hao nodded to his mother and stood up. "In that case, I will go see Shi Ming and the others, and we—"

"Hao’er, I hope you stay away from them for the time being." Yuan Hao seemed confused by Duanmuo Luolan’s request. "All these years, the Tian, Qing, and Shi Clans have been good. However, things changed after Zhang Xiaolong [3] took over the Leng Clan, and they began to show their true character. They wanted to seize the Leng Clan from him, and they had begun to devise plans to harm him."
"Is that true, Mother?" Huan Hao found it difficult to believe his mother because he knew Tian Jingxuan and the others well.

Duanmu Luolan nodded at him. "A few days ago, they tried to persuade the Yin, Lin, and Chi Clans to join forces with them to attack Zhang Xiaolong [3]. However, Yin Cheng and Lin Zuxin have already rejected their proposal, while Chi Yuexin has yet to make up her mind, despite my attempts to persuade her to also reject it. They haven’t acted due to the Cho Clan and their allies, but the situation will change once we manage to stop that clan, and they will probably attack him right after that."
"Why would they do that?"
"Greed and jealousy." Duanmu Luolan then asked. "You’ve seen the pills at the Sky Jade Shop, right?"
"Yes."

"The Sky Jade Shop belongs to Zhang Xiaolong [3], but Jia Yuyan and the spirit races help him to manage it, and all the pills there are his concoction." Duanmu Luolan’s response shocked him. "He is a Venerable Rank alchemist, so you shouldn’t be surprised if he can concoct those pills. Moreover, Tian Jingxuan and the others have been eyeing the Leng Clan for a long time, but they didn’t expect that he would take it over, which angered them."

Yuan Hao nodded in understanding. "He shouldn’t take over the Leng Clan, and he can hand it over to them. This way, there won’t be any tension between them, and they won’t possibly think of harming him."

"Your thoughts are too innocent and naive, Hao’er." Duanmu Luolan released a soft sigh. "Do you think they can take over the Leng Clan? If they had that ability, they would have done it a long time ago. Zhang Xiaolong [3] was able to do it because he had powerful acquaintances, and they were aware of that. He was also trying to help us stop the Cao Clan and Qi Lai by bringing his acquaintances to this realm, and he only wanted the Leng Clan in return. Unfortunately, Tian Jingxuan and the others were too greedy, and they forgot that they were powerless to fight those people without him and his acquaintances. If he gets angry and takes acquaintances away from our realm, those people will take over this realm, and all the inhabitants will suffer because of them."
Yuan Hao naturally knew that the Cao Clan was powerful, and they were still supported by several other clans, such as the Gu, Sima, and Bao Clans. "Is their new ally that powerful, Mother?"

"Qi Lai came from the realm beyond, so no one in this realm can defeat him." Duanmu Luolan’s answer shocked Yuan Hao again. "I can’t explain in detail, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] has some acquaintances from that realm, and they are in our realm right now. They are our hope to save us and this realm, but Tian Jingxuan and the others are more concerned with their ambition and greed. Therefore, I want you to keep your distance from Shi Ming and the others, at least until this matter is over, or he will regard you as his enemy as well."

"Phew." Yuan Hao released a heavy sigh. "That’s why I hate politics, and I will never be interested in such a thing. In that case, I will contact Shi Ming now, and I will go somewhere else to take care of things."

"Yes." After her son left, Duanmu Luolan immediately read the old book again, and she found a formation that allowed them to check on the Cao Clan without infiltrating it. "Where exactly did my ancestor find this book? Could it be that all the formations in this book are relics from that era? This Heaven’s Eye Perception Array should be able to help us check on the clan, but the grade is unknown, and I have never heard of some of the materials used to make it either."

Duanmu Luolan decided to inform Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he asked her to meet him in the Verdant Northern Forest. She immediately put the book into her storage ring, arranged all the scattered books, and left her clan.

A few hours later, Duanmu Luolan arrived at the Verdant Northern Forest and found a group resting in one of the clearings, so she landed in front of them. She immediately noticed that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was not like his usual self, and he seemed to be thinking about something heavy. "Is something bothering you?"
"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shortly replied and extended his hand to her. "Let me see the materials to create the formation first."

chapters.title: Chapter 1023: Leave
paragraphs: Duanmu Luolan immediately gave the old book to Zhang Xiaolong [3] while warning him. "Don’t study the other formation arrays, especially since they are used for evil purposes."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to Duanmu Luolan, but he certainly did not listen to her warning, especially since he himself was a demon. He began to read the book, and Mei recorded everything into the system.

Duanmu Luolan first looked at the six giants, Ren Xiyi, and Qian Shuang before sitting down at Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s side. She waited for him to finish reading the book, but her face turned red again when she remembered the incident in the dream. ’What actually happened to him? Why did his attitude suddenly become different? He looked more serious than usual.’
Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s hand suddenly moved behind Duanmu Luolan’s waist, pulled her closer, and embraced her, making her feel embarrassed towards the people in front of them.
Duanmu Luolan glared at him, but Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s attention was completely focused on every formation in the book, making her sigh softly and let him embrace her.
Two women kept their eyes on Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Duanmu Luolan, but Ren Xiyi was not too concerned about their closeness, especially since she did not have any feelings for him.

On the other hand, Qian Shuang felt jealous of Duanmu Luolan, but she herself was still confused about her feelings, especially after their first kiss ten days ago. Moreover, her feelings for Zhang Xiaolong [3] arose because of the influence of his demon charm, and they had rarely communicated with each other, especially since he was too focused on his cultivation in the life pond.

Besides them, there was another woman who repeatedly stole glances at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. Ju Tan’s daughter, Ju Zhu, was curious about him. Her father told her that he was interested in her, but she was too quiet, making it difficult for them to communicate.
A while later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already read the Heaven’s Eye Perception Array page. ’Does the system have these materials, Mei?’

[Some materials are available in the system, but some are not, so you can’t make this formation, Master. The only way is to infiltrate the Cao Clan, and you can leave your Demon’s Eye Orb there, so you can monitor them freely.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] had considered this option, but he intended to use it as a last resort. Since the materials for creating the Heaven’s Eye Perception Array were incomplete, he had no other choice but to do that. He immediately contacted Helian Xun’er via telepathy, and she agreed to help him infiltrate the Cao Clan.

After he had read all the formations in the book and Mei had recorded them all, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately returned the book to Duanmu Luolan. "Unfortunately, we don’t have some of the materials to create the formation, so I will use other methods to check the Cao Clan. In my opinion, you should burn this book to prevent the worst, especially since the majority of the formations in it are extremely dangerous. If this book falls into the hands of evil cultivators, it will cause mass chaos, and there will be too many casualties."

"I agree with you." Duamu Luolan put the book into her storage ring again. "After I read them all, I will immediately destroy it, so it won’t bring chaos to anyone. So, what happened to you? Did you encounter anything unusual before?"

’I’ve never felt so scared since I became a cultivator, and that mysterious woman frightened me to death.’ Duanmu Luolan was a little surprised because Zhang Xiaolong [3] spoke to her using telepathy. ’I don’t know the identity of that woman, but she is one of the strongest cultivators I have ever met besides Huo Ling. I wasn’t scared when I first met the people from the Star Tower, Serpentera, and Tian Kui, but that woman was really scary to me. Fortunately, she didn’t do anything to me, and she summoned me to her place because I accidentally interfered in her affairs.’

’How did you interfere in that woman’s business?’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately told Duanmu Luolan about Bian Zhizhu and Bian Luosha, which shocked her. ’Doesn’t that mean the woman with two personalities is her puppet? What’s the purpose of that woman using her?’
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at her. ’I don’t know anything about her or her plans, and one of my acquaintances is also her puppet.’
’How did your acquaintance become her puppet?’ Duanmu Luolan asked in confusion.

’I don’t know.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] released a heavy sigh. ’The last time I met Wang Yin, the undead demon, was a year ago. She left to find a new goal in her life, and I asked her to keep in touch with me. However, she never contacted me, and I met her at the mysterious woman’s place last night. If my guess is right, the mysterious woman turned her into an undead demon for a specific purpose, and she has complete control over her, just like Bian Zhizhu or Bian Luosha.’

After hearing all that, Duanmu Luolan embraced Zhang Xiaolong [3] and held his hand. ’It doesn’t matter if you feel afraid of the mysterious woman; it proves that you are still an ordinary human with feelings, even if you are a powerful cultivator. She might be stronger than you right now, but that is because she is older and started her cultivation journey earlier than you. Moreover, you are still in your early twenties, but you have already proven that you are not an ordinary cultivator with your current cultivation. You still have a long road ahead, and I believe you will be able to reach her level in the future. At that time, you will be able to stand on equal footing with her, and you can prove to her that you are better than her in all aspects.’

’You’re right.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] leaned against a tree and looked up at the sky. ’That mysterious woman is indeed too strong for the current me, and her status is probably not ordinary in her realm. However, I’ve gone through a lot to reach this stage, and I will never stop improving myself. I will use last night’s incident as encouragement for me, and I will work even harder to become even stronger. Once I manage to surpass her, I will find her and kick her ass.’

Duanmu Luolan smiled in amusement when she heard that, but she believed that Zhang Xiaolong [3] would not do such a thing to the mysterious woman, and he would definitely do something else to her. ’Hey, my son wants to meet you, and I hope you are willing to meet him and talk to him.’
’Oh?’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately teased her. ’Why did you tell your son about me? Does this mean you are willing to accept me now?’

Duanmu Luolan denied it with a shake of her head. ’I told my son about you because I’m still thinking about our relationship, and I wanted to hear his opinion, but he wanted to meet and talk to you first.’
’All right, I will meet your son tomorrow.’
Duanmu Luolan was relieved to hear that. "Since you still want to hunt beasts with them, I will return to my clan now."

"I’ll send you there." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then opened a teleportation portal, which surprised Duanmu Luolan and the others. "This is one of my beast abilities, and you will arrive at the main city directly, so you don’t have to waste time on a long journey."
"I will wait for you in my clan tomorrow."
After Duanmu Luolan disappeared, Zhang Xiaolong immediately closed the portal and approached Qian Shuang, especially since he noticed her expression earlier. "Let’s take a night walk."
"Yeah." Qian Shuang shyly followed beside him.
"Are you interested in him, Xiyi?"
Ren Xiyi shook her head at Ju Tan. "Uncle Ju, I only want a man who loves me alone, so I will never be interested in him regardless of his extraordinary talents."

"Hahaha." Ju Tan laughed before speaking to her daughter. "Zhu’er, I know you’re shy, but I hope you can open up more. Our master does have many wives, but your mother and I still feel that he is the best man for you. Moreover, he has already expressed that he is interested in you, so we hope you can get closer to him first before going any further."
"Yes, Father." Ju Zhu nodded at him.
In another forest area, Qian Shuang blushed because Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly pressed her against a tree, causing her heart to beat faster and louder.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] lifted her chin and looked into her eyes. "You are really pretty, and I like your eyes as they radiate gentleness and innocence. I have wronged you, and I shouldn’t have used my charm on you."

"It happened, and I never blamed you." Qian Shuang clenched her fists in nervousness, stood on tiptoes to briefly kiss him, and then hugged him. "I hope you are willing to spend your time with me, so I can get to know you better and understand my feelings."
"All right, I will make more time for you." Zhang Xiaolong [3] hugged Qin Shuang back and took her up the branch of the tallest tree, where they talked a lot about each other’s lives.
"Why are you pouting?"

Wei Xiaoya turned to Zhang Fei [5]. "My mother has been bothering me all day, especially since we haven’t had our first night yet. I have already explained to her that I am not ready to give myself to you, as our marriage happened solely due to her insistence, and I don’t have any feelings for you whatsoever. However, she never stopped urging me to give myself to you, and she even asked me to get pregnant with your child as soon as possible."

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that and sat next to her. "How about you go with me to another realm? If you don’t meet our mother, she won’t be able to pressure you anymore, and you don’t need to be upset like this. Moreover, you are my wife now, so I think our parents won’t mind if you go with me."
Wei Xiaoya furrowed her brows. "Are you already planning to leave this realm?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "I originally planned to stay a few days in this realm to open my shops, but I’ve been here for almost two weeks now, which is because of our sudden relationship. Therefore, I plan to leave tomorrow morning, and I will go to the Shandian Realm first to open some shops there. After that, I will go to the Falling Star Realm to see my master’s senior sister, and I might also open some shops there if that realm has good prospects."
Wei Xiaoya thought deeply about his offer. "Okay, I’ll go with you so I don’t have to meet my mother; otherwise, I’ll die of irritation from her pestering me like that."
"Let’s meet our parents first."

"Father! Mother!" Wei Hongtian and Hun Liying, who were talking in front of their room, immediately turned to the two. "Zhang Fei wants to go to the Shandian Realm and open some shops there, and since I’m his wife now, I’ll go with him tomorrow morning. We probably won’t be back for a long time, especially since he’s also planning to open shops in various realms."
Wei Hongtian nodded in understanding. "All right, you two can go, but I hope you won’t forget us and come back often."

"Haha." Wei Xiaoya softly laughed. "You two are my parents, so how could I forget you? Moreover, Zhang Fei has his gate ability, so we can come back here whenever we want. All right, I’ll go back to my room to pack, and you two can talk to him first."

After Wei Xiaoya left, Hun Liying immediately pulled Zhang Fei [5] to sit with them. "Son, I heard what you did to Jiang Bai from Ling Yingfei, and she enjoyed the results so much, so I want you to do the same to your father."
Zhang Fei [5] turned to his father-in-law, who smiled awkwardly. "Do you really want that, father-in-law?"
"As the saying goes, ’Happy wife, happy life.’" Wei Hongtian replied with a resigned sigh.

Zhang Fei [5] laughed upon hearing that from the Wei Emperor, and he immediately stood behind him and used his body modification ability on him, causing him discomfort, especially on his lower body. "It’s done."
"Has that thing really changed?" Hun Liying asked with sparkling eyes.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "Mother-in-law, I will leave you two alone now, and you can check it yourself."

After Zhang Fei [5] left, Hun Liying hurriedly pulled her husband into their room, causing Wei Hongtian to feel helpless with his attitude. The empress was overjoyed after seeing the results, and the two hurriedly had fun.

On his way back to his room, Zhang Fei [5] bumped into Wei Xiaolu, who stared at him hatefully. "Why are you looking at me like that, my fatty sister-in-law? Do you want me to make your body even fatter?"
"You—" Wei Xiaolu swallowed her words and ran away from Zhang Fei [5], as she was afraid that he would make her appearance even worse. ’Tch! I’ll kill him one day!’
Zhang Fei [5] just shook his head and rushed back to his room, where he spent the night with Wei Xiaoya.

sentences.text: Duanmu Luolan immediately gave the old book to Zhang Xiaolong [3] while warning him.
"Don’t study the other formation arrays, especially since they are used for evil purposes."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to Duanmu Luolan, but he certainly did not listen to her warning, especially since he himself was a demon.
He began to read the book, and Mei recorded everything into the system.
Duanmu Luolan first looked at the six giants, Ren Xiyi, and Qian Shuang before sitting down at Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s side.
She waited for him to finish reading the book, but her face turned red again when she remembered the incident in the dream. ’What actually happened to him?
Why did his attitude suddenly become different?
He looked more serious than usual.’
Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s hand suddenly moved behind Duanmu Luolan’s waist, pulled her closer, and embraced her, making her feel embarrassed towards the people in front of them.
Duanmu Luolan glared at him, but Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s attention was completely focused on every formation in the book, making her sigh softly and let him embrace her.
Two women kept their eyes on Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Duanmu Luolan, but Ren Xiyi was not too concerned about their closeness, especially since she did not have any feelings for him.
On the other hand, Qian Shuang felt jealous of Duanmu Luolan, but she herself was still confused about her feelings, especially after their first kiss ten days ago.

Moreover, her feelings for Zhang Xiaolong [3] arose because of the influence of his demon charm, and they had rarely communicated with each other, especially since he was too focused on his cultivation in the life pond.
Besides them, there was another woman who repeatedly stole glances at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Ju Tan’s daughter, Ju Zhu, was curious about him.
Her father told her that he was interested in her, but she was too quiet, making it difficult for them to communicate.
A while later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already read the Heaven’s Eye Perception Array page. ’Does the system have these materials, Mei?’
[Some materials are available in the system, but some are not, so you can’t make this formation, Master.
The only way is to infiltrate the Cao Clan, and you can leave your Demon’s Eye Orb there, so you can monitor them freely.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] had considered this option, but he intended to use it as a last resort.
Since the materials for creating the Heaven’s Eye Perception Array were incomplete, he had no other choice but to do that.
He immediately contacted Helian Xun’er via telepathy, and she agreed to help him infiltrate the Cao Clan.
After he had read all the formations in the book and Mei had recorded them all, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately returned the book to Duanmu Luolan.
"Unfortunately, we don’t have some of the materials to create the formation, so I will use other methods to check the Cao Clan.
In my opinion, you should burn this book to prevent the worst, especially since the majority of the formations in it are extremely dangerous.
If this book falls into the hands of evil cultivators, it will cause mass chaos, and there will be too many casualties."
"I agree with you." Duamu Luolan put the book into her storage ring again.
"After I read them all, I will immediately destroy it, so it won’t bring chaos to anyone.
So, what happened to you?
Did you encounter anything unusual before?"

’I’ve never felt so scared since I became a cultivator, and that mysterious woman frightened me to death.’ Duanmu Luolan was a little surprised because Zhang Xiaolong [3] spoke to her using telepathy. ’I don’t know the identity of that woman, but she is one of the strongest cultivators I have ever met besides Huo Ling.
I wasn’t scared when I first met the people from the Star Tower, Serpentera, and Tian Kui, but that woman was really scary to me.
Fortunately, she didn’t do anything to me, and she summoned me to her place because I accidentally interfered in her affairs.’

’How did you interfere in that woman’s business?’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately told Duanmu Luolan about Bian Zhizhu and Bian Luosha, which shocked her. ’Doesn’t that mean the woman with two personalities is her puppet?
What’s the purpose of that woman using her?’
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at her. ’I don’t know anything about her or her plans, and one of my acquaintances is also her puppet.’
’How did your acquaintance become her puppet?’ Duanmu Luolan asked in confusion.
’I don’t know.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] released a heavy sigh. ’The last time I met Wang Yin, the undead demon, was a year ago.
She left to find a new goal in her life, and I asked her to keep in touch with me.
However, she never contacted me, and I met her at the mysterious woman’s place last night.
If my guess is right, the mysterious woman turned her into an undead demon for a specific purpose, and she has complete control over her, just like Bian Zhizhu or Bian Luosha.’

After hearing all that, Duanmu Luolan embraced Zhang Xiaolong [3] and held his hand. ’It doesn’t matter if you feel afraid of the mysterious woman; it proves that you are still an ordinary human with feelings, even if you are a powerful cultivator.
She might be stronger than you right now, but that is because she is older and started her cultivation journey earlier than you.
Moreover, you are still in your early twenties, but you have already proven that you are not an ordinary cultivator with your current cultivation.
You still have a long road ahead, and I believe you will be able to reach her level in the future.
At that time, you will be able to stand on equal footing with her, and you can prove to her that you are better than her in all aspects.’

’You’re right.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] leaned against a tree and looked up at the sky. ’That mysterious woman is indeed too strong for the current me, and her status is probably not ordinary in her realm.
However, I’ve gone through a lot to reach this stage, and I will never stop improving myself.
I will use last night’s incident as encouragement for me, and I will work even harder to become even stronger.
Once I manage to surpass her, I will find her and kick her ass.’

Duanmu Luolan smiled in amusement when she heard that, but she believed that Zhang Xiaolong [3] would not do such a thing to the mysterious woman, and he would definitely do something else to her. ’Hey, my son wants to meet you, and I hope you are willing to meet him and talk to him.’
’Oh?’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately teased her. ’Why did you tell your son about me?
Does this mean you are willing to accept me now?’

Duanmu Luolan denied it with a shake of her head. ’I told my son about you because I’m still thinking about our relationship, and I wanted to hear his opinion, but he wanted to meet and talk to you first.’
’All right, I will meet your son tomorrow.’
Duanmu Luolan was relieved to hear that.
"Since you still want to hunt beasts with them, I will return to my clan now."
"I’ll send you there." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then opened a teleportation portal, which surprised Duanmu Luolan and the others.
"This is one of my beast abilities, and you will arrive at the main city directly, so you don’t have to waste time on a long journey."
"I will wait for you in my clan tomorrow."
After Duanmu Luolan disappeared, Zhang Xiaolong immediately closed the portal and approached Qian Shuang, especially since he noticed her expression earlier.
"Let’s take a night walk."
"Yeah." Qian Shuang shyly followed beside him.
"Are you interested in him, Xiyi?"
Ren Xiyi shook her head at Ju Tan.
"Uncle Ju, I only want a man who loves me alone, so I will never be interested in him regardless of his extraordinary talents."
"Hahaha." Ju Tan laughed before speaking to her daughter.
"Zhu’er, I know you’re shy, but I hope you can open up more.
Our master does have many wives, but your mother and I still feel that he is the best man for you.
Moreover, he has already expressed that he is interested in you, so we hope you can get closer to him first before going any further."
"Yes, Father." Ju Zhu nodded at him.
In another forest area, Qian Shuang blushed because Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly pressed her against a tree, causing her heart to beat faster and louder.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] lifted her chin and looked into her eyes.
"You are really pretty, and I like your eyes as they radiate gentleness and innocence.
I have wronged you, and I shouldn’t have used my charm on you."
"It happened, and I never blamed you." Qian Shuang clenched her fists in nervousness, stood on tiptoes to briefly kiss him, and then hugged him.
"I hope you are willing to spend your time with me, so I can get to know you better and understand my feelings."
"All right, I will make more time for you." Zhang Xiaolong [3] hugged Qin Shuang back and took her up the branch of the tallest tree, where they talked a lot about each other’s lives.
"Why are you pouting?"
Wei Xiaoya turned to Zhang Fei [5].
"My mother has been bothering me all day, especially since we haven’t had our first night yet.
I have already explained to her that I am not ready to give myself to you, as our marriage happened solely due to her insistence, and I don’t have any feelings for you whatsoever.
However, she never stopped urging me to give myself to you, and she even asked me to get pregnant with your child as soon as possible."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that and sat next to her.
"How about you go with me to another realm?
If you don’t meet our mother, she won’t be able to pressure you anymore, and you don’t need to be upset like this.
Moreover, you are my wife now, so I think our parents won’t mind if you go with me."
Wei Xiaoya furrowed her brows.
"Are you already planning to leave this realm?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her.
"I originally planned to stay a few days in this realm to open my shops, but I’ve been here for almost two weeks now, which is because of our sudden relationship.

After that, I will go to the Falling Star Realm to see my master’s senior sister, and I might also open some shops there if that realm has good prospects."
Wei Xiaoya thought deeply about his offer.
"Okay, I’ll go with you so I don’t have to meet my mother; otherwise, I’ll die of irritation from her pestering me like that."
"Let’s meet our parents first."
"Father!

"Zhang Fei wants to go to the Shandian Realm and open some shops there, and since I’m his wife now, I’ll go with him tomorrow morning.
We probably won’t be back for a long time, especially since he’s also planning to open shops in various realms."
Wei Hongtian nodded in understanding.
"All right, you two can go, but I hope you won’t forget us and come back often."
"Haha." Wei Xiaoya softly laughed.
"You two are my parents, so how could I forget you?
Moreover, Zhang Fei has his gate ability, so we can come back here whenever we want.
All right, I’ll go back to my room to pack, and you two can talk to him first."

chapters.title: Chapter 1024: Send The Demon’s Eye Orb
paragraphs: "These tree formation arrays are similar to those in our forest, but they are more complex than ours." Sabina, the dryad leader from the Sky Jade Realm, spoke in awe.
Qian Shuang immediately explained to her. "These tree formation arrays were created by Aunt Shenlin, and she is a dryad like you."
"I see." Sabina nodded in understanding before turning to her members. "Will the dryads in your forest be willing to accept them?"

"Since Aunt Yuyan and the others have agreed, they will definitely be willing to accept all of you, so you don’t have to worry about that." Qian Shuang immediately activated the formation, revealing the path to the underground. "Let’s enter."
After Qian Shuang pulled Zhang Xiaolong [3] into the underground, Sabina and the other leaders immediately led their members into the place in neat rows.
Since Elmyra was not with them, Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked Qian Shuang to lead the elf race members from the Sky Jade Realm, especially since she herself was an elf.
"How did you guys manage to build such a big and strong underground?" Gravir, the dwarf, asked Qian Shuang.
Tanbar, the gnome leader, was also curious about it. "Are there many dwarf and gnome races in there?"

"Yes, there are many dwarf and gnome races in our forest, and their ancestors built this underground, assisted by other races." Qian Shuang’s answer made Gravir and Tanbar excited, and they couldn’t wait to meet the two races. "When we get there, Aunt Yuyan will take you to each race’s residential area, and you’ll live with them from now on."
When they came out of the underground, Jia Yuyan and several other people were already waiting for them in front of the exit.

However, Qian Chaoying smiled strangely, especially when he saw his daughter intimately hugging Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s arm. He initially didn’t like him, but the effect of his pills made him eager to match the two.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] naturally noticed Qian Chaoying’s expression, but he ignored him and introduced the natural races of the Sky Jade Realm to them.
Jia Yuyan then brought Oliver and the fairy race members with him. Ren Shuo brought Gravir and the dwarf race members. Zhu Ru led Tanbar and his people to another area, where the gnome race lived.

After Qian Chaoying brought the elf races of the Sky Jade Realm away, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately spoke to Jing Shenlin. "Lillea has already treated Cassia, Milia, and Viola as her own daughters, so I hope you can take good care of them."
"Don’t worry, I will definitely take good care of them." Jing Shenlin then led Sabina and the other dryads to follow her.
Before the three followed them, Cassia, Milia, and Viola first kissed Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Are they your women too?" Qian Shuang suddenly asked as she looked at the three dryads.

"Not really." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then recounted to Qian Shuang about his first meeting with Cassia, Milia, and Viola. "Even though we often kissed in the past, they didn’t want to be my women because Lillea and Janette were their queen and princess, and they didn’t want to be in an equal position with them."
Qian Shuang nodded in understanding. "The dryads in this forest don’t have that kind of feeling either, and they reproduce independently."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] softly laughed, hugged her waist, and then led her to meet Qian Chaoying. "In fact, Lillea was like them before, and she gave birth to Janette independently. It even took me a while to convince her, but she eventually became my wife."
"Are you interested in some of the women in this forest?" Qian Shuang curiously asked.
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to her. "Apart from you, I’m only interested in Jia Yuyan and Ju Zhu."
Qian Shuang naturally knew about Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s interest in the two women. "What about Aunt Shenlin? Are you not interested in her?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to her with a smile. "Jing Shenlin is indeed beautiful and sexy, but I don’t feel the slightest attraction towards her; otherwise, I would have approached her from the start."
"What about Xiyi?"

"Shuang’er, I have numerous women by my side, but that doesn’t mean I’ll be interested in every woman I meet, okay?" Qian Shuang nodded slightly to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Ren Xiyi is no less beautiful than you, and I like her character. However, I don’t view her romantically; instead, I prefer to have a familial relationship with her, which makes your brother’s jealousy of me completely unfounded."

Qian Shuang released a soft sigh. "My brother has always been like that; he’s always jealous whenever he sees other men getting close to Xiyi. Even though our father and brother have warned him many times, he still never changes, which irritates her."

"I don’t care about him or his actions, but your brother will have to bear the consequences if he dares to look for trouble with me just because of his blind jealousy." Seeing Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s seriousness, Qian Shuang chose not to comment on it, but she hoped that there would be no conflict between them.

Before long, they had arrived at the area where the elf race lived, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately told Qian Chaoying that he wanted to take Qian Shuang as his wife, to which he right away agreed.

Qian Zhanji and Qian Bing were thrilled to hear the news, and they felt happy for Qian Shuang. However, Qian Li, who had hated Zhang Xiaolong [3] because of his closeness to Ren Xiyi, did not like the news.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] naturally didn’t care whether Qian Li agreed to their relationship or not, and he immediately took Qian Shuang to the main city.
"Are you really going to let Quang’er marry that bastard, Father?"

Qian Chaoying glared fiercely at his second son. "That bastard is much more capable than you, who always acts childish because of your blind jealousy. He is still in his early twenties, but his cultivation has already reached the Seven Divine Realms, and he has also become a Venerable Rank alchemist at such a young age. In contrast, it took you a few hundred years to reach that stage, and your only skill is hunting."
"Father, you—"

"I’ve decided to accept their relationship, and you’d better accept that fact; otherwise, I’ll exile you from our race, and you can look for resources for your cultivation by yourself." Not only was Qian Li shocked by Qian Chaoying’s decision, but Qian Zhanji and Qian Bing were also shocked to hear their father’s and uncle’s. "Leave and don’t ever interfere with your sister’s relationship, or I will really do what I said just now."
After Qian Li left, Qian Zhanji immediately asked his father. "Are you really serious about what you just said?"

"Don’t I look serious to you?" Qian Chaoying turned the question around with a shake of his head. "Your brother is too stupid! He can’t tell good from bad, and he will die quickly if he stays outside with that mindset."
Qian Zhanji nodded in agreement with his father. "Li’er is too stubborn and spoiled, which makes his character like that."
"Forget it." Qian Chaoying then looked at Oliver and the others. "Take care of them, Zhanji. I’ll go take care of other things."
"Yes, Father."
Helian Xun’er immediately appeared in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Qian Shuang. "Hehe! You got such a pretty elf as your new woman, eh?"
’This woman is much stronger than my father and Aunt Yuyan!’ Qian Shuang inwardly muttered as she blushed.
"Do you also want to be my woman, Senior Xun’er?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] teased her back.

"Hehe." Helian Xun’er chuckled and touched his chest with her index finger. "Honestly, I have been interested in you since your success in learning the Yin-Yang Fire Art, but you are still too weak now. If you succeed in reaching my level in the future, I might consider you, so you must work hard for that."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] simply smiled at that, and he took out the Demon’s Eye Orb. "Can you send it into that clan? I want to infiltrate there myself, but I think it’s too risky, so I want to use this thing to check on that clan."
"It’s just a trivial matter." Helian Xun’er immediately took the orb and sent it into the Cao Clan. "It’s done; you can freely spy on them from now on."
"Thank you." Zhang Xiaolong [3] thought for a moment before speaking to her again. "Senior Xun’er, I want to ask you about a woman, and she probably came from the Paradise Realm."

"Share me her image." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then shared his memories of meeting the mysterious woman with Helian Xun’er. "I’ve never met a woman like her, and her attire looks much more ancient than the attire of the residents in the Paradise Realm. Why are you looking for her?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] trembled every time he remembered the mysterious woman. "I don’t know her, but she suddenly kidnapped me and brought me to her place."

"Hmm?" Helian Xun’er frowned at that, especially since she and the others had been living in the realm for a while, but none of them had sensed the presence of such a powerful cultivator. She frowned deeper after Zhang Xiaolong [3] recalled everything. "I’ve met many powerful cultivators in the Paradise Realm, be they humans, beasts, or demons, but I’ve never heard of someone having such an ability. If she can kidnap you from inside a dream you created yourself, that means she has the same ability as you. Perhaps you guessed right that she left something in her puppet’s body, and she used it on you without you realizing it. Unfortunately, I don’t have information about a woman like her, but my master might know something about it, so I’ll go back now and ask him."
"Please inform me if your master knows anything about her, Senior Xun’er."
"All right."
After Helian Xun’er left, Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought Qian Shuang to the Duanmu Clan, especially since he had promised Duanmu Luolan to talk to her son.
"Hey! Why are you helping that kid again, Xun’er?"

Helian Xun’er ignored Hua Mei’er and informed Wan Jiang about her conversation with Zhang Xiaolong [3] just now, and she shared the mysterious woman’s appearance with him. "Can you recognize her, Master?"
"Let me see her first." Minutes later, Wan Jiang’s expression turned serious. "What happened? Didn’t that race disappear a long time ago? How can a woman from that race still exist?"
"Which race are you talking about, Master?" Sima Yun asked him.

Wan Jiang let out a soft sigh. "Based on her attire and the symbols on it, I believe that the woman is from one of the ancient clans that disappeared several million years ago, specifically the Ancient Nether Clan."
"Is the Ancient Nether Clan the same as the Nine-Nethers Demon Clan, Master?"

"No." Wan Jiang shook his head in response. "The Ancient Nether Clan is far more ancient than all the clans that exist in the Paradise Realm now, and they were extremely powerful in the past. Besides them, there were nine other ancient clans, and people in the past called them the Ten Heavenly God Clans. But several million years ago, they suddenly vanished for no apparent reason, and there are only a few records about them left behind, so no one knows whether they still exist or have vanished. The mysterious woman’s sudden appearance proves that at least one of them still exists, and the others may also still exist today, but no one knows about their whereabouts."

"Master, if that woman is truly a member of the Ancient Nether Clan, then why is she wandering around the three mortal realms? What is her purpose in turning those women into her puppets?" Helian Xun’er asked with an expression full of doubt.

Wan Jiang let out a soft sigh and shook his head. "For now, it’s just my guess, and I can’t confirm its truth. However, you can tell Zhang Fei about my guess, and you must ask him not to get too close to her puppets. If she really is a member of the Ancient Nether Clan, he will face the most dangerous enemy, and no one can save him, including those two ancient beasts."
"Yes, Master."
Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was chatting with Yuan Hao and Duanmu Luolan, immediately changed his expression after he listened to Helian Xun’er’s voice transmission.
"What happened?" Duanmu Luolan asked him.

"Do you remember the mysterious woman I told you about yesterday?" Duanmu Luolan nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "One of my acquaintances just contacted me, and her master suspects that she is a member of an ancient clan, but it should have disappeared several million years ago."
Duanmu Luolan, Yuan Hao, and Qian Shuang were shocked by that. "What clan is that? Did it come from the Paradise Realm?"

sentences.text: "These tree formation arrays are similar to those in our forest, but they are more complex than ours." Sabina, the dryad leader from the Sky Jade Realm, spoke in awe.
Qian Shuang immediately explained to her.
"These tree formation arrays were created by Aunt Shenlin, and she is a dryad like you."
"I see." Sabina nodded in understanding before turning to her members.
"Will the dryads in your forest be willing to accept them?"

"Since Aunt Yuyan and the others have agreed, they will definitely be willing to accept all of you, so you don’t have to worry about that." Qian Shuang immediately activated the formation, revealing the path to the underground.
"Let’s enter."
After Qian Shuang pulled Zhang Xiaolong [3] into the underground, Sabina and the other leaders immediately led their members into the place in neat rows.
Since Elmyra was not with them, Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked Qian Shuang to lead the elf race members from the Sky Jade Realm, especially since she herself was an elf.
"How did you guys manage to build such a big and strong underground?" Gravir, the dwarf, asked Qian Shuang.
Tanbar, the gnome leader, was also curious about it.
"Are there many dwarf and gnome races in there?"

"Yes, there are many dwarf and gnome races in our forest, and their ancestors built this underground, assisted by other races." Qian Shuang’s answer made Gravir and Tanbar excited, and they couldn’t wait to meet the two races.
"When we get there, Aunt Yuyan will take you to each race’s residential area, and you’ll live with them from now on."
When they came out of the underground, Jia Yuyan and several other people were already waiting for them in front of the exit.
However, Qian Chaoying smiled strangely, especially when he saw his daughter intimately hugging Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s arm.
He initially didn’t like him, but the effect of his pills made him eager to match the two.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] naturally noticed Qian Chaoying’s expression, but he ignored him and introduced the natural races of the Sky Jade Realm to them.
Jia Yuyan then brought Oliver and the fairy race members with him.
Ren Shuo brought Gravir and the dwarf race members.
Zhu Ru led Tanbar and his people to another area, where the gnome race lived.
After Qian Chaoying brought the elf races of the Sky Jade Realm away, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately spoke to Jing Shenlin.
"Lillea has already treated Cassia, Milia, and Viola as her own daughters, so I hope you can take good care of them."
"Don’t worry, I will definitely take good care of them." Jing Shenlin then led Sabina and the other dryads to follow her.
Before the three followed them, Cassia, Milia, and Viola first kissed Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Are they your women too?" Qian Shuang suddenly asked as she looked at the three dryads.
"Not really." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then recounted to Qian Shuang about his first meeting with Cassia, Milia, and Viola.
"Even though we often kissed in the past, they didn’t want to be my women because Lillea and Janette were their queen and princess, and they didn’t want to be in an equal position with them."
Qian Shuang nodded in understanding.
"The dryads in this forest don’t have that kind of feeling either, and they reproduce independently."
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] softly laughed, hugged her waist, and then led her to meet Qian Chaoying.
"In fact, Lillea was like them before, and she gave birth to Janette independently.
It even took me a while to convince her, but she eventually became my wife."
"Are you interested in some of the women in this forest?" Qian Shuang curiously asked.
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to her.
"Apart from you, I’m only interested in Jia Yuyan and Ju Zhu."
Qian Shuang naturally knew about Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s interest in the two women.
"What about Aunt Shenlin?
Are you not interested in her?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to her with a smile.
"Jing Shenlin is indeed beautiful and sexy, but I don’t feel the slightest attraction towards her; otherwise, I would have approached her from the start."
"What about Xiyi?"
"Shuang’er, I have numerous women by my side, but that doesn’t mean I’ll be interested in every woman I meet, okay?" Qian Shuang nodded slightly to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Ren Xiyi is no less beautiful than you, and I like her character.
However, I don’t view her romantically; instead, I prefer to have a familial relationship with her, which makes your brother’s jealousy of me completely unfounded."
Qian Shuang released a soft sigh.
"My brother has always been like that; he’s always jealous whenever he sees other men getting close to Xiyi.

"I don’t care about him or his actions, but your brother will have to bear the consequences if he dares to look for trouble with me just because of his blind jealousy." Seeing Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s seriousness, Qian Shuang chose not to comment on it, but she hoped that there would be no conflict between them.

Before long, they had arrived at the area where the elf race lived, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately told Qian Chaoying that he wanted to take Qian Shuang as his wife, to which he right away agreed.
Qian Zhanji and Qian Bing were thrilled to hear the news, and they felt happy for Qian Shuang.

Qian Chaoying glared fiercely at his second son.
"That bastard is much more capable than you, who always acts childish because of your blind jealousy.
He is still in his early twenties, but his cultivation has already reached the Seven Divine Realms, and he has also become a Venerable Rank alchemist at such a young age.
In contrast, it took you a few hundred years to reach that stage, and your only skill is hunting."
"Father, you—"

"Leave and don’t ever interfere with your sister’s relationship, or I will really do what I said just now."

"Are you really serious about what you just said?"
"Don’t I look serious to you?" Qian Chaoying turned the question around with a shake of his head.
"Your brother is too stupid!
He can’t tell good from bad, and he will die quickly if he stays outside with that mindset."
Qian Zhanji nodded in agreement with his father.
"Li’er is too stubborn and spoiled, which makes his character like that."
"Forget it." Qian Chaoying then looked at Oliver and the others.
"Take care of them, Zhanji.
I’ll go take care of other things."
"Yes, Father."

"Hehe!

’This woman is much stronger than my father and Aunt Yuyan!’ Qian Shuang inwardly muttered as she blushed.
"Do you also want to be my woman, Senior Xun’er?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] teased her back.
"Hehe." Helian Xun’er chuckled and touched his chest with her index finger.
"Honestly, I have been interested in you since your success in learning the Yin-Yang Fire Art, but you are still too weak now.
If you succeed in reaching my level in the future, I might consider you, so you must work hard for that."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] simply smiled at that, and he took out the Demon’s Eye Orb.
"Can you send it into that clan?
I want to infiltrate there myself, but I think it’s too risky, so I want to use this thing to check on that clan."
"It’s just a trivial matter." Helian Xun’er immediately took the orb and sent it into the Cao Clan.
"It’s done; you can freely spy on them from now on."
"Thank you." Zhang Xiaolong [3] thought for a moment before speaking to her again.
"Senior Xun’er, I want to ask you about a woman, and she probably came from the Paradise Realm."
"Share me her image." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then shared his memories of meeting the mysterious woman with Helian Xun’er.
"I’ve never met a woman like her, and her attire looks much more ancient than the attire of the residents in the Paradise Realm.
Why are you looking for her?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] trembled every time he remembered the mysterious woman.
"I don’t know her, but she suddenly kidnapped me and brought me to her place."
"Hmm?" Helian Xun’er frowned at that, especially since she and the others had been living in the realm for a while, but none of them had sensed the presence of such a powerful cultivator.
She frowned deeper after Zhang Xiaolong [3] recalled everything.
"I’ve met many powerful cultivators in the Paradise Realm, be they humans, beasts, or demons, but I’ve never heard of someone having such an ability.
If she can kidnap you from inside a dream you created yourself, that means she has the same ability as you.
Perhaps you guessed right that she left something in her puppet’s body, and she used it on you without you realizing it.
Unfortunately, I don’t have information about a woman like her, but my master might know something about it, so I’ll go back now and ask him."
"Please inform me if your master knows anything about her, Senior Xun’er."
"All right."
After Helian Xun’er left, Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought Qian Shuang to the Duanmu Clan, especially since he had promised Duanmu Luolan to talk to her son.
"Hey!
Why are you helping that kid again, Xun’er?"
Helian Xun’er ignored Hua Mei’er and informed Wan Jiang about her conversation with Zhang Xiaolong [3] just now, and she shared the mysterious woman’s appearance with him.
"Can you recognize her, Master?"

If she really is a member of the Ancient Nether Clan, he will face the most dangerous enemy, and no one can save him, including those two ancient beasts."
