chapters.title: Chapter 1025: The Secret of The Cao Clan I
paragraphs: "Over there." Shangguan Yan pointed in a certain direction. "Isn’t the Sky Jade Shop yours?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "All my shops and restaurants use the name Sky Jade, especially since I first stepped on my cultivation path in that realm."

"How could you bring us to this realm so quickly? What kind of gate was that earlier?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately changed into his half-fox form, which shocked Yuan Hao. "You... you are a fox beast?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned into his transcendent lust demon fox, shocking Yuan Hao again. Duanmu Luolan immediately explained to her son about his three identities, but he found it hard to believe that a living creature had three identities at once.

"You don’t need to be confused like that." Yuan Hao turned to Qian Shuang, who had not said anything before. "Zhang Xiaolong is the man in the prophecy, and he is destined to be the peacemaker for this universe."
"What kind of prophecy?"

Qian Shuang explained the prophecy to Yuan Hao directly. "No human knows about it, but all the beasts and natural races from all over the universe do. The ten-tailed fox is our savior, and Zhang Xiaolong is his successor."
"Phew." Yuan Hao sighed heavily as he massaged his forehead. "I didn’t expect you to have such a story."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head in response. "The natural and beast races may regard me as the man in the prophecy, but I don’t think much of it. I have no desire to fight for others, and I fight only for myself and those closest to me. Even so, it will ultimately involve the fate of many people, especially since those bad guys will never stop targeting me. Therefore, I will reach the pinnacle of cultivation in the future, and no one can harm my loved ones then."

"The peak of cultivation, huh?" Yuan Hao muttered under his breath. "Your dream is surely too lofty for many people, including me. However, you are different from us with your three identities, and the prophecy also wrote about you, so I believe you can achieve it. At that time, Miyuan, I, and our children will watch you from afar."
"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that. "Why do you say that? Your mother will be my wife in the future, and so will Shangguan Yan."
"Huh?" Yuan Hao looked at Shangguan Yan in shock, but he glared at Zhang Xiaolong [3] instead. "Is... is that true, Aunt Yan? Are you in love with him too?"
Shangguan Yan immediately flew away. "Let’s meet Miyuan and Han’er."
"Haha." Duanmuo Luolan laughed at Shangguan Yan’s behavior, and she hurriedly caught up to her, followed by Qian Shuang.
"You’ve got the answer, right?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] patted Yuan Hao’s shoulder. "You and Shangguan Miyuan will be my family, and I will never forget my family."
Yuan Hao let out a soft sigh. "My mother and Aunt Yan have always been loyal to their deceased husbands, but you managed to change their minds and make them fall in love with you."
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then turned to Zhe Wuming, who had just appeared. "Hmm? Congratulations, you finally broke through to the 3-Moon Divine Ascension Realm."
"Isn’t my success because of your pills? If you hadn’t given them to me, I wouldn’t have broken through now." Zhe Wuming then asked him. "Do you have any recent information about Xereth?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "Xereth is on his way to the Sovereign Heaven Realm with some people, and I plan to end everything there. However, there is a powerful cultivator from the Paradise Realm with them now, and I still don’t know the purpose of that person being willing to help them."
"What if you take me to that realm?" Zhe Wuming asked him.
"What do you think about his request?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked Yuan Hao instead.
Zhe Wuming looked at Yuan Tian in surprise. "Did he come from the Sovereign Heaven Realm?"

"I was born and grew up in that realm." Yuan Hai nodded to Zhe Wuming. "Sure, you can bring him to my realm, but he must pass those tests first, and not everyone can do it as quickly as you, which will waste a lot of time. The only way to pass them is through your gate, but you have to hide him somewhere else; otherwise, Uncle Tian and the others will notice his presence, and they will expel him by force even if he is your friend, especially since they already have plans against you."

"The only way to avoid that is to bring him to the eastern forest, and they won’t notice his presence." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told Zhe Wuming. "I will discuss this matter first with the natural races in that realm, and I will take you guys there if they agree to accommodate you temporarily."
"All right, I will wait for news from you."

After that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought Yuan Hao to his shop, and Zhe Wuming watched them from afar. However, Tian Shuixiang suddenly appeared by his side, and he immediately asked him. "Do you think we can use your status as the alchemy god?"

Tian Shuixiang shook her head in reply. "They don’t necessarily know me, so my status probably won’t be useful there. The only way is to wait for Zhang Fei to discuss it with them first, and you can focus on your cultivation there."
"What about you?"

Tian Shuixiang immediately explained to him. "Actually, Zhi Ye and I were able to defeat Xereth because our cultivation has long since reached the Five Celestial Realms, but I sealed our cultivation with a special seal, and you can only sense our cultivation in the Divine Ascension Realm. If we release the seal, the people of our races will detect our presence here, especially since it will release the power of our bloodline as well. Moreover, there was Taotie behind that demon, so we deliberately didn’t do anything. Therefore, I don’t bother with my cultivation, especially since I can only continue it in the Paradise Realm."
"I see." Zhe Wuming nodded in understanding. "Let’s go back."
"Mother? What are you doing in this realm? Why didn’t you tell us that you would follow us here?" Shangguan Miyuan asked as soon as Shangguan Yan and the others entered the shop.
Shangguan Yan pointed at Yuan Hao. "Luolan and Huan’er came to our clan to ask for your hand in marriage, but since you two are in this realm, we came here to bring you back with us."
"What?" Shangguan Han shouted loudly before asking her sister. "Since when did you have a romantic relationship with Brother Hao?"
"Hehehe." Shangguan Miyuan giggled as she stuck out her tongue. "Brother Hao and I have been lovers for the past two years, and I forbade him to tell anyone before he was ready to marry me."

’This troublesome sister of mine!’ Shangguan Han grumbled in his heart as he glanced at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. ’Fortunately, our mother has not matched her with this kid; otherwise, everything would be chaotic.’

Shangguan Miyuan walked next to Yuan Hao, hugged his arm, and spoke to her mother. "Mother, Brother Hao and I love each other, and since he has conveyed his wishes to you, I hope you are willing to agree to our relationship, and we will get married soon."
"Why should I disagree?" Shangguan Yan shook her head. "Our two clans have been on good terms since our ancestors were alive, and Hao’er is a good son, so I will fulfill your wish to get married."
"Hahaha." Shangguan Miyuan laughed loudly as she jumped for joy. "Brother Hao! We will get married soon!"
Yuan Hao hugged his lover. "Thank you, Aunt Yan. I will take good care of Miyuan and make her happy."
"Yes." Shangguan Yan replied with a relieved expression, as she had always worried that her daughter might become an old maid due to her behavior; however, those concerns had proven to be unfounded.

Shangguan Han immediately showed some pills to his mother. "Look at these pills, Mother. Our realm is much stronger than this realm, but our realm does not have as many superior-grade pills as here, so I bought quite a few pills for us."
"Our realm has these pills now." Shangguan Yan’s answer stunned her son. "This Sky Jade Shop opened a branch in our realm a few days ago, and Jia Yuyan is in charge of it."
"Huh? Are you serious about that, Mother?" Shangguan Miyuan asked.
Shangguan Yan pointed to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "He is the owner of both shops, and he also has many other shops spread across various realms."
Both Shangguan Han and Shangguan Miyuan looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in disbelief, but he only smiled at them and spoke to the shopkeeper. "Please return all their jewels."
"Yes, Young Master." The shopkeeper immediately carried out Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s order, confusing the two.
"Why did you return our jewels? Didn’t you open your shops to collect resources?" Shangguan Han asked in confusion.
"He is the future stepfather to both of you." Shangguan Han and Shangguan Miyuan’s eyes widened as they stared at Duanmu Luolan. "Just ask your mother."
Shangguan Miyuan immediately let go of Yuan Hao and hugged her mother. "Is that true, Mother? Have you really fallen in love with him?"

"Please tell us the truth, Mother." Shangguan Han urged his mother because Shangguan Yan and Zhang Xiaolong [3] had only met recently, and she didn’t show any signs when she taught him to create his domain, but their relationship had suddenly gone so far.

"You have a big mouth, Luolan." Duanm Luolan responded to Shangguan Yan with a joyful laugh, causing her to sigh helplessly. "Actually, we haven’t established such a relationship in the real world, but our relationship has indeed gone that far in the dream."
"What do you mean by ’in the dream’?" The Shangguang siblings were confused by that.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] spoke to them. "Let’s go back there first."

A while later, they had already gathered in the main hall of the Shangguan Clan, and Shangguan Yan immediately explained to his two children many things about Zhang Xiaolong [3], including his dream abilities and other wives. She told them that she was always comfortable being with him in the dream, but she still didn’t accept him in the real world.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] showed them the other two identities, and his demon identity shocked them. However, Shangguan Yan immediately provided an explanation to them, and Qian Shuang backed up her statement.

After hearing everything, Shangguan Miyuan held her mother’s hand and spoke to her. "I was truly shocked to hear about your relationship with him, Mother. Moreover, he is still very young and already has many wives; however, I always hope that you will find new happiness. chapters.title: Chapter 1026: The Secret of The Cao Clan II
paragraphs: "People experimented by combining various types of beasts or demon beasts to create new species, and the results of these failed experiments were known as chimeras. In fact, the experiments were not failures; rather, the results produced creatures that were much stronger than normal ones, but their appearance was disgusting, like the people on this screen. Look at those creatures; most lacked rationality and were completely under the control of their beast instincts." Jia Yuyan observed the people on the screen with a serious expression, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] also appeared deep in thought. "I don’t know where the Cao Clan came from or who taught them such a thing, but these creatures are very dangerous if they are allowed to run loose. Have you never seen such creatures in the Paradise Realm? According to the old man, there was a mad scientist there, and that person created the chimeras in the tower."

"I don’t know about other domains, but there have never been creatures like this roaming around in my domain. Even if they manage to enter my domain, the guards will eliminate them as soon as they set foot there." Jia Yuyan then asked him. "Can you check their strength?"

"Unfortunately, I can’t check their strength, but I’m sure they weren’t ordinary cultivators before the people from the Cao Clan turned them into chimeras like this." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then took the orb to check other areas until it reached an underground prison, where he found many humans, members of natural races, and beast races locked up in terrible conditions. "How did your people fall into their hands?"

Jia Yuyan naturally recognized the members of the natural races who were imprisoned there, which made her furious. "Back then, they went out to look for goods to trade with humans, but they never returned. We tried to look for them, but it never came to fruition. We thought they died at the hands of the beasts, but it turned out they were captured by the Cao Clan, and those bastards intended to use them for their experiments. Can you ask your friends to send us into that clan? I want to free my people, and I will kill those evil bastards."

"I can understand your feelings, but we have to investigate the Cao Clan deeper first, and we will meet him after this." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then continued to inspect the clan using the Demon’s Eyes Orb. However, they did not see anything else scary, making him wonder where the clan members were conducting their experiments. "I think they didn’t do it alone, and some other clans might be involved in their experiments."
"The Bao and Sima Clans."

"That’s right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "I’ve gotten information about the Gu Clan from Gu Changsheng’s memories, so I know they weren’t involved in these experiments. Therefore, it’s very likely that the Bao and Sima Clan members helped the Cao Clan to conduct their experiments, and they might have conducted them in one of those clans."

Upon hearing that, Jia Yuyan rested her chin on one hand while contemplating various matters. "If your guess is correct, how could they transfer the results of their experiments to the Cao Clan without other people knowing?"

"Let me check the clan in more detail." Sometime later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] found a path leading underground, and he sent the orb to check inside directly. To their surprise, they saw a fairly wide underground passageway, but it was not as wide as the one beneath the eastern forest. "We should have guessed it; they built that passageway to connect the three clans, and they transported the results of their experiments through it."
"Do you have a way to destroy the passageway?" Jia Yuan turned her head to him.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately asked Mei to buy some items at the modern shop, and he took them from the system inventory, showing them to Jia Yuyan. "We just need to plant these explosives all over the place, and I will detonate them from a distance. This way, they won’t notice our actions, especially since we don’t need to use Qi or anything. Even so, their explosions will be enormous, and the situation in this realm will probably be a bit chaotic."
"I don’t care about that! I have to stop them and free my race from the hands of the Cao Clan." Jia Yuyan immediately stood up and walked out. "Let’s go! We have to meet Zhu Ru and Ren Shuo now."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately turned off the memory extractor, flew the Demon’s Eyes Orb out of the Cao Clan, and hurried to follow Jia Yuyan to meet the two leaders of the dwarf and the genome races.

A while later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already brought many people to a rice field. He handed the explosives to the people of the two races. "Old Ren! Old Zhu! This location serves as the meeting point for the passageway, so we will begin our operation from here. After you guys enter it, you two and your men must move quickly to plant these explosives on the walls. Once you guys come out, I will immediately detonate them."

"All right." After they handed the explosives to their subordinates, Ren Shuo and Zhu Ru immediately used their earth elements and dug the ground until they reached the passageway. Once they entered it, the two immediately led their subordinates and spread out into three different passages, where they planted those explosives on both walls.
Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] monitored the situation in the underground passageway through the system map, just in case people from the three clans suddenly appeared there.
Fortunately, no members of the three clans wandered into the underground passageway in the process, leaving the people of the dwarf and the gnome races more free to carry out their duties.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] tried to check on the Bao and Sima Clans, but only the latter was protected by the same barrier as the Cao Clan. Therefore, he sent the Demon’s Eyes Orb to the Bao Clan to investigate that clan while waiting for the people from the dwarf and the gnome races to complete their tasks.
A while later, Jia Yuyan turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3] and questioned him. "Did you find any terrible things in the Bao Clan?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "There are a lot of chimeras in the Bao Clan, but they put them under their clan dungeon because they are more numerous and more brutal than the ones in the Cao Clan."
"Did you find any other nature races in the Bao Clan?"

"I couldn’t find any prisoners in the Bao Clan, and I don’t think they dare to keep them in their clan, because their barrier is more than the ones in the Cao and Sima Clans." Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a sigh after saying that. "I didn’t expect that the situation in this realm would be this awful, and none of you noticed the actions of the three clans. If Cao Ren and the others released those chimeras, then massive chaos would occur in this realm, and the situation would take too many lives."
Jia Yuyan couldn’t help but sigh listening to that. "Do you think I should tell Tian Jingxuan and the others about this matter?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately agreed. "I don’t want to waste my time dealing with the problems that arise due to their carelessness, so you should go and discuss this matter with them, and you guys should devise a plan to deal with the problems that will arise if Cao Ren and the others decide to use those chimeras."
"All right, I will go meet them now."

After Jia Yuyan left him, Zhang Xiaolong [3] tried to investigate the entire area of the Bao Clan more thoroughly. He believed that Cao Ren and the others could not create those chimeras themselves, and he was sure that there were others helping them behind the scenes. Unfortunately, he was disappointed, especially since he couldn’t find the mastermind behind it.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then turned towards the location of the Sima Clan, but Tian Kui and Serpentera suddenly appeared in front of him. "Why are you so serious? Did you find anything unusual?"
"Why did you order these natural races to do that?" Serpentera asked him.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately shared the events he had discovered in the Cao and Bao Clans with the two, causing Serpentera and Tian Kui to frown.

"Such a method is left behind in this realm, huh?" Serpentera muttered to himself. "In the past, my late master and I often encountered those creatures, and if I remember correctly, the people who controlled them were members of the Kuang Clan. However, that clan was long destroyed by those righteous cultivators, especially since they used those creatures to slaughter many living beings."
"Do you think there are still remnants of the Kuang Clan?"
Serpentera nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "You yourself have fought those creatures in the Star Tower, and I believe that the people who created them are the remnants of the Kuang Clan."

"You’re wrong about that." All of them turned to Wan Jiang, who had just arrived with his three disciples. "We have completely wiped out the Kuang Clan, leaving no remnants. However, their method of creating those creatures fell into the hands of a madman, and he created the ones in my tower. My higher-ups have hunted him for hundreds of thousands of years, but he always managed to escape thanks to his unique abilities."
"Who is that person, Old Man?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked him.
Wan Jiang looked at Serpentera and Tian Kui. "I’m sure you know that person, especially since he is an ancient beast like you two."
"Hmm?" Serpentera and Tian Kui frowned at him. "What kind of ancient beast is he?"
"The Chaos Nightmare Beast."
"What the fuck! That guy again!" Tian Kui shouted as he trembled.
"Hahaha!" Serpentera laughed as he patted his friend’s shoulder. "That incident happened too long ago, so you should forget your trauma from fighting that guy."

"Forget your ass!" Tian Kui shouted at him. "That guy almost killed me back then! He even considered transforming me into that disgusting creature! Fortunately, he was caught off guard because of those humans, and I managed to escape from him; otherwise, I would have died long ago and become like them!"
Since Mei has no data on the Chaos Nightmare Beast, Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked them. "Is that beast so powerful and terrifying?"

In addition to this, he was an amalgamation of fragments from those ancient realms, which allowed him to master the dao and the laws. "All right."

"Then—"

The female fairy immediately created a Qi screen to display the discovery she and Zhang Xiaolog made in the Cao Clan. "We were all too careless this whole time, and we didn’t pay attention to them."
"What kind of terrifying creatures are they? How could they be inside the Cao Clan?" Tian Jingxuan asked with a serious expression.

"Chimeras." Jia Yuyan then explained to them about those creatures. "We never noticed their actions because they transported those creatures through the underground passageway that connected their three clans, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] just blew them up. We don’t know the strength of those creatures, but they would definitely wreak havoc in our realm if they were released outside. Therefore, we must quickly formulate a plan to prevent the worst possibility; otherwise, there would be too many casualties."
"If that’s the case—"

Shangguan Yan hurriedly interrupted Qing Huang. "Zhang Xiaolong [3] is not a native of this realm, but we are, so we can’t keep relying on him. Moreover, he has already agreed to help us stop Qi Lai, so we have to deal with the trouble that has arisen due to our carelessness."
"I agree with her." Li Zixun spoke. "I’ve contacted the Ning and Yi Clans, and I asked them to come here immediately."

Qing Huang and Shi Yan’s expressions turned irritated, especially since Shangguan Yan and the others clearly sided with Zhang Xiaolong [3]. However, Tian Jingxuan forbade them to say anything, and they immediately sat together to discuss the matter.

sentences.text: "People experimented by combining various types of beasts or demon beasts to create new species, and the results of these failed experiments were known as chimeras.
In fact, the experiments were not failures; rather, the results produced creatures that were much stronger than normal ones, but their appearance was disgusting, like the people on this screen.

Look at those creatures; most lacked rationality and were completely under the control of their beast instincts." Jia Yuyan observed the people on the screen with a serious expression, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] also appeared deep in thought.
"I don’t know where the Cao Clan came from or who taught them such a thing, but these creatures are very dangerous if they are allowed to run loose.
Have you never seen such creatures in the Paradise Realm?
According to the old man, there was a mad scientist there, and that person created the chimeras in the tower."
"I don’t know about other domains, but there have never been creatures like this roaming around in my domain.
Even if they manage to enter my domain, the guards will eliminate them as soon as they set foot there." Jia Yuyan then asked him.
"Can you check their strength?"

"Unfortunately, I can’t check their strength, but I’m sure they weren’t ordinary cultivators before the people from the Cao Clan turned them into chimeras like this." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then took the orb to check other areas until it reached an underground prison, where he found many humans, members of natural races, and beast races locked up in terrible conditions.
"How did your people fall into their hands?"
Jia Yuyan naturally recognized the members of the natural races who were imprisoned there, which made her furious.
"Back then, they went out to look for goods to trade with humans, but they never returned.
We tried to look for them, but it never came to fruition.
We thought they died at the hands of the beasts, but it turned out they were captured by the Cao Clan, and those bastards intended to use them for their experiments.
Can you ask your friends to send us into that clan?
I want to free my people, and I will kill those evil bastards."

"I can understand your feelings, but we have to investigate the Cao Clan deeper first, and we will meet him after this." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then continued to inspect the clan using the Demon’s Eyes Orb.
However, they did not see anything else scary, making him wonder where the clan members were conducting their experiments.
"I think they didn’t do it alone, and some other clans might be involved in their experiments."
"The Bao and Sima Clans."
"That’s right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her.
"I’ve gotten information about the Gu Clan from Gu Changsheng’s memories, so I know they weren’t involved in these experiments.
Therefore, it’s very likely that the Bao and Sima Clan members helped the Cao Clan to conduct their experiments, and they might have conducted them in one of those clans."
Upon hearing that, Jia Yuyan rested her chin on one hand while contemplating various matters.
"If your guess is correct, how could they transfer the results of their experiments to the Cao Clan without other people knowing?"

To their surprise, they saw a fairly wide underground passageway, but it was not as wide as the one beneath the eastern forest.
"We should have guessed it; they built that passageway to connect the three clans, and they transported the results of their experiments through it."
"Do you have a way to destroy the passageway?" Jia Yuan turned her head to him.

"We just need to plant these explosives all over the place, and I will detonate them from a distance.
This way, they won’t notice our actions, especially since we don’t need to use Qi or anything.
Even so, their explosions will be enormous, and the situation in this realm will probably be a bit chaotic."
"I don’t care about that!
I have to stop them and free my race from the hands of the Cao Clan." Jia Yuyan immediately stood up and walked out.
"Let’s go!
We have to meet Zhu Ru and Ren Shuo now."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately turned off the memory extractor, flew the Demon’s Eyes Orb out of the Cao Clan, and hurried to follow Jia Yuyan to meet the two leaders of the dwarf and the genome races.

"Old Ren!

After you guys enter it, you two and your men must move quickly to plant these explosives on the walls.
Once you guys come out, I will immediately detonate them."
"All right." After they handed the explosives to their subordinates, Ren Shuo and Zhu Ru immediately used their earth elements and dug the ground until they reached the passageway.

Fortunately, no members of the three clans wandered into the underground passageway in the process, leaving the people of the dwarf and the gnome races more free to carry out their duties.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] tried to check on the Bao and Sima Clans, but only the latter was protected by the same barrier as the Cao Clan.
Therefore, he sent the Demon’s Eyes Orb to the Bao Clan to investigate that clan while waiting for the people from the dwarf and the gnome races to complete their tasks.

"Did you find any terrible things in the Bao Clan?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her.

"Did you find any other nature races in the Bao Clan?"

"I couldn’t find any prisoners in the Bao Clan, and I don’t think they dare to keep them in their clan, because their barrier is more than the ones in the Cao and Sima Clans." Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a sigh after saying that.
"I didn’t expect that the situation in this realm would be this awful, and none of you noticed the actions of the three clans.
If Cao Ren and the others released those chimeras, then massive chaos would occur in this realm, and the situation would take too many lives."
Jia Yuyan couldn’t help but sigh listening to that.
"Do you think I should tell Tian Jingxuan and the others about this matter?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately agreed.

"I don’t want to waste my time dealing with the problems that arise due to their carelessness, so you should go and discuss this matter with them, and you guys should devise a plan to deal with the problems that will arise if Cao Ren and the others decide to use those chimeras."
"All right, I will go meet them now."

chapters.title: Chapter 1027: The Ancestors
paragraphs: With the absence of Cao Ren and the elders, the situation in the Cao Clan was in chaos because the previous explosion was very close to their clan, which caused many of their buildings to be destroyed.

However, an old man and an old woman suddenly appeared in the clan, they were the ancestors of the Cao Clan, whom Ren Shou had told Zhang Xiaolong [3] about when they first met. The male ancestor was Cao Yunbai, and he was the one who helped Gu Changsheng when fighting the ancestor of the natural races, Ju Xing.
"What do you think happened, Old Man? Who dared attack our clan?" The female ancestor asked Cao Yubai as she gave some instructions to their clan members.

Cao Yunbai looked at the barrier protecting their clan. "Feihong, no one can get through our protection, so I’m sure the explosion just now wasn’t because someone attacked our clan directly, but it came from something else."

"Ancestors." Both of them looked at the man who had just arrived. "The explosion just now came from the underground passageway, and it not only happened in our area, but it also destroyed the other three passageways."
"Hmm?" Both Cao Yunbai and Cao Feihong frowned. "Did no one detect the mastermind’s movements? Have you checked the ruins of the passageway?"

"Ancestor, our warning alarms didn’t activate before the explosion, so we couldn’t detect the mastermind’s movements. I have already ordered people to excavate the ruins of the passageway, but we don’t have many earth element cultivators, so it will probably take a while before we can investigate the cause of the explosion."
Cao Yunbai nodded in understanding. "Leave and help the others."
"Yes, Ancestor."

Cao Yunbai then used his senses to inspect the area for remnants of the culprit’s Qi, and he managed to find many thin traces of it there. He then informed Cao Feihong. "The mastermind is not one person but dozens, but I don’t understand how they could destroy it without leaving a strong trace of Qi. They destroyed all four passageways at the same time, so they must have used a large amount of Qi to do it. Our alarm should have detected their actions, and both of us would have sensed their movements, but we didn’t feel anything even after the explosion happened."

"I also think that this incident is really strange." Cao Feihong then asked him. "Do you think the previous explosions had something to do with the Tian and Shangguan Clans? After all, only those two clans still have their ancestors, so I think they might be the masterminds."

"That’s impossible." Cai Yunbai immediately denied it and looked towards the location of the two clans. "I am familiar with the Qi of Tian Jinfeng and Shangguan Mengxin, and the traces of Qi I found in the ruins do not belong to them. Furthermore, they have not come out of their seclusion cave, so I am certain that they are not the masterminds. We were too focused on our seclusion before, and we were unaware of several events in this realm until the explosion just now."
"I will order our clansmen to investigate everything." Cai Feihong immediately ordered some people to investigate everything that had happened recently in their realm.

"Those masterminds could be hiding anywhere in this realm, and they might not dare to come out after attacking us." Cao Yunbai then contacted Cao Ren and the others, ordering them to return as soon as possible. He also contacted the three ancestors of the Bao, Sima, and Gu Clans. "Our lifespan continues to decrease, but we still have no way to break through to the next stage. If we continue like this, we will die like our predecessors."

Cao Feihong looked gloomy because of that. "What exactly did we do wrong? Do we need something else to break through to the next stage? The ancient records in our realm’s library clearly indicate that the realm beyond and the next cultivation level exist, but they don’t provide any instructions on how to ascend there or break through to the next stage."

"I—" Cao Yunbai stopped talking and listened to Cao Ren’s reply voice transmission. "Ren’er managed to reach the top of the Dark Tower, and he told me that the tower is the key to ascending to the realm beyond. However, we cannot go to the top directly, and we must undergo a series of tests before we can do so."
"Did any of them decide to ascend before us?" Cao Feihong’s expression turned furious.
"No." Cao Yunbai shook his head. "They decided to return to this realm, and they brought a powerful cultivator from the realm beyond with them to help us get rid of the Tian Clan and the others."
"Hmm?" Cao Feihong looked at him in shock.

Cao Yunbai continued straightaway. "According to Ren’er, the realm beyond is the Paradise Realm, and we can only continue our cultivation if we ascend to that realm because we need the Celestial Qi to break through to the Five Celestial Realms."
"Celestial Qi? Five Celestial Realms?"

"Yes." Cao Yubai nodded slightly. "However, we can’t go to the Dark Tower anymore because the people from that realm will capture us if we set foot there, which is due to that person’s decision to help us. That person told Ren’er that there are still many other towers in the middle realms, so we will go to one of them after we get rid of the Tian Clan and the others."

Cai Feihong clasped her hands, and an evil smile appeared on his old face. "The Tian Clan has been in control of our realm for a long time, and our Cao Clan has always been under them. I’m fed up with their attitude, so we must get rid of them, and our clan will rule this realm. By the way, did Ren’er tell you the reason that person was willing to help us?"

"Jia Yuyan." Cai Feihong raised an eyebrow in confusion. "That person said that female fairy is not a native of this realm, but she came from the Paradise Realm. She has a special bloodline and physique, and the Fairy King deliberately sent her here to hide her."

"I see." Cao Feihong nodded in understanding. "No wonder Jia Yuyan was so strong back then, and she could even take on the five of us alone; it turns out she came from the Heaven Realm. If it weren’t for her, our dream of ruling this realm would have long since come true."
"Forget the past and look to the future, and this realm will belong to our clan soon." After he said that, Cao Yunbai immediately disappeared, and Cai Feihong followed.

In the Bao Clan, the patriarch of the clan was busy ordering his clan members to dig up the ruins of the passageway, and a woman accompanied him by his side. "What exactly happened? How did someone know about our secret passageway? Our ancestors built the passageway over several years, and they also placed an alarm formation to warn us; however, the mastermind managed to infiltrate and destroy it without our knowledge."

"I myself am confused as to why the alarm formation didn’t respond when the intruders broke in." The two then looked up at the sky, specifically at the old man standing there. "Why did you suddenly come out of your seclusion, Ancestor Yundong?"
"Do you think I’m deaf to not hear such a loud explosion, Bao Sanli?" The old man asked with narrowed eyes.

Bao Sanli smiled bitterly in response. "That’s not what I meant, Ancestor. I know the explosion was very loud, but you don’t need to bother with such a trivial matter. Ji Qingchun and I can handle this, and—"

"What can you do?" Bao Yundong landed directly in front of them. "Cao Yunbai just contacted me; he told me that the perpetrators were dozens of people. You were here, but you couldn’t sense the intruders, and they managed to blow up our passageway because of your carelessness."

"Ancestor, I know you’re angry, but you shouldn’t blame my husband." Bao Yundong glared at Ji Qingchun, but she returned it with a smile. "Aren’t you in this clan yourself? Yet, you didn’t sense the presence of the intruders, right? Moreover, you have installed an intruder alarm on our passageway, but it didn’t react at all."

"Bring our people to investigate this entire realm, and you must find the intruders as soon as possible. If you fail to find them, I will beat you with my own hands" Bao Sanli immediately left while grumbling in his heart. Bai Yundong then grabbed Ji Qingchun and kissed her. "If I didn’t need your services, I would have killed you because of your words just now."
"Hehe." Ji Qingchun giggled and rubbed the old man’s lower body. "Are you ordering my husband to investigate the masterminds so we can have fun?"
Bao Yundong squeezed her buttocks directly. "You little bitch! How dare you tease me! I’ll teach you a lesson while your husband is away."
"I’m looking forward to it." Ji Qingchun leaned against his chest, twirled her finger around it, and asked him a question. "Did Cao Yunbai give you any other news?"

Bao Yundong nodded at Ji Qingchun and recounted the news he had gotten from Cao Yunbai, which shocked and elated her. "Once the Tian Clan and the other clans disappear, I will take you to one of those towers, and we will ascend to the Paradise Realm together."
"What about my husband?"

"Leave that useless guy." Bao Yundong then looked at the ruin. "I didn’t expect that Jia Yuyan came from the Paradise Realm, and I felt that today’s incident had something to do with her. She is much more powerful than us, so it is not difficult for her to trick the intruder alarm I installed in it."
"Are we going to do something about the natural races?"

"We don’t need to do anything now." Bao Yundong shook his head slightly. "That senior is willing to help Cao Ren because he wants to get Jia Yuyan, so we just need to wait for him to capture her and take her away. Once she leaves, no one will protect those natural races, and we will have no difficulty capturing them."
Ji Qingchun nodded in understanding before pulling him along. "Let our people handle this matter, and we’ll have a good time before my husband returns."
"Hahaha!" Bao Yundong laughed at that.

Inside a cave, a middle-aged man was sitting opposite an old woman, who was thinking with a serious expression. "Sima Yunfeng, order our members to spread out and search for those intruders immediately. I am sure that Tian Jingxuan and the others were not the masterminds of the explosion just now, but other people did it. If my guess is right, Jia Yuyan and the natural races were the perpetrators, but I am sure they had help from others because the explosion just now did not use Qi."

"How can you conclude that Jia Yuyan is the culprit, Ancestor Huiqing?" Sima Huiqing immediately explained to Sima Yunfeng the information she had previously received from Cao Yunbai, which shocked him. "That bitch! I don’t know how that person could influence her and the other natural races to attack us, but we must find that person as soon as possible. Yan’er has already told me about Zhang Xiaolong, and I’m sure you’ve heard the same thinga about him."

Tian Junfeng nodded at her. "Jingxuan already told me about that kid and his acquaintances, but he was acting stupid by being hostile towards him. Those people were clearly stronger than us, so he and the others would just be throwing their lives away in vain if they fought with that kid."
"Why didn’t you go there and warn him?"
"Haha." Tian Junfeng laughed before asking her. "Would you believe me if I said that I want my Tian Clan to fall?"

"I see." Shangguan Lizhi expressed her understanding. "Shall we meet him now?"

"No." Tian Junfeng refused with a shake of his head. "If we go out now, Cao Yunbai and the others will be alerted. Once everything is over, I will go straight to him to talk to him, and I will ask for his help to carry out my plan."

Shangguan Lizhi shook her head slightly after Tian Junfeng disappeared, but she then left her private room to confirm something.

sentences.text: With the absence of Cao Ren and the elders, the situation in the Cao Clan was in chaos because the previous explosion was very close to their clan, which caused many of their buildings to be destroyed.
However, an old man and an old woman suddenly appeared in the clan, they were the ancestors of the Cao Clan, whom Ren Shou had told Zhang Xiaolong [3] about when they first met.
The male ancestor was Cao Yunbai, and he was the one who helped Gu Changsheng when fighting the ancestor of the natural races, Ju Xing.
"What do you think happened, Old Man?

Cao Yunbai looked at the barrier protecting their clan.

Have you checked the ruins of the passageway?"

I have already ordered people to excavate the ruins of the passageway, but we don’t have many earth element cultivators, so it will probably take a while before we can investigate the cause of the explosion."
Cao Yunbai nodded in understanding.
"Leave and help the others."
"Yes, Ancestor."
Cao Yunbai then used his senses to inspect the area for remnants of the culprit’s Qi, and he managed to find many thin traces of it there.
He then informed Cao Feihong.
"The mastermind is not one person but dozens, but I don’t understand how they could destroy it without leaving a strong trace of Qi.
They destroyed all four passageways at the same time, so they must have used a large amount of Qi to do it.
Our alarm should have detected their actions, and both of us would have sensed their movements, but we didn’t feel anything even after the explosion happened."
"I also think that this incident is really strange." Cao Feihong then asked him.
"Do you think the previous explosions had something to do with the Tian and Shangguan Clans?
After all, only those two clans still have their ancestors, so I think they might be the masterminds."
"That’s impossible." Cai Yunbai immediately denied it and looked towards the location of the two clans.
"I am familiar with the Qi of Tian Jinfeng and Shangguan Mengxin, and the traces of Qi I found in the ruins do not belong to them.
Furthermore, they have not come out of their seclusion cave, so I am certain that they are not the masterminds.
We were too focused on our seclusion before, and we were unaware of several events in this realm until the explosion just now."
"I will order our clansmen to investigate everything." Cai Feihong immediately ordered some people to investigate everything that had happened recently in their realm.

"Those masterminds could be hiding anywhere in this realm, and they might not dare to come out after attacking us." Cao Yunbai then contacted Cao Ren and the others, ordering them to return as soon as possible.

If we continue like this, we will die like our predecessors."

"I—" Cao Yunbai stopped talking and listened to Cao Ren’s reply voice transmission.
"Ren’er managed to reach the top of the Dark Tower, and he told me that the tower is the key to ascending to the realm beyond.

"Did any of them decide to ascend before us?" Cao Feihong’s expression turned furious.
"No." Cao Yunbai shook his head.

"Celestial Qi?
Five Celestial Realms?"
"Yes." Cao Yubai nodded slightly.

"Jia Yuyan." Cai Feihong raised an eyebrow in confusion.

She has a special bloodline and physique, and the Fairy King deliberately sent her here to hide her."
"I see." Cao Feihong nodded in understanding.
"No wonder Jia Yuyan was so strong back then, and she could even take on the five of us alone; it turns out she came from the Heaven Realm.
If it weren’t for her, our dream of ruling this realm would have long since come true."
"Forget the past and look to the future, and this realm will belong to our clan soon." After he said that, Cao Yunbai immediately disappeared, and Cai Feihong followed.

"What exactly happened?
How did someone know about our secret passageway?
Our ancestors built the passageway over several years, and they also placed an alarm formation to warn us; however, the mastermind managed to infiltrate and destroy it without our knowledge."
"I myself am confused as to why the alarm formation didn’t respond when the intruders broke in." The two then looked up at the sky, specifically at the old man standing there.
"Why did you suddenly come out of your seclusion, Ancestor Yundong?"
"Do you think I’m deaf to not hear such a loud explosion, Bao Sanli?" The old man asked with narrowed eyes.
Bao Sanli smiled bitterly in response.
"That’s not what I meant, Ancestor.
I know the explosion was very loud, but you don’t need to bother with such a trivial matter.
Ji Qingchun and I can handle this, and—"
"What can you do?" Bao Yundong landed directly in front of them.
"Cao Yunbai just contacted me; he told me that the perpetrators were dozens of people.
You were here, but you couldn’t sense the intruders, and they managed to blow up our passageway because of your carelessness."
"Ancestor, I know you’re angry, but you shouldn’t blame my husband." Bao Yundong glared at Ji Qingchun, but she returned it with a smile.
"Aren’t you in this clan yourself?
Yet, you didn’t sense the presence of the intruders, right?
Moreover, you have installed an intruder alarm on our passageway, but it didn’t react at all."
"Bring our people to investigate this entire realm, and you must find the intruders as soon as possible.
If you fail to find them, I will beat you with my own hands" Bao Sanli immediately left while grumbling in his heart.
Bai Yundong then grabbed Ji Qingchun and kissed her.
"If I didn’t need your services, I would have killed you because of your words just now."
"Hehe." Ji Qingchun giggled and rubbed the old man’s lower body.
"Are you ordering my husband to investigate the masterminds so we can have fun?"
Bao Yundong squeezed her buttocks directly.
"You little bitch!

I’ll teach you a lesson while your husband is away."
"I’m looking forward to it." Ji Qingchun leaned against his chest, twirled her finger around it, and asked him a question.

paragraphs: Jia Yuyan became gloomy after Zhang Xiaolong [3] told her the fact that Qi Lai was willing to help Cao Ren in order to get her, but she was confused about how that person could know about her, especially since only members of her race and the other natural races knew about her special bloodline and physique. "Could it be that Wan Jiang was right that the Fairy King was a traitor? Could it be that he spread the news about me to the public? Why did he ask me to hide here if that was true?"

"I already said that your Fairy King is not a good man, but I didn’t expect that the old man from the Star Tower belonged to the fairy race, and his disguise was so neat that I couldn’t notice it." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked her. "What exactly are the benefits of the Wood Spirit Nourishing Physique and the Immortal Treant Spirit Bloodline?"
Jia Yuyan looked at him with a frown. "How did you know about these two?"
"I can’t tell you, at least for now, and I will tell you in the future."

"Tch! Did you tell that to your other women?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at Jia Yuyan, making her sigh at his secrecy. "My physique is deeply connected to the essence of life, nature, and regeneration. My body naturally absorbs the wood element from the world around me, granting me rapid recovery, deep vitality, and a strong affinity for the power of nature. As for my bloodline, I obtained it from the one and only Ancient Immortal Treant Spirit in the universe."
"The one and only Ancient Immortal Treant Spirit?"
Jia Yuyan nodded at him. "According to him, there were many Immortal Treant Spirits in the distant past, but a massive catastrophe wiped them out, and he was the only one left in this universe."
"Did he tell you about the catastrophe?"

"No." Jia Yuyan’s response was slightly disappointing to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "When the catastrophe happened, he was still a flower bud, so he knew nothing about it. However, the memories inherited from his bloodline provided him with extensive information about his race, and he tried to locate members of his race when he grew up. Despite searching for billions of years, he never succeeded in finding even one. In the end, he gave up and accepted that he was the last remaining member of his race, but he gained a significant amount of information and heard about the catastrophe from other living beings during his search. Unfortunately, none of them had clear information about it, including all the powerful cultivators who exist in this era."
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was really surprised to hear all that. "If he had lived that long, he should be a primordial being, right?

Jia Yuyan nodded at him. "The Ancient Immortal Treant Spirit is a sentient being born during the primordial era, and he was formed from the confluence of the Dao of Wood and the Dao of Life. His roots stretch across the realms, stabilizing space and the flow of qi. He has profound knowledge of cultivation, formations, and even the lost Dao. In the end, he became a guardian to protect the balance of nature, and all natural races seek his guidance to reach higher realms. He is capable of reviving fallen lands, cleansing demonic corruption, and even regenerating lost souls under rare conditions."
"Huh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was shocked after Jia Yuyan mentioned the last thing. "How did you meet him? How did you convince him to give his bloodline to you?"

"I didn’t do anything to convince him, and he chose me when my grandfather took me to see him when I started my cultivation path. I once asked him about the reason, and he told me that it was because of my Wood Spirit Nourishing Physique." Jia Yuyan let out a soft sigh before continuing. "Thanks to his teachings, my cultivation improved much faster than anyone else’s, especially since my body kept absorbing Wood Qi from all over the realm. However, many natural races in my domain became jealous of me, but they did not dare to act because my grandparents were the direct subordinates of the previous fairy king. When the previous fairy king died, the new fairy king sent me to this territory for two reasons. First, to protect me, and second, to find the heir of the ten-tailed fox."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "Not only humans, but all living creatures are susceptible to jealousy and envy. Since your progress is so fast, it is natural for others to become jealous of you. As for your Fairy King, I can’t say too much about her because I’ve never met her, but I fully believe that she’s not a good person. Therefore, you must always be wary of him if you return to your domain one day, and you should never trust everything he says; otherwise, you will suffer yourself."
"Yeah." Jia Yuyan then leaned against his chest. "What do you think if I go back there today?"

"Isn’t it too late?" Zhang Xialong [3] carried Jia Yuyan to the bed and pinned her down. "Qi Lai is on his way to this realm, and he will be furious if he can’t find you here. Furthermore, Wan Jiang, his three disciples, Serpentera, and Tian Kui are in this realm now. Therefore, you don’t have to worry about him, and they will help us deal with him."
Jia Yuyan nodded slightly. "What about Xereth?"

"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] softly laughed. "I have discussed the matter regarding Xereth with them, and we have two possible solutions to handle him. First, we can send him back to the Paradise Realm through the portal in this realm, but he can come back again if we do that. Second, we can lock him up in the Star Tower, and he won’t be able to summon Taotie there. The old man will confine him in a special location, preventing any chance of escape, which means he won’t be able to cause trouble in the Three Mortal Realms anymore."

"Hmm?" Jia Yuyan pondered the two possibilities for a while. "I think the second option is more feasible because Wan Jiang can monitor him at all times, and he can stop the demon if he tries to escape from his tower."

"I think so too." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then lay down by Jia Yuyan’s side and hugged her. "We have prepared many things to stop them, so you don’t need to think too hard about them, and I believe we will get through everything well."
"I hope you’re right." Jia Yuyan let out a soft sigh and embraced his neck. "Can you take me to your real body?"
"Are you really ready?"

"Yes." Jia Yuyan firmly nodded. "After everything settles here, I’ll return to the Paradise Realm, and we won’t see each other for quite a long time. Furthermore, I have chosen you as my husband, so I want to meet your real body."

"All right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] directly lifted Jia Yuyan to her feet. "Before that, release your soul first, and I will merge our souls together. This way, I can sense if you are in danger when you are in the Paradise Realm, and I can think of a way to save you if that happens."

As soon as Jia Yuyan released her soul from her body, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately used his soul manipulation ability. He replicated her soul and merged it with his. He actually wanted to merge her original soul with his, but she would die if he died, and he didn’t want that to happen, especially after his encounter with the mysterious woman.
Once that was done, Zhang Xiaolong [3] sent Jia Yuyan into the training space, and he went to the life pond after that. However, he ran into Qian Shuang, and the two of them went there together.
"Shuang’er, I probably won’t come out of the bottom for some time."

"I have no other business, and I also want to improve myself in the pond, so I will accompany you to cultivate in it." Qian Shuang then shyly took off her dress, causing Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s gaze to burn. Once she was naked, she covered her two private parts with her hands. "Why are you looking at me like that?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled and pulled her hand down from her chest. "You are not only pretty, but you also hide such a sexy figure. I can’t wait to eat you, but I don’t want to do it now, and I will do it when you really fall in love with me."
"Uhm." Qian Shuang nodded with a blush on her cheeks, but she then helped him to remove his clothes. "Let’s go in."
A while later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Qian Shuang had arrived at the bottom of the Life Pond, and both of them were cultivating by utilizing the different Qi at the bottom.

"Wow! Such a pretty fairy!" Xin Xianzi exclaimed as soon as Zhang Fei took Jia Yuyan out of the training space, and the others also admired her beauty. "Are you really from the Paradise Realm, Senior?"

Jia Yuyan nodded at her. "My home domain is the Floral Mirage Domain, and countless natural races of various races live there. Since you are a fairy like me, you should go there in the future, and you will definitely like the nature there."

"Hehehe." Xin Xianzi giggled. "Senior, I don’t have the ability to go to the Paradise Realm by myself, so I can only rely on Zhang Fei to go there. Moreover, my strength is still too weak to travel there, so I might only be able to go to your domain in hundreds or thousands of years."

"Why are you so pessimistic? Your cultivation is already excellent, especially since you were born in the middle realms. If you were born in the upper realms, I’m sure your cultivation would have been much higher than this." Jia Yuyan then pointed to Zhang Fei. "Furthermore, he already has a big plan for his training space, and all of you will be able to cultivate faster after he implements it there."

Xin Xianzi nodded in response. "Zhang Fei has already told us about the Celestial Qi, and we can’t wait to cultivate using it. Unfortunately, we still have to wait until his clone arrives at the Paradise Realm, which is still a few months away."
"Be patient, okay?" Zhang Fei held Jia Yuyan’s hand. "Since all of you have successfully created your domains, we should leave this place now, and we will wait for the others to arrive."
Once they arrived outside, Zhang Fei brought Jia Yuyan back into the training space before taking her to the pavilion.
Zhang Fei then took Jia Yuyan to the Celestial Spring Pool, and the female fairy immediately squatted beside it, dipping her hand into it. "Why didn’t you bring me here before?"

"This pool is specifically for dual cultivating, so I didn’t bring you here before. Actually, I still have the Yin-Yang Union Bed in my room, but I’ll bring you there later." Zhang Fei picked up Jia Yuyan, gave her a kiss, and started taking off her dress.
Jia Yuyan immediately returned the kiss and quickly took off his clothes, and both of them were naked a few moments later.

Zhang Fei pulled Jia Yuyan into the pool and shared a few things with her, including the Flawless Yin-Yang Art and the Yin-Yang Splitting Avatar Technique. The second technique surprised the female fairy, especially after she read the description. "Do you think our cultivation can improve so rapidly just because of dual cultivating with me? All of us have our own avatars, and they never stop cultivating in other rooms. paragraphs: "Are you serious about that?" An old man asked Song Qingci.

Song Qingci nodded her head. "Grandfather, Zhang Fei’s true cultivation was indeed at the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm, but it suddenly shot up and became on par with cultivators at the Divine Ascension Realm. Moreover, his killing intent was not natural, and he should have killed countless people to achieve it."
"I think you should check on that brat, Zifeng." An old woman spoke to the old man as she was sure that Song Qingci was not lying to them based on the fear in her expression.
"You’re right, Yu Shi." Song Zifeng nodded slightly. "Do you know where that kid went?"

"Since he wants to open his shop, I’m sure he should be checking out the other three big cities right now, Grandpa." Song Qingci suddenly remembered something. "Grandpa, I’m worried that he might join the Zhang Clan, especially since he has the same surname as them. If that happens, they’ll be a threat to our Song Clan, and—"

"You are exaggerating your concerns." Yu Shi dismissed her granddaughter’s guess immediately. "That kid already said that he came from the Xianjin Realm, and he came to our realm just to open his shop. Therefore, I believe he won’t interfere in the matters in our realm, let alone join the Zhang Clan here."
"But, Grandma, he—"
"Don’t argue with your grandmother, Qingci." Song Zifeng immediately stood up. "I’ll monitor that kid for now, and I’ll meet him if he returns to our city."

After her grandfather left, Song Qingci tried to persuade her grandmother to do something about Zhang Fei [4]. However, Yu Shi was much more experienced than her, so she realized that looking for trouble with him would only bring disaster to their clan. "Leave and don’t bother with this matter."
"Tch!" Song Qingci gritted her teeth in annoyance and left her grandmother straightaway.

Yu Shi let out a heavy sigh as she shook her head. "Even though Qingci is already quite old, her character has remained unchanged. If she continues to behave like that, she will die sooner than I will. The Xianjin Realm is the strongest planet in the upper realms, and it is a gathering place for powerful cultivators. Moreover, that kid’s talent in alchemy is incredible, so I believe he has many backers there. If one of his backers attacks us, we will definitely die ridiculously."

Zhang Fei [4] had already arrived at another city and was looking at the shops in that area, but he shook his head slightly when he felt someone’s senses lock onto him. ’5-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm! I’m sure that old man is a member of the Song Clan, and he’s probably Song Qingci’s grandfather.’
[Are you going to do something to that woman, Master?’

’Hey! Do you think I’m a madman? I don’t like Song Qingci’s behavior, but there’s still no serious problem between us, so I won’t do anything to her for now.’ Zhang Fei [4] glanced into the distance. ’For now, I want to see what that old man wants from me, but he’d better not look for trouble with me; otherwise, I will make them regret it.’

Although the city was no less big than Song Qingci’s city, it did not have as many people as her city, and the trade in the city was not as bustling as there, so Zhang Fei [4] decided to leave the city and go to two other big cities.

The third city was slightly larger than Song Qingci’s city, had a larger population, and its trade was equally busy. Zhang Fei [4] found out that the Zhang Clan was ruling the city, but he heard many horrible things about that clan. He didn’t feel afraid of that clan, but he also didn’t want to have anything to do with them, so he abandoned his intention to open his shop there.

Zhang Fei [4] went straight to the fourth city, where Long Zhenxia and her family lived. He didn’t intend to meet the female fire dragon, but she just appeared in front of him on her own, especially after she sensed his presence in that realm.
Long Zhenxia felt nervous about seeing Zhang Fei [4] again after they had parted ways a year and a half ago, but his indifferent attitude disappointed her. "Long time no see."
"Yeah, long time no see." Zhang Fei [4] casually replied. "I didn’t expect you to move to this realm."

Long Zhenxia nodded at him. "My father was worried that Long Aotian would do something to us, so he took us away from the Sky Dragon Realm and settled in this realm. I didn’t expect your cultivation to have progressed so rapidly, and you have already broken through to the Seven Divine Realms now."

"I am fortunate to have many women who have always helped me in my cultivation, and I could not have reached this stage without them." Zhang Fei [4] replied as he looked around them, looking for something.
"Oh." Long Zhenxia then asked him. "What brought you to this realm?"

"Actually, I came to the realm because I was following an evil cultivator, but I saw that this realm was quite promising, so I wanted to open an alchemy shop here." Long Zhenxia was not surprised to hear that because Zhang Fei [4] had two shops in the Sky Dragon Realm. "How about your alchemy?"
"I have been improving myself since our last match, and I am already an Ancestor Rank alchemist now." Long Zhenxian then asked him again. "How about you?"

"I am a Venerable Rank alchemist now." Zhang Fei [4]’s answer shocked Long Zhenxia, especially since he was still a King Rank alchemist a year and a half ago. He then looked at a building with the ’Long’ signboard in front of it. "Did you open an alchemy shop in this city?"

"How about you help me sell my pills in your shop?" Long Zhenxia was surprised by Zhang Fei [4]’s request. "Usually, I would open my own shop, but I don’t have the time to take care of so many shops spread across so many realms. Moreover, we are old acquaintances, and you gave me your bloodline. Therefore, I want to help you and your family, and I will give you 50% of the proceeds from the sale."
"Are you sure you want to give me 50% of the sales?" Long Zhenxia asked in surprise.

Zhang Fei [4] nodded at her. "Although 50% of the sales is a large amount, your flame dragon bloodline has helped me a lot. If you agree, I will give you my stock of pills, and you can start selling them today."

"Even though you began your journey in alchemy before I did, I can confidently say that I trained much harder than you." Zhang Fei [4] then took out some alchemy ingredients and gave them to her. "You can order your servants to arrange these pills and ingredients in the display case, and your shop will definitely be even more crowded with customers. "Do you have any problems with them?" Zhang Fei [4] explained to Long Zhenxia about his meeting with Song Qingci earlier, but she was not surprised to hear that because the female major’s character was no longer a secret. "I will arrange them in the display case now, and I will tell my staff not to allow them to set foot in my shop."
"That’s excellent." Zhang Fei [4] immediately followed Long Zhenxia back to the front. "I will return to the city now, and you can contact me if you are short of stock."
Long Zhenxia wanted to ask Zhang Fei [4] to stay for some time, especially since she still wanted to talk to him. However, she swallowed her words and nodded at him.

"I will contact you directly if I need additional stock." Long Zhenxia released a heavy sigh after Zhang Fei [4] left, and she rubbed her lips, recalling their kiss back at the Phoenix Clan in the Sky Dragon Realm. ’Does he just think of me as an acquaintance?’

Zhang Fei [4] had already arrived at Song Qingci’s city and was rushing to find the best inn, but Song Zifeng immediately appeared in front of him, surprising the people at the inn. "Can I have a word with you, kid?"

"If you want to persuade me to open my shop in this city, you can forget about it because I no longer have the interest to do so. Moreover, I just met an old acquaintance, and she is already willing to sell my pills in her alchemy shop, so I will not open another shop in this realm."

"I see." Song Zifeng nodded in understanding. "It’s truly unfortunate if you have decided like that, but I respect your decision. In that case, I won’t waste your time anymore, and you can freely enjoy your time in this city."
The inn visitors were shocked to hear that, but Song Zifeng ignored them and left the inn. They then looked at Zhang Fei [4], wondering in their hearts about his true identity.
Zhang Fei [4] ignored them and chose the best room directly. He then rushed to his room and cultivated there, and he ordered Mei to keep an eye on You Shanyi’s movements.

After he had practiced for quite some time and successfully mastered the first stage of the Heaven-Severing Sword Technique, Zhang Fei immediately returned to his bedroom because Jia Yuyan had already woken up from her sleep.

Given their imminent separation, Zhang Fei spared no time and resumed his dual cultivation with Jia Yuyan. Their souls began to dual-soul cultivate above them, and they did so non-stop for quite a long time.
A week passed quickly, and Feng Xishui, who had flown for a very long time, immediately entered a realm while carrying Zhang Fei [5] and Wei Xiaoya on his back.
[Ding.]
[The system has already recorded the Falling Star Realm, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
[Starts mapping the entire area of the Falling Star Realm.]
"Have you ever met my master’s senior sister, wife?"

"Senior Tang Ying has never liked crowds, and she prefers to live in solitude." Wei Xiaoya pointed in a direction. "She should be living at the foot of that mountain, so we can go there directly to meet her."

Therefore, I hope you are willing to go to the Mirage Heaven Realm and stop him, so he will no longer carelessly use his soul abilities against other people."

Tang Ying let out a soft breath. "Our late master had repeatedly asked You Shanyi to stop his actions, but he was never willing to listen to him, forcing him to expel him. If he were not the son of his old friend, our late master would have long ago crippled or even killed him. Our late master spared him and gave him a chance to change, but his nature was too rotten, and he continued to act like that even after thousands of years had passed. "Senior, Xiaoya and I will not go with you to that realm, and my other clone will meet you there." As soon as Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate to the Mirage Heaven Realm, Tang Ying immediately disappeared into it.

"Let me guess, you were able to marry Mu Qingyun because of a political decision between the Chen and Mu Clans, and she is the first woman in your life, right?"

"Haha." Chen Long laughed awkwardly as he scratched his head. "Back then, our two clans had just arrived in this realm, and we had no influence whatsoever, so our parents decided to unite by marrying us off. Coincidentally, I liked her, and she liked me too, so we accepted their decision. How could you guess like that?"

"Oh." Wei Xiaoya nodded in understanding. "Actually, Zhang Fei once challenged one of those towers, and he obtained many valuable treasures there. Therefore, he sent his other wives to that tower, and they have been there for some time."

Mu Qingyuan then asked her. "How long are you going to be like this? Even though you don’t like Zhang Fei yet, he is your husband now, and it is a wife’s duty to serve her husband well. Moreover, he has many other wives, so you can’t keep delaying your relationship, and he might forget you because of their presence by his side."

"Haha." Wei Xiaoya softly laughed. "Even though I haven’t known my husband for a long time, I know that he is not that kind of man, and I believe that he will never forget me. For now, I am not really ready to be his wife, and I am still preparing myself to accept our relationship. Once I am ready, I will give myself to him, and we will have many children."
Mu Qingyuan could only shake his head at that. "I hope you are right about him because I don’t want you to suffer."
"I know."
