"Release your soul first, Senior." Zhang Fei [5] immediately sat in front of Tang Ying, and they released their souls right away.
"Hmm?" Tang Ying was shocked when she saw countless white lotuses inside Zhang Fei [5]’s soul. "How did you create so many lotuses inside your soul?"

"Their number represents all the women by my side, and two of them belong to my senior sisters, Shang Yingyue and Jing Qiuyue." Tang Ying raised her eyebrows because she knew that one of them was already married and had a daughter, but she had guessed wrong about that, and Zhang Fei [5] immediately explained it to her. "Senior Sister Yingyue is my first dual-soul cultivation partner, but our relationship is only limited to that. Moreover, she is no longer doing it with me, and she is doing it with Senior Brother Xueming now."
"Is Wu Xueming a soul cultivator now?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "He indeed doesn’t have the talent to become a soul cultivator, but I have a special method to help people like him. I taught it to Senior Sister Yingyue, who helped him become one."
"Can you teach me your lotus technique?"

"Senior, you can know my secrets, so you should already know that the technique can only be learned by those who have an unwavering heart and absolute trust in each other, right?" Tang Ying nodded at Zhang Fei [5]. "We just met today, so we don’t have both of them yet. Moreover, I’m still suspicious about how you managed to know all my secrets, especially about Mei. Neither of my wives knows about her existence in my body, especially since I still keep it under wraps."

Tang Ying smiled faintly, and two eyes appeared above her head, one white and the other grey, leaving Zhang Fei [5] in shock and amazement. "My technique is the Eyes of Samsara, and it has five stages. However, I have only mastered it up to the second stage, and the white one has the ability to reveal everything hidden in one’s heart."
’What a frightening technique!’ Zhang Fei [5] took a deep breath. "Isn’t that too scary, Senior? This way, no one can hide their secrets from you, right?"
Tang Yin nodded at him. "No matter how tightly other people keep their secrets, my white eyes can reveal everything."
"Then, what is the ability of the gray eye?" Zhang Fei [5] asked as he looked at the eye.

sentences.text: "Why do you ask that, Brother?" Zhang Fei [5] then asked Chen Long back.
Chen Long pointed forward.
"You are handsome and dashing, but she is ugly, fat, and short!
I am confident that everyone will have the same opinion as me if they look at her!
Your decision to marry her is the most absurd thing I have ever heard, and she will only make people look down on you.
You should find a woman who is much prettier than her, and I can introduce you to some of them if you want."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that.
"What is the importance of a woman’s physique?
There are so many beautiful women out there, but many of them have rotten hearts.
They are far more concerned with their greed, jealousy, and envy."
Chen Long shook his head and patted his shoulders.
"You may not consider women’s physiques, especially their faces, to be important.
However, we live in a world full of insults and abuse, so you should think more about your image.
If you have a beautiful wife, people will admire and envy you, especially when you take her out in public.
Moreover, it is beneficial for our image, especially in political matters."
’This guy is just a naive idiot.’ Zhang Fei [5] could actually see that Chen Long was not a bad person, and his soul was quite good, but his opinions on life were too innocent.
"Let me guess, you were able to marry Mu Qingyun because of a political decision between the Chen and Mu Clans, and she is the first woman in your life, right?"
"Haha." Chen Long laughed awkwardly as he scratched his head.
"Back then, our two clans had just arrived in this realm, and we had no influence whatsoever, so our parents decided to unite by marrying us off.
Coincidentally, I liked her, and she liked me too, so we accepted their decision.
How could you guess like that?"
"Even though you are a husband and father, you are still too innocent, naive, and idiotic." Black lines appeared on Chen Long’s forehead when Zhang Fei [5] made that remark.
"Unlike you, I cannot care about politics or other people’s opinions.
My life is my choice, and they have no opinion on it or my relationships.
I like beautiful and sexy women, but both of them are just a bonus, and their hearts are the most important to me.
Furthermore, Xiaoya surpasses your expectations in beauty, and your wife’s beauty pales in comparison to hers."
"You—"
"Do you think your wife is that beautiful?" The previously relaxed Chen Long immediately turned furious when Zhang Fei [5] asked that in a mocking tone.
"If you think your wife is beautiful, you’re a frog in a well who doesn’t know the universe’s vastness and true beauty."
"You—"
"You what?" Zhang Fei [5] casually interrupted him.
"If you want to know the true beauty, I will show you."
Chen Long frowned in response, but he turned surprised when Zhang Fei [5] opened the portal to the training space.
He was left dumbstruck as soon as Jia Yuyan walked out of it, and he stared at her like a person who had lost his soul.
Jia Yuyan shook her head at his reaction.
"Are you asking me out just to show off to this kid, husband?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that.
"This guy looks down on Wei Xiaoya just because she’s fat and short, so I have to defend my wife’s dignity, right?
Moreover, he feels that his wife is the most beautiful woman, but she’s just a frog in a well, so I want to show her the true beauty."
Jia Yuyan let out a heavy sigh as she walked back inside.
"Since he’s already in such shock, I’ll go back inside now."
After he closed the portal, Zhang Fei [5] grabbed Chen Long’s shoulder and squeezed it slightly, bringing him back to his senses.
"Do you understand now?
Your wife is beautiful, but there are many women who are much more beautiful than her out there, and my wife just now is one of them."
"How... how did you get a beautiful fairy as your wife, Brother?"
"What else?" Zhang Fei [5] shrugged his shoulders and walked forward.
"I am handsome and dashing, right?
Therefore, it’s only natural that I could get a wife as beautiful as her, right?
By the way, Jia Yuyan and Wei Xiaoya are two of my dozens of wives, and all of them are much more beautiful than your wife."
"What?" Chen Long let out a loud scream, causing the servants in the area around them to turn their attentions toward them.
"Are you kidding me, Brother?
Do you really have dozens of wives?"
Zhang Fei [5] tilted his head to the side.
"Is there any benefit in me lying to you?
If you don’t believe me, you can ask Xiaoya inside."
A while later, they had arrived at the main hall, and Wei Xiaoya was teasing the little boy.
"Do you want to have a child, Wife?" Wei Xiaoya’s lips twitched as Zhang Fei [5] asked that.
"You are already fit to be a mother, and I will impregnate you today if you can’t wait to have a child."
"Shut up!" Wei Qiaoya gave him a fierce side glance.
"Hahaha." Mu Qingyun laughed at that, and she then asked Zhang Fei [5].
"How are you going to impregnate Xiaoya if you two haven’t had your first night yet?"
Zhang Fei [5] let out a soft sigh.
"As Xiaoya said before, our marriage happened so quickly, and she is not ready to be my wife for real.
Therefore, I have to hold myself back for now, but we will have many adorable children like her in the future."
"Feelings are important in marriage, or our married life will turn sour." Mu Qingyuan spoke while lightly nodding her head.
"You are lucky to have him as your husband, Xiaoya.
If you were to marry another man, he might force you to serve him even though you are not ready yet."
Wei Xiaoya chose not to say anything and instead focused on teasing the little boy sitting on her lap.
However, she also thought about Zhang Fei [5] and Mu Qingyuan’s words in her heart, and she wanted many children in the future.
Mu Qingyuan suddenly noticed her husband’s expression.
"What happened to you, Husband?
Why do you look shocked like this?"
"How can I not be shocked?" Chen Long then pointed at Zhang Fei [5].
"He had many other wives, and one of them was a beautiful fairy."
After Chen Long said that, Wei Xiaoya looked at him, and Mu Qingyuan looked at Zhang Fei [5].
Zhang Fei [5] shrugged his shoulders at Mu Qingyuan.
"I didn’t cheat on her, okay?
Xiaoya already knew that I had many wives before we got married."
"Is that true, Xiaoya?" Mu Qingyuan asked with a silly look.
"Yeah." Wei Xiaoya nodded helplessly.
"As I said before, I married him because of my mother, and I couldn’t refuse her wishes.
Honestly, I haven’t met his other wives yet because they are still busy in another realm, and we left for this realm the day after our wedding.
However, he has already shared their situation with me, and they maintain a warm and harmonious relationship, even sharing a home."
Mu Qingyuan nodded slightly and realized that Wei Xiaoya was uncomfortable talking about her marriage with Zhang Fei [5], so she quickly shifted the topic to their conversation.
"Xiaoya told me that you want to open an alchemy shop, and I can help you with that.
Although we are best friends and have known each other since childhood, business is still business, and I have to make a profit for my clan.
However, you don’t have to worry because I am not greedy, and I only want 10% of the sales."
"Only 10%?" Mu Qingyuan nodded to Zhang Fei [5].
"Since you and Xiaoya are best friends, I will give you more profit, and you can take 20% of the sales."
"Are you sure about that?" Mu Qingyuan asked in surprise.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded and sent a pill bottle to Mu Qingyuan, which she immediately opened to check its contents.
She looked at him in shock after seeing the grade of his pills, and her body trembled in excitement, mainly because she believed that his pills would bring huge profits to her Mu Clan.
Noticing his wife’s overreaction, Chen Long quickly approached her and examined the pills, which caused his expression to shift to a mix of shock and excitement.
"Did you concoct these pills yourself, brother?"
"I am a Venerable Rank Alchemist, and concocting those pills is not difficult for me." Zhang Fei [5] then threw another bottle of pills at him, which shocked both of them even more.
"Those pills are just a few of my concoctions, and I still have many other pills."
Chen Long immediately spoke to him.
"Brother, I think 20% is too much, and we will only take 10% of the sales."
"My husband is right." Mu Qingyuan nodded slightly.
"A superior grade is worth the sky in this realm, at a minimum of tens of millions of purple jewels for one.
That’s why we—"
"No need." Zhang Fei [5] stopped her directly.
"I already said that I would give you guys 20% of the sales, and I never go back on my word.
If you two feel that’s too much, you can consider the remaining 10% as building rent and salaries for your employees."
Seeing them hesitating, Wei Xiaoya immediately spoke to them.
"Qingyuan, please accept my husband’s offer.
Moreover, he has no shortage of jewels since his shops are spread across the lower, middle, and upper realms.
He even has a shop in the Xianjin Realm, and he gets so many jewels from the people of that realm, so 10% won’t be much for him.
Additionally, you two will handle everything for him, making this a mutually beneficial solution for all of us."
"Since you have decided so, I will accept it.
If you have your stock of pills, you can hand it over to me, and I will instruct my subordinates to start selling them in all our shops.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately took out a storage ring containing a large number of pills of various types and handed it to her.
"What is the price for each pill?"
Zhang Fei [5] thought for a moment before giving his answer.
"I have written down in detail the effects of each pill, and you are more familiar with the alchemy market in this realm, so I will leave their prices to you."
"Okay, I will sell your pills at the best price, and you can come to me once every two weeks to collect the proceeds." Mu Qingyuan then called someone to come and see him.
"How about you two stay at my clan?"
"Sure." Zhang Fei [5] immediately stood up.
"I still have other matters, so I will take my leave first, and Xiaoya will stay here."
"Does your husband have any acquaintances in this realm, Xiaoya?" Wei Xiaoya immediately told Mu Qingyuan about Tang Ying.
"I didn’t expect that your uncle’s senior sister lived in this realm, and I never knew about her."
"Senior Tang has never liked crowds, and she prefers to live in solitude under the Falling Star Mountain." Wei Xiaoya then asked her.
"Where are your parents?
Did they go to another realm?"
"Husband, Mu Wanqing will arrive soon, and you can help her in our main shop." Mu Qingyuan immediately got off her chair, took her son from Wei Xiaoya, and led them to another area.
On the other hand, Chen Long went to another area, waiting for the woman to arrive.
"Our parents went to the Azure Sky Realm in the middle realms two years ago, and they still haven’t returned until now."
Wei Xiaoya raised an eyebrow.
"What are they doing in that realm?
Why did they go that far?"
"Phew." Mu Qingyuan sighed softly before telling her.
"My father received information that there was a tower called the Sky Tower in that realm, and the information mentioned many precious items inside.
Therefore, they decided to check it out, and they worked together with the leaders of other clans."
"Oh." Wei Xiaoya nodded in understanding.

chapters.title: Chapter 1036: Imminent Battle
paragraphs: "The gray one is the samsara cycle vision." Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow as soon as Tang Ying said that. Although he was not a religious person, he naturally knew the meaning of the samsara cycle, which shocked him. "You’re right, I can pierce through the veil of reincarnation and witness the past lives, karmic burdens, and lingering soul fragments of any living being—humans, beasts, or demons. Throughout my life, I have met several reincarnators, but there is only one person who terrifies me the most."
"Feng Yao."

Tang Ying nodded at Zhang Fei [5]. "Among all the reincarnators I have encountered in the past, Feng Yao stands out as the most terrifying, having experienced numerous reincarnations. Her soul power was too terrifying, and she could destroy the souls of all living creatures that exist now if she wanted to. Moreover, there is a powerful female fire spirit by her side, and she is no less terrifying than her master."
"Huo Ling."
"That female fire spirit is far more terrifying than you can imagine." Tang Ying looked scared when she said that.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] himself had long been aware that Huo Ling was not an ordinary fire spirit. "What exactly is her identity?"
"Huo Ling is the spirit of the Primordial Flame."

Zhang Fei [5] froze, and his eyes widened in shock after hearing that. Back then, Feng Yao told him that the primordial flame once existed in the Temple of Forgotten Flames established by the primordial beings, but it suddenly disappeared several million years ago. Moreover, the flame is the lifeblood of the Forgotten Land, and that place became isolated after it disappeared.

"Master." Tang Ying looked at Huo Diqiu, who had just come out of Zhang Fei [5]’s body. "Master, if this woman is correct that Huo Ling is the spirit of the Primordial Flame, that means the flame never disappeared in the first place, and it is inside Feng Yao’s body now."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him with a serious expression. "No wonder Feng Yao’s mastery of the fire element is so amazing, and her flame power is also incredibly terrifying. Uncle Luo said that the people in the past nicknamed one of her reincarnations as the Flame Spirit Empress, Huo Yanling. Moreover, her first identity was a primordial being, Shen Yuanzhi, so it was natural that she had the ability to take on the Primordial Flame."

"Then, why did the two of them lie to you, Master? They said that they didn’t know anything about the disappearance of the Primordial Flame, but in fact Huo Ling is its soul, which means the flame is in Feng Yao’s hands now."

"Phew." Zhang Fei [5] exhaled heavily. "I don’t know their real purpose in lying to me, but we don’t need to think about them now. The two of them have long since gone to the Paradise Realm, so they are far beyond my reach now, and I will focus on myself for now."
"All right then." Huo Diqiu immediately entered Zhang Fei [5]’s body.
Zhang Fei [5] then asked Tang Ying. "Has Feng Yao ever said anything to you, Senior? I’m sure she knew your abilities, and she wouldn’t just keep quiet about it."

"Feng Yao never said anything about my abilities." Zhang Fei [5] gave Tang Ying a distrustful look. "Instead, she ordered me to wait for you, and she also ordered me to help you improve your soul power."
Zhang Fei [5] folded his forehead. "Why did Feng Yao order you to wait for me? Why did you obey her orders?"

"Do you think I dare to refuse her orders?" Tang Ying responded by shaking her head. "Feng Yao didn’t enslave me or do anything else to me, but her and Huo Ling’s strength frightened me so much. Therefore, I chose to obey her order, and I kept waiting for you to come to this realm."
"When did Feng Yao order you?"
"The day she left for the Paradise Realm. Additionally, she asked me to follow you when you go to that realm in the future."
"Two years ago, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] muttered to himself as he thought about Feng Yao’s reasons for helping him to that extent. "Where did you get the Eyes of Samsara technique?"
"Guess it." Tang Ying responded with a smile.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately guessed it without thinking twice. "You are a reincarnator, and your technique is your past technique."

"You are right that I am a reincarnator, but the technique is not my past technique, and I obtained it after my soul entered the circle of reincarnation." Zhang Fei [5] found it hard to believe that Tang Yin obtained such a powerful technique after her death. "Even though I am a reincarnator, I do not have a deep understanding of reincarnation and the like, so I cannot explain the details to you. However, I did not lie to you, and I obtained my technique at that time."
"Can you teach me?"

"No." Tang Ying shook her head. "Even though you have died once, you have never entered the circle of reincarnation, especially since that little girl revived you. To learn the Eyes of Samsara, you must have experienced a real death and passed through the circle of reincarnation once, so I can’t teach it to you. How about you bring me into your space? Your soul power will increase faster if we dual-soul cultivate there, right?"

After he contacted Wei Xiaoya and informed her about it, Zhang Fei [5] immediately brought Tang Ying to the pavilion, and the two sat together in the main garden. The two immediately held hands, as did their souls.

Zhang Fei [5] then activated his soul domain, surprising Tang Ying a bit. "My soul domain has almost the same effect as my lust domain, and it will boost the results of our dual-soul cultivation by about twofold. Since your soul power is much higher than mine, my soul power will probably break through to the early stage of the Venerate Soul level soon. However, that is not enough for me, and I want to reach the Divine Soul level as soon as possible."
"Your cultivation and soul power have already far surpassed the cultivators of your generation, so why do you have to be so hasty?" Tang Yin responded by shaking her head.

Zhang Fei [5] released a soft sigh. "Strong enemies keep appearing to block my path, and they won’t give me time to relax. For now, I have many allies to sort out my problems, but they won’t be able to help me forever, especially when I go to the Paradise Realm. Therefore, I have to let go of my dependence on them, and I must keep improving myself to reach their level as soon as possible, or I will die at their hands."
"All right, let’s start now, and I will help you increase your soul power." Tang Ying frowned when Zhang Fei [5] sat her on his lap. "What would you do?"
"Nothing." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head and closed his eyes. "Let’s start."
Tang Ying did not speak further and closed her eyes, and the two of them began their dual-soul cultivation.

Meanwhile, the ancestors of the Cao, Sima, Bao, and Gu Clans gathered in one place. Almost all of the gathered ancestors were gloomy and furious due to the incident a week ago when Serpentera destroyed their chimeras, while only Gu Changsheng remained calm and unperturbed by the situation.

"What should we do now?" Cao Yunbai asked the others. "I, Cao Feihong, and all my clansmen have been trying to find the mastermind since a week ago, but we still haven’t found any clues. I suspect that the mastermind is more than one person; one of them blew up our passageways, and the other wiped out our chimeras."

"What can we do?" Bao Yundong shook his head in response. "It took us a few months to create one chimera, but our hundreds of years of hard work were destroyed in a single day, and we still don’t know the identity of the mastermind."

"I think we focused too much on finding the masterminds, and we overlooked other factors." All of them turned to Sima Huiqing directly. "I’ve checked the main city before, and I found a shop that had not been opened for long. The natural races own that shop, and they sell a lot of extraordinary pills there. However, I couldn’t go there, so I ordered Sima Yunfeng to check it out, but they forbade members of our four clans from entering. He tried to force his way in, but he suddenly sensed a deadly aura locking him in, forcing him to retreat."
"A deadly aura?"

Sima Huiqing nodded to them. "I tried to find the owner of that aura, but that person blew my senses away. However, I felt strange because that person didn’t attack me, and he or she also didn’t say anything to pressure me. Perhaps that person just wanted to protect the shop and didn’t want to do anything else, so I doubt that person was one of the masterminds."
"Where did you find that person?"

"I didn’t find the person, and he or she found my action, so I don’t know his or her exact location." Sima Huiqing’s answer left all of them deep in thought. "Do you know anything about that person, Old Gu?"

"Yes." Gu Changsheng nodded at her. "I also sensed the presence of that person about three weeks ago when I checked the eastern forest, but that person didn’t do anything and only scared me, so I gave up my intention to investigate further."
"Three weeks ago?" Cao Yunbai and others looked at Gu Changsheng with a frown. "What were you doing in the eastern forest at that time? Why did you never mention anything to us?"

"Didn’t you listen to Old Sima just now? Do you think that person wouldn’t find out if I mentioned him or her to all of you? That person didn’t do anything to me, but I could feel my death when his or her aura suppressed me, so I chose to keep this matter to myself." Sima Huiqing stopped the others when they wanted to ask Gu Changsheng again. Regarding my reason for going to the eastern forest, I sensed a change in the Gu insect that is inside Ju Xing’s body, which prompted me to investigate it. However, the formation protecting the forest was very powerful, and that person scared me away when I wanted to try to break it. After reflecting on everything, I came to believe that the mysterious person was the protector of the natural races, so we should think twice about messing with them."
"To be precise, that mysterious person is Jia Yuyan’s protector."

Cao Yunbai nodded in agreement with Sima Huiqing. "You are right, Old Sima. Jia Yuyan is a cultivator from the Paradise Realm, and she herself is much stronger than us. However, we do not have any in-depth information about her, so the mysterious person is most likely her protector. Since we cannot defeat them, we should wait for Ren’er to bring Qi Lai to this realm, and he might be able to do something about them. If he can get rid of them, we will no longer need those chimeras, and we will attack the Tian Clan and other clans head-on."
"Do you think we’ll make it?" Bao Yundong asked skeptically.

All of them shook their heads at him because they didn’t have the answer themselves. Cao Feihong then spoke. "Ren’er will arrive in this realm in a week, so we should disperse now and prepare our members. The success or failure of our plan will depend on whether Qi Lai can defeat Jia Yuyan and that mysterious person. If he succeeds in defeating them, we will make our move immediately, but we will have to postpone it if he fails to do so."
"All right, let’s disperse."
Inside the cave, Shangguan Lizhi smiled with satisfaction because she had experienced significant improvements in the past week, especially after she swallowed Zhang Fei’s beast pills.

"You’ve become stronger, Lizhi." Shangguan Lizhi nodded to Tian Junfeng, who had just arrived. "That kid’s basic pills are truly potent, and everything about me is stronger now. However, your changes are more significant than mine."

"Unlike you, I am a divine beast, and Yan’er also gave me that kid’s beast pills, so my improvement is much more significant than yours." Shangguan Lizhi patted her side, inviting him to sit with her. "What about those people?"

Tian Junfeng shook his head at her. "I don’t know what happened within their clans a week ago, but Cao Yunbai and the others were panic-stricken now. Jingxuan told me that their members kept checking all corners of this realm, but their search was only in vain because that kid was hiding in the eastern forest, and they didn’t dare to check there because of Jia Yuyan."

"I see." Shangguan Lizhi nodded in understanding. "If I’m not mistaken, Cao Ren will return to our realm soon, and he brought a cultivator from the Paradise Realm with him. Although that kid has brought his acquaintances to this realm, it is our responsibility to protect our home, so we must prepare our clan members for the worst. Yan’er should have prepared them, but I don’t know about your clan."

"Haha." Tian Jufeng laughed at that. "Jingxuan is not really stupid, so he and the others have prepared all their members. For now, we just need to wait for Cao Ren to return, and the big battle will happen then."

[Congratulations! Your wood element has been upgraded to the intermediate stage.]
[Congratulations! Your wood elemental law has been upgraded to the intermediate stage.]

"Yeah."

sentences.text: "The gray one is the samsara cycle vision." Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow as soon as Tang Ying said that.
Although he was not a religious person, he naturally knew the meaning of the samsara cycle, which shocked him.
"You’re right, I can pierce through the veil of reincarnation and witness the past lives, karmic burdens, and lingering soul fragments of any living being—humans, beasts, or demons.
Throughout my life, I have met several reincarnators, but there is only one person who terrifies me the most."
"Feng Yao."
Tang Ying nodded at Zhang Fei [5].
"Among all the reincarnators I have encountered in the past, Feng Yao stands out as the most terrifying, having experienced numerous reincarnations.
Her soul power was too terrifying, and she could destroy the souls of all living creatures that exist now if she wanted to.
Moreover, there is a powerful female fire spirit by her side, and she is no less terrifying than her master."
"Huo Ling."
"That female fire spirit is far more terrifying than you can imagine." Tang Ying looked scared when she said that.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] himself had long been aware that Huo Ling was not an ordinary fire spirit.
"What exactly is her identity?"
"Huo Ling is the spirit of the Primordial Flame."
Zhang Fei [5] froze, and his eyes widened in shock after hearing that.
Back then, Feng Yao told him that the primordial flame once existed in the Temple of Forgotten Flames established by the primordial beings, but it suddenly disappeared several million years ago.
Moreover, the flame is the lifeblood of the Forgotten Land, and that place became isolated after it disappeared.
"Master." Tang Ying looked at Huo Diqiu, who had just come out of Zhang Fei [5]’s body.
"Master, if this woman is correct that Huo Ling is the spirit of the Primordial Flame, that means the flame never disappeared in the first place, and it is inside Feng Yao’s body now."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him with a serious expression.
"No wonder Feng Yao’s mastery of the fire element is so amazing, and her flame power is also incredibly terrifying.
Uncle Luo said that the people in the past nicknamed one of her reincarnations as the Flame Spirit Empress, Huo Yanling.
Moreover, her first identity was a primordial being, Shen Yuanzhi, so it was natural that she had the ability to take on the Primordial Flame."
"Then, why did the two of them lie to you, Master?
They said that they didn’t know anything about the disappearance of the Primordial Flame, but in fact Huo Ling is its soul, which means the flame is in Feng Yao’s hands now."
"Phew." Zhang Fei [5] exhaled heavily.
"I don’t know their real purpose in lying to me, but we don’t need to think about them now.
The two of them have long since gone to the Paradise Realm, so they are far beyond my reach now, and I will focus on myself for now."
"All right then." Huo Diqiu immediately entered Zhang Fei [5]’s body.
Zhang Fei [5] then asked Tang Ying.
"Has Feng Yao ever said anything to you, Senior?
I’m sure she knew your abilities, and she wouldn’t just keep quiet about it."
"Feng Yao never said anything about my abilities." Zhang Fei [5] gave Tang Ying a distrustful look.
"Instead, she ordered me to wait for you, and she also ordered me to help you improve your soul power."
Zhang Fei [5] folded his forehead.
"Why did Feng Yao order you to wait for me?
Why did you obey her orders?"
"Do you think I dare to refuse her orders?" Tang Ying responded by shaking her head.
"Feng Yao didn’t enslave me or do anything else to me, but her and Huo Ling’s strength frightened me so much.
Therefore, I chose to obey her order, and I kept waiting for you to come to this realm."
"When did Feng Yao order you?"
"The day she left for the Paradise Realm.
Additionally, she asked me to follow you when you go to that realm in the future."
"Two years ago, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] muttered to himself as he thought about Feng Yao’s reasons for helping him to that extent.
"Where did you get the Eyes of Samsara technique?"
"Guess it." Tang Ying responded with a smile.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately guessed it without thinking twice.
"You are a reincarnator, and your technique is your past technique."

"You are right that I am a reincarnator, but the technique is not my past technique, and I obtained it after my soul entered the circle of reincarnation." Zhang Fei [5] found it hard to believe that Tang Yin obtained such a powerful technique after her death.
"Even though I am a reincarnator, I do not have a deep understanding of reincarnation and the like, so I cannot explain the details to you.
However, I did not lie to you, and I obtained my technique at that time."
"Can you teach me?"
"No." Tang Ying shook her head.
"Even though you have died once, you have never entered the circle of reincarnation, especially since that little girl revived you.
To learn the Eyes of Samsara, you must have experienced a real death and passed through the circle of reincarnation once, so I can’t teach it to you.
How about you bring me into your space?
Your soul power will increase faster if we dual-soul cultivate there, right?"
After he contacted Wei Xiaoya and informed her about it, Zhang Fei [5] immediately brought Tang Ying to the pavilion, and the two sat together in the main garden.
The two immediately held hands, as did their souls.
Zhang Fei [5] then activated his soul domain, surprising Tang Ying a bit.
"My soul domain has almost the same effect as my lust domain, and it will boost the results of our dual-soul cultivation by about twofold.
Since your soul power is much higher than mine, my soul power will probably break through to the early stage of the Venerate Soul level soon.
However, that is not enough for me, and I want to reach the Divine Soul level as soon as possible."
"Your cultivation and soul power have already far surpassed the cultivators of your generation, so why do you have to be so hasty?" Tang Yin responded by shaking her head.
Zhang Fei [5] released a soft sigh.
"Strong enemies keep appearing to block my path, and they won’t give me time to relax.
For now, I have many allies to sort out my problems, but they won’t be able to help me forever, especially when I go to the Paradise Realm.
Therefore, I have to let go of my dependence on them, and I must keep improving myself to reach their level as soon as possible, or I will die at their hands."
"All right, let’s start now, and I will help you increase your soul power." Tang Ying frowned when Zhang Fei [5] sat her on his lap.
"What would you do?"
"Nothing." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head and closed his eyes.
"Let’s start."
Tang Ying did not speak further and closed her eyes, and the two of them began their dual-soul cultivation.
Meanwhile, the ancestors of the Cao, Sima, Bao, and Gu Clans gathered in one place.

Almost all of the gathered ancestors were gloomy and furious due to the incident a week ago when Serpentera destroyed their chimeras, while only Gu Changsheng remained calm and unperturbed by the situation.
"What should we do now?" Cao Yunbai asked the others.
"I, Cao Feihong, and all my clansmen have been trying to find the mastermind since a week ago, but we still haven’t found any clues.
I suspect that the mastermind is more than one person; one of them blew up our passageways, and the other wiped out our chimeras."
"What can we do?" Bao Yundong shook his head in response.

The natural races own that shop, and they sell a lot of extraordinary pills there.
However, I couldn’t go there, so I ordered Sima Yunfeng to check it out, but they forbade members of our four clans from entering.
He tried to force his way in, but he suddenly sensed a deadly aura locking him in, forcing him to retreat."
"A deadly aura?"
Sima Huiqing nodded to them.

However, I felt strange because that person didn’t attack me, and he or she also didn’t say anything to pressure me.
Perhaps that person just wanted to protect the shop and didn’t want to do anything else, so I doubt that person was one of the masterminds."
"Where did you find that person?"
"I didn’t find the person, and he or she found my action, so I don’t know his or her exact location." Sima Huiqing’s answer left all of them deep in thought.
"Do you know anything about that person, Old Gu?"
"Yes." Gu Changsheng nodded at her.

"I also sensed the presence of that person about three weeks ago when I checked the eastern forest, but that person didn’t do anything and only scared me, so I gave up my intention to investigate further."
"Three weeks ago?" Cao Yunbai and others looked at Gu Changsheng with a frown.
"What were you doing in the eastern forest at that time?
Why did you never mention anything to us?"
"Didn’t you listen to Old Sima just now?
Do you think that person wouldn’t find out if I mentioned him or her to all of you?

That person didn’t do anything to me, but I could feel my death when his or her aura suppressed me, so I chose to keep this matter to myself." Sima Huiqing stopped the others when they wanted to ask Gu Changsheng again.

However, the formation protecting the forest was very powerful, and that person scared me away when I wanted to try to break it.
After reflecting on everything, I came to believe that the mysterious person was the protector of the natural races, so we should think twice about messing with them."
"To be precise, that mysterious person is Jia Yuyan’s protector."
Cao Yunbai nodded in agreement with Sima Huiqing.
"You are right, Old Sima.
Jia Yuyan is a cultivator from the Paradise Realm, and she herself is much stronger than us.
However, we do not have any in-depth information about her, so the mysterious person is most likely her protector.
Since we cannot defeat them, we should wait for Ren’er to bring Qi Lai to this realm, and he might be able to do something about them.
If he can get rid of them, we will no longer need those chimeras, and we will attack the Tian Clan and other clans head-on."
"Do you think we’ll make it?" Bao Yundong asked skeptically.
All of them shook their heads at him because they didn’t have the answer themselves.
Cao Feihong then spoke.
"Ren’er will arrive in this realm in a week, so we should disperse now and prepare our members.
The success or failure of our plan will depend on whether Qi Lai can defeat Jia Yuyan and that mysterious person.
If he succeeds in defeating them, we will make our move immediately, but we will have to postpone it if he fails to do so."
"All right, let’s disperse."

paragraphs: After they had waited for quite some time, Hun Di and the others’ group finally arrived at the fourth floor, and all of them looked so excited to face all the challenges on that floor.

"Master, I’ve met your senior sister." Hun Di was taken aback when Zhang Fei said that. "Senior Tang is in the pavilion now, and she has been dual-soul cultivating with one of my clones since a week ago."
"Hey! Junior brother! Are you thinking about taking our martial aunt as your woman?" Lin Moxian asked with surprise.

"Do you need to ask that, Senior Brother?" Yan Yinqing responded while shaking her head. "Our junior brother clearly said that our martial aunt is dual-soul cultivating with one of her clones in the pavilion, and you should remember that only his woman lives there."
"Hey! I’m not his woman!" Jing Qiuyue argued.

Yan Yinqing shrugged her shoulders. "Senior Sister Jing, you don’t have to deny it, okay? Although you haven’t become his woman yet, you’ve lived with them for so long, and you should be used to their activities. Therefore, I believe that you will become his woman one day, and I’m sure that time won’t be too long."
"I agree with her, Senior Sister Jing." Shang Yingyue spoke while nodding. "It’s clear that he wants you as his woman; otherwise, he would never allow you to live with them, right?"
Jing Qiuyue immediately looked at Zhang Fei with a frown. "Do you really have thoughts like that about me?"

"Have I ever tried to approach you since you’ve been living with us, Senior Sister Jing? If I wanted you to be my woman, you would have long been mine, so you can ignore their words, especially what Senior Sister Yan said." After hearing that, Jiu Qiuyue sighed in relief, and Zhang Fei continued to inform Hun Di of another matter. "Master, Senior Tang has already punished You Shanyi."
"Hmm?" Hun Di furrowed his brows. "How can my senior sister find You Shanyi?"

Zhang Fei immediately explained to Hun Di in detail about his accidental encounter with You Shanyi in the Grand Royal Realm, and he also told him about the process of how the old man fell into Tang Ying’s hands.

"I see." Hun Di nodded in understanding. "It’s really regrettable that something like that happened to You Shanyi, but he really went too far by using his soul technique to do all that. Even though so much time has passed, he still hasn’t changed, and he has to bear the consequences now."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei rubbed his nose as he thought about telling Hun Di about his relationship with Wei Xiaoya, but he felt awkward about telling him the truth.
"What are you thinking about, Junior Brother?" Yan Yinqing asked him. "Every time you’re confused, you always rub your nose, so I’m sure you’re hiding something from us."
Lin Moxian put her arm around Zhang Fei’s shoulder. "Tell us, what are you keeping a secret from us?"
"Ha ha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "I’m not hiding anything serious, okay? It’s just that I feel confused about telling our master, especially since this matter is related to his family."
Hun Di and his other four disciples looked at Zhang Fei with suspicion. "I remember my sisters live in the Grand Royal Realm, so you should have met them there, right?"
"Yes, Master." Zhang Fei nodded at him. "Actually, I’ve not only met them, but I’ve become part of their family now."
"What?" Yan Yinqing, Jing Qiuyue, and Lin Moxian shouted in surprise after hearing that.
Qiao Liangreng then asked him. "Which one? Wei Xiaoya or Wei Xiaolu?"
"Are you really in a relationship with one of them, Junior Brother?" Yan Yinqing and Jing Qiuyue asked at the same time.
Zhang Fei nodded to them. "I married Wei Xiaoya about two weeks ago."
"Tell us! How could you suddenly marry Wei Xiaoya? Moreover, we’ve met her a few times, and we’re sure she’s not your type."

"Why do you two think like that?" Zhang Fei responded with a shake of his head. "You two don’t know the true Wei Xiaoya, and she is completely different from the one everyone knows. In reality, she is a beautiful woman, and she disguised herself like that on purpose because she didn’t want to be close to those men."
"How—" Zhang Fei directly touched Yan Yinqing and Jing Qiuyue’s foreheads, and he shared Wei Xiaoya’s true appearance with them, leaving both of them stunned. "What the hell! She’s truly beautiful!"
"Junior brother—"

"Enough." Hun Di immediately stopped Lin Moxian. "I have known for a long time that Xiaoya never used her real appearance in front of many people, and she always used a disguise to meet them; even her parents never knew about it. So how can you marry her?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed before explaining the details to them, leaving them speechless.

Hun Di let out a soft sigh and patted Zhang Fei’s shoulder. "Since you and Xiaoya are already married, I won’t say anything more, and I will bless your relationship. Moreover, you are my disciple, and I believe you will be fair and kind to her."
"Yes, Master." Zhang Fei then changed their conversation. "By the way, we will postpone our challenge, and I want all of you to learn something new first."
"What’s that?" Lin Jingxia, who had previously been silent, finally asked a question.

Zhang Fei smiled at her. "A domain! I obtained the method in the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and I have already taught it to Xianqin and the others. So, I’ll teach you the method now, and we’ll resume our challenges after you create your domain."

All of them are excited to hear that, except Hun Di, especially since he already has his domain. Zhang Fei immediately explained the method to all of them, and he guided his other women to create it, especially since most of them still lacked experience.
"Hmm?" Shangguan Yan, Duanmu Luolan, and Leng Xueyan looked at Jia Yuyan as soon as she landed in front of the main hall of the Shangguan Clan.

Shangguan Yan and Duanmu Luolan were not surprised by the strength and thickness of Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s Yang Qi within Jia Yuyan’s body, especially since they already knew that they had previously entered seclusion together.

Leng Xueyan, on the other hand, gazed at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with inquisitive eyes, particularly since she could feel the same as the two women. ’Since when was he in a relationship with Jia Yuyan? His yang qi was so strong and dense inside her body, but, strangely, she was still a virgin.’

"Why are you looking at me like that?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked Leng Xueyan with a playful smile. "If you miss my twin brother that much, I can bring him here for you, and you two can have fun later."

Leng Xueyan blushed and turned her face away, while Shangguan Yan and Duanmu Luolan smiled amusedly at her, which made her feel embarrassed in front of them. ’Tch! This guy is truly hateful! His twin brother is the same! He hasn’t contacted me since we parted that day!’
"What about Cao Ren and Qi Lai? Are they almost in this realm?" Jia Yuyan asked her question while sitting beside Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"According to Serpentera, they will arrive in a few hours, so we will end everything today." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then spoke to the other three. "The people from the Cao, Sima, and Bao clans are ready to move, so you guys should order your men to prepare to face them."
Leng Xueyan answered him first. "My father and my clan members are already prepared, and they will immediately move if the people from the three clans move."
"My clan members are ready, and I will join them after this." Duanmu Luolan said.
"My clan—"
Shangguan Lizhi suddenly appeared in front of them and spoke to them. "Han’er and Miuyan will lead our people, and I will join Tian Junfeng to fight Bao Yundong and Sima Huiqing."
"Hahaha." Loud laughter suddenly rang in their ears, and several people landed in front of the main hall. "I have a personal grudge against Cao Yunbai, so I will face him myself."
"Have you completely recovered, old friend?" Shangguan Lizhi asked Ju Xing, who had just arrived with Qian Chaoying and several leaders of the natural race, including Ju Tan and his family.

"Hahaha." Ju Xing laughed at that. "Even though I was dying before, I have fully recovered now. If it weren’t for the help of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and his pills, I might never have recovered, and I might have really died."
"I’m glad you’ve finally recovered." Shangguan Lizhi gratefully looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Then, what about the Gu Clan?"

"Gu Changsheng has total control of the Gu Clan, and he’s been my slave for a while, so we don’t need to worry about them." Shangguan Lizhi, Leng Xueyan, and the leaders of the natural races were shocked to hear that, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded to them with a casual smile and walked out. "If the patriarch of the Gu Clan insists on helping those three clans, I will order that old man to slaughter them."
’This kid is truly a madman! How could he possibly speak so lightly about slaughtering a clan?’ All of them spoke in their minds.

"Those beast races have finally come out of their dimensional space, and their numbers are quite large." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked towards the east. "The people from the Yi Clan are already on standby, including the members of the Midnight Jade Sect. I asked them to guard the eastern area in case the people from the three clans escape there, and I asked them to kill anyone who tries to escape. The Ning Clan is also already on standby in the south, but I have no connections with them, so I didn’t tell them anything. However, they are experienced cultivators, so they should know the best course of action to take against those people."
"Are you really going to allow them to massacre those three clans?" Qian Chaoying asked in disbelief.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smirked at him. "I don’t know about you guys, but my main principle is to kill my enemies down to their core; otherwise, their descendants will bring new problems in the future, and it will only waste my time dealing with them again. Believe it or not, I once did it in my home realm, and we killed all the heretics there without any left."
After Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that, all of them inhaled deeply, feeling that he was far more vile and cruel than the people from the Cao, Bao, and Sima Clans.

"They killed thousands of heretics in that realm in a day." Shangguan Lizhi and the others looked at Jia Yuyan directly. "When that incident happened, I had already started monitoring him, so I knew everything that happened in that realm. His decision was indeed too cruel, but it benefited all the residents of that realm, and they could live much more peacefully with no heretics left there. Therefore, I agree with him to eliminate those three clans; the people in this realm will no longer have to live in worry and fear, including my natural races."

Since Jia Yuyan had already decided, Qian Chaoying and the others did not continue. Although they did not like such a method because it was too cruel, they realized that it was the best choice for everyone.

"What are your plans for Sima Huiqing and Cao Feihong? You can’t possibly kill them, right?" Jia Yuyan’s questions made everyone turn their attention to Zhang Xiaolong [3] again, waiting for his answer.

"I won’t kill them." Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s answer confused most of them, except for Jia Yuyan, Leng Xueyan, Shangguan Yan, and Duanmu Luolan, especially since it was contrary to his previous decision. "Even if I don’t kill them, they won’t be able to roam freely anymore, and I will imprison them in my personal prison."
"Your personal prison?" Shangguan Lizhi asked.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "I have a special place to lock up my enemies, but I only imprison the female ones, especially since I need their Yin Qi."
"Does that mean you use them as your cultivation furnace?" This time, Jing Shenlin, the Dryad, asked him.

"You can say it like that, but I use a different method from those evil cultivators. They don’t feel the slightest pain, and they just sleep while having sweet dreams." Jing Shenlin and the others did not believe it, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not want to explain further to them. Jia Yuyan and the other three women remained silent, despite already knowing about his Yin-Yang Space. "You guys should not gather here; otherwise, those people wouldn’t dare leave their clans."
After he said that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately disappeared from their sight.
Ju Xing and the leaders of the natural races immediately dispersed, returning to their respective positions.
On the other hand, Shangguan Lizhi went to check on her clan members’ final preparations.
"I will return to my clan now." Duanmu Luolan left directly, followed by Leng Xueyan.
"Have you dual cultivated with him before?" Shangguan Yan asked Jia Yuyan after the others had left.

"We did it for almost two whole months." Jia Yuyan’s shameless reply left Shangguan Yan stunned. "Since your children have agreed to your relationship with him, you should not delay any longer and start dual cultivating with him, and I’m sure you will enjoy it."
Shangguan Yan blushed at the thought, but she then asked Jia Yuyan another question. "How can you still be a virgin if you’ve dual cultivated with him before?"

"Have you forgotten his demon identity?" Shangguan Yan shook her head at Jia Yuyan. "According to legend, lust demons actually have no gender, and they have the ability to change their bodies into male or female at will. He has that ability, and he used it to change my hymen before we did it, so I’m still a virgin even though we’ve dual cultivated many times. Unfortunately, he couldn’t absorb my Yin Qi because my true cultivation was in the Five Celestial Realms, but he had stored all of it for his future use. Unlike me, your cultivation is still in the Seven Divine Realms, and you are also a divine beast, so you will be of great help to him if you dual cultivate with him."

"I know." Shangguan Yan replied with a soft sigh. "Even though my children have accepted our relationship, I am still not ready to engage in dual cultivation with him, so I will first prepare myself."

"You shouldn’t delay it too long and help him to improve his cultivation, and you guys can go to the Paradise Realm sooner." Jia Yuyan then stood up from her chair. "I will join my natural races now."
After Jia Yuyan left, Shangguan Yan also went to see Shangguan Lizhi and her two children, especially since the time of the battle was approaching.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already arrived in front of Serpentera and Tian Kui. "I want you two to replace that old man to stop Qi Lai, and they will help me imprison Xereth in the Star Tower. This way, he won’t be able to contact or summon Taotie, so he won’t send a substitute to stop him anytime soon, and I will have more time to focus on my cultivation."

"All right." Serpentera immediately agreed. "Do you want to absorb his cultivation? If you do that, you should be able to comprehend the Celestial Qi earlier, and you can start absorbing it once your clone arrives in the Paradise Realm."

Tian Kui immediately warned him. "However, you can’t absorb his cultivation all at once because the Celestial Qi is completely different from the Divine Qi, so you have to absorb his cultivation slowly and comprehend the difference first. By the way, I will capture Qi Lai and bring him to another realm, and Old Snake will stay here to monitor the progress of their battle."
"Okay." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "Once they arrive, you can move to capture Qi Lai and take him to another realm directly, and I will meet you there after I clean up Xereth."

"Master, I’ve met your senior sister." Hun Di was taken aback when Zhang Fei said that.

"Hmm?" Hun Di furrowed his brows.

"Ha ha." Zhang Fei laughed at that.
"I’m not hiding anything serious, okay?
It’s just that I feel confused about telling our master, especially since this matter is related to his family."
Hun Di and his other four disciples looked at Zhang Fei with suspicion.
"I remember my sisters live in the Grand Royal Realm, so you should have met them there, right?"
"Yes, Master." Zhang Fei nodded at him.
"Actually, I’ve not only met them, but I’ve become part of their family now."
"What?" Yan Yinqing, Jing Qiuyue, and Lin Moxian shouted in surprise after hearing that.
Qiao Liangreng then asked him.

"Are you really in a relationship with one of them, Junior Brother?" Yan Yinqing and Jing Qiuyue asked at the same time.

"Tell us!

"Why do you two think like that?" Zhang Fei responded with a shake of his head.
"You two don’t know the true Wei Xiaoya, and she is completely different from the one everyone knows.

’This kid is truly a madman!

Believe it or not, I once did it in my home realm, and we killed all the heretics there without any left."

Therefore, I agree with him to eliminate those three clans; the people in this realm will no longer have to live in worry and fear, including my natural races."

They don’t feel the slightest pain, and they just sleep while having sweet dreams." Jing Shenlin and the others did not believe it, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not want to explain further to them.

paragraphs: "What are you doing here, Kid?"

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that. "I came here to check on these two foxes, Old Mu. They’ve been trying to comprehend the Dao for almost a month and a half, but they still haven’t shown any signs of success."

"Not everyone has as high a comprehension as you, kid." Mu Ling let out a soft sigh as he looked at Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing. "In the past, it took me a thousand years to comprehend the Dao, despite my master giving me pointers. These two foxes, especially the male one, were too stupid. He couldn’t clear his mind because he was thinking too much about his anger toward you, and his test hasn’t even started, even though they’ve been here for almost a month and a half. Unlike him, the female fox had already started undergoing her test a week ago, and she hasn’t managed to pass it since then."
"The first question should be, what is Dao, right?"

Mu Ling nodded at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "The Dao has many concepts, but only one is true. The question is simple, but most people think too complicatedly, preventing them from seeing the true answer. Actually, this female fox is not stupid, but she thinks too much like them, and she will never succeed as long as she can’t clear her mind."
"You’re right." A faint smirk appeared on Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s face.

"Hmm?" Mu Ling raised an eyebrow when he noticed his smirk. "Are you thinking about doing something to that female fox? I still didn’t expect that you managed to subdue my master, and the two of you disappeared for so long before."

"Your master is quite proud, but it’s not difficult to conquer her, and she is my wife now." Mu Ling could only shake his head upon hearing that from Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Actually, I need these two foxes, but I can’t kill them now. However, I have prepared other plans for them, especially Tian Baixing."
"Are you going to capture her?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "I will capture Tian Baixing once she successfully completes her Dao test, especially since she will be more useful to me at that time. As for Tian Baitian, I plan to send him to another place. Once I am ready, I will kill both of them, and I will evolve into the ten-tailed fox."

"I see." Mu Ling nodded in understanding. "Once you evolve to ten tails, I believe your strength will skyrocket. Countless people, especially the natural races, will welcome the heir of the ten-tailed fox with joy."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a soft sigh instead. "Old Mu, I have never been interested in being the peacemaker, and I fight only to protect myself and those closest to me. As long as we are all safe, I cannot care about the fate of those people."

"Hahaha." Mu Ling laughed, stood facing him, and pointed at his chest. "Are you really like that, kid? Deep down, you know that you’ve always cared about them, but you’ve repeatedly denied it because of what happened to you in the past. Otherwise, you wouldn’t have helped the people of the Sky Jade Realm to purge those heretics, right? Ever since you arrived in this realm, you’ve unknowingly brought about changes here. You helped and strengthened the natural races, you cured Ancestor Ju Xing, and you’re now fighting to eliminate those three clans. You may not want to admit it, but your actions have helped many people in this realm and other realms, and none of that would have happened if you didn’t care about others."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] chose not to comment on it. "Old Mu, please inform me if Tian Baixing successfully passes her Dao Test, and I will immediately move to capture her."
"All right." Mu Ling released a soft sigh after Zhang Xiaolong [3] disappeared from her sight. "That kid is actually nice, but he’s too hard on himself."

Elsewhere, the ancestors of the Cao, Bao, and Sima had gathered in one place, discussing their plans to resist the Tian Clan and the others. However, Gu Changsheng was not present among them, mainly because of Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s order.
"Where is Old Gu? Why didn’t he come?" Bao Yundong asked the others.
"You don’t need to worry about Old Gu; his Gu clan members have already left for the Qing Clan." Cao Yunbai then asked them. "How are your clans’ preparations? Are they ready to fight?"

Bao Yundong nodded at him. "Bao Sanli and the others have already prepared our clan members, and they should have started moving to surround the Tian Clan. However, their barrier is as strong as yours and Old Sima’s, so my clan members won’t be able to attack them as long as they hide inside."

"Sima Yunfeng and the others have also moved, and I ordered them to surround the Chi and Lin clans first, especially since these two are the weakest among them." Cao Yunbai and the others were surprised by Sima Huiqing’s decision. "Why are you guys looking at me like that? Apart from those two clans, I have already dispatched some people to the Duanmu, Yuan, Ren, Nalan, and Beihuang clans. However, they will not immediately move, and they will wait for help from those who attacked the first two clans."

Cao Feihong then warned them. "We can focus on our plans, but we must not ignore those mysterious people. We have been searching for them for two weeks, but we still haven’t found them. They haven’t made any other moves in the past two weeks, but they are an unexpected variable in our plans. They destroyed our passageways and chimeras, so we can’t rule out the possibility that they will attack us once we make a move against those clans. Moreover, Shangguan Lizhi, Tian Junfeng, and Ju Xing have already come out of their seclusion, and their target is definitely us."

"Ju Xing’s target is definitely you, Old Cao."

Cao Yunbai nodded in agreement with Bao Yundong. "Tian Junfeng’s target is most likely you or Old Gu, and Shangguan Lizhi’s target is Cao Feihong or Old Sima."

"Heh." Cao Feihong snorted at that. "Shangguan Lizhi may be a divine beast, but I have defeated her several times in the past, and I will defeat her again this time. I won’t hold back this time, and I will kill her if she comes at me."

"You underestimate Shangguan Lizhi too much." Cao Feihong frowned at Sima Huiqing. "Do you think you can defeat her if she uses her domain? She never used her domain in the few fights you two had in the past, remember? I don’t know her reason for not using her domain back then, but I’ve seen it once, and I can tell you that it’s very unique. Therefore, you should not underestimate her, and the two of us will face her together."
"Alright, we will face Shangguan Lizhi together." Cao Feihong then asked Cao Yunbai. "How long will it take for Ren’er to arrive in this realm?"

"Three hours." Cao Yunbai then stood up from his seat. "They are already preparing to attack us, but we will attack them first once Ren’er enters this realm. We only need to focus on their ancestors, and Qi Lai will take care of Jia Yuyan and the natural races for us."
*Bam*)
Duanmu Luolan, Yuan Hao, and the people from the Duanmu Clan were shocked to see the two unconscious people in front of them.
"Why are you here? Who are these two people?" Duanmu Luolan asked as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] appeared beside her.

"They are people from the Sima Clan, and they previously scouted this clan under Sima Huiqing’s orders." Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s answer made Duanmuo Luolan and Yuan Hao frown. "My acquaintances have been watching them since the beginning, and they told me about the old woman’s plan. You are my future wife, so I can’t just sit idly by, right?"
*Gasp*

The dozens of people from the Duanmu Clan gasped in shock when Zhang Xiaolong [3] called their matriarch his future wife, especially since they had not yet made their relationship public. They then looked at Duanmu Luolan, and the embarrassed expression on her face proved his words.

"What are you all looking at?" Yuan Hao asked them. "My mother and Zhang Xiaolong [3] are indeed in a relationship, and I have already approved of their relationship. This way, he will be the leader of this clan in the future, and you guys must be respectful to him. Do you all understand?"
"Yes, young master!"
Duanmu Luolan was really embarrassed by her son’s sudden announcement, especially since she wasn’t really ready to publicize her relationship with Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled and embraced her. "This way, our relationship is official now, so you don’t have to be shy like this anymore."
"Humph!" Duanmu Luolan snorted and turned her face away.
"I’ll go to the Yuan, Ren, Nalan, and Beihuang clans now, especially since Sima Huiqing also sent her people to keep an eye on the four clans."

Duanmu Luolan let out a disappointed sigh once Zhang Xiaolong [3] disappeared, and Yuan Hao immediately teased his mother. "Mother, you should have told him if you wanted to be with him, and I don’t mind if you stay with him. If necessary, you can give yourself to him, so I will have a younger sibling from the two of you, and—Ouch! Mother! Release—Ouch."
"How dare you tease your mother? Do you want me to postpone your wedding with Miyuan?" Duanmui Luolan asked with a fierce gaze as she pinched Yuan Hao’s waist harder.
Yuan Hao immediately put on a pitiful look. "Mother, please don’t do that! I can’t wait to marry Miyuan!"
"Humph!" Duanmu Luolan immediately pulled her hand back.

Their clan members laughed at their young master like that, but they immediately shut their mouths once Yuan Hao shot a fierce glance at them. "Get ready! Cao Ren will arrive in three hours, and our battle will begin then!"
"Yes, young master!"
*Bam... Bam...*

Yuan Tianquan, Ren Zhiwei, and the others were shocked by the loud crashing sound. They were even more shocked after seeing the five people lying helplessly, and they could immediately recognize that they were people from the Sima Clan.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately landed in front of them and explained it to them. "They were spying on this clan and the Ren Clan, but I didn’t kill them because it would attract Sima Huiqing’s attention, so I captured them and brought them here."
They were shocked to hear that, as they had never noticed Sima Huqing’s actions. "Thank you, Zhang Fei."
"No need." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at Yuan Tianquan. "Tianling is my future wife, so this clan is my family. I can’t stay long, and I will go to the Nalan and Beiming Clans now."
"Okay."

"That kid is too scary." Yuan Tianxie muttered to himself. "Back in the Scorching Earth Realm, I thought I could defeat him, but his abilities and actions made me realize that he was far better than me in many aspects."
Yuan Tianjie nodded in agreement to him. "Luckily, we didn’t attack him back in that realm, or we would be dead by now."
"We were really stupid back then, and we almost hurt ourselves."
"I agree with you, Tiankong." Yuan Tianhua said it with a light nod. "Among us, only Tianling had other opinions about him at that time, and she is his future wife now."

Yuan Tianquan and Ren Zhiwei exchanged glances and smiled at each other. "Forget about the past and focus on our problems! The battle will start in three hours, so all of you should focus on that. We must guard our clan tightly so that our enemies cannot break in."

In a few minutes, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already cleared out Sima Huiqing’s spies from the Nalan and Beiming Clans, and he left them in the two clans. He did not go to meet the people from the two clans; instead, he went to the Lin Clan.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not act alone because the Sima clan’s people who surrounded the clan were very many, but he found Lin Zuxin and informed her about them.

Lin Zuxin immediately ordered her clan’s elders to take care of the people from the Sima Clan, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked her to inform Chi Yuexin about those people, especially since they were also surrounding the Chi clan. "Have you cleared out those who surrounded the other clans?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "However, I ignored those who surrounded the Tian, Qing, and Shi clans. I also didn’t tell them about those people, especially since they had clearly chosen to be my enemies. sentences.text: "What are you doing here, Kid?"
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that.
"I came here to check on these two foxes, Old Mu.
They’ve been trying to comprehend the Dao for almost a month and a half, but they still haven’t shown any signs of success."
"Not everyone has as high a comprehension as you, kid." Mu Ling let out a soft sigh as he looked at Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing.
"In the past, it took me a thousand years to comprehend the Dao, despite my master giving me pointers.

"The first question should be, what is Dao, right?"
Mu Ling nodded at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"The Dao has many concepts, but only one is true.

Actually, this female fox is not stupid, but she thinks too much like them, and she will never succeed as long as she can’t clear her mind."
"You’re right." A faint smirk appeared on Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s face.
"Hmm?" Mu Ling raised an eyebrow when he noticed his smirk.

Countless people, especially the natural races, will welcome the heir of the ten-tailed fox with joy."

Ever since you arrived in this realm, you’ve unknowingly brought about changes here.
You helped and strengthened the natural races, you cured Ancestor Ju Xing, and you’re now fighting to eliminate those three clans.
You may not want to admit it, but your actions have helped many people in this realm and other realms, and none of that would have happened if you didn’t care about others."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] chose not to comment on it.
"Old Mu, please inform me if Tian Baixing successfully passes her Dao Test, and I will immediately move to capture her."
"All right." Mu Ling released a soft sigh after Zhang Xiaolong [3] disappeared from her sight.
"That kid is actually nice, but he’s too hard on himself."

paragraphs: "Ancestor, we-gah!" The patriarch of the Gu Clan was knocked away by Gu Changsheng.

Gu Changsheng immediately moved in front of the patriarch of the Gu Clan again and stomped his right leg to his chest. "Do you think you’re so great now that you dare to defy my orders, Gu Jizhao? Do you think our clan could still exist today if it weren’t for me? You weren’t even capable of defeating Tian Jingxuan! Everything you’ve enjoyed so far is the result of my hard work! As long as I’m alive, the control of this clan will always be in my hands! A doll like you should follow my orders; otherwise, I will kill you and replace you with someone else."
Not only did Gu Jizhao tremble in fear, but his family and clan members also trembled with fear listening to Gu Changsheng’s words.
Cold sweat dripped from their foreheads when Gu Changsheng looked at them, especially since the look in his eyes was so vicious, forcing everyone present to hold their breaths.
Tap... Tap...

"Sealed his cultivation and the others." Gu Jizhao and the others looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others in confusion, and the elders intended to capture him as they considered him an intruder. However, he swiftly activated the soul link, borrowed the power of all the beasts in the beast space, and pressed them to the ground instantly. "Don’t waste my time."

"Yes, Master." Gu Changsheng’s answer and behavior shocked all of them, but he couldn’t care less about them, and he immediately moved to carry out Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s order by sealing the cultivation of all the important people of his clan. "It’s done, Master."
’Master? Why does our ancestor recognize this boy as his master?’ All of them were shocked and frightened by their situation.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately used his soul manipulation ability, and he replicated their souls before merging them with his.
[Ding]
[The host’s soul power level has increased to the early stage of the soul venerate level.]

=== (A/N: I made a mistake from Chapters 966 to 1038 by writing his soul level as ancestral soul level, and his true soul cultivation has reached the Perfection Saint Soul level in Chapter 966. I have already corrected the few Chapters that showed his soul level, and I will correct the rest soon.)

’Finally.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] breathed a sigh of relief after his soul level broke through. ’Dual-soul cultivation with a high-level soul cultivator like Tang Jing is truly beneficial, and if we keep doing it, I’m sure I will be able to reach the Divine Soul level faster.’

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then returned those people’s souls into their bodies before asking Gu Changsheng to unseal their cultivation. He then sat on the head seat with the old man standing beside him in a respectful posture, making Gu Jizhao and the others even more afraid of him. "From today on, this clan belongs to me, and so do your lives. If you all don’t want to die a miserable death, you had better obey me and carry out all my orders well. Do you guys understand?"
"Y... yes..." Gu Jizhao and the others stuttered in response.

"Your first task is to join forces with the people from the Cao, Sima, and Bao clans. Once they make a move, I want you to attack them from behind and kill them." Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s orders shocked all of them, but he didn’t care about their reactions and spoke to Gu Changhseng directly. "I need Sima Huiqing and Cao Feihong, so you have to think of a way to bring them to me at all costs."

Gu Changsheng nodded to him. "Don’t worry, Master. I will bring the two old women to you, and you can have fun with them afterward. If they are unable to serve you, you can have fun with all the women in this clan."

"Do you think I’m that kind of person?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked, shooting a fierce glare at the old man. "Many of your clan members are strong, and some of them are quite pretty, but none of them interest me."
Gu Changsheng felt a chill down his spine and rubbed his sweat. "Please forgive me, Master."
The women of the clan felt relieved after hearing that, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately got down from his seat. "Leave and carry out my orders! If you fail, I will kill you all."
"Go!" Gu Changsheng quickly instructed the others to follow him as he went to meet the other ancestors.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] had arrived at the eastern forest, where various natural races had gathered. To his surprise, Zhe Wuming joined them. "My cultivation has not reached their level, but my void element will be very useful to help them. Moreover, I live in this forest now, so I decided to join them."

"I don’t think it’s a problem, but you should be careful with those ancestors, especially since they are stronger than the others." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked towards the north. "Those beast races seem to be split into two, and some of them find it useless to help us."
"Are you going to meet them, Master?" Ju Tan asked him.

"No need." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head in response. "Many of them don’t want to accept my presence among them, so I won’t waste my time with them. Once this battle is over, I want you to go to their dimensional space and help me open a shop there; however, I will not sell superior-grade pills in that shop, only the lower-grade ones."
"Leave it to me, Master."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then spoke to Jia Yuyan. "Stay by my side for now, okay? Once Tian Kui takes Qi Lai away from this realm, you can join them to slaughter those people."
"All right."

In the Northern Verdant Forest, Lei Yulong looked frustrated because their group was split in two, especially since half of them found it difficult to accept Zhang Xiaolong [3]. ’Tch! These guys are just idiots! I already told them that they would also suffer if the Cao Clan succeeded in taking over the outside world, but they wouldn’t listen to me!’
Long Qiu and Jin Xiang exchanged glances for a moment before sighing in their hearts, mainly because the two of them had already tried to convince half their group without success.

Bian Zhizhu was also with them and the leading members of her race, but she didn’t seem too concerned about their situation, and she participated with them so that they wouldn’t be suspicious of the two’s identities as Bian Luosha. Bian Ling, on the other hand, looked worried because of the division in their group.
"Hey! Yulong! We will return to our space, and you can take care of those people by yourself!"
Lei Yulong turned to a man with a dashing appearance like a white lion. "Bai Shi, you—"

"What a fool." All of them went on alert as soon as they heard that, and they spread their senses to search for the owner of the voice. However, their senses were immediately repelled, and half of their group was forced to lie face down on the ground, especially those who rejected Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Heh! You guys are so confident in your abilities, but you are no different from ants in the presence of the mighty me. If you dare to refuse that kid, I will devour all of you first, and I will devour all the people closest to you without leaving any of them behind."

Bai Shi and the people on his side broke out in a cold sweat hearing the threat. Moreover, their cultivation was already at the peak of mortal cultivation, but he did not move under the pressure of the mysterious person. ’Shit! This man should come from the realm beyond!’
Long Qiu and Jin Xiang were amused by the people’s expressions, but they were also curious about the mysterious person’s identity.
Lei Yulong cupped his hands to the sky. "Senior, I know they were wrong, but I hope you are willing to let them off this time."

"If you cannot control your people, then you do not deserve to be their leader; I will devour you along with them." Lei Yulong trembled at that, but the pressure suddenly disappeared, allowing Bai Shi and his allies to get up from the ground with mixed expressions. "Thank you, Senior."

The mysterious man said nothing in response to Lei Yulong, causing him to sigh softly. He then spoke to Bai Shi and the others. "Do you understand now? Zhang Xiaolong [3] is the heir of the ten-tailed fox, and he definitely has a powerful protector. If you still think of attacking him, I will not stop you, but I will not be responsible if you die and your race is wiped out."
"We know."
"Hmm?" Sima Huiqing raised an eyebrow as soon as Gu Changsheng landed in front of her. "What are you doing here, Old Gu? Why aren’t you leading your clansmen?"

"Hahaha." Gu Changsheng laughed at that. "Old Sima, Gu Jizhao is enough to lead them, and those people do not have the ability to ward off our Gu insects. Once our insects invade their bodies, they will fall under our control, and we can kill them easily."

Sima Huiqing nodded in understanding toward him. "Old Gu, Cao Yunbai will face Ju Xing. You should assist Old Bao in fighting Tian Junfeng, especially since Tian Jingxuan and the others will help him. Meanwhile, Cao Feihong and I will face Shangguan Lizhi together, especially since her domain is so terrifying."

"Leave them to me, and Old Bai can fight with Tian Junfeng." Gu Changsheng then handed a bottle to Sima Huiqing. "If you and Cao Feihong are unable to defeat Shangguan Lizhi, you can release the two Gu Insects inside, and I will control that female beast."
Sima Huiqing unsuspectingly accepted the bottle. "This way, our victory over Shangguan Lizhi is within sight, and I will force her to make a contract with me."

"I don’t care about that bitch, so you can do whatever you want to her. However, I’m sure that Cao Feihong also wants Shangguan Lizhi as her contract beast, so you have to think of something to stop her." Sima Huiqing nodded in understanding to Gu Changsheng, but the two suddenly received a voice transmission from Cao Yunbai informing them that Cao Ren was about to enter their realm. "I will return to my clansmen now, and we will soon begin our final battle with those foolish guys."

Sima Huiqing immediately spoke to Sima Yunfeng. "Lead them now! Our targets are the Chi and Lin Clans! After you conquer those two clans, you must lead them straight to the Tian and Ren clans. Meanwhile, I will join Cao Feihong, and we will face Shangguan Lizhi."
"Yes, Ancestor." Sima Yunfeng immediately led their clan members over. "Move out and spread out according to our original plan!"
"Yes, Patriarch!"
Not only the people from the Sima Clan, but the people from the Cao and Bao clans also moved out of their clans.

According to Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s order, the Gu Clan members divided themselves into several groups. Their main force headed towards the Leng Clan, and several other groups spread out and infiltrated the three clans’ forces.

On the other hand, the people of the Tian clan and other clans did not move from their clans, and they chose to wait and defend within their clans. Even so, they had already divided their members into several layers of defense, waiting for their enemies to come.
