sentences.text: "Ancestor, we-gah!" The patriarch of the Gu Clan was knocked away by Gu Changsheng.
Gu Changsheng immediately moved in front of the patriarch of the Gu Clan again and stomped his right leg to his chest.
"Do you think you’re so great now that you dare to defy my orders, Gu Jizhao?
Do you think our clan could still exist today if it weren’t for me?
You weren’t even capable of defeating Tian Jingxuan!
Everything you’ve enjoyed so far is the result of my hard work!
As long as I’m alive, the control of this clan will always be in my hands!
A doll like you should follow my orders; otherwise, I will kill you and replace you with someone else."
Not only did Gu Jizhao tremble in fear, but his family and clan members also trembled with fear listening to Gu Changsheng’s words.
Cold sweat dripped from their foreheads when Gu Changsheng looked at them, especially since the look in his eyes was so vicious, forcing everyone present to hold their breaths.
Tap...
Tap...
"Sealed his cultivation and the others." Gu Jizhao and the others looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others in confusion, and the elders intended to capture him as they considered him an intruder.
However, he swiftly activated the soul link, borrowed the power of all the beasts in the beast space, and pressed them to the ground instantly.
"Don’t waste my time."

"Yes, Master." Gu Changsheng’s answer and behavior shocked all of them, but he couldn’t care less about them, and he immediately moved to carry out Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s order by sealing the cultivation of all the important people of his clan.
"It’s done, Master."
’Master?
Why does our ancestor recognize this boy as his master?’ All of them were shocked and frightened by their situation.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately used his soul manipulation ability, and he replicated their souls before merging them with his.
[Ding]
[The host’s soul power level has increased to the early stage of the soul venerate level.]
=== (A/N: I made a mistake from Chapters 966 to 1038 by writing his soul level as ancestral soul level, and his true soul cultivation has reached the Perfection Saint Soul level in Chapter 966.
I have already corrected the few Chapters that showed his soul level, and I will correct the rest soon.)

’Finally.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] breathed a sigh of relief after his soul level broke through. ’Dual-soul cultivation with a high-level soul cultivator like Tang Jing is truly beneficial, and if we keep doing it, I’m sure I will be able to reach the Divine Soul level faster.’
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then returned those people’s souls into their bodies before asking Gu Changsheng to unseal their cultivation.
He then sat on the head seat with the old man standing beside him in a respectful posture, making Gu Jizhao and the others even more afraid of him.
"From today on, this clan belongs to me, and so do your lives.
If you all don’t want to die a miserable death, you had better obey me and carry out all my orders well.
Do you guys understand?"
"Y... yes..." Gu Jizhao and the others stuttered in response.
"Your first task is to join forces with the people from the Cao, Sima, and Bao clans.

Once they make a move, I want you to attack them from behind and kill them." Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s orders shocked all of them, but he didn’t care about their reactions and spoke to Gu Changhseng directly.
"I need Sima Huiqing and Cao Feihong, so you have to think of a way to bring them to me at all costs."
Gu Changsheng nodded to him.
"Don’t worry, Master.
I will bring the two old women to you, and you can have fun with them afterward.
If they are unable to serve you, you can have fun with all the women in this clan."
"Do you think I’m that kind of person?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked, shooting a fierce glare at the old man.
"Many of your clan members are strong, and some of them are quite pretty, but none of them interest me."
Gu Changsheng felt a chill down his spine and rubbed his sweat.
"Please forgive me, Master."
The women of the clan felt relieved after hearing that, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately got down from his seat.
"Leave and carry out my orders!
If you fail, I will kill you all."
"Go!" Gu Changsheng quickly instructed the others to follow him as he went to meet the other ancestors.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] had arrived at the eastern forest, where various natural races had gathered.
To his surprise, Zhe Wuming joined them.
"My cultivation has not reached their level, but my void element will be very useful to help them.
Moreover, I live in this forest now, so I decided to join them."
"I don’t think it’s a problem, but you should be careful with those ancestors, especially since they are stronger than the others." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked towards the north.
"Those beast races seem to be split into two, and some of them find it useless to help us."
"Are you going to meet them, Master?" Ju Tan asked him.
"No need." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head in response.
"Many of them don’t want to accept my presence among them, so I won’t waste my time with them.
Once this battle is over, I want you to go to their dimensional space and help me open a shop there; however, I will not sell superior-grade pills in that shop, only the lower-grade ones."
"Leave it to me, Master."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then spoke to Jia Yuyan.
"Stay by my side for now, okay?
Once Tian Kui takes Qi Lai away from this realm, you can join them to slaughter those people."
"All right."
In the Northern Verdant Forest, Lei Yulong looked frustrated because their group was split in two, especially since half of them found it difficult to accept Zhang Xiaolong [3]. ’Tch!
These guys are just idiots!
I already told them that they would also suffer if the Cao Clan succeeded in taking over the outside world, but they wouldn’t listen to me!’
Long Qiu and Jin Xiang exchanged glances for a moment before sighing in their hearts, mainly because the two of them had already tried to convince half their group without success.

Bian Zhizhu was also with them and the leading members of her race, but she didn’t seem too concerned about their situation, and she participated with them so that they wouldn’t be suspicious of the two’s identities as Bian Luosha.
Bian Ling, on the other hand, looked worried because of the division in their group.
"Hey!
Yulong!
We will return to our space, and you can take care of those people by yourself!"
Lei Yulong turned to a man with a dashing appearance like a white lion.
"Bai Shi, you—"
"What a fool." All of them went on alert as soon as they heard that, and they spread their senses to search for the owner of the voice.
However, their senses were immediately repelled, and half of their group was forced to lie face down on the ground, especially those who rejected Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Heh!
You guys are so confident in your abilities, but you are no different from ants in the presence of the mighty me.
If you dare to refuse that kid, I will devour all of you first, and I will devour all the people closest to you without leaving any of them behind."
Bai Shi and the people on his side broke out in a cold sweat hearing the threat.
Moreover, their cultivation was already at the peak of mortal cultivation, but he did not move under the pressure of the mysterious person. ’Shit!
This man should come from the realm beyond!’
Long Qiu and Jin Xiang were amused by the people’s expressions, but they were also curious about the mysterious person’s identity.
Lei Yulong cupped his hands to the sky.
"Senior, I know they were wrong, but I hope you are willing to let them off this time."

"If you cannot control your people, then you do not deserve to be their leader; I will devour you along with them." Lei Yulong trembled at that, but the pressure suddenly disappeared, allowing Bai Shi and his allies to get up from the ground with mixed expressions.
"Thank you, Senior."
The mysterious man said nothing in response to Lei Yulong, causing him to sigh softly.
He then spoke to Bai Shi and the others.
"Do you understand now?
Zhang Xiaolong [3] is the heir of the ten-tailed fox, and he definitely has a powerful protector.
If you still think of attacking him, I will not stop you, but I will not be responsible if you die and your race is wiped out."
"We know."
"Hmm?" Sima Huiqing raised an eyebrow as soon as Gu Changsheng landed in front of her.
"What are you doing here, Old Gu?
Why aren’t you leading your clansmen?"
"Hahaha." Gu Changsheng laughed at that.
"Old Sima, Gu Jizhao is enough to lead them, and those people do not have the ability to ward off our Gu insects.
Once our insects invade their bodies, they will fall under our control, and we can kill them easily."
Sima Huiqing nodded in understanding toward him.
"Old Gu, Cao Yunbai will face Ju Xing.
You should assist Old Bao in fighting Tian Junfeng, especially since Tian Jingxuan and the others will help him.
Meanwhile, Cao Feihong and I will face Shangguan Lizhi together, especially since her domain is so terrifying."
"Leave them to me, and Old Bai can fight with Tian Junfeng." Gu Changsheng then handed a bottle to Sima Huiqing.
"If you and Cao Feihong are unable to defeat Shangguan Lizhi, you can release the two Gu Insects inside, and I will control that female beast."
Sima Huiqing unsuspectingly accepted the bottle.
"This way, our victory over Shangguan Lizhi is within sight, and I will force her to make a contract with me."
"I don’t care about that bitch, so you can do whatever you want to her.

However, I’m sure that Cao Feihong also wants Shangguan Lizhi as her contract beast, so you have to think of something to stop her." Sima Huiqing nodded in understanding to Gu Changsheng, but the two suddenly received a voice transmission from Cao Yunbai informing them that Cao Ren was about to enter their realm.
"I will return to my clansmen now, and we will soon begin our final battle with those foolish guys."
Sima Huiqing immediately spoke to Sima Yunfeng.
"Lead them now!
Our targets are the Chi and Lin Clans!
After you conquer those two clans, you must lead them straight to the Tian and Ren clans.
Meanwhile, I will join Cao Feihong, and we will face Shangguan Lizhi."
"Yes, Ancestor." Sima Yunfeng immediately led their clan members over.
"Move out and spread out according to our original plan!"
"Yes, Patriarch!"
Not only the people from the Sima Clan, but the people from the Cao and Bao clans also moved out of their clans.
According to Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s order, the Gu Clan members divided themselves into several groups.
Their main force headed towards the Leng Clan, and several other groups spread out and infiltrated the three clans’ forces.

The Ning Clan in the southern region did the same thing, and their members blocked the escape routes of these people so that they would not escape to their territory.

chapters.title: Chapter 1040: Capture Xereth-Qi Lai
paragraphs: Qian Chaoying, Ju Tan, and the other spirit races went on alert as soon as Qi Lai appeared before them. All of them swiftly protected Zhe Wuming as soon as the old man touched the void walls.

"Interesting! I never expected to find a cultivator with the void element on this weak planet." Qi Lai then looked at Zhe Wuming, who was standing at the very back and protected by the natural races. "How about you join me, kid? Your void element is extremely rare even in the Paradise Realm, and I will help you become truly strong if you are willing to join me."

Zhe Wuming had always been considered the strongest cultivator in the Three Mortal Realms because of his void element, but he felt afraid for the first time in the presence of Qi Lai. "I am not interested in joining anyone."

"What a shame." Zhe Wuming spurted blood from his mouth as soon as Qi Lai destroyed his void walls. "Your void walls may be strong to protect you from other cultivators in these Three Mortal Realms, but they are useless before me. Since you are unwilling to join me, I will take you with me by force, and these ants will not be able to protect you from me."
Qi Lai released his aura to suppress Zhe Wuming and all the members of the natural races, forcing them to lie prone on the ground without being able to move a single finger.

Qi Lai gave an evil smirk as he approached them, but his aura suddenly disappeared by itself, allowing Zhe Wuming and the others to breathe normally. Before he could react, Tian Kui had appeared behind him and grabbed his shoulder.

"Ha ha ha." Tian Kui laughed at Qi Lai’s fearful expression. "Do you think you are the only cultivator from the Paradise Realm on this planet, brat? They may be ants in your eyes, but you are still an ant in the presence of the mighty me, even though your cultivation has reached the 3-Sun Celestial Emperor."
"Who... who are you, Senior?" Qi Lai asked in a trembling and afraid tone.

"An ant is not worthy to know the mighty me." In an instant, Tian Kui vanished from their view, transporting Qi Lai to a different realm at the request of Zhang Xiaolong [3]. No one, including Xereth and Cao Ren, was aware of that.

Ju Tan and the others hurriedly got up from the ground and wiped their sweat. "A cultivator from the Paradise Realm is indeed terrifying! Luckily, that senior was on my master’s side; otherwise, we would all die today."
"Even though we’ve reached the peak of mortals’ cultivation, the gap between us and them is too great." Ren Shuo said this as his body trembled.
Qian Chaoying and the others also felt extreme fear because of Qi Lai and Tian Kui’s presence earlier. "The battle has begun! Get ready to kill anyone who tries to invade our forest!"
Shangguan Yan, Yuan Hao, and the people from the Shangguan Clan froze as soon as Xereth appeared above their residence.
’Mother, is he the demon that Zhang Fei told us about before?’ Yuan Hao asked as he tightly held his spear.
’His name is Xereth, and he is truly powerful.’ Shangguan Yan nodded at him, but she did not look the least bit anxious because Zhang Xiaolong [3] had prepared everything to protect them.
"Ice bone physique." Shangguan Yan stiffened as soon as Xereth mentioned that. "Moreover, you are a domain master, so I will capture you and turn you into a demon like me."

Xereth intended to destroy the barrier protecting the Shangguan Clan, but a sword suddenly shot towards him, forcing him to summon his black scythe to deflect it. He immediately recognized the demon extermination sword. "Hahaha! I didn’t expect to find you here, you little bastard! Come out now and face me."

"Heh." The demon extermination sword instantly returned to Zhang Xiaolong [3], who had just appeared in front of Xereth. "Honestly, I still want to fight you, but we won’t do it here, and we will do it somewhere else."

"Do you think you can escape from me again?" Xereth immediately flew toward him, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] casually opened the gate. The demon immediately gave up his intention to absorb him, but he suddenly lost control of his body. ’What’s going on? Why isn’t my body listening to my commands?’

"Are you surprised?" Xereth looked back at Helian Xun’er and the other three. "A demon from the Paradise Realm like you does not belong on this planet, so we will take you away from here, and you will accept your punishment for all your actions in the Three Mortal Realms."
’Shit!’ Wan Jiang immediately grabbed Xereth’s shoulder and led him into the gate, followed by Helian Xun’er, Sima Yun, and Hua Mei’er.

After Zhang Xiaolong [3] closed the gate, Shangguan Yan, Yuan Hao, and their clan members exhaled with relief. "Yuyan, they are enough to protect the eastern forest, so I want you to stay here to help Yan’er and the others."
Jia Yuyan suddenly appeared on the scene. "Are you going to catch up with Tian Kui now?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened another gate and disappeared into it.
Jia Yuyan then landed beside Shangguan Yan and teased her. "Are you ready to fight, Yan’er?"

"Shut up!" Shangguan Yan glared at Jia Yuyan, particularly because her son and clan members laughed at her for being called that by Zhang Xiaolong [3], despite the fact that she was hundreds of thousands of years older than him. "Those ancestors have made their move, and my ancestor will directly confront Cai Feihong and Sima Huiqing."
Jia Yuyan nodded at her. "We don’t need to interfere in their fight, and we will focus on killing the members of their three clans who intend to attack this clan."
"Where are they? Why didn’t they join us?" Cao Yunbai asked as Cao Ren flew beside him, prompting him to explain everything, causing him to frown.
Cao Yunbai wanted to look for the two, but Ju Xing suddenly appeared in front of them with a large iron mace, forcing them to stop flying and prepare to fight him.

"Hahaha." Ju Xing laughed at their reaction and pointed his iron mace at them. "Cao Yunbai! I came here to settle accounts with you! Back then, you managed to defeat me thanks to Gu Changsheng’s help, but no one can help you now!"
"Heh!" Cao Ren snorted. "You may be strong, but you underestimate me, foolish giant! Let’s attack him together, ancestor! We must kill today, and no one will protect the natural races after he dies."

Cao Yunbai nodded at him, and the two immediately moved to attack Ju Xing. The people who were not far from their location hurriedly fled as far as possible, especially since the strength of the three was too overwhelming for them.
Meanwhile, Shangguan Lizhi stood calmly opposite Sima Huiqing and Cao Feihong, despite facing two female cultivators of equal strength. "Long time no see, Feihong and Huiqing."
"Heh!" Cao Feihong snorted and wanted to attack Shangguan Lizhi, but Sima Huiqing hurriedly grabbed her hand and stopped her. "What are you doing? She’s alone, so we don’t need to be afraid of her."
Sima Huiqing let out a soft sigh. "I told you not to act recklessly against her, but you’re too hot-headed. Look at her! Do you think she’s afraid of us with her expression that calm?
"Hmm?" Cao Feihong narrowed her eyes at Shangguan Lizhi. "No matter what! We will attack her together, and she won’t be able to fight both of us at once!"
Cai Feihong slapped her hand and attacked Shangguan Lizhi directly, making Sima Huiqing sigh before joining her to fight the female divine beast.

"Honestly, I didn’t want to use this, but I will use it today, especially since my opponents are the two of you." Shangguan Lizhi activated her domain, trapping both women within it. In an instant, another her appeared before the two women, making their numbers even.
’Shit!’ Cao Feihong and Sima Huiqing cursed in their hearts. Despite this, the two of them immediately attacked the two Shangguan Lizhi.
Within seconds, the four women were already engaged in a fierce fight, but Shangguan Yan and her clone had a slight upper hand over Cao Feihong and Sima Huiqing.
Elsewhere, Bao Yundong and Gu Changsheng were already standing in the air, facing Tian Junfeng, Tian Jingxuan, and Leng Hua in front of them.
"Hahaha!" Bao Yundong laughed at them. "Do you really think your descendant and Leng Hua can help you against us, Tian Junfeng?"

"As always, you are too confident, Bao Yundong." Tian Junfeng turned to the two men beside him. "I will deal with that guy, and you guys can deal with Gu Changsheng. However, you must be careful of his Gu insect, lest you two fall under his control."

"Yes, Ancestor." Before he followed Tian Junfeng, who had already moved to attack Bao Yundong, Tian Jingxuan first ordered Tian Jiantang to lead their clan members to kill the people from the Cao and Bao clans who were moving towards their clan. "Let’s go!"

Leng Hua also ordered his son and daughter to attack the enemy before following behind Tian Jingxuan, but he did not focus on Gu Changsheng. Instead, he focused more on observing the movements of the patriarch of the Tian Clan. After all, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already told him that the Gu ancestor was one of his slaves, so they were both on the same side.
Meanwhile, Lin Zuxin led a group from the Lin Clan to attack members of the Sima Clan, who were under the leadership of Sima Yunfeng.
Chi Yuexin and her Chi Clan have also been busy attacking people from the Sima Clan under the leadership of their clan elders.
The Shangguan clan was similarly engaged in battle, but they faced their enemies with relative ease, particularly due to the presence of Shangguan Yan and Jia Yuyan.

The situation in the Leng Clan was not much different; Leng Xueyan and her brother led their clan members to kill all the enemies who attacked their clan, making the atmosphere in the main city become noisy because of their fight.

Unlike the major clans, the situation in the Yuan, Ren, Nalan, and Beihuang clans was relatively calmer because the leaders of their three enemy clans did not attack them directly, and they only faced their subordinates, led by one or two elders.

The situation in the northern, western, eastern, and southern regions was still calm without any fighting at all. After all, the distance between the four regions was quite far from the main city, and their enemies needed some time to arrive at their territories.
Bam
"Guah!" Xereth groaned in pain after Wan Jiang threw him into a deep, dark hole. "Who the fuck are you? How dare you interfere in my business! My master Taotie will definitely kill you all!"

"Hahaha! Why don’t you try summoning that evil mythical beast?" Xereth frowned in response to Wan Jiang’s challenge, and he immediately took out his device, but it couldn’t work. "Have you realized now? This is not an ordinary tower, and powerful cultivators from our realm deliberately created it to lock up criminals like you. Even if you managed to contact Taotie, he would never dare attack this tower, especially since one of the creators of this tower was the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon Emperor."

"You—" Xereth immediately exploded his aura as Wan Jiang closed the hole from above. He tried to fly upwards to escape, but his expression changed as he couldn’t get close to the exit because the distance between them remained the same, even though he continued flying upwards. "Damn it! What kind of formation is this? Why does the exit keep moving away from me?"
Xereth decided to stop flying and land at the bottom of the hole, but he immediately summoned his black scythe and tried to break the walls around him.
Clang... Clang...

No matter how hard Xereth attacked those walls, all his attacks left no mark on them. "Shit! I should have known that those people had prepared a trap for us from the start! I was too confident because that old man was much stronger than me!"
"What exactly does Zhang Fei want to do to Qi Lai, Master? Why did he ask Tian Kui to take that old man away?" Sima Yun asked.

"That kid always does unexpected things, so I can’t guess his plan for Qi Lai. Since he said he would hand that old man over to me, we just have to wait for now." Wan Jiang then sat down in his usual place and activated the Qi screen in front of him, but the scene that appeared surprised him and his three disciples. "He taught them to create their own domains."

"Zhang Fei is making me more and more curious, Master." Helian Xun’er spoke as she smiled faintly. "Even in our realm, not everyone can create their domains, but he can come up with an easy method to help them create their domains. Hun Di and Lin Jingxia are the foremost among them, and I believe their domains will have extraordinary effects."

Wan Jiang nodded in agreement with her. "Perhaps Zhang Fei and his people will become a new force in our realm in the future, and their abilities will open everyone’s eyes that people without talent can become stronger by trying much harder than others."

"Yes." Helian Xun’er nodded slightly. "If Zhang Fei’s force joins Sect Master Luo, I believe they will become a terrifying force in the future. Moreover, he still has connections with some other cultivators in our realm, and I believe that he will persuade them to join his group."

"Tch! You two always praise Zhang Fei to the skies!" Hua Mei’er spoke with an irritated look. "His talent is indeed extraordinary, but his cultivation is still at the Divine Transcend Realm. Moreover, no one knows the future, and he might die before he can reach our level!"
None of them responded to Hua Mei’er, and they were more focused on watching the people on the fourth floor trying to create their domain.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was already standing in front of Qi Lai, who was still under Tian Kui’s pressure. "Who are you two really? Why are you guys meddling in my affairs?"

"Didn’t you come to that realm to capture Jia Yuyan?" Qi Lai frowned at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately took out the Yin-Yang Absorber Shackles and chained him. "She is my wife, so I have to act, right?"

Qi Lai was stunned by Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s confession, especially since his cultivation was too low compared to him and Jia Yuyan. However, his expression changed as the shackles began to absorb his Qi, and the absorption gradually accelerated.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] touched the tub at the end of the shackles, but he couldn’t absorb the Qi inside, especially since Qi Lai’s Qi was the Celestial Qi.
Tian Kui directly spoke to him. "You already have the method to absorb the Celestial Qi, right? Before you can absorb his celestial Qi, you have to learn the method first."

"All right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] himself had neglected the method ever since Feng Yao gave it to him due to the lack of Celestial Qi in the Three Mortal Realms. He immediately sat cross-legged, closed his eyes, and studied the method.
Qi Lai looked at Tian Kui. "Who exactly are you, Senior? Why would a powerful cultivator like you be willing to help this weakling?"

"Hahaha." Tian Kui laughed at Qi Lai. "You don’t know this kid, so you consider him to be a weakling. He is indeed weak now, but I have full confidence in his abilities, and he will defeat all the cultivators in the Paradise Realm in the future. At that time, he will stand at the top, and people will bow down to him. For now, you just need to wait patiently, and this kid will use you as a guinea pig to absorb the Celestial Qi."

"Hmm?" Qi Lai turned his gaze to Zhang Xiaolong [3] again, but he felt irritated by his powerlessness, and the shackles also continued to absorb his Qi. ’Damn it! I was confident I could capture that fairy, but instead I met a monster in that damn realm! Moreover, this monster sides with this weakling!’
- To Be Continued –

sentences.text: Qian Chaoying, Ju Tan, and the other spirit races went on alert as soon as Qi Lai appeared before them.
All of them swiftly protected Zhe Wuming as soon as the old man touched the void walls.
"Interesting!
I never expected to find a cultivator with the void element on this weak planet." Qi Lai then looked at Zhe Wuming, who was standing at the very back and protected by the natural races.
"How about you join me, kid?
Your void element is extremely rare even in the Paradise Realm, and I will help you become truly strong if you are willing to join me."
Zhe Wuming had always been considered the strongest cultivator in the Three Mortal Realms because of his void element, but he felt afraid for the first time in the presence of Qi Lai.
"I am not interested in joining anyone."
"What a shame." Zhe Wuming spurted blood from his mouth as soon as Qi Lai destroyed his void walls.
"Your void walls may be strong to protect you from other cultivators in these Three Mortal Realms, but they are useless before me.
Since you are unwilling to join me, I will take you with me by force, and these ants will not be able to protect you from me."
Qi Lai released his aura to suppress Zhe Wuming and all the members of the natural races, forcing them to lie prone on the ground without being able to move a single finger.
Qi Lai gave an evil smirk as he approached them, but his aura suddenly disappeared by itself, allowing Zhe Wuming and the others to breathe normally.
Before he could react, Tian Kui had appeared behind him and grabbed his shoulder.
"Ha ha ha." Tian Kui laughed at Qi Lai’s fearful expression.
"Do you think you are the only cultivator from the Paradise Realm on this planet, brat?
They may be ants in your eyes, but you are still an ant in the presence of the mighty me, even though your cultivation has reached the 3-Sun Celestial Emperor."
"Who... who are you, Senior?" Qi Lai asked in a trembling and afraid tone.
"An ant is not worthy to know the mighty me." In an instant, Tian Kui vanished from their view, transporting Qi Lai to a different realm at the request of Zhang Xiaolong [3].
No one, including Xereth and Cao Ren, was aware of that.
Ju Tan and the others hurriedly got up from the ground and wiped their sweat.
"A cultivator from the Paradise Realm is indeed terrifying!
Luckily, that senior was on my master’s side; otherwise, we would all die today."
"Even though we’ve reached the peak of mortals’ cultivation, the gap between us and them is too great." Ren Shuo said this as his body trembled.

"The battle has begun!
Get ready to kill anyone who tries to invade our forest!"

’His name is Xereth, and he is truly powerful.’ Shangguan Yan nodded at him, but she did not look the least bit anxious because Zhang Xiaolong [3] had prepared everything to protect them.
"Ice bone physique." Shangguan Yan stiffened as soon as Xereth mentioned that.
"Moreover, you are a domain master, so I will capture you and turn you into a demon like me."
Xereth intended to destroy the barrier protecting the Shangguan Clan, but a sword suddenly shot towards him, forcing him to summon his black scythe to deflect it.
He immediately recognized the demon extermination sword.
"Hahaha!
I didn’t expect to find you here, you little bastard!
Come out now and face me."
"Heh." The demon extermination sword instantly returned to Zhang Xiaolong [3], who had just appeared in front of Xereth.
"Honestly, I still want to fight you, but we won’t do it here, and we will do it somewhere else."
"Do you think you can escape from me again?" Xereth immediately flew toward him, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] casually opened the gate.
The demon immediately gave up his intention to absorb him, but he suddenly lost control of his body. ’What’s going on?
Why isn’t my body listening to my commands?’
"Are you surprised?" Xereth looked back at Helian Xun’er and the other three.

After Zhang Xiaolong [3] closed the gate, Shangguan Yan, Yuan Hao, and their clan members exhaled with relief.

The people who were not far from their location hurriedly fled as far as possible, especially since the strength of the three was too overwhelming for them.
Meanwhile, Shangguan Lizhi stood calmly opposite Sima Huiqing and Cao Feihong, despite facing two female cultivators of equal strength.
"Long time no see, Feihong and Huiqing."
"Heh!" Cao Feihong snorted and wanted to attack Shangguan Lizhi, but Sima Huiqing hurriedly grabbed her hand and stopped her.
"What are you doing?
She’s alone, so we don’t need to be afraid of her."
Sima Huiqing let out a soft sigh.
"I told you not to act recklessly against her, but you’re too hot-headed.
Look at her!
Do you think she’s afraid of us with her expression that calm?
"Hmm?" Cao Feihong narrowed her eyes at Shangguan Lizhi.
"No matter what!
We will attack her together, and she won’t be able to fight both of us at once!"
Cai Feihong slapped her hand and attacked Shangguan Lizhi directly, making Sima Huiqing sigh before joining her to fight the female divine beast.
"Honestly, I didn’t want to use this, but I will use it today, especially since my opponents are the two of you." Shangguan Lizhi activated her domain, trapping both women within it.
In an instant, another her appeared before the two women, making their numbers even.
’Shit!’ Cao Feihong and Sima Huiqing cursed in their hearts.
Despite this, the two of them immediately attacked the two Shangguan Lizhi.
Within seconds, the four women were already engaged in a fierce fight, but Shangguan Yan and her clone had a slight upper hand over Cao Feihong and Sima Huiqing.
Elsewhere, Bao Yundong and Gu Changsheng were already standing in the air, facing Tian Junfeng, Tian Jingxuan, and Leng Hua in front of them.
"Hahaha!" Bao Yundong laughed at them.
"Do you really think your descendant and Leng Hua can help you against us, Tian Junfeng?"
"As always, you are too confident, Bao Yundong." Tian Junfeng turned to the two men beside him.
"I will deal with that guy, and you guys can deal with Gu Changsheng.
However, you must be careful of his Gu insect, lest you two fall under his control."

"Yes, Ancestor." Before he followed Tian Junfeng, who had already moved to attack Bao Yundong, Tian Jingxuan first ordered Tian Jiantang to lead their clan members to kill the people from the Cao and Bao clans who were moving towards their clan.
"Let’s go!"
Leng Hua also ordered his son and daughter to attack the enemy before following behind Tian Jingxuan, but he did not focus on Gu Changsheng.
Instead, he focused more on observing the movements of the patriarch of the Tian Clan.
After all, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already told him that the Gu ancestor was one of his slaves, so they were both on the same side.
Meanwhile, Lin Zuxin led a group from the Lin Clan to attack members of the Sima Clan, who were under the leadership of Sima Yunfeng.
Chi Yuexin and her Chi Clan have also been busy attacking people from the Sima Clan under the leadership of their clan elders.
The Shangguan clan was similarly engaged in battle, but they faced their enemies with relative ease, particularly due to the presence of Shangguan Yan and Jia Yuyan.

The situation in the Leng Clan was not much different; Leng Xueyan and her brother led their clan members to kill all the enemies who attacked their clan, making the atmosphere in the main city become noisy because of their fight.

Unlike the major clans, the situation in the Yuan, Ren, Nalan, and Beihuang clans was relatively calmer because the leaders of their three enemy clans did not attack them directly, and they only faced their subordinates, led by one or two elders.
The situation in the northern, western, eastern, and southern regions was still calm without any fighting at all.

paragraphs: ’In the path of cultivation, divine qi is a power that surpasses mortal realms, which is associated with the heavenly law. Yet to tread the road of immortality, one must refine this divine qi into the celestial qi, which is aligned with the heavenly dao.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] spoke to himself in his mind. ’Does immortality really exist? If immortality exists, why did Feng Yao choose to reincarnate over and over again? Why did the ten-tailed fox choose to sacrifice itself?’

Zhang Xiaolong [3] ignored that and read on. ’To transform the Divine Qi into the Celestial Qi, a cultivator must first learn the Celestial Tempering Cycle method to achieve harmony with the laws of heaven. Utilize the technique to direct the divine qi into the dantian, where it slowly rotates along precise meridian pathways. Use the soul and mind power to temper and purify the divine qi through countless cycles, shedding its divine power and adopting the rhythm of the heavenly dao. Over time, the divine qi transforms completely into celestial qi—purer, gentler, and perfectly suitable for nourishing one’s immortal foundation. This process must be undertaken with utmost care, for forcing the transformation risks fracturing the meridians or breaking the cultivation core and soul.’

Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a sigh in his heart and began to learn the Celestial Tempering Cycle method, as did some of his clones in the training space and also Feltia [2], who was still on her way to the Paradise Realm with Han Ling.
In the pavilion, Tang Ying sat cross-legged while watching Zhang Fei [5], who was studying the method. ’What exactly is he doing? Why does he suddenly want to stop dual-soul cultivating with me?

As Tang Ying thought that, she suddenly felt a change within Zhang Fei [5]’s body, and all the divine qi within his body slowly moved towards his dantian. Additionally, she could feel that the divine qi in his dantian was starting to rotate within it, as well as all the divine qi moving there.

Tang Ying raised her eyebrows slightly, especially when she realized that Zhang Fei [5] was using his soul and mental power to do something to the divine qi in his body. ’What kind of cultivation method is this? What was his purpose in doing this?’

Sometime later, Tang Ying could feel that Zhang Fei [5]’s divine qi was increasingly gathering inside his dantian, and its circulation gradually became faster and faster. She carefully used her senses to observe his body, and she started to notice the subtle change in his divine qi.

’Oh? He intentionally employed his soul and mental power to temper and purify his divine qi, didn’t he? Could it be a method to transform the divine qi into the celestial qi? How could he do it with the absence of the celestial qi in the three mortal realms?’ Tang Ying immediately used her technique, and the white eye appeared above her head. ’I see! He used the celestial qi of the cultivators from the Paradise Realm to understand the concept, but I think it’s a big mistake if he did that. There’s no celestial qi here, and he won’t be able to cultivate if he transforms his divine qi into it. I hope he’s not that stupid, or else his cultivation will slow down, and his desire to go to that realm will be delayed even longer.’

Since Zhang Fei [5] was still focused on himself, Tang Ying decided to leave him and go to the Celestial Spring Pool. She immediately took off her dress and soaked in it, but the effect of the ancient formation in the pool surprised her. ’Yin and Yang Essences, huh? It’s no wonder he and all his women’s cultivation could improve that quickly, especially since he had so many valuable items in his possession, including the pavilion and this pool. Who exactly are those two little girls? One killed him and gave him the system and Mei, and the other used the time ability to resurrect him.’
Tang Ying shook her head, then sat cross-legged in the pool, leaning against the wall as she began to absorb the Yin essence within it.

After a few hours passed, the battle in the Sovereign Heaven Realm was becoming more intense, causing Serpentera, who was observing the conflict between the two sides, to shake her head. He saw that the members of the Shangguan Clan had successfully stopped all the enemies attacking their clan, especially with the help of Jia Yuyan.

Moreover, their enemies were helpless in the face of so many domain masters, and Shangguan Yan’s domain trapped most of them in illusions, allowing her clansmen to kill their enemies without much difficulty.

After the enemy stopped attacking, Shangguan Yan went straight to the Lin Clan, especially since Lin Zuxin and her clansmen were quite overwhelmed by the attacks from the three clans. She forbade Shangguan Han and Shangguan Miyuan from following her, and she asked them to stay on guard in case other enemies attacked their clan.
Meanwhile, Jia Yuyan went to the Duanmu Clan to help Duanmu Luolan wipe out all their enemies, and she ordered some people from the natural races to help the Leng Clan and the other clans.

Since the other natural races seemed hesitant to move, Ju Tan directly led his family to leave the eastern forest. He went to the Leng Clan to help Leng Xueyan and the others, and his family members spread out to several clans that were targeted by the enemy, such as the Yuan, Ren, Ruan, Beihuang, and Nalan clans. The presence of the six giants swiftly altered the battle dynamics within the six clans, making it easier for them to eliminate their adversaries.

The situation in the Lin and Chi clans was also changing rapidly, especially for the Chi Clan. Jia Yuyan demonstrated her superiority by using her wood element to stop the attackers, and she utilized her light element to heal the members of the Chi clan.
On the other hand, the situation in the Qing and Shi clans was quite dire, especially after the people from the Cao, Bao, and Sima clans managed to destroy their clan barriers.

However, Gu Changsheng forbade people from the Gu Clan who had mixed into the three clans’ forces from attacking them, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3] wanted to use them to weaken the Qing and Shi clans first.

Unlike the Qing and Shi clans, the Tian Clan’s barrier was still intact, and the members of the clan mostly used ranged attacks to kill the attackers, except for Tian Jiantang and a few elders who fought among the crowd of enemies using their swords.
"Gah!" Cao Ren screamed in pain as Ju Xing’s iron mace slammed into his chest, causing him to spurt blood and break several bones. ’Fuck! The strength of the giant race can’t be underestimated.’

"Without Gu Changsheng’s help, you are not my opponent, Cao Yunbai!" Jumping high toward Cao Yunbai, who was trying to stabilize himself after his previous attack, Ju Xin laughed. "Hahaha! Fight seriously or die!"
"Shit!" Cao Yunbai hurriedly flew away as Ju Xing swung his iron mace at him, causing it to slam into his previous spot.
Boom
Ju Xing’s attacks left quite a big hole there, but the giant immediately dashed toward Cao Yunbai again. Cao Ren tried to stop him, but his strong attack sent him flying backwards.
Ju Xing paid little attention to Cao Ren and focused on Cao Yunbai, especially since he was the one who almost killed him in the past.

Cao Ren immediately stabilized himself and searched for the whereabouts of his two allies, but unfortunately, he still did not realize that Qi Lai and Xereth were no longer in the realm. ’Damn it! Where are the two of them? That senior has promised to help me destroy these people, but he and that male demon are nowhere to be seen!’

Seeing his ancestor pressed by Ju Xing’s attack, Cao Ren dragged his reaching body to help Cao Yunbai. However, the giant always has the upper hand due to his superiority in raw strength, physique, and stamina.

Tian Jingxuan, who was fighting Gu Changsheng, was confused by his opponent’s attitude. He knew that the Gu ancestor’s main weapon was his Gu insects, but the old man had yet to use them since the beginning of the fight, and he felt that he was deliberately toying with him.

Leng Hua, who was fighting with Tian Jingxuan, also fought half-heartedly, and he never used a fatal attack on Gu Changsheng. ’Did I miss something? Could these two people be working together? Old Leng is Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s slave, so it shouldn’t be possible, unless that bastard already enslaved this old man as well.’ "Hey! Old Leng! We have to defeat this old man quickly!"
"Didn’t you see me trying to defeat him earlier?" Leng Hua asked with a frown. "Didn’t you always feel stronger than me? Since you are stronger than me, you can defeat him yourself."
After he said that, Leng Hua immediately landed on the trunk of a big tree and sat there, irritating Tian Jingxuan because of his behavior.

"You-Gah!" Tian Jingxuan suddenly screamed after something pierced through his body, but he didn’t see any wounds on his body. He then looked at Gu Changsheng, who cynically smiled at himself as he stared at him. "Tch!"

Tian Jingxuan immediately ignored Leng Hua and flew into the sky, where he used his strongest sword technique. After a huge sword Qi shot out from his sword, he immediately slashed it towards Gu Changsheng.

"Haha! Your attacks are just child’s play in front of me!" Gu Changsheng immediately shot something at Tian Jingxuan, which directly penetrated his chest and disrupted his Qi circulation. "Can you feel it? If I wanted to kill you, I could have done it a long time ago. However, I don’t want you to die so quickly, and I will torture you slowly."

’Shit! Tian Jingxuan immediately fled from the battle and returned to his clan, especially since he was sure that Gu Changsheng would not be able to break through the barrier. As he expected, the old man did not attack him; instead, he looked at Tian Junfeng, who was fighting Bao Yundong in the distance.

Gu Changsheng seriously watched the course of the fight between the two, and he could clearly see that Tian Junfeng’s attacks were continuously cornering Bao Yundong. He then turned to Leng Hua and spoke to him via voice transmission. ’You should go there and help that Tian guy.’
’Hmm?’ Leng Hua raised his eyebrows for a moment before looking at the two people, and he immediately flew to their side to help Tian Junfeng, driving Bao Yundong even further into a corner.

Tian Jingxuan, who was watching from within his clan, was completely confused by Leng Hua and Gu Changsheng’s actions. ’Damn it! This old man must have fallen into the hands of that little bastard, and I never realized that before!’
With Leng Hua’s help, Tian Junfeng finally managed to defeat Bao Yundong.
’Old Tian! Don’t kill him!’ Leng Hua shouted just as Tian Junfeng was about to kill Bao Yundong. ’Zhang Xiaolong ordered me to capture him.’

Tian Junfeng raised his eyebrows for a moment, but he immediately gave up his intention to kill Bai Yundong. Instead, he sealed his cultivation and handed him over to Leng Hua, who immediately took him away.

Tian Junfeng then looked at Gu Changsheng. "Hehe! Instead of looking at me like that, you should move to save your woman; otherwise, she will fall into the hands of Cao Feihong and Sima Huiqing, and she will become the contract beast of one of them."

"You are his, right?" Gu Changsheng did not respond to him, and Tian Junfeng immediately moved to help Shangguan Lizhi. ’That kid is too scary! He already had many powerful people by his side, and he now has Old Gu as his slave.’
When he arrived at Shangguan Lizhi’s location, Tian Junfeng saw him and his clone fighting fiercely with Cao Feihong and Sima Huiqing. He immediately joined his lover, making the two women panic.
’Shit! Bao Yundong has been defeated by him!’ Cao Feihong cursed in his heart as he moved away from them.

Sima Huiqing also did not dare to move to attack them, especially since Tian Junfeng was stronger than the two of them. She then took out the bottle given by Gu Changsheng, but she did not immediately release the Gu insects inside. ’Will they work on the two of them?’
Tian Junfeng did not directly attack Cao Feihong and Sima Huiqing; instead, he approached Shangguan Lizhi and checked her condition. "Are you okay?"
"Yeah." Shangguan Lizhi nodded as she swallowed a recovery pill. "With my domain, I could fight both equally, but it kept draining my qi. If you come any later, I might lose to them."
Tian Junfeng nodded slightly and looked at the two women. "Bao Yundong and Gu Changsheng have already lost, and Old Ju will soon defeat Cao Yunbai, so this fight is already in vain."
’Damn it! Where are the two people brought by Ren’er? Why don’t they show up and help us?’ Cao Feihong gripped her weapon tightly.

"You may have beaten them, but we won’t give up that easily." Sima Huiqing showed the bottle in her hand. "With the things in this bottle, we will defeat both of you, and Shangguan Lizhi will become my contract beast."

Tian Junfeng and Shangguan Lizhi immediately moved to seize the bottle, but Sima Huiqing hurriedly opened the lid and released the Gu insects inside. However, the result was different from their expectations.
The Gu insects did not attack Tian Junfeng and Shangguan Lizhi; instead, they entered Cao Feihong and Sima Huiqing’s bodies, and their eyes became dull instantly.

"Hahaha!" Gu Changsheng laughed as he appeared in front of them. "Sima Huiqing was overconfident that my Gu insects would help her, but she didn’t realize that I had purposely prepared my insects for them."
"Did Zhang Xiaolong order you to do this to them?"

"He is my master, so I should help him, right? Since he wants these two women, I will control them for now." Then, Gu Changsheng ordered the members of the Gu Clan who had been mingling with the people from the three clans to move. They immediately attacked the people from the Cao, Bao, and Sima clans from behind. "This way, we just need to wait for Ju Xing to defeat Cao Yunbai and Cao Ren, and this war should be ended once they are dead."
Shangguan Lizhi and Tian Junfeng exchanged glances for a moment, and both of them immediately moved towards the fighting location of Ju Xing and the two men from the Cao Clan.
Upon arrival, Shangguan Lizhi and Tian Junfeng immediately moved and killed Cao Ren, who had been seriously injured by Ji Xing’s attack.
Shangguan Lizhi and Tian Junfeng did not interfere with the fight between Ju Xing and Cao Yunbai, who were already struggling to block the giant’s attack.
"Hah... Hah...." Cao Yunbai gasped heavily as blood poured out from the injuries on his body.
Ju Xing walked in front of Cao Yunbai, carrying his iron mace on one shoulder. "Your allies have fallen, and many of your clan are dead, including your patriarch."

"Hahaha." Cao Yunbai laughed hysterically as he glared at him. "We had planned everything well for hundreds of years, but the appearance of two mysterious variables thwarted all our plans. If they had not destroyed our chimeras, and if I had not trusted those two cultivators from the Paradise Realm too much, we would never have had this day, and we would have definitely ruled this realm."

"You made a mistake by being overly concerned and ignoring the shifts in this realm’s circumstances, oblivious to the two mysterious variables right before your eyes." Ju Xing then raised his iron mace. "Actually, I don’t want to kill you because the death of you and the others will weaken this realm, but I have to do it anyway. Therefore, goodbye, Old Cao."

Cao Yunbai closed his eyes as Ju Xing’s iron mace approached him, but Serpentera suddenly appeared in their midst and stopped the giant, and he sealed the Cao ancestor’s cultivation directly, shocking him. "That kid still needs him."
- To Be Continued –

sentences.text: ’In the path of cultivation, divine qi is a power that surpasses mortal realms, which is associated with the heavenly law.

Yet to tread the road of immortality, one must refine this divine qi into the celestial qi, which is aligned with the heavenly dao.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] spoke to himself in his mind. ’Does immortality really exist?
If immortality exists, why did Feng Yao choose to reincarnate over and over again?
Why did the ten-tailed fox choose to sacrifice itself?’

Zhang Xiaolong [3] ignored that and read on. ’To transform the Divine Qi into the Celestial Qi, a cultivator must first learn the Celestial Tempering Cycle method to achieve harmony with the laws of heaven.
Utilize the technique to direct the divine qi into the dantian, where it slowly rotates along precise meridian pathways.
Use the soul and mind power to temper and purify the divine qi through countless cycles, shedding its divine power and adopting the rhythm of the heavenly dao.
Over time, the divine qi transforms completely into celestial qi—purer, gentler, and perfectly suitable for nourishing one’s immortal foundation.
This process must be undertaken with utmost care, for forcing the transformation risks fracturing the meridians or breaking the cultivation core and soul.’

Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a sigh in his heart and began to learn the Celestial Tempering Cycle method, as did some of his clones in the training space and also Feltia [2], who was still on her way to the Paradise Realm with Han Ling.
In the pavilion, Tang Ying sat cross-legged while watching Zhang Fei [5], who was studying the method. ’What exactly is he doing?
Why does he suddenly want to stop dual-soul cultivating with me?
As Tang Ying thought that, she suddenly felt a change within Zhang Fei [5]’s body, and all the divine qi within his body slowly moved towards his dantian.
Additionally, she could feel that the divine qi in his dantian was starting to rotate within it, as well as all the divine qi moving there.

Tang Ying raised her eyebrows slightly, especially when she realized that Zhang Fei [5] was using his soul and mental power to do something to the divine qi in his body. ’What kind of cultivation method is this?
What was his purpose in doing this?’
Sometime later, Tang Ying could feel that Zhang Fei [5]’s divine qi was increasingly gathering inside his dantian, and its circulation gradually became faster and faster.
She carefully used her senses to observe his body, and she started to notice the subtle change in his divine qi.
’Oh?
He intentionally employed his soul and mental power to temper and purify his divine qi, didn’t he?
Could it be a method to transform the divine qi into the celestial qi?
How could he do it with the absence of the celestial qi in the three mortal realms?’ Tang Ying immediately used her technique, and the white eye appeared above her head. ’I see!
He used the celestial qi of the cultivators from the Paradise Realm to understand the concept, but I think it’s a big mistake if he did that.
There’s no celestial qi here, and he won’t be able to cultivate if he transforms his divine qi into it.
I hope he’s not that stupid, or else his cultivation will slow down, and his desire to go to that realm will be delayed even longer.’
Since Zhang Fei [5] was still focused on himself, Tang Ying decided to leave him and go to the Celestial Spring Pool.
She immediately took off her dress and soaked in it, but the effect of the ancient formation in the pool surprised her. ’Yin and Yang Essences, huh?
It’s no wonder he and all his women’s cultivation could improve that quickly, especially since he had so many valuable items in his possession, including the pavilion and this pool.
Who exactly are those two little girls?
One killed him and gave him the system and Mei, and the other used the time ability to resurrect him.’
Tang Ying shook her head, then sat cross-legged in the pool, leaning against the wall as she began to absorb the Yin essence within it.
After a few hours passed, the battle in the Sovereign Heaven Realm was becoming more intense, causing Serpentera, who was observing the conflict between the two sides, to shake her head.
He saw that the members of the Shangguan Clan had successfully stopped all the enemies attacking their clan, especially with the help of Jia Yuyan.

"Hahaha!

"Shit!" Cao Yunbai hurriedly flew away as Ju Xing swung his iron mace at him, causing it to slam into his previous spot.
Boom
Ju Xing’s attacks left quite a big hole there, but the giant immediately dashed toward Cao Yunbai again.
Cao Ren tried to stop him, but his strong attack sent him flying backwards.
Ju Xing paid little attention to Cao Ren and focused on Cao Yunbai, especially since he was the one who almost killed him in the past.
Cao Ren immediately stabilized himself and searched for the whereabouts of his two allies, but unfortunately, he still did not realize that Qi Lai and Xereth were no longer in the realm. ’Damn it!

That senior has promised to help me destroy these people, but he and that male demon are nowhere to be seen!’
Seeing his ancestor pressed by Ju Xing’s attack, Cao Ren dragged his reaching body to help Cao Yunbai.
However, the giant always has the upper hand due to his superiority in raw strength, physique, and stamina.
Tian Jingxuan, who was fighting Gu Changsheng, was confused by his opponent’s attitude.
He knew that the Gu ancestor’s main weapon was his Gu insects, but the old man had yet to use them since the beginning of the fight, and he felt that he was deliberately toying with him.
Leng Hua, who was fighting with Tian Jingxuan, also fought half-heartedly, and he never used a fatal attack on Gu Changsheng. ’Did I miss something?

Old Leng is Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s slave, so it shouldn’t be possible, unless that bastard already enslaved this old man as well.’ "Hey!

We have to defeat this old man quickly!"
"Didn’t you see me trying to defeat him earlier?" Leng Hua asked with a frown.
"Didn’t you always feel stronger than me?
Since you are stronger than me, you can defeat him yourself."
After he said that, Leng Hua immediately landed on the trunk of a big tree and sat there, irritating Tian Jingxuan because of his behavior.
"You-Gah!" Tian Jingxuan suddenly screamed after something pierced through his body, but he didn’t see any wounds on his body.
He then looked at Gu Changsheng, who cynically smiled at himself as he stared at him.
"Tch!"
Tian Jingxuan immediately ignored Leng Hua and flew into the sky, where he used his strongest sword technique.
After a huge sword Qi shot out from his sword, he immediately slashed it towards Gu Changsheng.
"Haha!
Your attacks are just child’s play in front of me!" Gu Changsheng immediately shot something at Tian Jingxuan, which directly penetrated his chest and disrupted his Qi circulation.
"Can you feel it?

However, I don’t want you to die so quickly, and I will torture you slowly."

chapters.title: Chapter 1042: After Battle
paragraphs: The remaining people from the Cao, Sima, and Bao clans fled from their respective residences once their leaders fell. They spread to the other four regions, but the people from the natural races, the beast races, the Ning Clan, and the Yin Clan were already waiting for them in their respective regions.

Tian Junfeng and the others released soft sighs once Serpentera took Cao Yunbai away. "With the help of that senior, that kid could have stopped our battle from the start, but he preferred bloodshed."

"You don’t need to be surprised by his choice, Junfeng." Tian Junfeng turned to Shangguan Lizhi, who immediately told him about Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s action in the Sky Jade Realm. "Killing thousands of heretics in a single day was too ruthless, but I think his decision at that time was indeed the right one. Those heretics had already killed countless people, and his decision had a significant impact on the lives of the residents of that realm."

Tian Junfeng nodded in agreement with that. "However, I cannot let the people of these three clans perish, especially since not all of them share the same opinion as Cao Ren and Cao Yunbai. Their death will be a significant loss for our realm, so we must stop the Yin Clan and the others."
Thud

Jia Yuyan landed in front of them and spoke to them immediately. "I have asked the other natural races not to kill them and only paralyze them. Therefore, you only need to stop the Ning and Yin clans, and Ju Xing will stop the beast races."
"Are you sure it’s okay, Yuyan?" Ju Xing asked her. "That kid has already decided to slaughter them, and he will probably be disappointed if we spare them."

Jia Yuyan shook her head at him. "I will talk to him myself, and I am sure he will be willing to listen to me. You guys should go to those three regions to stop them, or the casualties from this battle will be even greater."
Without waiting any longer, Ju Xing, Tian Junfeng, and Shangguan Lizhi immediately spread to the other three regions to stop those survivors from the three clans.
"Leave those two women to me." Gu Changsheng said nothing and handed over Cao Feihong and Sima Huiqing to Jia Yuyan. "Order the people from your Gu Clan to guard the Cao, Sima, and Bao clans."

After Jia Yuyan took the two women away, Gu Changsheng immediately contacted his clan’s people to carry out Jia Yuyan’s orders. He ordered them to use their Gu insects if the people from the Tian, Qing, and Shi clans intended to break through the three clans.

Inside the Tian Clan, Tian Jingxuan sat at the head seat and pondered about the course of the previous battle, especially about the actions of Gu Changsheng and Leng Hua, causing his face to turn black and red with anger. ’That bastard! He had secretly done something to that old Gu, and I was never aware of it. Moreover, I still don’t know his plans for the Cao, Bao, and Sima clans. He already has the Leng clan, and the other clans are also on his side. If he also takes over the three clans, he will hold the vast majority of power in this realm. He’s just a newcomer, so I can’t let him do that. But what can I do to stop him?’

"Father." Tian Jingxuan looked at his son, Tian Jiantang. "According to Ancestor Junfeng’s orders, I have ordered our clan members to retreat. He asked me to tell you not to do anything to the Cao, Sima, and Bao clans, unless you want our clans to be destroyed."
Tian Jingxuan’s face darkened even more after he heard that. ’Why did our ancestors choose to side with that little bastard?’

"Father." Tian Jiantang sighed softly and sat down on an empty chair. "I know your thoughts, and I actually don’t want to interfere in this matter. However, you know for sure that Zhang Xiaolong [3] never intended to be our enemy, and you also know that we are not his match, especially with those powerful cultivators by his side. You have seen him summon five mythical beasts when he underwent the entrance tests, and you also know that their strength is on par with yours. Furthermore, he still has several other allies, and they could stop the battle easily if they wanted to. Additionally, the other clans have also decided to side with him, so I hope you will stop being hostile toward him just because of your greed and fear."
"You—"

"Father, are your personal ambitions more important than the future of our clan?" Tian Jiantang’s question made Tian Jingxuan glare at him sharply. "What good is your ambition if you die in their hands? Have you ever thought about the fate of our clan members? Zhang Xiaolong [3] is extremely cruel; he will kill you and slaughter our clan members if you decide to become his enemy. As the clan’s patriarch, I hope you can set aside your personal ambitions for the sake of greater interests, especially since your choices will impact our members’ lives, whether they are good or bad."
After he said that, Tian Jiantang immediately stood up and left Tian Jingxuan, who looked increasingly frustrated and furious.
"Grandfather, are you okay?" Qing Yun asked as he approached Qing Huang.
Qing Huang nodded at him before swallowing healing and restoration pills. "Even though my injuries were quite serious due to Gu Jizhao’s attack, I’m fine."
"Did he use his Gu insects on you?"

"No." Qing Huang herself felt strange about it. "Since we started fighting, Gu Jizhao has not used his Gu insects at all; instead, he fought me at close range, which is unusual for him. What about our clansmen who died?"

Qing Yun immediately reported it. "About fifty people died, and most of them sustained severe injuries. Despite their injuries not being life-threatening, some of them will be crippled for the rest of their lives."
"I see." Qing Huang released a heavy sigh. Although our clan suffered significant casualties, we are fortunate that it still remains intact. Pull them all back and ask them to focus on recuperating."
"My father and the others have already pulled them back." Qing Yun then asked him. "Can you stop being hostile toward Zhang Xiaolong, Grandfather?"
"Hmm?" Qing Huang frowned in response.

"Grandfather, you are an experienced cultivator, so you should have been able to see the situation clearly. We would never have won this battle if it were not for Zhang Xiaolong and his acquaintances." Qing Huang did not deny Qing Yun’s words, but he could not accept that a newcomer surpassed his clan and the other clans. "They gave us all the information, and they were the ones who took care of Qi Lai and Xereth, remember? If they hadn’t done that, those two people would have already succeeded in helping our enemies. Not only would we have perished, but our clan would have also faced destruction. Therefore, I hope you can think things through and stop being hostile toward him, especially since he can destroy us easily."
"Leave." Qing Yun did not speak further and left Qing Huang, who immediately sat down on an empty chair and thought about his words.

In the Shi Clan, Shi Yan was really depressed because many of his clan members had died in the previous battle, and several elders had also been killed by the enemy, which significantly reduced their strength.

Shi Yan himself suffered quite severe injuries, even though they were not life-threatening. He then ordered his clansmen to withdraw and focus on healing. After he cleared everything up, he sealed his clan to avoid unwanted things, and he entered seclusion to heal his injury.
After Ju Xing, Tian Junfeng, and Shangguan Lizhi met them, the people from the Ning clan, the Yin clan, and the beast races immediately withdrew their troops, returning to their respective places.

As for the people who fled from the Cao, Bao, and Sima Clans, Tian Junfeng ordered them to return to the three clans. They were initially hesitant about it because they were afraid that the other clans would attack and kill them, but he assured them that no one would attack them, and he ordered them to await further decisions there.
In the end, they decided to return to their respective clans, but their feelings continued to be filled with fear and worry.

Tian Junfeng did not return to the Tian clan, and he left his clan’s affairs to Tian Jingxuan and Tian Jiangtang. Instead, he went with Shangguan Lizhi to discuss their future plans, including their wedding and their plans to go to the Frozen Moon Realm.

After the battle was completely over, the residents of the main city began to return to their respective residences, and the people from those big clans also began to clean up the remains of their battle. However, the previous battle became the worst history for their realm, and they would never be able to forget it for the rest of their lives.
"Where is your husband, Xiaoya? Why hasn’t he shown up in the past week?" Mu Qingyuan asked.
Wei Xiaoya let out a soft sigh before explaining the situation to her. "Zhang Fei is in another realm right now, and he is helping the people from that realm to deal with powerful enemies."
"Which realm?"

"The Sovereign Heaven Realm." Mu Qingyuan had a confused look after Wei Xiaoya mentioned the realm. "According to him, that realm is the oldest and strongest in the upper realms, and there are many cultivators in the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm there. However, the people from that realm seal themselves off from the outside world, so not everyone can enter it, and they have to undergo some troublesome tests."

"Troublesome tests?" Wei Xiaoya informed Mu Qingyuan about all the tests based on the information provided by Zhang Fei. "Why didn’t he take you there if that realm was that strong? Wouldn’t you be able to cultivate much faster there?"

"Zhang Fei would never put his people in danger, especially all his wives and family members. He didn’t bring anyone there because of the dangers that threatened that realm, but he might bring all of us there if the problems there were resolved." Wei Xiaoya then asked her. "Are you interested in moving to that realm? I can ask him to bring your family and Chen Hong there if you want."

"No." Mu Qingyuan politely declined her offer. "Unlike you and Zhang Fei, my husband and I don’t have that big ambition, and we are already satisfied with our current life. Furthermore, you mentioned that there are too many powerful cultivators in that realm, and since our son is still young, I am unwilling to take the risk of bringing him to such a dangerous environment."

Wei Xiaoya nodded in understanding. "Honestly, I have never thought of going to that realm or the realm beyond before, and I have always enjoyed my life in my realm. However, my sudden marriage to him took my life in a different direction, and since I am his wife now, I have no choice but to follow him wherever he goes."

"Haha." Mu Qingyuan laughed softly. "It is a wife’s duty to follow her husband. You may not be in love with him now, but I’m sure you will in the future. Once you experience it, I’m sure you will get the happiness you’ve been looking for all this time."

Wei Xiaoya chose not to comment on it. "I won’t say anything for now, and time will tell. How about you accompany me for a walk? I’ve been in this realm for a week, but I haven’t seen any good places here. Moreover, I don’t know when Zhang Fei will return, so I want to go to some beautiful places first."
"Let’s go; I’ll take you to interesting places in this realm."

Several hours passed, and Tian Kui suddenly noticed the change in Zhang Xiaolong [3]. He immediately patted his shoulder and reminded him. "Stop it, kid. If you convert all your divine Qi into the celestial Qi, you will no longer be able to cultivate in these Three Mortal Realms. Therefore, you should stop now, and you can continue after your clone arrives in the Paradise Realm."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] halted his actions, opened his eyes, and exhaled with a sense of relief. "Even though I haven’t felt it completely, I can feel that the Celestial Qi is much more powerful than the Divine Qi. Additionally, it is purer and gentler."

"Haha." Tian Kui laughed at that. "Once you convert all your Divine Qi into the Celestial Qi, you will feel a significant change in your body. Your body will be stronger inside and out, and your cultivation will be faster. Once you and all your wives cultivate using the Celestial Qi, I believe you guys will reach the peak of mortal cultivation in three to four years."
"Bullshit!" Qi Lai shouted to them. "There has never been a cultivator who could reach the peak of mortal cultivation from the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm in three to four years."
"What are your plans for this guy?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Qi Lai, and his evil smile caused him to tremble, especially with his current situation. He touched the old man’s forehead and used his dreaming ability on him, causing him to fall asleep in an instant. "The flow of time in my training space is much faster, so I will lock him up there for the time being. Once I get a lot of his celestial Qi, I will hand him over to Wan Jiang, so he can hand him over to their higher-ups."
After he sent Qi Lai into his training space, Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought Tian Kui back to the Sovereign Heaven Realm.
