"You’re right." Just like what he did to Gu Changsheng, Zhang Xiaolong [3] used his memory manipulation ability to change some of Cao Yunbai’s memories and replicate his soul, and he also implanted his soul mark into his original soul.

After he did all that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately woke Cao Yunbai and ordered him to return to the Cao Clan to reorganize his clansmen. He then went to see Leng Huang at the Leng Clan, and he did the same to Bao Yundong. This way, the Cao and Bao clans were already under his control, solidifying his position in the Sovereign Heaven Realm.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then went to the eastern forest to meet Jia Yuyan and the others, and the female fairy immediately handed over Sima Huiqing and Cao Feihong to him. Unlike the two old men, he didn’t change the memories of the two women, but he replicated their souls and merged them with his.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked Gu Changsheng to come to him and removed the Gu insects from Sima Huiqing and Cao Feihong’s bodies, freeing them from his control.
Sima Huiqing and Cao Feihong were completely shocked once they realized their situation, especially since their cultivations had been sealed.
"You traitor!" Sima Huiqing shouted to Gu Changsheng.

Gu Changsheng did not say anything and stood quietly behind Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately lifted Sima Huiqing’s chin. "From today, you are my slaves, even though I don’t enslave you directly. Therefore, you should behave yourself, or I will make you suffer more than this. For now, I want you to return to the Sima Clan and reorganize your clan members, and all of you must submit completely to me. If any of your clan members dare to oppose you, you can kill them directly."
Sima Huiqing frowned at that, but she felt something within her forcing her to obey Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s order, making her sigh helplessly in her heart. "Yes."
"Leave." Sima Huiqing immediately got up and flew away from the eastern forest, leaving behind the frightened Cao Feihong. ’Shit! Things didn’t end up going according to our plans.’

Unlike Sima Huiqing, Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not let Cao Feihong go; instead, he took her into the Yin-Yang space and imprisoned her there, replacing Ruo Yanxi because she was the weakest among all the prisoners.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] slightly changed Ruo Yanxi’s memories and sent her back to the Huangfu Kingdom in the Nine Stars Realm, leaving her with Huangfu Lian.

sentences.text: The remaining people from the Cao, Sima, and Bao clans fled from their respective residences once their leaders fell.
They spread to the other four regions, but the people from the natural races, the beast races, the Ning Clan, and the Yin Clan were already waiting for them in their respective regions.
Tian Junfeng and the others released soft sighs once Serpentera took Cao Yunbai away.
"With the help of that senior, that kid could have stopped our battle from the start, but he preferred bloodshed."
"You don’t need to be surprised by his choice, Junfeng." Tian Junfeng turned to Shangguan Lizhi, who immediately told him about Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s action in the Sky Jade Realm.
"Killing thousands of heretics in a single day was too ruthless, but I think his decision at that time was indeed the right one.
Those heretics had already killed countless people, and his decision had a significant impact on the lives of the residents of that realm."
Tian Junfeng nodded in agreement with that.
"However, I cannot let the people of these three clans perish, especially since not all of them share the same opinion as Cao Ren and Cao Yunbai.
Their death will be a significant loss for our realm, so we must stop the Yin Clan and the others."
Thud
Jia Yuyan landed in front of them and spoke to them immediately.
"I have asked the other natural races not to kill them and only paralyze them.
Therefore, you only need to stop the Ning and Yin clans, and Ju Xing will stop the beast races."
"Are you sure it’s okay, Yuyan?" Ju Xing asked her.
"That kid has already decided to slaughter them, and he will probably be disappointed if we spare them."
Jia Yuyan shook her head at him.
"I will talk to him myself, and I am sure he will be willing to listen to me.
You guys should go to those three regions to stop them, or the casualties from this battle will be even greater."
Without waiting any longer, Ju Xing, Tian Junfeng, and Shangguan Lizhi immediately spread to the other three regions to stop those survivors from the three clans.
"Leave those two women to me." Gu Changsheng said nothing and handed over Cao Feihong and Sima Huiqing to Jia Yuyan.
"Order the people from your Gu Clan to guard the Cao, Sima, and Bao clans."
After Jia Yuyan took the two women away, Gu Changsheng immediately contacted his clan’s people to carry out Jia Yuyan’s orders.
He ordered them to use their Gu insects if the people from the Tian, Qing, and Shi clans intended to break through the three clans.

Inside the Tian Clan, Tian Jingxuan sat at the head seat and pondered about the course of the previous battle, especially about the actions of Gu Changsheng and Leng Hua, causing his face to turn black and red with anger. ’That bastard!
He had secretly done something to that old Gu, and I was never aware of it.
Moreover, I still don’t know his plans for the Cao, Bao, and Sima clans.
He already has the Leng clan, and the other clans are also on his side.
If he also takes over the three clans, he will hold the vast majority of power in this realm.
He’s just a newcomer, so I can’t let him do that.
But what can I do to stop him?’
"Father." Tian Jingxuan looked at his son, Tian Jiantang.
"According to Ancestor Junfeng’s orders, I have ordered our clan members to retreat.
He asked me to tell you not to do anything to the Cao, Sima, and Bao clans, unless you want our clans to be destroyed."
Tian Jingxuan’s face darkened even more after he heard that. ’Why did our ancestors choose to side with that little bastard?’
"Father." Tian Jiantang sighed softly and sat down on an empty chair.
"I know your thoughts, and I actually don’t want to interfere in this matter.
However, you know for sure that Zhang Xiaolong [3] never intended to be our enemy, and you also know that we are not his match, especially with those powerful cultivators by his side.
You have seen him summon five mythical beasts when he underwent the entrance tests, and you also know that their strength is on par with yours.
Furthermore, he still has several other allies, and they could stop the battle easily if they wanted to.
Additionally, the other clans have also decided to side with him, so I hope you will stop being hostile toward him just because of your greed and fear."
"You—"
"Father, are your personal ambitions more important than the future of our clan?" Tian Jiantang’s question made Tian Jingxuan glare at him sharply.
"What good is your ambition if you die in their hands?
Have you ever thought about the fate of our clan members?
Zhang Xiaolong [3] is extremely cruel; he will kill you and slaughter our clan members if you decide to become his enemy.

As the clan’s patriarch, I hope you can set aside your personal ambitions for the sake of greater interests, especially since your choices will impact our members’ lives, whether they are good or bad."
After he said that, Tian Jiantang immediately stood up and left Tian Jingxuan, who looked increasingly frustrated and furious.
"Grandfather, are you okay?" Qing Yun asked as he approached Qing Huang.
Qing Huang nodded at him before swallowing healing and restoration pills.
"Even though my injuries were quite serious due to Gu Jizhao’s attack, I’m fine."
"Did he use his Gu insects on you?"
"No." Qing Huang herself felt strange about it.
"Since we started fighting, Gu Jizhao has not used his Gu insects at all; instead, he fought me at close range, which is unusual for him.
What about our clansmen who died?"
Qing Yun immediately reported it.
"About fifty people died, and most of them sustained severe injuries.
Despite their injuries not being life-threatening, some of them will be crippled for the rest of their lives."
"I see." Qing Huang released a heavy sigh.
Although our clan suffered significant casualties, we are fortunate that it still remains intact.
Pull them all back and ask them to focus on recuperating."
"My father and the others have already pulled them back." Qing Yun then asked him.
"Can you stop being hostile toward Zhang Xiaolong, Grandfather?"
"Hmm?" Qing Huang frowned in response.
"Grandfather, you are an experienced cultivator, so you should have been able to see the situation clearly.

We would never have won this battle if it were not for Zhang Xiaolong and his acquaintances." Qing Huang did not deny Qing Yun’s words, but he could not accept that a newcomer surpassed his clan and the other clans.
"They gave us all the information, and they were the ones who took care of Qi Lai and Xereth, remember?
If they hadn’t done that, those two people would have already succeeded in helping our enemies.
Not only would we have perished, but our clan would have also faced destruction.
Therefore, I hope you can think things through and stop being hostile toward him, especially since he can destroy us easily."
"Leave." Qing Yun did not speak further and left Qing Huang, who immediately sat down on an empty chair and thought about his words.

In the Shi Clan, Shi Yan was really depressed because many of his clan members had died in the previous battle, and several elders had also been killed by the enemy, which significantly reduced their strength.
Shi Yan himself suffered quite severe injuries, even though they were not life-threatening.
He then ordered his clansmen to withdraw and focus on healing.
After he cleared everything up, he sealed his clan to avoid unwanted things, and he entered seclusion to heal his injury.
After Ju Xing, Tian Junfeng, and Shangguan Lizhi met them, the people from the Ning clan, the Yin clan, and the beast races immediately withdrew their troops, returning to their respective places.
As for the people who fled from the Cao, Bao, and Sima Clans, Tian Junfeng ordered them to return to the three clans.

They were initially hesitant about it because they were afraid that the other clans would attack and kill them, but he assured them that no one would attack them, and he ordered them to await further decisions there.
In the end, they decided to return to their respective clans, but their feelings continued to be filled with fear and worry.
Tian Junfeng did not return to the Tian clan, and he left his clan’s affairs to Tian Jingxuan and Tian Jiangtang.
Instead, he went with Shangguan Lizhi to discuss their future plans, including their wedding and their plans to go to the Frozen Moon Realm.

After the battle was completely over, the residents of the main city began to return to their respective residences, and the people from those big clans also began to clean up the remains of their battle.
However, the previous battle became the worst history for their realm, and they would never be able to forget it for the rest of their lives.
"Where is your husband, Xiaoya?
Why hasn’t he shown up in the past week?" Mu Qingyuan asked.
Wei Xiaoya let out a soft sigh before explaining the situation to her.
"Zhang Fei is in another realm right now, and he is helping the people from that realm to deal with powerful enemies."
"Which realm?"
"The Sovereign Heaven Realm." Mu Qingyuan had a confused look after Wei Xiaoya mentioned the realm.
"According to him, that realm is the oldest and strongest in the upper realms, and there are many cultivators in the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm there.
However, the people from that realm seal themselves off from the outside world, so not everyone can enter it, and they have to undergo some troublesome tests."
"Troublesome tests?" Wei Xiaoya informed Mu Qingyuan about all the tests based on the information provided by Zhang Fei.
"Why didn’t he take you there if that realm was that strong?
Wouldn’t you be able to cultivate much faster there?"
"Zhang Fei would never put his people in danger, especially all his wives and family members.
He didn’t bring anyone there because of the dangers that threatened that realm, but he might bring all of us there if the problems there were resolved." Wei Xiaoya then asked her.
"Are you interested in moving to that realm?
I can ask him to bring your family and Chen Hong there if you want."
"No." Mu Qingyuan politely declined her offer.
"Unlike you and Zhang Fei, my husband and I don’t have that big ambition, and we are already satisfied with our current life.

Furthermore, you mentioned that there are too many powerful cultivators in that realm, and since our son is still young, I am unwilling to take the risk of bringing him to such a dangerous environment."
Wei Xiaoya nodded in understanding.
"Honestly, I have never thought of going to that realm or the realm beyond before, and I have always enjoyed my life in my realm.
However, my sudden marriage to him took my life in a different direction, and since I am his wife now, I have no choice but to follow him wherever he goes."

chapters.title: Chapter 1043: Enter Seclusion Again
paragraphs: Jia Yuyan and Zhang Xiaolong [3] walked side by side toward the life pond, followed by Qian Shuang, who looked jealous because of his Yang Qi inside the female fairy’s body. "What are your plans now?"

"Since all the problems in this realm have been resolved, I will focus on myself to reach the Divine Ascension Realm as soon as possible." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked toward the life pond. "For now, this clone will focus on my water element, elemental law, and body technique. Once all three reach peak stage, I will enter my training space to master the other things."
"What about the Tian, Huang, and Shi clans?"

"If they were smart, those three old men wouldn’t dare to find trouble with me directly after today’s battle. Moreover, they can’t enter this forest, so I don’t need to bother with them." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then faced Jia Yuyan. "Yuyan, I understand your desire to return to your domain and seek the truth about the problems within your race, but I hope you are willing to delay your return and help me with my wood element first. My second clone will arrive in the Paradise Realm in a few months, and you don’t need to waste your time on a long journey since I can send you there directly then."

"All right, I will wait for your second clone to arrive in the Paradise Realm, and I will help you with your wood element." Jia Yuyan looked back at Qian Shuang and then asked Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Are you going to take her to your training space?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at Jia Yuyan and turned to Qian Shuang. "Shuang’er, you don’t need to accompany me to cultivate in the life pond, and I want you to train diligently in my training space. After you complete your training, you will surpass the other natural races, especially in speed. Additionally, I will teach you to become a soul cultivator and some other things, which will be useful for you when we go to the Paradise Realm."
"Can you bring Xiyi along?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately contacted Ren Xiyi and some of the giant race members, relieving Qian Shuang.
A few minutes later, Ren Xiyi arrived at their location along with her parents, while Ju Tan brought his five family members with him.

Although the other giant race members had already acknowledged him as their leader, Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not really like them because of the various things he had discovered when examining their souls, so he never had the intention to bring them into his training space. After he explained everything to them, he sent all of them into the training space, and he went to the Life Pond to start his cultivation afterward.
"Did you enjoy peeking at me?" Tang Ying posed this question to Zhang Fei [5].
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that. "This place is my private place, and everything in it belongs to me. Therefore, you can’t say that I’m peeking at you, right?"

"If I think about it, you are the most shameless lust demon." Tang Ying immediately got out of the pool, and her dress right away covered her body by itself. "Did you previously transform your divine Qi into the Celestial Qi? How did you manage to do that?"

Zhang Fei [5] immediately told Tang Ying about Qi Lai, and he shared the method to transform the Divine Qi into the Celestial Qi with her. "You can learn it now if you want, but you can’t use it now, and we have to wait until my second clone arrives in the Paradise Realm. Previously, I only tried it, but I was forced to hold myself back; otherwise, I wouldn’t be able to cultivate, and that would hinder my progress."
"I see." Tang Ying nodded in understanding. "Initially, I believed you were foolish for trying to forcefully convert all your Divine Qi into Celestial Qi, but I was mistaken in my assumption."
"How could I be that stupid?" Zhang Fei [5] then asked her. "Do you also have the body double ability?"
Tang Ying replied to Zhang Fei [5] by summoning her five clones. "Most of our abilities are the same, but I have three different abilities compared to other lust demons."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei was genuinely curious about that statement. "For example?"

"Your demon charm makes people attracted to you, but it won’t work on women with high mental fortitude, and she can dispel it." Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Tang Ying. "Unlike you, I don’t have the demon charm ability, but I have my Love Derivation ability. If I use it on other people, both men and women will immediately go head over heels for me, and they will ignore everything for my sake."
Zhang Fei [5] raised his eyebrows after hearing that. "Does that mean their mental fortitude is useless in hindering your ability?"

"My ability is unstoppable, even by those with ultra-high mental fortitude." Tang Ying then asked Zhang Fei [5]. "Do you want to try it? If I use it on you, you will forget all your women, and you will always be obedient to me."
"Try it."

"Are you sure? Aren’t you afraid they will be disappointed?" After Zhang Fei [5] nodded, Tang Ying used her Love Derivation ability on him. However, the result was not as she expected, especially since the system immediately intervened in her actions and dispelled the effects of her ability. "I see! No wonder you are so confident; it turns out your system protects you from any control techniques."

Zhang Fei [5] smiled in response. "The system has helped me too many times, so I am confident that it will dispel the effects of your abilities. Will the person affected by your abilities stay that way forever?"
"No." Tang Ying shook her head. "Just like your demon charm, I can remove the effect of my Love Derivation from my target, and that person will return to normal."
"What is your second ability?" Zhang Fei [5] suddenly became horny as soon as Tang Ying used her other abilities. "Aphrodisiac?"

Tang Ying nodded and explained it. "My ability is somewhat similar to your Lust Manipulation ability, but it also has distinct differences. All the fluids in my body, including my blood, contain aphrodisiacs. This passive ability is troublesome, and it almost caused your master to violate me by force in the past."
"How did that happen?"

Tang Ying let out a soft sigh. "That incident happened when we were young and weak, and a powerful beast’s attack injured me. The aphrodisiac in my blood affected your master, who came to my rescue. Fortunately, our late master arrived just in time and knocked him directly; otherwise, he would have done it because I was in a helpless situation at that time."
"The third?"
"Hehe." Tang Ying chuckled. "My third ability is quite similar to your Familiar Manipulation ability, but it can only be used on myself."
"Show it to me."
"No." Tang Ying rejected Zhang Fei [5]’s request outright. "I don’t want to get pregnant and give birth to a baby."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately realized it because there was a similar ability in the system shop, but he was not interested in purchasing it. "So, your third ability is self-reproduction, right?"

"That’s right." Tang Ying gave a nod of approval. "Lust demons are basically genderless, but our body modification ability allows us to become a man or a woman. My third ability makes me have both chromosomes, so I can get pregnant and give birth to my own baby."
Zhang Fei [5] felt uncomfortable discussing the topic, particularly because it led him to question whether Tang Ying was truly a woman.
"Hey!" Tang Ying called out to Zhang Fei [5]. "I was born as a woman, okay? Just like you, I became a lust demon by accident, so you don’t have to doubt my identity."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed awkwardly. "Your ability is too terrifying! I can’t hide anything from you. I’ll bring Wei Xiaoya here to train, but first I’ll return to the Falling Star Realm to pick her up. After that, we’ll focus on our dual-soul cultivation, and I hope to reach the Divine Soul level before going to the Paradise Realm."
"Go." Tang Ying then turned to Jia Yuyan, who had just walked in. "A fairy from the Paradise Realm, huh?"
"Tang Ying, right?" Jia Yuyan approached her. "I hope you will continue to help him in his soul cultivation path, especially since he needs a higher soul level."

Tang Ying nodded at her. "Don’t worry, I will help him achieve his wish, and he will be ready to face the situation in the Paradise Realm. By the way, you must not return to your domain, and it’s better if you wait for him."
"What do you mean by that?" Tang Ying touched Jia Yuyan’s forehead and shared a few things with her, causing the female fairy to frown. "Where did you get all that?"

Tang Ying summoned the gray eye and explained it to Jia Yuyan. "You might not believe me now, but everything I share with you will happen if you force yourself to return to your domain. Moreover, you’ve already spent some time with him, so you should already understand his character. What do you think will happen if those things really happen? Do you believe he will remain silent and refrain from taking any action?"
"But—"

"Why don’t you look for another solution?" Jia Yuyan looked at Tang Ying in confusion. "You are powerful, but your fairy king is much more powerful. Why do you have to force yourself for something that is beyond your control? Instead, you can wait for him to arrive in the Paradise Realm, and you can contact your grandparents without having to return to your domain. They are much stronger than you, so they have more ability to investigate the matter than you do."
Jia Yuyan let out a heavy sigh. "You are right, I do not have the ability to investigate the matter."
"Then, don’t act stupid and stay by his side for now."
"All right."
"That’s good." Tang Ying then pulled Jia Yuyan to sit next to her, and they discussed various other topics.
"How are your affairs in the Sovereign Heaven Realm? Is everything over?" Wei Xiaoya asked her question immediately after Zhang Fei [5] appeared in front of her and Mu Qingyuan.

On the other hand, Mu Qingyuan gave the sales results of the pills in the past week to Zhang Fei [5]. "Your pills sold much faster than I had previously calculated, and my stock has run low in just a week."

"Isn’t that great? I’ll give you some extra stock so you won’t run out of my pills." Zhang Fei [5] immediately gave Mu Qingyuan a storage ring containing various types of pills. "Xiaoya, all my affairs in that realm are settled now, and I will focus on myself from today. Therefore, I will take you to my private place now, and you will focus on practicing there."
Wei Xiaoya was taken aback by Zhang Fei [5]’s sudden decision. "But—"

chapters.title: Chapter 1044: Their Domains
paragraphs: After a day passed, Hun Di, Lin Jingxia, and Xia Tian had successfully created their domains. However, the other senior cultivators, such as Yan Leibao, Wang Zhemin, and some others, had yet to succeed.

To Zhang Fei’s surprise, many of his women also succeeded in creating their domains at the same time as the three seniors, such as Hong Xinxin, Murong Qianying, Murong Mengying, Wang Yourou, Shang Yumei, Xi Yinying, Shang Ziyuan, and all the female mythical beasts.
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed with satisfaction as he approached them, and he gave them a brief kiss. "Congratulations! All of you have successfully created your domain."

Hong Xinxin lightly punched his chest. "Isn’t this because of you? By the way, my domain is a lightning domain, and it will enhance my lightning element power. It might be useful in the Three Mortal Realms, but I doubt that it will be helpful in the Paradise Realm. Therefore, I’m thinking about repairing and enhancing it again, but I won’t do that now, and I’ll do it after we leave this tower."

"Fortunately, you met Shangguan Yan in the Sovereign Heaven Realm. If you hadn’t discovered the method and taught us the shortcut, we would have never succeeded in creating a domain." Murong Qianying spoke. "I won’t tell you the effects of my domain now, and I will use it when we are together later. I’m sure you will like the effects."
Zhang Fei shook his head as he could already guess the effect of Murong Qianying’s domain, mainly because their souls had long since merged together. "What about you, Yourou?"

Wang Yourou raised both hands. "My domain is beneficial, and it strengthens my body and increases my speed even when I’m not using it. If I use it, my body strength and speed will increase even more significantly."
"I think it’s good, Yourou." Zhang Fei then turned to Shang Yumei, playfully squeezed her buttocks, and asked her a question. "What about your domain, my little vixen?"

"I’m not a little vixen, but the old one, okay?" Shang Yumei then told him. "My domain has several abilities because I combined the effects of my master’s bloodline into it, and one of them will be related to our fox charm. Anyone who is trapped inside it will be completely infatuated and obedient to me, and I can order them to do anything I want, including committing suicide. However, my cultivation is still at this stage, so my domain will not have much impact on cultivators who are stronger than me, especially those with high mental fortitude."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "I think it doesn’t matter because your cultivation will still continue to increase, and the effect of your domain will also increase along with the increase in your cultivation."
"That’s true." Shang Yumei nodded slightly.
"What about you, Mengying?"
Murong Mengying smiled wryly. "Fei, my domain’s effect is not intended for offense, defense, or control; rather, it functions as a sensor type."
"Sensor type?" Zhang Fei and the others were surprised to hear that.

"Do you remember my Heavenly Perception Eye Technique?" Zhang Fei nodded to Murong Mengying, who immediately activated her domain. "I created my domain based on the effects of my eye technique, and it can detect many things, including those covered by concealment formations. Moreover, all of you can’t sense my domain, right? This way, I can monitor the enemy’s movements without them knowing, but unfortunately, the range of my domain is still not as wide as I expected, and I have to increase my cultivation to expand its range."

"Amazing!" Zhang Fei exclaimed. "By the way, I obtained the Heaven’s Eye Perception Array from Duanmu Luolan, and its effects are similar to your eye technique. I previously wanted to create that array, but most of the materials do not exist here. Since your domain can do such a thing, I will forget about that formation for now, and you will help me if I encounter something like that before."
Murong Mengying smiled at that and canceled her domain. "Just call me if you need my help."
"Ahh!" Xi Yinying screamed softly as Zhang Fei pulled her into his arms. "Master, I—"
"Didn’t I forbid you from addressing me as a master? Do you want me to punish you, Little Yinying?" Zhang Fei asked with a playful smile.

"Fei." Xi Yinying called softly. "My domain is a control type and is related to the shadow element, and I can control my enemies as long as they are within the range of my domain. However, their cultivation level will affect the effect of my control, and the duration will be too short if their cultivation is much higher than mine. If their cultivation is equal to or below mine, they will never be able to free themselves from my shadow control."

Zhang Fei himself had expected that, so he was not surprised by Xi Yinying’s explanation. "That’s fine; your domain will become stronger and stronger, and people will find it difficult to escape your trap, especially after you break through to the Five Celestial Realms in the future."
"Uhm." Xi Yinying gave a light nod.
Zhang Fei let go of Xi Yinying before asking Shang Ziyuan. "How about you?"

Shang Ziyuan shocked Zhang Fei and the others by activating five domains at once, and the five were not gathered in one place but spread across several areas with her as the center. "The first one has the same effect as my Reversal Mirror technique, and you must already understand its effect. I created the second one based on my Heaven Suppression Palm, but the effect is two times stronger than that. My third one has the effect of my Mind-Seizing Illusion art, but the illusion is more deadly because it will enhance the illusion that arises from their fear. I created the fourth based on your dual cultivation technique, and its effect will increase our Yang and Yin Qi. As for the fifth, I created it on a whim, and it is a support type that will enhance the strength of everyone in it, but it will only apply to my allies."
’How genius is she really? She said she created her fifth domain on a whim, but the effect was incredibly amazing.’ Zhang Fei and the others thought the same thing in their minds.

"Try your second domain on me." Shang Ziyuan immediately activated it, which almost forced Zhang Fei to kneel. However, he immediately activated the soul link, and the effect disappeared right away because his strength surpassed hers. "It is true that its effect is stronger than your Heaven Suppression Palm, but cultivators with higher cultivation can dispel it."
Shang Ziyuan nodded at Zhang Fei. "The main weakness of my domain is indeed the difference in my cultivation and my target. Do you want to try the effect of my third domain?"
"No." Zhang Fei rejected that outright, opened his palm, and used his Annihilation Flame. "Instead, use your fifth domain, as I’m curious about the effect."
"Okay."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei and the others were immediately shocked as his Annihilation Flame became bigger and hotter, which was due to the effect of Shang Ziyuan’s fifth domain.
"Hey, Fei! This tower might explode if you use that technique." Feng Qingmeng suddenly spoke.
Zhu Lingyao nodded in agreement with her. ’Fei, I can also feel that the explosive power of your technique has significantly increased, so you should not use it in this place.’

"Yeah." Zhang Fei immediately dispelled his technique. "Ziyuan, I will bring you to fight by my side if I face powerful enemies, and the effect of your fifth domain will be of great help to me in eliminating them."
"Sure." Shang Ziyuan deactivated her five domains instantly.

Zhang Fei then asked those female mythical beasts about the effects of their domain, but Zhu Lingyao, Feng Qingmeng, and Zhu Zhanniang’s explanation was within his expectations, especially since their domain was an attack type related to the fire element. Meanwhile, the domain effects of Huli Haohao, Huli Zhishen, and Huli Xianniang were almost the same because they were of the golden fox race, which was related to charm, control, and sex.
Zhang Fei then asked the last female mythical beast, Nu Qichen, the Nian beast. "What is the effect of your domain, Qichen?"
"I’ll show you somewhere else, Fei." Ni Qichen immediately pulled Zhang Fei away, leaving the others confused.

After they arrived at another area, Nu Qichen immediately activated her domain, but it was completely different compared to Zhang Fei’s or his other women’s domains. He could see ten nian beasts flying around inside the domain, but he knew that they were not real.

"First, restore your cultivation to normal, then I’ll show you my domain’s first effect." As soon as Zhang Fei deactivated the soul link, Nu Qichen immediately activated her domain, and the result shocked him greatly. "Do you like the effect?"
"Amazing!" Zhang Fei exclaimed in admiration, especially since his cultivation became on par with Nu Qichen’s directly. "How long does it last?"

"You must fight within my domain to keep your current cultivation, as the effect will vanish if you leave. However, I can’t use it for too long, and it’s only about five minutes for now." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding to Nu Qichen. "Now try using your abilities to improve your strength."

"Okay." Zhang Fei once again activated the soul link before releasing his aura, but his action caused the Star Tower to shake violently. "Holy shit! My strength improved further by using both of them, but I don’t know what level it is exactly."

"Your strength is now equivalent to Qi Lai’s in the 3-Sun Celestial Emperor." Zhang Fei and Nu Qichen turned to Wan Jiang, who had suddenly appeared. "When you use your usual ability, your strength becomes equivalent to a 3-Sun Celestial Lord, and this woman’s domain raises it to that stage. Unfortunately, the effect of her domain is limited to close range, so you can’t bring her to fight by your side, especially if you go to the Paradise Realm. Those people will definitely notice it, and they will try to capture her for their benefit or even kill her."

"Equivalent to a cultivator in the 3-Sun Celestial Emperor, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself as he clenched both fists. "I know it’s still not enough in the Paradise Realm, but it’s more than enough to defeat all my enemies in the Three Mortal Realms."

Wan Jiang nodded at him. "However, you no longer have any enemies in the Three Mortal Realms, right? Therefore, you don’t need to worry about that and can focus on reaching the Divine Ascension Realm; additionally, you can bring them to the Paradise Realm earlier than you originally planned."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei canceled the soul link directly. "Where did you lock Xereth up, old man?"
Wan Jiang told him directly. "The ninth floor was purposely built to lock up demons like him, so I sent him there. If you want to fight him, you have to reach that floor first."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "My second clone will arrive in the Paradise Realm in two to three months, and I will take them all into seclusion again once he gets there."
"What about Qi Lai? When will you hand him over to me?"

Zhang Fei smirked at that. "For now, I will milk that old man’s celestial qi because I want to use his qi to break through several levels directly, and I will hand him over to you after I transform my Divine Qi into the Celestial Qi."
"Don’t let him die, understand?"

"Don’t worry, I will hand him over to you alive." Wan Jiang immediately disappeared from their sight, and then Zhang Fei turned to Nu Qichen to ask her a question. "What are the other effects of your domain?"

Nu Qichen immediately used the second ability of her domain, and the ten small nian beasts right away attacked Zhang Fei with a sonic attack, causing him to experience severe dizziness. "The second is a sonic attack, and it will destroy the brain if I use it at full power."

"Amazing! Now, use another one." Zhang Fei immediately experienced deep fear as soon as Nu Qichen used the third effect of his domain, but it still couldn’t compare to the fear he had for the mysterious woman from the Ancient Nether Clan. "Fear, huh?’

Nu Qichen nodded at him. "The effect will induce different fears in each person based on their innermost feelings. At first, I thought you would be extremely scared, but you were able to overcome it easily."
"Haha." Zhang Fei hugged and kissed Nu Qichen directly. "The fear is quite scary, but I have met someone much scarier before; thus, the effect of your domain does not affect me much."
"Someone scary?" Zhang Fei immediately told Nu Qichen about the woman. "Ancient clans? Such monsters exist in the Paradise Realm, eh?"

Zhang Fei released a soft sigh. "The Three Mortal Realms are indeed part of the cultivation world, but the Paradise Realm represents the true cultivation world, which holds far more secrets, including those of ancient clans. Therefore, we cannot slack off, and we must at least reach the peak of mortal cultivation before we go there. Does your domain still have some other effects?"
"Yes." Nu Qichen then showed and explained all the remaining effects of her domain.

"Each of you has successfully created a unique domain, and I am very satisfied with your success." Zhang Fei then hugged Nu Qichen’s waist and led her back to the others. "Let’s wait for them to finish, and we will continue our challenge until they reach their limits. After that, we will focus on our isolation, and we will challenge this tower again after all of them have broken through to the Seven Divine Realms.

Nu Qichen turned to him. "Back then, you couldn’t absorb my Qi and those who had reached the Seven Divine Realms, but your cultivation was already this fast. Now, you can absorb our Qi, so your cultivation should be even faster, right?"

"You’re right." Zhang Fei nodded in response. "Honestly, I can break through to the 2-Moon Divine Transcend Realm whenever I want, but Feng Yao once forbade me from breaking through while on my way to the Paradise Realm. Since my second clone was on the way there, I was forced to slow down my cultivation, and I focused more on other things, such as my soul cultivation and training."
"I see."

Upon their arrival at the others’ location, Zhang Fei immediately informed Hong Xinxin about Feng Xishui, who was on his way to the Shandian Realm to meet the Yan and Tantai clans. Since the Yan clan and Tantai Lingyan had not yet completed their domains, he intended to send her to that realm after the male phoenix installed the teleportation formation, especially since she was part of the Yan clan.
Hong Xinxin immediately agreed with that. "If my grandfather and the others haven’t finished, I’ll go to that realm and talk to them, and I’ll ask them to help Feng Xishui open your shop."

Since the battle had ended, the Duanmu and Shangguan clans had started to busy themselves with preparations for Yuan Hao and Shangguan Miyuan’s wedding, which was also the reason why Zhang Fei had not brought Shangguan Yan and Duanmu Luolan into his training space.

Unlike them, Shangguan Lizhi and Tian Junfeng did not bother with the wedding. They did not even prepare anything for their wedding, and they got married in a simple ceremony, which was witnessed by all the members of the Shangguan Clan.
"When will you two leave for the Moon Tower, Ancestors?" Shangguan Yan asked them.
Shangguan Lizhi turned to Tian Junfeng. "What do you think about that? Are you going to leave the Tian Clan in such a situation?"

"Yes." Tian Junfeng unhesitatingly decided. Jingxuan is old and has been the patriarch for a long time, so he should be able to handle everything by himself. Moreover, there is no longer any danger threatening this realm, so I don’t need to worry about them, and we will leave for the Frozen Moon Realm after Yuan Hao and Shangguan Miyuan’s wedding."

Shangguan Yan spoke straightaway. "I think that’s a good idea, Ancestor Junfeng. Zhang Fei will definitely attend my daughter’s wedding, and he can send you all to the Shrouded Sky Realm, which is much closer to the Frozen Moon Realm. This way, you all won’t have to waste much time on a long journey, and you can arrive at that realm faster."
"It’s decided then; we will leave after their wedding."

However, the other senior cultivators, such as Yan Leibao, Wang Zhemin, and some others, had yet to succeed.

To Zhang Fei’s surprise, many of his women also succeeded in creating their domains at the same time as the three seniors, such as Hong Xinxin, Murong Qianying, Murong Mengying, Wang Yourou, Shang Yumei, Xi Yinying, Shang Ziyuan, and all the female mythical beasts.

However, my cultivation is still at this stage, so my domain will not have much impact on cultivators who are stronger than me, especially those with high mental fortitude."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.

Murong Mengying smiled at that and canceled her domain.

"Instead, use your fifth domain, as I’m curious about the effect."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei immediately dispelled his technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 1045: Two Days Later
paragraphs: Another day passed, and all of them had successfully created their own domains. Zhang Fei immediately asked his women about their domains, and they took turns explaining to him.
Zhang Yue’s domain was related to the ice element and her ice phoenix bloodline, and its effects strengthened her domain technique from the ice phoenix scripture.

Hu Yue’s domain has two functions: attack and support. However, its attacks are more powerful against cultivators with the dark element, demons, and demonic beasts. Its abilities support maintaining healing, recovery, and purification.
Zhang Lin’s domain was naturally related to her water element, but it also strengthened the effects of Leviathan’s tears and the sea dragon bracelet.

Since she has two elements, Ru Xue successfully created two domains: one light domain, which functions similarly to Hu Yue’s. The other is a darkness domain with some abilities similar to the celestial demon, especially since he inherited Oz the First’s bloodline.
Liu Hua did not reveal her domain to Zhang Fei, but she informed him that it was associated with the poison element.
Chu Qing and Chu Ying created the fire domains, and some of their effects are useful for alchemy.
Zhang Lingxue also created her fire domain with almost the same effect, but she also created a darkness domain, which is different from Ru Xue’s.

Liu Qingyu, Bai Tian’er, Bai Shushi, and Chu Xing have light elements, so the two of them created their light domain. However, the latter also created another domain based on the Yin-Yang Avatar technique, but she did not show it directly.

Qing Yi, Xian Xianqin, Zhou Shenxin, and Zhao Ziqin succeeded in creating their wind domains. However, the effects of their domains differ from one another, and Zhao Ziqin’s domain is particularly special because she integrates it with her sound technique.

The three women from the Shen Clan also created their water domains, but Shen Huang’s domain was more of a support. Meanwhile, Shen Yu’s domain is more balanced between attack and defense, and Shen Xueyi’s domain is more focused on attack.
Tang Ziyu, Helian Xueyi, and Lian Xing created their earth domains, which were not limited to defense; they could also be used for attacks, particularly area attacks within their domains.

Just like Hong Xinxin, Yun Xinyue, Zhong Yan, and Ye Lian were lightning element possessors. They managed to create their lightning domains, but the Yun Princess’s domain had a slight advantage over the other two women, and she could create lightning fields that had various effects within her domain.
The two dryads, Lillea and Janette, naturally created wood domains. However, the daughter also created the darkness domain, the element she got from the demon seed in her body.

All the male and female beasts have also created their own domains, but the most deadly is Feng Yichen’s domain, mainly because of her dark phoenix flames, which can burn everything to nothing, including the souls of living creatures.

Like the others, all of Zhang Fei’s unofficial women and servants also succeeded in creating diverse domains, but the most unique is the domain of the Shi Sisters. Shi Xi’s domain became the most difficult to penetrate, primarily due to her mastery of the metal element and her status as the White Tiger. Shi Wu’s wood domain was similar to Janette and Lillea’s, but her domain was several levels above theirs, especially since she was no longer a human but an Azure Dragon.

Angela’s domain was no less deadly than Feng Yichen’s domain, especially since she created it from her lightning and water elements. Although she was not as powerful as the female Dark Phoenix, the combination of the two elements was truly deadly against her enemies.

Zhang Fei did not immediately lead them to continue the challenge on the fourth floor, but one of his clones brought Tantai Lingyan and Yan Leibao to the Phoenix Realm, where he installed the teleportation device that connected it to the Shandian Realm, especially since Feng Xishui had already arrived in that realm.
Before the two of them went to their home realm, Zhang Fei’s clone handed over several storage rings containing pills, alchemy ingredients, and earth goods to Tantai Lingyan and Yan Leibao.

After receiving everything, Tantai Lingyan and Yan Leibao immediately went to the Shandian Realm to meet Feng Xishui. They ordered the members of the Yan and Tantai clans to assist the male phoenix in opening two stores in two different cities.

Zhang Fei’s clone also went to the Shandian Realm, but he did not go to the two clans, and he only wanted to store the location of the realm in the gate feature. This way, he can go there whenever he wants without having to go to the Phoenix Realm first. After Tantai Lingyan and Yan Leibao took care of everything, he sent them back to the Star Tower, and he himself continued his training.
After Tantai Lingyan and Yan Leibao returned to the Star Tower, Zhang Fei immediately led them to continue the challenge on the fourth floor, and their large numbers made things easier for them.

Quickly, another day passed again, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to leave the life pond, especially since he had promised Shangguan Yan and Duanmu Luolan to attend Shangguan Miyuan and Yuan Hao’s wedding.
Shangguan Yan and Duanmu Luolan agreed to hold their children’s wedding in the Shangguan Clan, especially since that clan was much bigger than the Duanmu Clan.

The Shangguan Clan itself was already crowded with invited guests, but not all the major clan leaders were present, such as Tian Jingxuan, Qing Huang, and Shi Yan, who were still recovering. Only their children, such as Tian Jiantang, Qing Yu, and a woman from the Shi Clan, represent the three clans.
Unusually, the natural races were also present in the Shangguan Clan led by Ju Xing, who forced them to come, considering their relationship with Zhang Xiaolong [3].

Since Zhang Xiaolong [3] was the lover of their two mothers, Shangguan Miyuan and Yuan Hao asked him to represent their late fathers, which made Shangguan Yan and Duanmu Luolan embarrassed and awkward toward the guests.
The wedding of Shangguan Miyuan and Yuan Hao was quite lively and long, and the event ended in the afternoon.

After the guests left the Shangguan Clan, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately spoke to them. "Your mothers have indeed prepared your bridal chamber in this clan residence, but I want you two to do it in my private place. There are some good formations there, and their effects will be beneficial to both of you. Once you guys are satisfied with your wedding night, you can join the others to practice, and I will focus on my cultivation in the eastern forest."
"What do you think about that, wife?" Yuan Hao asked Shangguan Miyuan a question, but his tone sounded awkward due to their new marital status.
Shangguan Miyuan nodded at him. "I think it’s not a problem, and we can start our training straight away without bothering Zhang Fei to pick us up."
"That’s true." Yuan Hao then spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Please send us there."
"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed and teased him. "Are you that impatient to have Miyuan?"
Yuan Hao rubbed the back of his head. "I’ve waited long enough to marry her, and my wait is finally over today."

"Take these bottles." Shangguan Miyuan and Yuan took both of them while looking at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in confusion. "Use both of them before you start, and you two will have an unforgettable first wedding night."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened the portal to the training space, asked both of them to enter, and told them to go to the pavilion. He normally wouldn’t let anyone else enter the pavilion, especially since all his women lived there. However, most of them are in the star tower, and the rest are in the demon realm, so he made an exception for them.
"Where are they?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked Shangguan Yan and Duanmu Luolan after he closed the portal.

Shangguan Yan immediately led Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the back area of her clan, followed by Duanmu Luolan, where Tian Junfeng and Shangguan Lizhi were already waiting for him along with several people from both clans.
"Kid, I hand over this clan to you, and you must protect it well." Shangguan Lizhi directly spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"Don’t worry, I’m part of this clan now, so I’ll definitely protect everyone." Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Tian Junfeng. "I’ve heard from Yan’er about your plans regarding your clan, but I can’t say anything about it now, and the decision is up to Tian Jingxuan. If he really wants to be my enemy, I won’t back down, and I will face him. If your clan’s people act foolishly to support him, then I will eliminate them along with him."

"Haha." Tian Junfeng laughed instead. "I have no problem with that since I already decided it from the start, but you must keep your word. You can kill those who support Tian Jingxuan, and you have to spare those who don’t side with him."

The people from the Tian Clan, who were standing behind Tian Junfeng, wore bad looks after their ancestor said that. However, none of them opened their mouths, especially since they were aware of the strength of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the people around him.

"As long as they don’t side with Tian Jingxuan, I will never touch them, but vice versa." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then opened the gate to the Shrouded Sky Realm. "You can all leave now, and I will return to my isolation right away."
Tian Junfeng took Shangguan Lizhi’s hand and led her into the gate, followed by people from the Tian and Shangguan Clans.

As soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] closed the gate, Gu Changsheng appeared before them as ordered. "I will take Shangguan Yan and Duanmu Luolan into seclusion, so I want your people to protect their two clans, and they can kill anyone who dares to try to attack the two."

"Yes, Master." Gu Changsheng immediately contacted several people and asked them to protect the Duanmu and Shangguan Clans. "Leave everything to me, Master. We will protect their clans well, and I will always monitor their situation."
"That’s good." Zhang Xiaolong [3] led the two women back to the main hall.
"Aren’t you going to bring Leng Xueyan with us?" Shangguan Yan asked him.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] released a soft sigh as he still hadn’t made a decision about Leng Xueyan, but Duanmu Luolan directly spoke to him. "Xueyan might have a hard time accepting the fact that you and the man she met in the Grand Royal Realm are clones of your original body, but you should be able to convince her, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1046: Tian Kongquan’s Soul Remnant
paragraphs: "Hahaha." Yan Huo laughed at that. "Back then, I was close friends with Tian Kongquan, but I wasn’t one of the founders of this realm, and I met him after he and the others founded it. At that time, he was looking for resources to improve this realm, and I was one of his competitors. Our strengths were equal, and we shared many similar thoughts; therefore, we embarked on an adventure together until we found the Sky Flame, which ultimately led to my current condition."
"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "Do you remember Qing Peng, old man?"
"How do you know that name?" Yan Huo asked with a frown, especially since only he and the people closest to Tian Kongquan should know about the beast.

"My wife and I found Qing Peng’s preserved corpse in the Raging Thunder Realm, and we also met his soul there." Yan Huo was a little surprised after Zhang Xiaolong [3] mentioned that. "He told us that Tian Kongquan deliberately kept his corpse and soul in the hole within the Thunderfall Gorge to wait for his successor to come, and he chose my wife as his successor. With his permission, I used his corpse to turn her into the Azure Emperor Roc."
"Is it possible to turn a human into a beast?" Yan Hao asked in disbelief.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled in response. "Old man, you have witnessed many of my actions since I arrived in this realm, and you yourself previously said that I am not an ordinary kid. Therefore, you shouldn’t be surprised if I can do such a thing, right?"
"Yeah, you’re right." Yan Hao nodded his head slightly.

"Actually, I’ve turned several of my wives into beasts or demon beasts, but I won’t explain the details because it’s my secret." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked him. "Can I look inside? I want to check Tian Yualing’s situation myself."
Instead of answering his question, Yan Hao grabbed Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s shoulder and took him away.
A while later, they arrived at the cemetery complex, and Yan Hao immediately led Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the center, where a tall golden statue stood upright.
"Why did you bring me here, old man?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked in confusion.

Yan Huo did not answer Zhang Xiaolong [3] and continued walking until they arrived in front of a statue with a large cube of stone beneath it. The statue was naturally the statue of the founder of the Sovereign Heaven Realm, Tian Kongquan.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked up. "So, this is Tian Kongquan’s tomb, huh?"

"Not everyone can come to this place, and only certain people can do it." Yan Huo pressed the symbol in front of the stone and channeled his qi into it, causing it to open by itself and reveal a descending staircase. "Let’s go in."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately followed behind Yan Huo, and the entrance swiftly closed by itself. "Doesn’t anyone know about this secret staircase?"

"No." Yan Hao responded with a shake of his head. "Only cultivators in our generation and the generation after us know about this place; not even Ji Zhongli knows about it, especially since he came from Tian Jingxuan’s grandfather’s generation. Currently, I am the only remaining member of those two generations, and we have never disclosed this information to others as per my friend’s instructions."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] felt strange about it because the Tian Clan were Tian Kongquan’s direct descendants, but he deliberately hid the place from his descendants. "Why did you guys decide to hide this place from them?"
"The answer to your question is at the bottom." Yan Huo briefly replied.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] questioned him again. "If that’s the case, why did you bring me here? After all, I am a newcomer in this realm, and I don’t have a favorable relationship with the Tian Clan. Moreover, there is a possibility that I will become their enemy, remember?"

"Qing Peng." Yan Hao stopped walking and faced Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "My old friend told me to bring whoever managed to find his beast’s corpse and get that brat’s approval. Moreover, that Qing brat should have told you about his master’s unique ability, including his reason for leaving his corpse and soul in that hole, right?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "Actually, Qing Peng didn’t say anything to me, and he only told my wife about Tian Kongquan’s ability to see a person’s fate far into the future."
"I see." Yan Huo then continued walking down the path, followed by Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was still pondering the truth.

A few minutes later, they had arrived at the bottom. Zhang Xiaolong [3] saw an old wooden coffin in the middle of the room, and there was a bookshelf full of old books to the north of it. On the walls around the place, he could see many paintings, and he immediately approached one of them. However, it was clearly not a depiction of the Sovereign Heaven Realm, but something else. "Did Tian Kongquan paint all of these paintings himself?"

"Yes." Yan Huo walked beside Zhang Xiaolong [3] and touched the painting. "Tian Kongquan’s unique ability not only allowed him to see the future fate of others, but he could also see the past. However, such an ability was not without its risks, and it came at the cost of his lifespan, causing him to die faster as his lifespan continued to decrease every time he used it. According to him, this one shows our universe in the past when the realm beyond and the Three Mortal Realms were still connected to each other, and this realm was the last realm that connected the two."
"Does that mean this realm didn’t exist back then?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked as he looked at the painting in a serious manner. ’Mei, record everything.’
[I’m doing it, Master.]

Yan Huo shook his head at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "This realm already existed before Tian Kongquan and the others discovered it, but the barrier had already separated the realm beyond and the Three Mortal Realms when they occupied it and established the Sovereign Heaven Realm."

"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding, but he felt that some of the history he had heard before contradicted each other, which confused him. "The realm beyond is the Paradise Realm, and the cultivation stage after that is the Five Celestial Realms. The two people Cao Ren brought here before were cultivators from that realm; one of them had a cultivation at the 3-Sun Celestial Emperor, and the other had a cultivation at the 3-Sun Celestial Lord."

Yan Huo nodded slightly and didn’t bother too much with it, especially since he was already dead, and he would disappear once the Sky Flame merged with the Yuan Tianling. He then walked over to the old wooden coffin and stood in front of the head part. "Come here, kid."
"Hmm." Zhang Xiaolong [3] walked there, but he was standing in front of the lower part. "Don’t tell me that Tian Kongquan left a small part of his soul in this place."

"Smart." Yan Huo then told him. "However, I cannot summon his soul remnant, and the only person who can do that is your wife. Therefore, you must pick her up now and bring her here, and you will find out the truth."

"Okay." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened a portal to the training space, and Hong Xinxin walked out of it a few minutes later. "Xinxin, this coffin belongs to Qing Peng’s late master, and I brought you here because you are the only person who can summon his soul remnant."

Hong Xinxin was momentarily taken aback by that, but she quickly transformed into her Azure Emperor Roc form in a small form. She flew to the middle of the chest and landed there, and Yan Huo immediately instructed her. "Little girl, touch that symbol and channel your beast aura into it, and my old friend will appear to meet you."

Hong Xinxin nodded slightly, touched the symbol with her leg, and carried out Yan Huo’s instructions. In a few moments, the coffin sparkled brightly, followed by the appearance of Tian Kongquan’s soul remnant.
"Long time no see, old friend." Yan Huo spoke as he looked at Tian Kongquan’s soul remnant with a melancholy gaze.
Tian Kongquan’s soul remnant looked at Yan Huo as he smiled. {Apparently, the two of us will soon disappear, old friend.}

"Yes." Yan Huo did not have any regrets on his expression. "The merging process of the Sky Flame and Tian Yuanling is already halfway through, and I will disappear after the process is complete, just as you predicted in the past."
{Do you still regret your carelessness back then?}

"Hahaha." Yan Hao laughed at that. "What else is there to regret? I’ve been dead for too long, so all my regrets have long since disappeared. I’ve been waiting for this day to come, and I will embrace my death with open arms. My only regret is that I couldn’t continue our adventure back then, so I hope we’ll meet again in the future."

{Don’t worry, old man. We will meet again in the future, and we will have adventures together again, just like in the past.} Tian Kongquan’s soul remnant looked at Hong Xinxin, lifted her in front of him, and placed her in his hands. He rubbed her fur and looked at her longingly, but his longing was not for her but for Qing Peng. {My vision in the past has become a reality, and my little beast has found his successor.}

If another man dared to touch Hong Xinxin, Zhang Xiaolong [3] would have been furious and beaten up that man directly. However, he could understand Tian Kongquan’s feelings, so he didn’t say anything or stop him.

{Since you succeeded in convincing him and becoming his successor, I will give you a final gift. However, you won’t be able to use it now, and you have to go to the realm beyond first.} Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Hong Xinxin were shocked when Tian Kongquan’s soul remnant spoke, particularly because he was unaware of anything regarding the Paradise Realm, much less how to reach it. He then touched her small head and imparted something into her mind, causing her body to glow purple for a while. {Back then, I didn’t give it to that kid because I never managed to find a way to go to that place, but you and your husband are different from us, and you two have already found a way to get there.}
"How do you know about that, senior?" Hong Xinxin asked in confusion.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately spoke to him. "Did you use your ability to see this era?"

{Yes.} Tian Kongquan’s soul remnant nodded at him. {I didn’t know how the ten-tailed fox knew about me and my ability, but he suddenly came to me in the past, and he told me about many things, especially about the future of this universe. He has the ability to see the future, but he can’t see his own fate. Therefore, he came to me and asked me to use my ability to foresee his future fate, and the item I gave to your wife was a gift from him. In my vision at that time, I saw a man with three identities: a human, a demon, and a heavenly fox. According to my vision at that time, you have all three, right?}

"Moral degradation."

Tian Kongquan’s soul remnant nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. {I once witnessed the impending collapse of my Tian Clan, which was caused by the ten-tailed fox’s successor, who is none other than you. chapters.title: Chapter 1047: Jin Zhongli
paragraphs: Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Yan Huo were already inside the cave, where the Sky Flame was located. The flame enveloped Yuan Tianling’s body, but her dress remained intact despite the intense heat. "This little girl is only halfway through the process, so you still have to wait some time to take her away. Although Tian Yan did not choose you as his master, he will still fight by your side in the future, and you can use his flame to help you in various matters, including alchemy."
"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at Yan Huo. "Since the process is still long, I will return to the eastern forest to continue my seclusion."
"Master, can I stay here?" Huo Diqiu asked Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I’ll be back when your wife is done, and you can take her to your training room."
"Stay here, then." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately left the cave, leaving Huo Diqiu and Yan Huo behind.
"Are you really going to die, old man?"

Yan Huo nodded to Huo Diqiu as he looked at the sky flame. "Your brother has chosen his master, and they will merge into one soon. Once the process is complete, my task is complete, and I will enter the cycle of reincarnation."
"I see." Huo Diqiu nodded in understanding. "Thank you, old man. I know that you should have been able to reincarnate a long time ago, but you deliberately delayed it to accompany my brother."

"Hahaha." Yan Huo laughed as he walked out. "Your brother is like my biological son, so I can’t leave him alone, especially since those people will force him to submit to them if I leave first. After this, I will follow my old friend, and we will meet again like he saw in the past."
Huo Diqiu released a soft sigh and bowed his head in respect to Yan Huo. "Once again, thank you, old man."
Meanwhile, Tian Jingxuan was walking into an underground room, where many people were imprisoned.
"What brought you here today, Jingxuan?" An old man as he walked up the last steps of the room below. He is none other than Jin Zhongli, the administrator of the punishment ground.
Tian Jingxuan released a soft sigh. "Old Jin, you must have known about the big fight a few days ago, right?"
"Yes."

Tian Jingxuan immediately continued. "A kid who recently arrived in our realm helped us win that fight, and I am grateful for his help. However, he is excessively greedy and harbors lofty ambitions to become the most powerful force in this realm. He had previously enslaved Leng Hua and Gu Changsheng, so the Leng and Gu Clans had fallen into his hands. After the battle ended, he enslaved Cao Yunbai, Bai Yundong, Cao Feihong, and Sima Huiqing, making their three clans subordinate to him as well. Additionally, he had established close ties with the Shangguan and Duanmu Clans, with their two leaders becoming his wives. Apart from them, the Chi, Lin, Yuan, Ren, Yin, and Ning clans also sided with him. The natural races are also already on his side because Jia Yuyan is his wife now, and I heard that the beast races are considering becoming his allies."
"Hmm?" Jin Zhongli’s expression remained calm after Tian Jingxuan mentioned all that.

"I’ve discussed this matter with Ancestor Junfeng, but he doesn’t care about our situation; instead, he went with Shangguan Lizhi to the Frozen Moon Realm." Tian Jingxuan let out a heavy sigh and then looked at Jin Zhongli with extreme seriousness. "Old Jin, I’m afraid he’ll attack my Tian Clan and the remaining clans, such as the Qin and Shi clans. Therefore, I need your help to stop him, and you must imprison him here. This way, no one can free him, and he won’t be able to do anything to us."

"Do you think I don’t understand your character, Jingxuan? Do you think I’ve gone senile? Do you think I haven’t noticed that kid’s presence?" Tian Jingxuan frowned at Jin Zhongli. "I’ve been paying attention to him since he arrived in this realm, including when he underwent those tests. That kid isn’t greedy, but you are. Your greed has caused you to be overly paranoid that he wants to attack you, even though he never planned anything like that. He conquered the Leng Clan, so it’s his, but you and those two want to seize it from him."
"Old Jin, you—"

"Stop it, Jingxuan." Jin Zhongli then took out a piece of paper and gave it to Tian Jingxuan. "Before Tian Junfeng left, he had come to see me first, and he had already freed me from all my debts to your Tian Clan. Therefore, I no longer have the obligation to protect you and your clan, and since the problem between you and that kid arose because of your greed, you must resolve it yourself."
Tian Jingxuan’s expression was awful after he read the contents of the letter, and he immediately tore it into pieces in a fit of rage.

"It’s useless for you to tear it because Tian Junfeng has already removed your clan’s mark from me." Jin Zhongli then walked next to Tian Jingxuan and grabbed his shoulder. "Do you still not understand your ancestor’s reason for going to another realm with Shangguan Lizhi in a situation like this? You should have realized that none of us are worthy of being his opponent, especially with those powerful cultivators by his side. Even if they don’t help him, he is not someone we can afford to underestimate. He has those four mythical beasts as his contract beasts, and you shouldn’t forget Gu Changsheng and the others. Furthermore, you said it yourself that the other clans, along with the natural races and beast races, have decided to support him. Do you think your group can fight against them? If you don’t want your Tian clan to be destroyed and many of your clan members to die, you should control your greed and back down before it’s too late."

After he said all that, Jin Zhongli immediately left, leaving Tian Jingxuan, whose face had turned dark red from his overwhelming anger. His facial muscles were bulging out from under his skin, and his fists were clenched tightly.

A while later, Tian Jingxuan left the place as he glared fiercely at Jin Zhongli, who was already sitting relaxed on his old chair. ’This old traitor! I’ll settle accounts with you after I get rid of that little bastard!’

Jin Zhongli could only shake his head after Tian Jingxuan left. "Tian Hong, your Tian Clan is facing great danger now, and its destruction is just around the corner, especially since your great-grandson has been blinded by his greed and envy. If your ancestor, Tian Kongquan, were still alive and knew about this matter, he would definitely feel embarrassed to have such a descendant."

"Hahaha." Jin Zhongli looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who had just appeared in front of him after canceling his invisibility. "You have made the right decision not to side with Tian Jingxuan, old man. In fact, Tian Kongquan has seen two possibilities for his clan: one is glory, and the other is destruction. However, the final result is still unclear, and it will be determined by Tian Jingxuan’s next move."
At first, Zhang Xiaolong [3] wanted to return to the eastern forest, but he detected Tian Jingxuan’s movements, and he decided to follow him.
Jin Zhongli was not too surprised by Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s arrival and asked him directly. "How did you know that, kid?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] sat beside Jin Zhongli. "Naturally, I heard it from Tian Kongquan’s soul remnant that was intentionally left in this realm before his death, but there is only one person who knows about it."
"Old Yan Huo." Zhang Xiaolong [3] gave Jin Zhongli a nod. "So, what is your purpose in coming to see me today? Are you thinking of persuading me to take your side?"

"Not really." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then explained his reason for meeting him, causing the old man to frown. "I have heard about your gravity techniques from many people, and I have long wanted to meet you because of that. However, there were too many problems before, so I only came here today."
"Do you really want to try my gravity techniques?" Jin Zhongli asked with surprise.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately stood up from his seat and stood in front of Jin Zhongli. "Try making my body ten times heavier, old man."
"Phew." Jin Zhongli immediately stood up and grabbed Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s shoulder, but his expression turned shocked after he used his gravity technique on him. "Don’t you feel anything?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shifted Jin Zhongli’s hand away before running around the prison area, and the speed he displayed truly shocked the old man. After several rounds, he returned to the front of the old man. "Ten times gravity is too light for me, so I want you to use another technique of yours to make this area ten times heavier."

"I witnessed your speed competition with Qing Yun during the test, but I misjudged your speed at that time, and you deliberately did not use your true speed so as not to embarrass him." Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded to Jin Zhongli with a smile. "I don’t know how you trained your speed and how far you trained it, but you should be prepared because twenty times gravity is truly heavy, and you might not be able to move."
"Don’t worry about me, and please use it now." Zhang Xiaolong [3] casually replied.

Jin Zhongli didn’t say anything else and used his second gravity technique, but he was once again rendered speechless once Zhang Xiaolong [3] started running, even though it wasn’t as fast as before. ’This crazy kid! How could he still run under twenty times heavier gravity?’

Although Zhang Xiaolong [3] had not fully adapted to the twenty-two times heavier gravity in the training space, he had trained under that pressure for a month and a half based on the time flow outside, which equated to six months there due to the four times faster time flow. Thus, Jin Zhongli’s twenty times heavier gravity did not have much effect on him.

"Not bad." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in satisfaction after returning to Jin Zhongli. "Old man, I hope you are willing to join me, but you don’t have to worry that I will ask you to attack the Tian Clan because I can do it myself; instead, I need your help to train my subordinates using your gravity techniques. This way, they will be ready when it’s time for me to ascend to the Paradise Realm, and I will bring all of them there at that time."

Jin Zhongli himself had heard about the Paradise Realm from Tian Junfeng, so he was not surprised to hear about it from Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Why don’t you train them yourself? My gravity techniques are useless against you, so I’m sure you have a much better method to train them."

"That’s true." Zhang Xiaolong [3] gave him a nod of agreement. "They are indeed my subordinates, but I can’t let them reach my level, right? As their leader, I have to keep a distance between us, and I can stop them if they think of betraying me."
"Why did you take them as your subordinates if you don’t have trust in them?"
"Have you ever been betrayed before, old man?"
"No."

sentences.text: Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Yan Huo were already inside the cave, where the Sky Flame was located.
The flame enveloped Yuan Tianling’s body, but her dress remained intact despite the intense heat.
"This little girl is only halfway through the process, so you still have to wait some time to take her away.
Although Tian Yan did not choose you as his master, he will still fight by your side in the future, and you can use his flame to help you in various matters, including alchemy."
"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at Yan Huo.
"Since the process is still long, I will return to the eastern forest to continue my seclusion."

"Stay here, then." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately left the cave, leaving Huo Diqiu and Yan Huo behind.

"I see." Huo Diqiu nodded in understanding.
"Thank you, old man.
I know that you should have been able to reincarnate a long time ago, but you deliberately delayed it to accompany my brother."
"Hahaha." Yan Huo laughed as he walked out.
"Your brother is like my biological son, so I can’t leave him alone, especially since those people will force him to submit to them if I leave first.
