paragraphs: "No." Leng Xueyan shook her head in response. "Then, who met me in my dream?"
"No one."
Leng Xueyan raised an eyebrow in disbelief at him, prompting Zhang Xiaolong [3] to explain the truth to her. "When did you use your dream technique on me?"
"In the Phoenix Realm."
Leng Xueyan remembered that she did go to the Phoenix Realm back then, but she didn’t remember meeting Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially since she erased their encounter from her memories.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] had no intention of bringing up the incident again. "My other clone once told you that I am the current leader of the Phoenix Race, right? Back then, I was with Feng Zhen and Feng Xueying, but you didn’t notice my presence because I used my invisibility, and I used my technique on you without your knowledge."
"Why did you do that to me?" Leng Xueyan asked him. "We didn’t even know each other then, so you shouldn’t have a reason to do that to me."

"This." Leng Xueyan’s eyes widened as Zhang Xiaolong [3] summoned the Earth Flame. "Before I met you, I had already met Yuan Tianling, and she accompanied me while I was in the process of merging with this flame. She explained many things about you, especially your rude attitude toward her. Since she was my woman, I used my dream ability on you. However, I didn’t expect that Tian Jingxuan would send her and the others to the Frozen Moon Realm before you returned to this realm, so you didn’t meet each other at that time."
"Yuan Tianling, huh." Leng Xueyan muttered under her breath. "You are right; I have always treated them harshly, and I will threaten to punish them severely if they fail to obtain the Earth Flame."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] dispelled the Earth Flame and gave Leng Xueyan a kiss, causing her to be stunned. Even though he had told her that he and the one she met in the Grand Royal Realm were clones, she felt weird about kissing them. "Forget the past, and I will send you to my private quarters. For now, I want you to focus on your training, or you won’t be ready when I take you to the Paradise Realm."
"But—"
Crack

Leng Xueyan turned toward the door and saw Leng Hua walking in. She wanted to break away from Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s embrace, but he hugged her tighter and spoke to her father. "Even though Xueyan is my woman, I will never spare you for your intention to kill me. Instead, you should be grateful that I still let you live because I have never forgiven my enemies before, and I even killed my blood brother with my own hands. I will bring her into seclusion, so I leave all the affairs of this clan to you and your son."
"Yes, Master." After the previous fight, Leng Hua finally realized the horror of Zhang Xiaolong [3], and he truly regretted his decision back then, which put him in such a situation.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then opened the portal to the Yin-Yang Space. "Get in and join the others to train."
"Uhm." Leng Xueyan nodded slightly and disappeared into the portal.
A while later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] arrived at the natural races’ residence, bringing Jin Zhongli with him, making Qian Chaoying really uncomfortable with the old man’s presence.

At first, Zhang Xiaolong [3] wanted to send Sima Huiqing into the Yin-Yang Space to replace one of his prisoners, but he changed his mind and ordered her to help Gu Changsheng protect the other clans, especially since they were training in his training space. "I can understand your discomfort, but I brought him here specifically to train you all."
Qian Chaoying and the leaders naturally knew Jin Zhongli’s gravity techniques, but the old man had never used them anywhere else, apart from the punishing ground.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] spoke to them again. "Since you guys already know about his techniques, I don’t need to waste my time explaining them in too much detail. I’ll just tell you that the gravity in the Paradise Realm is much heavier than his; thus, I want you all to adapt to that weight before I take you all to that realm in the future."
"Are you really going to take us to the Paradise Realm, kid?" Zhu Ru, the leader of the gnome race, asked him.

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at them. "I can’t confirm our departure yet, especially since my cultivation is still far from the peak of mortal cultivation. However, my second clone is already on his way to the Paradise Realm and will arrive there in about two months, and I can go there whenever I want after that. Therefore, I want all of you to forget about unimportant matters and focus on training under Old Man Jin; otherwise, I will leave you here if you are still not ready when I am ready to move there."
"Let’s start our training, then!" All of them immediately agreed with Jing Shenlin, and Jin Zhongli asked them to take him to a much bigger place before starting to train them.
Qian Li wanted to ask Zhang Xiaolong [3] about Ren Xiyi, but Qian Chaoying immediately pulled him away with the others.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] himself rushed to the Life Pond, where he cultivated at the bottom again to improve his water element, elemental law, and body technique.

Inside the training space, Leng Xueyan was confused when she saw Shangguan Yan and the others lying prone in the center area, struggling to move. However, the presence of Zhang Fei’s other two clones a short distance away convinced her that he did indeed have multiple clones.

Leng Xueyan didn’t join Shangguan Yan and the others immediately; instead, she checked both mansions but found no one in either of them. She then went to the pavilion to check out the inside, as it piqued her interest.

In the main garden, Leng Xueyan caught sight of Zhang Fei [5], who was still focused on dual-soul cultivating with Tang Ying and Jia Yuyan. She chose not to disturb them and instead looked around the pavilion area, which left her feeling both amazed and confused. ’Where did he get all this from? No wonder he can do so much in my realm, even though his cultivation is still far below ours, and all his actions happen so fast. He even succeeded in enslaving my father, my uncle, and the other leaders.’
When she arrived in front of a room, Leng Xueyan heard the sound of a woman moaning, and she immediately realized that the owner was Shangguan Miyuan, who was having sex with Yuan Hao.
Leng Xueyan hurriedly left the area until she arrived at the Celestial Spring Pool, where she crouched by the edge and dipped her hand in.

"Hmm? The water in this pool is different from water everywhere else, and it’s rich in Yin and Yang essences." Leng Xueyan looked at the formation in one corner. "It must be because of that formation! Where did he get such a formation? Not even Duanmu Luolan could create it!"

"Ahh!" Leng Xueyan screamed loudly as something pulled her away from that place, but she immediately realized that it was Zhang Fei [5] who pulled her and brought her to their side. "What are you doing?"
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed in response, sat Leng Xueyan on his lap, and kissed her.
"You—" Leng Xueyan immediately suppressed her anger. "Who are you?"
"Guess who?" Zhang Fei [5]’s smirk made Leng Xueyan immediately realize it. "That’s right, I was the one in the Grand Royal Realm before."

"Tch! You’re confusing me!" Leng Xueyan lightly punched his chest, but she felt more comfortable than when she was with Zhang Xiaolong [3] before, mainly because they had spent quite a lot of time together in the Grand Royal Realm. "Why did you stop dual-soul cultivating with them?"
Zhang Fei [5] caressed her cheeks. "Since you’re here, and your soul cultivation level isn’t as high as ours, I’ll teach you better soul techniques to increase your soul power."
"Hmm?" Leng Xueyan momentarily raised her eyebrows. "Please teach me."

Zhang Fei [5] moved Leng Xueyan to the side, imparted his soul technique to her, and asked her to learn it first. On the other hand, Tang Ying and Jia Yuyan decided to leave them and go to the pool, especially since they had been dual-soul cultivating with him for several days non-stop.

After Leng Xueyan understood the technique enough, Zhang Fei [5] asked her to release her soul and guided her to create the black lotus first. Once she succeeded in creating it, they immediately began their dual-soul cultivation.
"How did it go? Is Old Jin willing to help us?" Qing Huang asked Tian Jingxuan, who had just arrived in his seclusion room.

Tian Jingxuan became furious again upon hearing that. "That dying old bastard isn’t willing to help us, and I can’t force him because Ancestor Junfeng has already absolved him of all his debts to my clan. Therefore, we can only fight on our own now, but we can’t possibly attack him now, especially since he’s already taken Shangguan Yan and the others away with him. I don’t know where he’s taken them or when they’ll return, so we can only wait while we recover."

"I see." Qing Huang nodded in understanding. "Moreover, Old Shi’s injuries are quite severe, and he won’t be able to recover any time soon, so we have no other choice but to wait for him to recover. However, we can’t just sit around and wait for them, and we have to start doing something."
"Hmm?" Tian Jingxuan frowned at Qing Huang. "What’s your idea?"
"The Ning Clan."
"Are you thinking about attacking them?"

Qing Huang nodded at Tian Jingxuan. "The Ning Clan has no relationship with that little bastard, so I’m sure he won’t protect them. Therefore, we should start with them, and the two of us will be enough to suppress Ning Yuwen."

"You’re right." Tian Jingxuan agreed, but he remembered Serpentera appearing when the fight was almost over to stop Ju Xing. "Forget that little bastard for now and focus on your recovery. We’ll move against the Ning Clan once you and Old Shi have recovered."

"All right." After Tian Jingxuan left, Qing Huang immediately contacted several people and ordered them to go to the Ning Clan. However, he didn’t order them to do anything and simply kept an eye on the clan for the time being.

On the top floor of the Star Tower, Hua Mei’er was frustrated watching Zhang Fei and his group go through their challenges, especially since those challenges were becoming more and more meaningless to them. The number of cultivators who had reached the Divine Ascension Realm was simply too high, and they became even stronger after creating their domains. "Master! That hateful brat deliberately took advantage of you! If you continue to let them act like this, they will loot all the treasures in this tower, and you will face big problems with the higher-ups!"

"Master, I agree with Mei’er this time." Sima Yun spoke. "We’ve been in this tower for thousands of years, and no one has ever reached the top, which makes the treasures here accumulate a lot because they keep adding to them. If Zhang Fei and the others plunder those treasures, the higher-ups will be furious and come down here, and they will punish us all. Moreover, he has already sent one of his clones to the Paradise Realm, so I think you should stop them and let them look for other treasures after they have ascended there."
"Hehe." Helian Xun’er chuckled as she listened to them. "Honestly, I still want to help Zhang Fei, but I have to agree with them, Master."
"Hey, Xun’er! Are you in love with Zhang Fei? Otherwise, you wouldn’t support and help him continuously, right?" Hua Mei’er suddenly asked, her gaze filled with suspicion.

"Hmm?" Helian Xun’er tilted her head at Hua Mei’er. "Is it wrong if I fall in love with Zhang Fei? He is a special existence with three identities, and his talent surpasses many people, including us. You won’t be able to find a man like him in the Paradise Realm; even the so-called geniuses like Sheng Linghan and Yuan Manqiu can’t compare to him. Thus, it’s natural that I’m attracted to and fall in love with him, right?"
Hua Mei’er didn’t refute Helian Xun’er, but she still couldn’t forget her annoyance with Zhang Fei, especially after he used his demon charm on her back then, which made her truly hate him.

"The only one who can match Zhang Fei’s talent is Luo Yunxiao, and they would make a terrible couple if they truly married in the future." Helian Xun’er nodded in agreement with Sima Yun. "So, what is your decision, Master?"

"Let them be." The three disciples frowned at Wan Jiang directly. "Even though I let them do as they please, most of Zhang Fei’s wives can’t continue on the fifth floor with their current cultivation, so they should stop after they complete all the challenges on that floor. Moreover, he already said he will stop and take them into seclusion, and they definitely won’t be coming out anytime soon. Therefore, we don’t need to worry too much about those treasures, and we have time to increase their number while they are in seclusion."
The three of them nodded in agreement with Wan Jiang before Hua Mei’er asked him, "When will he hand Qi Lai over to you, Master? Have you informed the higher-ups that we’ve captured him?"

"Not yet." Wan Jiang replied with a shake of his head. "I’ll tell them after Zhang Fei hands Qi Lai over to me, but I can’t be sure when he will do so, especially since he wants to milk his Celestial Qi for his supplies."

"Three years is the fastest, and five years is the longest."
"That fast?" Sima Yun and Hua Mei’er exclaimed in surprise.

"Why are you two so surprised?" Helian Xun’er responded by shaking her head. "Zhang Fei was able to reach the Seven Divine Realms in just three years by relying solely on ordinary Qi, remember? Moreover, Celestial Qi is several times higher than Divine Qi, and he has so many women by his side, some of whom have reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm. Just imagine, if all those women had transformed their Qi into Celestial Qi, I’m sure no one would be able to match his cultivation speed, including Luo Yunxiao."

Wan Jiang let out a soft sigh. "I don’t know if my calculations are correct, but we’ll know the result once they emerge from their seclusion. I hope Zhang Fei has already reached that stage by the time they emerge, so they won’t have to challenge this tower anymore and go straight to the Paradise Realm."
"Hahaha!" Sima Yun suddenly laughed out loud. "Master, you—Argh! My head! You broke my head, Master!"
Wan Jiang glared at him. "Shut your mouth and don’t spit out nonsense."
"Hahaha." Helian Xun’er and Hua Mei’er were delighted to see Sima Yun in pain, and they immediately left the two men.
Ten days passed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1049: Ma Kuangyu’s True Identity
paragraphs: After everyone returned to the training space, Zhang Fei left the Star Tower and went to the Sovereign Heaven Realm. However, he didn’t linger there for long and joined the others straightaway.

Most of them decided to go straight back to the portable mansion and cloud mansion, especially since they had previously spent a lot of time at the Star Tower taking on all the challenges from floors one to four. Even senior cultivators like Lin Jingxia, Xia Tian, and the others felt tired from all the challenges.

Zhang Fei asked Wei Xiaoya, Qian Shuang, Shangguan Yan, Duanmu Luolan, Jia Yuyan, and Leng Xueyan to temporarily stop their training. Since they had never met his other wives and family members before, he wanted them to spend some time together to get to know each other.

Zhang Fei introduced them to his grandmother first, and Zhang Chen’s warm response caused the six women to feel relieved and strange at the same time. After all, she was much younger than them, but she was their senior based on their relationship status with her grandson.
Zhang Chen always supported Zhang Fei’s decision in choosing new wives, as he has never made a mistake in choosing them with the help of his demon eyes.
"Uncle." Wei Xiaoya called out to Hun Di with an embarrassed expression.
Hun Di nodded slightly before rubbing Wei Xiaoya’s head. "All these years, I’ve always worried that you’ll live a lonely life when you’re old, but you’re Fei’er’s wife now, so I can feel relieved."
"Haha." Wei Xiaoya laughed awkwardly, especially since she still couldn’t fully accept Zhang Fei, even though they were now husband and wife.
"Hey, Xiaoya! Show us your true form!" Yan Yinqing suddenly spoke.
Jing Qiuyue nodded her head slightly. "Please don’t hide your true form from us anymore, Xiaoya."
"Come on, Xiaoya!" Lin Moxian shouted at her as he hugged his wife, Xi Hongyan.
Although he didn’t say anything, Qiao Liangren also looked at Wei Xiaoya curiously, as did Yue Qinhua, who was in his embrace.
Wei Xiaoya immediately returned to her true form, which amazed them. "Are you all satisfied now?"

"Haha." Yan Yinqing laughed and embraced her. "Hey! You’re already a wife now, so you should stop using your disguise. Moreover, no man will dare to approach you with my possessive junior brother around, and he will beat them up if they dare to do that."

Wei Xiaoya stole a glance at Zhang Fei, who was chatting with Zhang Chen and the others. She then nodded to Yan Yinqing. "Sigh, you are right, Yinqing. Uncle, your senior sister is inside the pavilion now, but she is not willing to come out and prefers to dual-soul cultivate with one of Zhang Fei’s clones."
Upon hearing that, Jing Qiuyue and Yan Yinqing immediately left them and went to the pavilion to meet Tang Ying, especially since the two of them rarely saw her.

"My senior sister has always been like that because she harbors ambitions to reach the peak of the soul cultivation path, so I won’t disturb her for now, and she will come to me by herself soon." Hun Di briefly looked at Zhang Fei and the others. "Go there and join them, Xiaoya. I will rest for a few days before starting my training."
"Yes, uncle."
After Wei Xiaoya joined Zhang Fei and the others, Hun Di led his two disciples and their wives to the portable mansion, and they decided to focus on resting to refresh their bodies and minds.

Zhang Chen didn’t stay with them for long, and she led the others back to the portable mansion to rest. After that, Zhang Fei took all his women back to the pavilion, where they spent time together to deepen the relationship between them.
However, Liu Hua and the other women insisted that Zhang Fei leave, primarily because they wanted to have a private conversation among themselves, making him feel helpless by their behaviors.

Zhang Fei decided to go to the Sealed World Pearl to check a few things, but he was disappointed because his soul power was still not strong enough to speed up the flow of time within it much faster, and the barrier that sealed the five areas was still not open, even though his soul level had already reached the Venerate Soul level.

Then, Zhang Fei went straight to the Yin-Yang Space to check the amount of Qi in the glass tube. As usual, he woke the prisoners to nourish their bodies and restore their Qi; otherwise, they would die from Qi depletion, especially since the chains continuously absorbed and sent their Qi into the glass tube.

Zhang Fei never touched any of his female prisoners, even though one of his clones had dual cultivated with some of them before, such as Qin Liangyu, Lei Huiyin, and Huang Bingyun, who were members of the destroyed Huang Clan from the Xianjin Realm.
Shi Wuxian and Shang Xishun had long resigned themselves to their fate, but they were jealous of Shang Ziyuan, especially since Zhang Fei did not imprison her in a dream like them.

The four female mythical beasts, Long Yingwu, Long Tianzhu, Wang Qingyi, and Dai Yanxu, also felt helpless about their situation. They couldn’t even remember how long Zhang Fei had imprisoned them, especially since the flow of time in the dream world differed from the real world.

Among the prisoners, Leng Xiulan and Cao Feihong still showed their anger toward Zhang Fei. He captured the first woman in the Grand Royal Realm and the last woman in the Sovereign Heaven Realm after the battle some time ago.

Zhang Fei originally wanted to imprison the Qiang Emperor and his three wives for a while longer, but he changed his mind and sent them back to the Grand Royal Realm, delighting the people of the Qian Kingdom with their return.
Zhang Fei stood in front of the glass tube while thinking. ’Do you think the Qi in this tube is enough for me to break through several minor levels, Mei?’

[I believe that with the Qi in this tube, you can only break through two or three minor stages, Master. After breaking into the Seven Divine Realms, you need a lot of Qi to break through to the next minor stage, and it will keep increasing with each minor stage; However, I’m sure that your cultivation will accelerate once you transform the divine qi in the training space into celestial qi. Additionally, you can teach these female prisoners how to convert their qi as well, and I’m sure your stock will be even more abundant, especially since the amount of their yin qi will be much greater.]

Zhang Fei nodded in agreement and seriously thought about it. He eventually decided to take the eleven female prisoners to the training space, especially since he couldn’t break through yet because his second clone was on his way to the Paradise Realm. Moreover, the flow of time there is faster than in the Yin-Yang space, so they can transform their divine qi into the celestial qi faster by using Qi Lai’s celestial qi.

These female prisoners were shocked when Zhang Fei moved them to the training space, leaving them wondering about his real purpose. He then took them to the cloud mansion, especially since he locked Qi Lai there.
"Hmm?" Qi Lai raised an eyebrow as soon as they entered the room. "What are you going to do? Why did you bring them here?"

"Sit." The female prisoners immediately sat on the floor, and Zhang Fei imparted the Celestial Tempering Cycle method to them, which shocked them. Some of them wanted to refuse, but they had no other choice except to follow his orders, especially since their soul replicas had already merged with his soul.
Zhang Fei then guided them to master it more easily, making Qi Lai realize his goal. ’This crazy kid! They won’t be able to cultivate if the Qi in their bodies turns into the celestial qi.’
A few minutes later, Cao Feihong and the others had started to learn that method. Qi Lai immediately asked Zhang Fei. "Are you crazy, kid? Why did you force them to do that?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei chuckled in response. "They aren’t my women, but my prisoners, so I want to use them as guinea pigs. If the results are as I expect, I will be able to reach the Divine Ascension Realm sooner than my initial estimate, and I will move to the Paradise Realm at that time. By the way, I heard from Wan Jiang that you have a relationship with the Nine Nether Demon Race, and I heard they are the fourth strongest demon race after the Celestial, Asura, and Heavenly Fiend."

"How do you know about those demon races? Did Jia Yuyan tell you about them?" Qi Lai’s eyes widened in shock as soon as Nalan Yushu and Ma Kuangyu emerged from Zhang Fei’s tiny soul world, and he could immediately recognize their identities. "Lord... Lord Ma!"

"I see." Ma Kuangyu nodded his head several times. "Back then, I could only guess your identity after Wan Jiang told this kid about you, but I am now certain that you are a member of the Qi Clan, which is a subsidiary of Gongsun Ye’s Gongsun Clan."

Qi Lai broke out in a cold sweat as soon as Ma Kuangyu mentioned that, and his reaction didn’t escape Zhang Fei’s notice. "Who is Gongsun Ye, Old Ma? What exactly is your true identity? Why is this old man so afraid of you?"

"Gongsun Ye was the first to find out that I obtained the cursed item, and he persuaded the others to betray me." Zhang Fei furrowed his brows at Ma Kuangyu’s response. "My real name is Ma Kuangyu, and my Ma clan always acts as the vice leader of the Nirvana Sky Domain, which is ruled by five powerful clans, including the Gongsun Clan. Those traitors were once my comrades, but their greed blinded their eyes and hearts, and they decided to betray me because of it."
"What are the other three clans?" Zhang Fei curiously asked.

Ma Kuangyu immediately explained it to him. "The Han, Qiao, and Liao Clans. However, our clans are not the leaders of our domain, and we are under the leadership of the Spirit Temple. Our true leader is the current leader of the Spirit Temple, Sheng Youhun. Each of the five clans supervises the other ten clans, and the Qi clan is under the Gongsun clan."
"Does that mean the Qi clan was also involved in their betrayal?" Zhang Fei asked this question as he glanced at Qi Lai.

"No." Ma Kuangyu shook his head in response. "Qi Hao is quite powerful, but he’s not powerful enough to participate in the betrayal. Actually, I’ve long suspected something was wrong with the Spirit Temple, but I couldn’t prove anything. I also suspected that Sheng Youhun ordered Gongsun Ye and the others to betray me, but I didn’t know his exact purpose. However, the Qi clan’s relationship with the nine-nethers demon clan made me think that the demon clan had already invaded the temple; otherwise, that clan would have been wiped out long ago ago."
Ma Kuangyu’s words caused Qi Lai to sweat even more, quickly soaking his clothes with his sweat. "Old Ma, it seems your guess was right."

"Yes." Ma Kuangyu released a soft sigh. "Sheng Qingtai established the Spirit Temple to combat the demon race, particularly after the Celestial Demon Race destroyed his Sheng clan. I never expected that one of his descendants would be in cahoots with one of them, and Sheng Youhun’s actions disgraced his ancestor’s reputation."
After saying all that, Ma Kuangyu immediately entered Zhang Fei’s tiny soul world again to calm his emotions, and Nalan Yushu right away followed him.
Qi Lai wiped away his sweat before asking Zhang Fei, "Did... did you meet Lord Ma and the female demon from the soul-devouring demon race in one of those towers, kid?"
"Yeah," Zhang Fei then asked him. "Is the Gongsun clan powerful?"
Qi Lai nodded his head vigorously. "The Gongsun clan is the third strongest after the Spirit Temple and the Ma clan, followed by the Han, Qiao, and Liao clans."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "No wonder Wan Jiang didn’t dare stop Old Ma when he asked me to take him away from the tower; it turned out his status was that high."

Qi Lai shook his head when he heard that. "High? Their status is higher than you can imagine, kid! Even many clans from the other domains don’t want to have problems with the Ma clan, especially since many of their members are truly powerful."

"Yes." Qi Lai responded with a light nod. Sometimes later, all the female prisoners had finished learning the method, and Zhang Fei ordered them to use Qi Lai’s qi inside the tube at the end of the Yin-Yang Absorbing Shackles to transform their divine qi into celestial qi.

Since the process took quite a long time, Zhang Fei decided to leave them with Qi Lai. He didn’t need to worry about them freeing the old man because they were completely obedient to him, and only he could untie the shackles.

On the other hand, Qi Lai looked at those female prisoners with pity, especially since Zhang Fei used them as guinea pigs. Zhang Fei could only shake his head, especially since he didn’t have such feelings for his senior sister, and Jing Qiuyue remained steadfast in her feelings for Qiao Liangren.
Zhang Fei didn’t bother Tang Ying and Jing Qiuyue; instead, he went to see Tantai Lingyan, who was pensive in front of her room alone. "What are you thinking, Lingyan?"

"Hmm?" Tantai Lingyan looked at Zhang Fei, but she still found it strange to hear him call her by her name directly, even though they had lived together for over a year in the pavilion. "I’m just thinking about the future."
"The future?" Tantai Lingyan nodded at Zhang Fei, who immediately carried her in his arms. "Are you thinking about our future?"
Back then, Tantai Lingyan always felt uncomfortable with Zhang Fei’s shamelessness and intimate actions toward her, but she became used to his presence after living together for so many years.
Tantai Lingyan wrapped her arms around Zhang Fei’s neck and asked him. "What kind of future do we have?"

"What is our future if we are not husband and wife?" Zhang Fei brought Tantai Lingyan into her room and laid her down on the bed. He then crawled on top of her and stared into her eyes, making her heart thump.
"Do you really love me, Fei?" Tantai Lingyan asked with a serious expression.

Zhang Fei smiled and rubbed her cheek. "Lingyan, we’ve lived together for years now, so you should already be clear about my feelings for you, right? All these years, I kept approaching you to convince you, and my senior sister has long agreed for you to become my wife, so I hope you won’t be stubborn anymore and accept me."
’Perhaps it’s time for me to move forward with my life.’ Tantai Lingyan let out a soft sigh before pulling Zhang Fei’s face closer and kissing him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1050: Meeting Wang Yin Again
paragraphs: Naturally, Zhang Fei was overjoyed that Tantai Lingyan took the initiative to kiss him, and it was their second kiss since their first meeting in the Xianjin Realm. He could have forced a kiss on her over the years, but he never did, waiting for her to be truly ready to accept him.
Zhang Fei rolled next to Tantai Lingyan, warmly embraced her, caressed her back, and slowly led her into a deeper kiss.
Tantai Lingyan hugged Zhang Fei’s head and took the initiative to insert her tongue into his mouth, which was immediately greeted by his tongue and gentle suction.

"Mhm..." Zhang Fei’s kiss and sucking gave Tantai Lingyan a taste of pleasure, and she involuntarily let out a muffled moan. She grabbed his hair, occasionally tugged it, and stuck her tongue out more. "Mhm..."

Despite her eagerness to eat Tantai Lingyan, Zhang Fei was not in a hurry to lead her to the next stage. He didn’t even touch her private parts; he just caressed the back of her head and back while giving her a kiss that got hotter and deeper.

Just like Zhang Fei, Tantai Lingyan was quite an expert at kissing, even though she had only ever been in a relationship with one man in her entire life. She knew perfectly how to follow his rhythm, and the sound of their kissing grew louder, mixing with their muffled moans. Their tongues alternately entered each other’s mouths, exchanging warm saliva.

They kissed long enough that Tantai Lingyan almost ran out of breath, forcing Zhang Fei to separate their lips. Then, he lay on his back and pulled her into his arms, with her head nestled in his broad, muscular chest.
"Fei."
"Yes?"
Tantai Lingyan looked up at Zhang Fei. "I am willing to accept your feelings."

"I’m glad that you are willing to accept me." Zhang Fei spoke as he rubbed her cheeks. "Lingyan, I know my plan is odd, but I plan to marry those who aren’t married to me yet, like Shen Huang, Lian Xiang, and several others. Since you’ve been willing to accept me, I want you to join in the marriage."

Although she wanted to marry Zhang Fei in a normal wedding ceremony, Tantai Lingyan understood their situation. Since she willingly accepted a man with numerous women by his side, she decided to accept his idea. "Alright, I’ll follow your plan. So, when do you want to hold the wedding ceremony with us?"

"I’ll wait for Yuan Tianling to finish merging with the Sky Flame, which is about two weeks away. This way, we’ll have enough time to prepare for my wedding with all of you, and we’ll get married in the Sky Jade Realm." Tantai Lingyan was surprised to hear that Zhang Fei wanted to marry them in that realm. "That realm was my first realm after I became a cultivator, and I obtained many things there, so I will never forget that realm. I always thought there was something hidden there; otherwise, the old fox wouldn’t have used his last strength to move it from the upper realms to the lower realms."

Tantai Lingyan was completely shocked to hear that the ten-tailed fox possessed such power that it could move a realm from the upper realms to the lower realms. "Is that true? What was that realm called in the past?"

"The Heaven Wilderness Realm, and it was once inhabited only by beasts and natural races until humans invaded it." Zhang Fei then recounted to Tantai Lingyan the history of the Sky Jade Realm that he had heard from Zefyr and Oliver back then. "Unfortunately, despite my long search, I still haven’t found any clues. However, I’m confident that I will successfully uncover its secrets once I manage to gather all the soul fragments of the old fox and become the new ten-tailed fox."

"Fei, I’ve heard from others that you need the heart of Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing to evolve into a ten-tailed fox. Is that true?" Zhang Fei nodded to Tantai Lingyan. "They’re both at the Sovereign Heaven Realm, right? Why don’t you capture them and imprison them in your Yin-Yang Space? That way, you can refine their Qi for your cultivation, and you can take their hearts when you’re ready to evolve. If you can’t do it yourself, you can ask Tian Kui or Serpentera to help you, right?"

"I had planned to capture them, but I was waiting for them to complete their Dao test first." Tantai Lingnya was confused by Zhang Fei’s decision regarding the two foxes. "It’s difficult for me to explain, but I felt a significant change within myself after successfully comprehending the Dao, which influenced my decision. After we come out of our seclusion, I will take you all away to the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and you can try to comprehend the dao before we go to the Paradise Realm, especially since that place is the most perfect for it."

As an experienced cultivator, Tantai Lingyan naturally knew that the Dao was the fundamental law of existence and the path of cultivation, and she was truly interested in comprehending it. "Why don’t you take us all there now? Are you afraid that Tian Jingxuan and the others will attack us? Even though they are strong, some of us are no less powerful than them, right? If I think about it, Feng Yichen is the strongest among us, and second is Huli Zhishen, followed by the other mythical beasts."

"You’re wrong about that." Zhang Fei shook his head. "I’m not worried about Tian Jingxuan and those two old men, and I just feel that it would be a waste of time if I took you all there now, especially since some people need tens or even thousands of years to comprehend the Dao. Even those two foxes have not yet succeeded in comprehending the Dao, despite their long efforts to do so. Therefore, I’m thinking of taking you guys there after our cultivation reaches the peak, and we’ll depart for the Paradise Realm after you guys have successfully comprehended the Dao."
Tantai Lingyan looked at him suspiciously. "Are you thinking of leaving the few of us in the Sovereign Heaven Realm if we haven’t managed to understand it?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei didn’t try to hide it from her. "According to my intuition, comprehending the Dao is the key to sustaining our lives in the Paradise Realm, especially since most of the powerful cultivators there have already comprehended it. Therefore, I will first bring those who manage to comprehend it, and I will leave those who have difficulty to do so. Naturally, I will never abandon them because they’re my women, and I’ll pick them up after they succeed."

"I think you’re right about that, but you should explain it clearly to them to prevent misunderstandings." Tantai Lingyan then moved on top of Zhang Fei, placed her arms behind his neck, and briefly kissed him. "Do you want to do it with me now?"
"At first, I thought about doing it with you now, but I changed my mind." Zhang Fei then explained to her about his idea, making a beautiful smile spread across her face. "Do you like my idea?"
Tantai Lingyan nodded in response. "I like it very much! Although it won’t change my status as a married woman, I really hope I can do it so I won’t have any regrets in my life."
"Haha." Zhang Fei cupped her face. "I will never let any regrets remain in your heart; instead, I will fill your heart with much happiness after we get married."

Tantai Lingyan smiled even wider. "I’ve lived here for several years and witnessed many things about you, so I believe that you will make me happy. By the way, please don’t tell my daughter about my decision for now; I would prefer her to learn about it on our wedding day, okay? Otherwise, she will disturb and tease me every day."

"As you wish, my Lingyan." Zhang Fei then touched Tantai Lingyan’s forehead and shared several techniques with her, shocking her. "I obtained the Indestructible Vajra Immortal Body and the Lotus Vanishing Step Technique during the test in the Sovereign Heaven Realm. Actually, we can only choose one technique, but I read and memorized them all. I have already shared the body technique with Xian Xianqin, Yun Xinyue, Bai Tian’er, and Xin Xianzi, but they haven’t had the time to learn it before. After this, I will share it with Liu Qingyu and the others, so all of you will become even stronger in physical matters."

"I see." Tantai Lingyan immediately shifted from Zhang Fei’s body and sat cross-legged on the bed. "In that case, I’ll learn these two now, and you have to go to the others to teach them those techniques."
Zhang Fei nodded and left Tantai Lingyan’s room directly, sharing all the techniques he had acquired in the Sovereign Heaven Realm with them all, causing Shangguan Yan to shake her head helplessly.

After all, Shangguan Yan was the one guarding the place, and she allowed Zhang Fei to read all the techniques. However, she never expected that he would remember them all, allowing him to share them with all his women.
After they obtained all the techniques, Liu Qingyu and the others immediately returned to their respective rooms, where they tried to study them first.
[The clone illusion steps have advanced to level seven.]
[The nine cloud steps have advanced to level six.]
The appearance of the two notifications made Zhang Fei smile, especially since he had waited quite a long time for it, which also ended his training with gravity level five.

Zhang Fei suddenly remembered Tian Kui’s story about Wang Yin’s change; he decided to visit her in the Demon Purgatory Realm and pick up some of his clones’ partners who were working hard to increase their demon rank there, such as the Amaris Twins and several others. However, he didn’t go there himself, and he went there using his first clone.

Zhang Fei himself did not relax, and he went to the alchemist room to concoct pills. He had long been a venerable rank alchemist, but he had neglected his alchemy for quite some time, and he wanted to reach the god rank before going to the Paradise Realm.

On the other hand, the rest of his clones were doing other things. Zhang Fei [4] went to the blacksmithing area to forge equipment with the materials he obtained from the Sovereign Heaven Realm. Zhang Fei [5] studied one of the remaining eight immortal-grade techniques.

"Fei!" As soon as Zhang Fei [1] entered his palace, Wang Yin screamed and ran toward him. She then jumped to hug him and gave him a kiss, making him sigh helplessly. "Hehe! You’ve finally returned to me after more than a year! By the way, the Amaris Twins are already emperor-rank demons, and several others have also experienced significant increases in their demon rank."

’What exactly is that mysterious woman’s goal in making Wang Yin like this? Is she intending to use her to monitor me? She should know that we don’t have that kind of relationship, so she shouldn’t have done this to her.’ Zhang Fei [1] then spoke to her. "I’m sorry, Yin’er.
